Functional Force-Aware Retargeting from Virtual Human Demos to Soft Robot Policies

Abstract (English): We introduce SoftAct, a framework for teaching soft robot hands to perform human-like manipulation skills by explicitly reasoning about contact forces. Leveraging immersive virtual reality, our system captures rich human demonstrations, including hand kinematics, object motion, dense contact patches, and detailed contact force information. Unlike conventional approaches that retarget human joint trajectories, SoftAct employs a two-stage, force-aware retargeting algorithm. The first stage attributes demonstrated contact forces to individual human fingers and allocates robot fingers proportionally, establishing a force-balanced mapping between human and robot hands. The second stage performs online retargeting by combining baseline end-effector pose tracking with geodesic-weighted contact refinements, using contact geometry and force magnitude to adjust robot fingertip targets in real time. This formulation enables soft robotic hands to reproduce the functional intent of human demonstrations while naturally accommodating extreme embodiment mismatch and nonlinear compliance. We evaluate SoftAct on a suite of contact-rich manipulation tasks using a custom non-anthropomorphic pneumatic soft robot hand. SoftAct's controller reduces fingertip trajectory tracking RMSE by up to 55 percent and reduces tracking variance by up to 69 percent compared to kinematic and learning-based baselines. At the policy level, SoftAct achieves consistently higher success in zero-shot real-world deployment and in simulation. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling contact geometry and force distribution is essential for effective skill transfer to soft robotic hands, and cannot be recovered through kinematic imitation alone. Project videos and additional details are available at https://soft-act.github.io/.

摘要（中文）: 我们提出了SoftAct框架，旨在通过显式推理接触力来教授软体机器人手执行类人操作技能。该框架利用沉浸式虚拟现实技术，捕捉丰富的人类示范数据，包括手部运动学、物体运动、密集接触斑块及详细的接触力信息。与传统重定向人类关节轨迹的方法不同，SoftAct采用两阶段力感知重定向算法：第一阶段将示范的接触力归因于各个人类手指，并按比例分配至机器人手指，从而建立人手机械臂间的力平衡映射；第二阶段通过结合基线末端执行器姿态跟踪与测地加权接触优化进行在线重定向，利用接触几何和力幅值实时调整机器人指尖目标位置。这种设计使软体机器人手能够复现人类示范的功能意图，同时自然适应极端形态差异和非线性柔顺性。我们在定制非拟人气动软体机器人手上，通过一系列接触密集型操作任务对SoftAct进行评估。相比运动学及基于学习的基线方法，SoftAct控制器将指尖轨迹跟踪均方根误差降低最高达55%，跟踪方差减少最高达69%。在策略层面，SoftAct在零样本真实世界部署和仿真中均实现了更高的成功率。这些结果表明，显式建模接触几何与力分布对于向软体机器人手的有效技能迁移至关重要，仅通过运动学模仿无法实现同等效果。项目视频及更多细节详见https://soft-act.github.io/。

TLDR: SoftAct introduces a force-aware retargeting method using VR human demonstrations to teach contact-rich manipulation skills to non-anthropomorphic soft robot hands, outperforming kinematic baselines.

简要说明: SoftAct 提出了一种基于力感知的示教重定向方法，利用VR人类演示来教非拟人化软体机器人手完成接触丰富的操作任务，性能优于运动学基线。

Authors: Uksang Yoo, Mengjia Zhu, Evan Pezent, Jom Preechayasomboon, Jean Oh, Jeffrey Ichnowski, Amir Memar, Ben Abbatematteo, Homanga Bharadhwaj, Ashish Deshpande, Harsha Prahlad

Collaborative Task and Path Planning for Heterogeneous Robotic Teams using Multi-Agent PPO

Abstract (English): Efficient robotic extraterrestrial exploration requires robots with diverse capabilities, ranging from scientific measurement tools to advanced locomotion. A robotic team enables the distribution of tasks over multiple specialized subsystems, each providing specific expertise to complete the mission. The central challenge lies in efficiently coordinating the team to maximize utilization and the extraction of scientific value. Classical planning algorithms scale poorly with problem size, leading to long planning cycles and high inference costs due to the combinatorial growth of possible robot-target allocations and possible trajectories. Learning-based methods are a viable alternative that move the scaling concern from runtime to training time, setting a critical step towards achieving real-time planning. In this work, we present a collaborative planning strategy based on Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) to coordinate a team of heterogeneous robots to solve a complex target allocation and scheduling problem. We benchmark our approach against single-objective optimal solutions obtained through exhaustive search and evaluate its ability to perform online replanning in the context of a planetary exploration scenario.

摘要（中文）: 高效的外星机器人探索需要具备多样能力的机器人，涵盖从科学测量工具到先进运动系统在内的多种功能。机器人团队能够将任务分配至多个专业化子系统，每个子系统凭借其特定专长协同完成使命。核心挑战在于如何高效协调团队运作，以最大化资源利用率和科学价值产出。经典规划算法在问题规模扩大时性能急剧下降，由于机器人目标分配方案与可行轨迹的组合式增长，导致规划周期过长且推理成本高昂。基于学习的方法是一种可行的替代方案，它将规模扩展的压力从运行时转移至训练阶段，为实现实时规划迈出了关键一步。本研究提出了一种基于多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）的协同规划策略，用于协调异构机器人团队解决复杂的目标分配与调度问题。我们通过穷举搜索获得的单目标最优解对本方法进行基准测试，并在行星探索场景中评估其在线重规划能力。

TLDR: This paper presents a Multi-Agent PPO (MAPPO) based collaborative planning strategy for coordinating heterogeneous robot teams in planetary exploration, benchmarking it against optimal solutions and evaluating online replanning.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）的协作规划策略，用于协调行星探索任务中的异构机器人团队，并与穷举搜索的最优解进行了基准测试，评估了其在线重规划能力。

Authors: Matthias Rubio, Julia Richter, Hendrik Kolvenbach, Marco Hutter

SMASH: Mastering Scalable Whole-Body Skills for Humanoid Ping-Pong with Egocentric Vision

Abstract (English): Existing humanoid table tennis systems remain limited by their reliance on external sensing and their inability to achieve agile whole-body coordination for precise task execution. These limitations stem from two core challenges: achieving low-latency and robust onboard egocentric perception under fast robot motion, and obtaining sufficiently diverse task-aligned strike motions for learning precise yet natural whole-body behaviors. In this work, we present \methodname, a modular system for agile humanoid table tennis that unifies scalable whole-body skill learning with onboard egocentric perception, eliminating the need for external cameras during deployment. Our work advances prior humanoid table-tennis systems in three key aspects. First, we achieve agile and precise ball interaction with tightly coordinated whole-body control, rather than relying on decoupled upper- and lower-body behaviors. This enables the system to exhibit diverse strike motions, including explosive whole-body smashes and low crouching shots. Second, by augmenting and diversifying strike motions with a generative model, our framework benefits from scalable motion priors and produces natural, robust striking behaviors across a wide workspace. Third, to the best of our knowledge, we demonstrate the first humanoid table-tennis system capable of consecutive strikes using onboard sensing alone, despite the challenges of low-latency perception, ego-motion-induced instability, and limited field of view. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate stable and precise ball exchanges under high-speed conditions, validating scalable, perception-driven whole-body skill learning for dynamic humanoid interaction tasks.

摘要（中文）: 现有仿人形机器人乒乓球系统仍受限于对外部感知的依赖，且无法为实现精确任务执行而达成灵巧的全身协调。这些局限源于两大核心挑战：在快速机器人运动下实现低延迟、鲁棒的机载自我中心感知，以及获取足够多样化且任务对齐的击球动作，以学习精确而自然的全身行为。本文提出\methodname，一个用于敏捷仿人形乒乓球运动的模块化系统。该系统将可扩展的全身技能学习与机载自我中心感知相统一，从而在部署时无需依赖外部摄像头。我们的研究在以下三个关键方面推进了现有仿人形乒乓球系统：首先，通过高度协调的全身控制而非解耦的上半身与下半身行为，实现了敏捷精准的击球交互。这使得系统能够展现多样化的击球动作，包括爆发性全身扣杀和低位蹲姿击球。其次，通过生成模型增强并丰富击球动作多样性，我们的框架从可扩展的运动先验中受益，能在广阔工作空间内产生自然且鲁棒的击球行为。最后，据我们所知，我们首次实现了仅依赖机载感知即可完成连续击球的仿人形乒乓球系统，克服了低延迟感知、自我运动引发的不稳定性及有限视野等挑战。大量真实世界实验表明，系统能在高速条件下实现稳定精准的连续对打，验证了可扩展的感知驱动全身技能学习在动态仿人形交互任务中的有效性。

TLDR: This paper presents SMASH, a system for humanoid table tennis that combines scalable whole-body skill learning with onboard egocentric vision, achieving agile, precise ball control and consecutive strikes without external sensing.

简要说明: 本研究提出了SMASH系统，它将可扩展的全身技能学习与机载自我中心视觉相结合，用于人形机器人乒乓球，实现了无需外部传感器的高敏捷性、精确击球和连续对打。

Authors: Junli Ren, Yinghui Li, Kai Zhang, Penglin Fu, Haoran Jiang, Yixuan Pan, Guangjun Zeng, Tao Huang, Weizhong Guo, Peng Lu, Tianyu Li, Jingbo Wang, Li Chen, Hongyang Li, Ping Luo

Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation under Distribution Shift with Bounded Extremum Seeking

Abstract (English): Reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in robotic manipulation, but learned policies often degrade in performance when test conditions differ from the training distribution. This limitation is especially important in contact-rich tasks such as pushing and pick-and-place, where changes in goals, contact conditions, or robot dynamics can drive the system out-of-distribution at inference time. In this paper, we investigate a hybrid controller that combines reinforcement learning with bounded extremum seeking to improve robustness under such conditions. In the proposed approach, deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) policies are trained under standard conditions on the robotic pushing and pick-and-place tasks, and are then combined with bounded ES during deployment. The RL policy provides fast manipulation behavior, while bounded ES ensures robustness of the overall controller to time variations when operating conditions depart from those seen during training. The resulting controller is evaluated under several out-of-distribution settings, including time-varying goals and spatially varying friction patches.

摘要（中文）: 强化学习在机器人操控任务中表现出优异性能，但测试条件与训练分布存在差异时，学习所得策略往往会出现性能退化。这一局限在接触密集型任务中尤为突出，例如物体推送和抓放操作——目标条件、接触状态或机器人动力学的变化都可能在推理阶段使系统脱离训练分布。本文研究了一种混合控制器，将强化学习与有界极值搜索相结合，以提升此类条件下的鲁棒性。该方法在标准条件下通过深度确定性策略梯度（DDPG）算法训练机器人推送和抓放任务策略，并在部署阶段与有界极值搜索结合使用。强化学习策略提供快速操控行为，而有界极值搜索则确保当操作条件偏离训练场景时，整体控制器对时变因素保持鲁棒性。研究通过在多种非训练分布场景下的测试评估该控制器性能，包括时变目标与空间摩擦分布变化等工况。

TLDR: This paper introduces a hybrid controller that combines deep reinforcement learning (DDPG) with bounded extremum seeking to improve robustness in robotic manipulation tasks like pushing and pick-and-place under distribution shifts, such as varying goals and friction.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种混合控制器，结合深度强化学习（DDPG）和有界极值搜索，以提高在推和抓放等机器人操作任务中对分布偏移（如目标变化和摩擦变化）的鲁棒性。

Authors: Shaifalee Saxena, Rafael Fierro, Alexander Scheinker

BAT: Balancing Agility and Stability via Online Policy Switching for Long-Horizon Whole-Body Humanoid Control

Abstract (English): Despite recent advances in control, reinforcement learning, and imitation learning, developing a unified framework that can achieve agile, precise, and robust whole-body behaviors, particularly in long-horizon tasks, remains challenging. Existing approaches typically follow two paradigms: coupled whole-body policies for global coordination and decoupled policies for modular precision. However, without a systematic method to integrate both, this trade-off between agility, robustness, and precision remains unresolved. In this work, we propose BAT, an online policy-switching framework that dynamically selects between two complementary whole-body RL controllers to balance agility and stability across different motion contexts. Our framework consists of two complementary modules: a switching policy learned via hierarchical RL with an expert guidance from sliding-horizon policy pre-evaluation, and an option-aware VQ-VAE that predicts option preference from discrete motion token sequences for improved generalization. The final decision is obtained via confidence-weighted fusion of two modules. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 humanoid robot demonstrate that BAT enables versatile long-horizon loco-manipulation and outperforms prior methods across diverse tasks.

摘要（中文）: 尽管在控制、强化学习和模仿学习领域近期取得了进展，但构建一个能够实现敏捷、精确且鲁棒全身行为的统一框架——尤其是在长时程任务中——仍然面临挑战。现有方法通常遵循两种范式：用于全局协调的耦合全身策略，以及用于模块化精度的解耦策略。然而，由于缺乏系统性的整合方法，敏捷性、鲁棒性与精度之间的权衡问题仍未得到解决。在本研究中，我们提出了BAT框架，这是一种在线策略切换机制，能够动态选择两个互补的全身强化学习控制器，以在不同运动场景下平衡敏捷性与稳定性。该框架包含两个互补模块：通过分层强化学习结合滑动时域策略预评估专家指导学习的切换策略，以及能够从离散运动序列中预测选项偏好的选项感知VQ-VAE，以提升泛化能力。最终决策通过两个模块的置信度加权融合得出。在宇树G1仿人机器人上进行的大量仿真与实物实验表明，BAT能够实现多样化的长时程移动操作任务，并在多种任务中超越现有方法。

TLDR: Proposes BAT, an online policy-switching framework using hierarchical RL and a VQ-VAE to dynamically select between two whole-body RL controllers, balancing agility and stability for long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks on a humanoid robot.

简要说明: 提出BAT框架，通过分层强化学习和VQ-VAE在线切换两个互补的全身RL控制器，在仿人机器人上实现敏捷与稳定的平衡，以完成长时序的移动操作任务。

Authors: Donghoon Baek, Sang-Hun Kim, Sehoon Ha

How to Train your Tactile Model: Tactile Perception with Multi-fingered Robot Hands

Abstract (English): Rapid deployment of new tactile sensors is essential for scalable robotic manipulation, especially in multi-fingered hands equipped with vision-based tactile sensors. However, current methods for inferring contact properties rely heavily on convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which, while effective on known sensors, require large, sensor-specific datasets. Furthermore, they require retraining for each new sensor due to differences in lens properties, illumination, and sensor wear. Here we introduce TacViT, a novel tactile perception model based on Vision Transformers, designed to generalize on new sensor data. TacViT leverages global self-attention mechanisms to extract robust features from tactile images, enabling accurate contact property inference even on previously unseen sensors. This capability significantly reduces the need for data collection and retraining, accelerating the deployment of new sensors. We evaluate TacViT on sensors for a five-fingered robot hand and demonstrate its superior generalization performance compared to CNNs. Our results highlight TacViTs potential to make tactile sensing more scalable and practical for real-world robotic applications.

摘要（中文）: 新型触觉传感器的快速部署对于可扩展机器人操作至关重要，尤其在配备视觉触觉传感器的多指灵巧手中。然而，当前推断接触特性的方法主要依赖卷积神经网络，尽管在已知传感器上表现良好，但需要大量传感器专用数据集。此外，由于镜头特性、光照条件和传感器磨损的差异，每种新传感器都需要重新训练。本文提出TacViT，一种基于视觉变换器的新型触觉感知模型，旨在实现对新传感器数据的泛化能力。TacViT利用全局自注意力机制从触觉图像中提取稳健特征，即使在未接触过的传感器上也能实现精准的接触特性推断。这一能力显著降低了数据收集和重新训练的需求，加速了新传感器的部署进程。我们在五指机器人手传感器上评估TacViT，并证明其相较于卷积神经网络具有更优越的泛化性能。研究结果凸显了TacViT在推动触觉感知技术向实际机器人应用规模化、实用化发展方面的潜力。

TLDR: Introduces TacViT, a Vision Transformer-based model for tactile perception that generalizes across different vision-based tactile sensors on multi-fingered robot hands, reducing data collection and retraining needs.

简要说明: 提出了 TacViT，一种基于 Vision Transformer 的触觉感知模型，能够在多指机器人手上跨不同视觉触觉传感器泛化，减少数据收集和重新训练需求。

Authors: Christopher J. Ford, Kaichen Shi, Laura Butcher, Nathan F. Lepora, Efi Psomopoulou

SoftHand Model-W: A 3D-Printed, Anthropomorphic, Underactuated Robot Hand with Integrated Wrist and Carpal Tunnel

Abstract (English): This paper presents the SoftHand Model-W: a 3D-printed, underactuated, anthropomorphic robot hand based on the Pisa/IIT SoftHand, with an integrated antagonistic tendon mechanism and 2 degree-of-freedom tendon-driven wrist. These four degrees-of-acuation provide active flexion and extension to the five fingers, and active flexion/extension and radial/ulnar deviation of the palm through the wrist, while preserving the synergistic and self-adaptive features of such SoftHands. A carpal tunnel-inspired tendon routing allows remote motor placement in the forearm, reducing distal inertia and maintaining a compact form factor. The SoftHand-W is mounted on a 6-axis robot arm and tested with two reorientation tasks requiring coordination between the hand and arm's pose: cube stacking and in-plane disc rotation. Results comparing task time, arm joint travel, and configuration changes with and without wrist actuation show that adding the wrist reduces compensatory and reconfiguration movements of the arm for a quicker task-completion time. Moreover, the wrist enables pick-and-place operations that would be impossible otherwise. Overall, the SoftHand Model-W demonstrates how proximal degrees of freedom are key to achieving versatile, human-like manipulation in real world robotic applications, with a compact design enabling deployment in research and assistive settings.

摘要（中文）: 本文介绍SoftHand Model-W：这是一款基于Pisa/IIT SoftHand的3D打印欠驱动拟人机器人手，集成了对抗式腱绳机构与双自由度腱驱动腕关节。其四个驱动自由度通过主动屈伸控制五指运动，并实现腕部带动手掌的主动屈伸及桡尺偏转，同时保留了此类软体手的协同性与自适应特性。受腕管结构启发的腱绳布局将驱动电机置于前臂远端，既降低了末端惯性又保持了紧凑外形。该软体手搭载于六轴机械臂上，通过立方体堆叠与平面圆盘旋转两项需手-臂姿态协调的再定向任务进行测试。对比腕部驱动启用与禁用状态下的任务耗时、关节行程及构型变化数据表明，腕关节的加入减少了机械臂的补偿性运动与重配置动作，从而缩短任务完成时间。此外，腕部关节实现了原本无法完成的抓放操作。总体而言，SoftHand Model-W通过紧凑型设计证明了近端自由度是实现现实机器人应用中多功能拟人化操作的关键要素，适用于研究及辅助场景的部署需求。

TLDR: This paper introduces the SoftHand Model-W, a 3D-printed, underactuated robotic hand with an integrated wrist, and demonstrates through manipulation tasks that the wrist reduces compensatory arm movements and expands task capabilities.

简要说明: 本文介绍了SoftHand Model-W，一款3D打印、欠驱动的机械手，集成腕部，通过操作任务证明腕部减少了手臂的补偿运动并扩展了任务能力。

Authors: Dhillon B. Merritt, Christopher J. Ford, Haoran Li, Malia Smith, Zhixing Chen, Efi Psomopoulou, Nathan F. Lepora

A Physical Imitation Learning Pipeline for Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion Assisted by Parallel Elastic Joint

Abstract (English): Due to brain-body co-evolution, animals' intrinsic body dynamics play a crucial role in energy-efficient locomotion, which shares control effort between active muscles and passive body dynamics -- a principle known as Embodied Physical Intelligence. In contrast, robot bodies are often designed with one centralised controller that typically suppress the intrinsic body dynamics instead of exploiting it. We introduce Physical Imitation Learning (PIL), which distils a Reinforcement Learning (RL) control policy into physically implementable body responses that can be directly offloaded to passive Parallel Elastic Joints (PEJs), enabling therefore the body to imitate part of the controlled behaviour. Meanwhile, the residual policy commands the motors to recover the RL policy's performance. The results is an overall reduced energy consumption thanks to outsourcing parts of the control policy to the PEJs. Here we show in simulated quadrupeds, that our PIL approach can offloads up to 87% of mechanical power to PEJs on flat terrain and 18% on rough terrain. Because the body design is distilled from -- rather than jointly optimised with -- the control policy, PIL realises brain-body co-design without expanding the search space with body design parameters, providing a computationally efficient route to task-specific Embodied Physical Intelligence applicable to a wide range of joint-based robot morphologies.

摘要（中文）: 受脑体协同进化影响，动物内在的躯体动力学在高效节能运动中发挥着关键作用，其将控制任务分配给主动肌肉与被动躯体动力学共同承担——这一原理被称为"具身物理智能"。相比之下，机器人躯体的设计通常采用集中式控制器，这类控制器往往会抑制而非利用其内在躯体动力学。本研究提出物理模仿学习（PIL）方法，通过将强化学习（RL）控制策略提炼为可直接卸载至被动并联弹性关节（PEJ）的物理可执行躯体响应，使机器人躯体能够模仿部分受控行为。同时，剩余策略通过控制电机来恢复强化学习策略的完整性能。由于将部分控制策略外包给并联弹性关节执行，最终实现了整体能耗的降低。我们在四足机器人仿真实验中证明，该物理模仿学习方法在平坦地形上可将高达87%的机械功率卸载至并联弹性关节，在复杂地形上仍可实现18%的功率卸载。由于躯体设计是从控制策略中提炼而来，而非与控制策略联合优化，物理模仿学习实现了脑体协同设计，且无需扩展躯体设计参数的搜索空间，为面向特定任务的具身物理智能提供了一条适用于各类关节型机器人形态的高效计算路径。

TLDR: The paper introduces Physical Imitation Learning (PIL), a method to distill a Reinforcement Learning policy for quadruped locomotion into passive Parallel Elastic Joints to reduce energy consumption by offloading control effort.

简要说明: 本文提出了物理模仿学习（PIL）方法，将强化学习策略提炼到被动平行弹性关节中，为四足机器人实现节能运动，将部分控制任务卸载到身体结构上。

Authors: Huyue Ma, Yurui Jin, Helmut Hauser, Rui Wu

Multi-Camera View Scaling for Data-Efficient Robot Imitation Learning

Abstract (English): The generalization ability of imitation learning policies for robotic manipulation is fundamentally constrained by the diversity of expert demonstrations, while collecting demonstrations across varied environments is costly and difficult in practice. In this paper, we propose a practical framework that exploits inherent scene diversity without additional human effort by scaling camera views during demonstration collection. Instead of acquiring more trajectories, multiple synchronized camera perspectives are used to generate pseudo-demonstrations from each expert trajectory, which enriches the training distribution and improves viewpoint invariance in visual representations. We analyze how different action spaces interact with view scaling and show that camera-space representations further enhance diversity. In addition, we introduce a multiview action aggregation method that allows single-view policies to benefit from multiple cameras during deployment. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate significant gains in data efficiency and generalization compared to single-view baselines. Our results suggest that scaling camera views provides a practical and scalable solution for imitation learning, which requires minimal additional hardware setup and integrates seamlessly with existing imitation learning algorithms. The website of our project is https://yichen928.github.io/robot_multiview.

摘要（中文）: 机器人模仿学习策略的泛化能力从根本上受限于专家示教数据的多样性，而实际中收集不同环境下的示教数据成本高昂且困难重重。本文提出一种实用框架，通过在示教收集中扩展相机视角，无需额外人力即可利用固有的场景多样性。该框架不增加轨迹采集数量，而是使用多个同步的相机视角，从每条专家轨迹生成伪示教数据，从而丰富训练分布并提升视觉表征的视角不变性。我们分析了不同动作空间与视角扩展的交互关系，并证明相机空间表征能进一步增强多样性。此外，我们提出了一种多视角动作聚合方法，使单视角策略在部署时也能受益于多相机系统。在仿真和真实机器人操作任务中的大量实验表明，相比单视角基线方法，本框架在数据效率和泛化能力上均取得显著提升。研究结果表明，扩展相机视角为模仿学习提供了实用且可扩展的解决方案，该方法仅需最低限度的额外硬件配置，并能与现有模仿学习算法无缝集成。项目网站为：https://yichen928.github.io/robot_multiview。

TLDR: The paper proposes a framework for robot imitation learning that uses multiple synchronized camera views to generate pseudo-demonstrations from a single trajectory, improving data efficiency and generalization with minimal hardware changes.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种机器人模仿学习框架，利用多个同步相机视角从单一轨迹生成伪演示，以最小的硬件改动提高了数据效率和泛化能力。

Authors: Yichen Xie, Yixiao Wang, Shuqi Zhao, Cheng-En Wu, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Jianwen Xie, Hao-Shu Fang

Learning Humanoid Navigation from Human Data

Abstract (English): We present EgoNav, a system that enables a humanoid robot to traverse diverse, unseen environments by learning entirely from 5 hours of human walking data, with no robot data or finetuning. A diffusion model predicts distributions of plausible future trajectories conditioned on past trajectory, a 360 deg visual memory fusing color, depth, and semantics, and video features from a frozen DINOv3 backbone that capture appearance cues invisible to depth sensors. A hybrid sampling scheme achieves real-time inference in 10 denoising steps, and a receding-horizon controller selects paths from the predicted distribution. We validate EgoNav through offline evaluations, where it outperforms baselines in collision avoidance and multi-modal coverage, and through zero-shot deployment on a Unitree G1 humanoid across unseen indoor and outdoor environments. Behaviors such as waiting for doors to open, navigating around crowds, and avoiding glass walls emerge naturally from the learned prior. We will release the dataset and trained models. Our website: https://egonav.weizhuowang.com

摘要（中文）: 我们推出EgoNav系统，该系统仅通过5小时人类行走数据学习，无需机器人数据或微调，即可使人形机器人在多样化、未见过的环境中自主穿行。该系统采用扩散模型预测未来可行轨迹的概率分布，条件输入包括历史轨迹、融合彩色、深度与语义信息的360度视觉记忆，以及从冻结DINOv3骨干网络提取的视频特征——这些特征能捕捉深度传感器无法检测的外观线索。通过混合采样策略在10步去噪过程中实现实时推理，并结合滚动时域控制器从预测分布中选取路径。我们在离线评估中验证了EgoNav的性能，其在避障和多模态覆盖能力上均超越基线模型；同时在Unitree G1人形机器人上进行了零样本部署测试，成功穿越未见过的室内外环境。系统自然涌现出等待开门、绕行人群、规避玻璃墙等行为，这些能力均源于学习到的先验知识。我们将公开数据集与训练模型。项目网站：https://egonav.weizhuowang.com

TLDR: The EgoNav system enables a humanoid robot to navigate unseen environments by learning from human walking data, using a diffusion model for trajectory prediction and a visual memory system, validated on a physical humanoid.

简要说明: EgoNav系统通过从人类行走数据中学习，使人形机器人能够在未见过的环境中导航，使用了用于轨迹预测的扩散模型和视觉记忆系统，并在物理人形机器人上进行了验证。

Authors: Weizhuo Wang, Yanjie Ze, C. Karen Liu, Monroe Kennedy

Hierarchical Motion Planning and Control under Unknown Nonlinear Dynamics via Predicted Reachability

Abstract (English): Autonomous motion planning under unknown nonlinear dynamics requires learning system properties while navigating toward a target. In this work, we develop a hierarchical planning-control framework that enables online motion synthesis with limited prior system knowledge. The state space is partitioned into polytopes and approximates the unknown nonlinear system using a piecewise-affine (PWA) model. The local affine models are identified once the agent enters the corresponding polytopes. To reduce computational complexity, we introduce a non-uniform adaptive state space partition strategy that refines the partition only in task-relevant regions. The resulting PWA system is abstracted into a directed weighted graph, whose edge existence is incrementally verified using reach control theory and predictive reachability conditions. Certified edges are weighted using provable time-to-reach bounds, while uncertain edges are assigned information-theoretic weights to guide exploration. The graph is updated online as new data becomes available, and high-level planning is performed by graph search, while low-level affine feedback controllers are synthesized to execute the plan. Furthermore, the conditions of classical reach control theory are often difficult to satisfy in underactuated settings. We therefore introduce relaxed reachability conditions to extend the framework to such systems. Simulations demonstrate effective exploration-exploitation trade-offs with formal reachability guarantees.

摘要（中文）: 在非线性动力学未知的情况下进行自主运动规划，需要同时学习系统特性并朝着目标导航。本研究开发了一种分层规划-控制框架，能够在先验系统知识有限的情况下实现在线运动合成。通过将状态空间划分为多面体单元，并采用分段仿射模型来逼近未知非线性系统。当智能体进入相应多面体时，局部仿射模型才被识别。为降低计算复杂度，我们引入了一种非均匀自适应状态空间划分策略，仅在任务相关区域进行细化划分。将所得分段仿射系统抽象为有向加权图，其中边的存在性通过可达控制理论和预测可达性条件进行增量验证。已验证边采用可证明的时间-到达边界加权，而未确定边则赋予信息论权重以引导探索。该图随新数据获取而在线更新，高层规划通过图搜索实现，同时合成底层仿射反馈控制器以执行规划。此外，经典可达控制理论的条件在欠驱动场景下往往难以满足，为此我们引入放宽的可达性条件以扩展该框架的适用范围。仿真实验表明，该框架在具有形式化可达性保证的前提下，有效实现了探索与利用的平衡。

TLDR: Presents a hierarchical planning-control framework for autonomous agents with unknown nonlinear dynamics, using piecewise-affine models, reachability analysis, and online graph-based planning with formal guarantees.

简要说明: 提出了一种用于具有未知非线性动力学自主智能体的分层规划控制框架，使用分段仿射模型、可达性分析和具有形式保证的在线图规划。

Authors: Zhiquan Zhang, Melkior Ornik

DreamControl-v2: Simpler and Scalable Autonomous Humanoid Skills via Trainable Guided Diffusion Priors

Abstract (English): Developing robust autonomous loco-manipulation skills for humanoids remains an open problem in robotics. While RL has been applied successfully to legged locomotion, applying it to complex, interaction-rich manipulation tasks is harder given long-horizon planning challenges for manipulation. A recent approach along these lines is DreamControl, which addresses these issues by leveraging off-the-shelf human motion diffusion models as a generative prior to guide RL policies during training. In this paper, we investigate the impact of DreamControl's motion prior and propose an improved framework that trains a guided diffusion model directly in the humanoid robot's motion space, aggregating diverse human and robot datasets into a unified embodiment space. We demonstrate that our approach captures a wider range of skills due to the larger training data mixture and establishes a more automated pipeline by removing the need for manual filtering interventions. Furthermore, we show that scaling the generation of reference trajectories is important for achieving robust downstream RL policies. We validate our approach through extensive experiments in simulation and on a real Unitree-G1.

摘要（中文）: 开发稳健的仿人机器人自主移动操控技能仍是机器人学领域的开放难题。虽然强化学习在足式运动控制中已成功应用，但将其应用于复杂、交互密集的操控任务仍面临挑战，主要源于操控任务所需的长时程规划难题。近期提出的DreamControl方法通过利用现成的人类运动扩散模型作为生成先验，在训练过程中引导强化学习策略，从而应对这些挑战。本文深入探究了DreamControl运动先验的作用机制，并提出一种改进框架：直接在仿人机器人运动空间训练引导扩散模型，将多样化的人类与机器人数据集聚合到统一的具身化空间。实验证明，得益于更丰富的训练数据融合，我们的方法能够掌握更广泛的技能，并通过消除人工筛选干预实现了更高程度的自动化流程。此外，研究还表明扩展参考轨迹的生成规模对于构建稳健的下游强化学习策略至关重要。我们通过在仿真环境及真实Unitree-G1机器人上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。

TLDR: Proposes DreamControl-v2, which trains a guided diffusion model in a humanoid's motion space using mixed human and robot data to generate diverse reference trajectories, enabling robust RL policies for complex loco-manipulation skills.

简要说明: 提出DreamControl-v2，通过在类人机器人的运动空间中使用混合人类和机器人数据训练引导扩散模型，以生成多样化的参考轨迹，从而为复杂的移动操作技能实现稳健的强化学习策略。

Authors: Sudarshan Harithas, Sangkyung Kwak, Pushkal Katara, Srujan Deolasee, Dvij Kalaria, Srinath Sridhar, Sai Vemprala, Ashish Kapoor, Jonathan Chung-Kuan Huang

Long-Horizon Geometry-Aware Navigation among Polytopes via MILP-MPC and Minkowski-Based CBFs

Abstract (English): Autonomous navigation in complex, non-convex environments remains challenging when robot dynamics, control limits, and exact robot geometry must all be taken into account. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical planning and control framework that bridges long-horizon guidance and geometry-aware safety guarantees for a polytopic robot navigating among polytopic obstacles. At the high level, Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) is embedded within a Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework to generate a nominal trajectory around polytopic obstacles while modeling the robot as a point mass for computational tractability. At the low level, we employ a control barrier function (CBF) based on the exact signed distance in the Minkowski-difference space as a safety filter to explicitly enforce the geometric constraints of the robot shape, and further extend its formulation to a high-order CBF (HOCBF). We demonstrate the proposed framework in U-shaped and maze-like environments under single- and double-integrator dynamics. The results show that the proposed architecture mitigates the topology-induced local-minimum behavior of purely reactive CBF-based navigation while enabling safe, real-time, geometry-aware navigation.

摘要（中文）: 在复杂非凸环境中，当机器人动力学特性、控制限制以及精确几何结构均需被纳入考量时，自主导航仍面临严峻挑战。本文提出一种分层规划与控制框架，为多面体机器人在多面体障碍物环境中的导航任务，搭建了长时程轨迹引导与几何感知安全保证之间的桥梁。高层规划中，我们将混合整数线性规划嵌入模型预测控制框架，通过在计算中将机器人简化为质点以保证处理效率，从而生成围绕多面体障碍物的标称轨迹。底层控制中，我们采用基于闵可夫斯基差分空间精确符号距离的控制屏障函数作为安全滤波器，以显式强化机器人几何形状约束，并进一步将其扩展为高阶控制屏障函数。我们在单积分与双积分动力学模型下，通过U形与迷宫状环境验证所提框架的有效性。实验结果表明，该架构既能缓解纯反应式控制屏障函数导航因环境拓扑结构导致的局部极小值问题，又能实现实时、安全且几何感知的自主导航。

TLDR: A hierarchical framework for robotic navigation uses MILP-MPC for long-horizon trajectory planning and Minkowski-based CBFs for geometry-aware safety guarantees, enabling robots to navigate complex, non-convex environments.

简要说明: 一种用于机器人导航的分层框架，结合MILP-MPC进行长时程轨迹规划和基于Minkowski的CBF实现几何感知安全保证，使机器人能在复杂非凸环境中安全导航。

Authors: Yi-Hsuan Chen, Salman Ghori, Ania Adil, Eric Feron, Calin Belta

Benchmarking Interaction, Beyond Policy: a Reproducible Benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation

Abstract (English): We propose Question-Asking Navigation (QAsk-Nav), the first reproducible benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation (CoIN) that enables an explicit, separate assessment of embodied navigation and collaborative question asking. CoIN tasks an embodied agent with reaching a target specified in free-form natural language under partial observability, using only egocentric visual observations and interactive natural-language dialogue with a human, where the dialogue can help to resolve ambiguity among visually similar object instances. Existing CoIN benchmarks are primarily focused on navigation success and offer no support for consistent evaluation of collaborative interaction. To address this limitation, QAsk-Nav provides (i) a lightweight question-asking protocol scored independently of navigation, (ii) an enhanced navigation protocol with realistic, diverse, high-quality target descriptions, and (iii) an open-source dataset, that includes 28,000 quality-checked reasoning and question-asking traces for training and analysis of interactive capabilities of CoIN models. Using the proposed QAsk-Nav benchmark, we develop Light-CoNav, a lightweight unified model for collaborative navigation that is 3x smaller and 70x faster than existing modular methods, while outperforming state-of-the-art CoIN approaches in generalization to unseen objects and environments. Project page at https://benchmarking-interaction.github.io/

摘要（中文）: 我们提出问答式导航（QAsk-Nav），这是首个可复现的协作式实例物体导航（CoIN）基准，能够对具身导航与协作式提问进行明确、独立的评估。CoIN任务要求具身智能体在部分可观测环境下，仅通过自我中心视角的视觉观察和与人类的交互式自然语言对话，到达以自由形式自然语言描述的目标位置；其中对话可帮助分辨视觉相似物体实例间的歧义。现有CoIN基准主要关注导航成功率，未能提供对协作交互的一致评估支持。为解决这一局限，QAsk-Nav提供：（i）独立于导航评分的轻量化提问协议；（ii）具有真实、多样、高质量目标描述的增强导航协议；（iii）包含28,000条质量校验的推理与提问轨迹的开源数据集，用于训练与分析CoIN模型的交互能力。基于提出的QAsk-Nav基准，我们开发了轻量化统一协作导航模型Light-CoNav，其体积比现有模块化方法缩小3倍，速度提升70倍，并在泛化至未见过的物体和环境时超越了当前最先进的CoIN方法。项目页面详见https://benchmarking-interaction.github.io/。

TLDR: This paper introduces a new benchmark for Collaborative Instance Object Navigation (CoIN) that separately evaluates navigation and interactive question-asking abilities, along with a lightweight model for the task.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一个用于协作实例对象导航的新基准，可独立评估导航和交互问答能力，并附带一个用于该任务的轻量级模型。

Authors: Edoardo Zorzi, Francesco Taioli, Yiming Wang, Marco Cristani, Alessandro Farinelli, Alberto Castellini, Loris Bazzani

Compact Keyframe-Optimized Multi-Agent Gaussian Splatting SLAM

Abstract (English): Efficient multi-agent 3D mapping is essential for robotic teams operating in unknown environments, but dense representations hinder real-time exchange over constrained communication links. In multi-agent Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), systems typically rely on a centralized server to merge and optimize the local maps produced by individual agents. However, sharing these large map representations, particularly those generated by recent methods such as Gaussian Splatting, becomes a bottleneck in real-world scenarios with limited bandwidth. We present an improved multi-agent RGB-D Gaussian Splatting SLAM framework that reduces communication load while preserving map fidelity. First, we incorporate a compaction step into our SLAM system to remove redundant 3D Gaussians, without degrading the rendering quality. Second, our approach performs centralized loop closure computation without initial guess, operating in two modes: a pure rendered-depth mode that requires no data beyond the 3D Gaussians, and a camera-depth mode that includes lightweight depth images for improved registration accuracy and additional Gaussian pruning. Evaluation on both synthetic and real-world datasets shows up to 85-95\% reduction in transmitted data compared to state-of-the-art approaches in both modes, bringing 3D Gaussian multi-agent SLAM closer to practical deployment in real-world scenarios. Code: https://github.com/lemonci/coko-slam

摘要（中文）: 高效的多智能体三维地图构建对于在未知环境中运行的机器人团队至关重要，但密集的表征方式制约了其在有限通信链路上的实时交互。在多智能体同步定位与地图构建（SLAM）系统中，通常依赖中央服务器对各智能体生成的局部地图进行融合与优化。然而，共享这些大规模地图表征——尤其是由高斯溅射等近期方法生成的类型——在带宽受限的实际场景中成为性能瓶颈。本文提出了一种改进的多智能体RGB-D高斯溅射SLAM框架，能够在保持地图精度的同时显著降低通信负载。首先，我们在SLAM系统中引入了压缩步骤，可在不降低渲染质量的前提下去除冗余的三维高斯元素。其次，该方法实现了无需初始猜测的集中式闭环检测计算，提供两种运行模式：纯渲染深度模式仅需三维高斯数据；相机深度模式则通过引入轻量级深度图像来提升配准精度，并进一步优化高斯元素剪枝。在合成数据集与真实场景数据集上的实验表明，该框架在两种模式下相比现有先进方法最高可减少85-95%的数据传输量，推动三维高斯多智能体SLAM向实际场景部署迈出关键一步。代码：https://github.com/lemonci/coko-slam

TLDR: Improves multi-agent Gaussian Splatting SLAM by compressing the 3D map representation to reduce communication bandwidth, enabling more efficient multi-robot mapping in unknown environments.

简要说明: 改进多智能体高斯泼溅SLAM，通过压缩3D地图表示以减少通信带宽，在多机器人未知环境建图中实现更高效率。

Authors: Monica M. Q. Li, Pierre-Yves Lajoie, Jialiang Liu, Giovanni Beltrame

StretchBot: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Adaptive Guidance with Assistive Robots

Abstract (English): Assistive robots have growing potential to support physical wellbeing in home and healthcare settings, for example, by guiding users through stretching or rehabilitation routines. However, existing systems remain largely scripted, which limits their ability to adapt to user state, environmental context, and interaction dynamics. In this work, we present StretchBot, a hybrid neuro-symbolic robotic coach for adaptive assistive guidance. The system combines multimodal perception with knowledge-graph-grounded large language model reasoning to support context-aware adjustments during short stretching sessions while maintaining a structured routine. To complement the system description, we report an exploratory pilot comparison between scripted and adaptive guidance with three participants. The pilot findings suggest that the adaptive condition improved perceived adaptability and contextual relevance, while scripted guidance remained competitive in smoothness and predictability. These results provide preliminary evidence that structured actionable knowledge can help ground language-model-based adaptation in embodied assistive interaction, while also highlighting the need for larger, longitudinal studies to evaluate robustness, generalizability, and long-term user experience.

摘要（中文）: 辅助机器人在家庭和医疗场景中支持用户身体健康的潜力日益增长，例如通过引导用户进行拉伸或康复训练。然而，现有系统大多仍依赖预设脚本，限制了其适应用户状态、环境背景及交互动态的能力。本研究提出了StretchBot——一种基于混合神经符号系统的自适应辅助指导机器人教练。该系统结合多模态感知与基于知识图谱的大语言模型推理，能够在短期拉伸训练中实现情境感知的实时调整，同时保持训练流程的结构性。在系统描述之外，我们通过一项探索性先导研究比较了脚本化与自适应指导模式（涉及三名参与者）。先导研究表明：自适应模式在感知适应性与情境相关性方面表现更优，而脚本化指导在流程流畅性与可预测性方面仍具竞争力。这些结果为结构化可操作知识有助于在具身辅助交互中实现基于语言模型的自适应提供了初步证据，同时也凸显了需要更大规模、更长期的纵向研究来评估系统的鲁棒性、泛化能力及长期用户体验。

TLDR: StretchBot is a neuro-symbolic robotic coach for adaptive assistive guidance, combining multimodal perception, knowledge graphs, and LLM reasoning to adjust stretching routines based on user state and context.

简要说明: StretchBot是一个用于自适应辅助指导的神经符号机器人教练，结合了多模态感知、知识图谱和LLM推理，根据用户状态和上下文调整拉伸程序。

Authors: Luca Vogelgesang, Ahmed Mehdi Soltani, Mohammadhossein Khojasteh, Xinrui Zu, Stefano De Giorgis, Madalina Croitoru, Filip Ilievski

Sampling-based Task and Kinodynamic Motion Planning under Semantic Uncertainty

Abstract (English): This paper tackles the problem of integrated task and kinodynamic motion planning in uncertain environments. We consider a robot with nonlinear dynamics tasked with a Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces ($\ltlf$) specification operating in a partially observable environment. Specifically, the uncertainty is in the semantic labels of the environment. We show how the problem can be modeled as a Partially Observable Stochastic Hybrid System that captures the robot dynamics, $\ltlf$ task, and uncertainty in the environment state variables. We propose an anytime algorithm that takes advantage of the structure of the hybrid system, and combines the effectiveness of decision-making techniques and sampling-based motion planning. We prove the soundness and asymptotic optimality of the algorithm. Results show the efficacy of our algorithm in uncertain environments, and that it consistently outperforms baseline methods.

摘要（中文）: 本文研究了不确定环境下任务与运动学的综合规划问题。我们考虑一个具有非线性动力学的机器人，其任务是在部分可观测环境中执行有限轨迹上的线性时序逻辑（$\ltlf$）规范。具体而言，环境的不确定性体现在语义标签的模糊性上。我们展示了如何将问题建模为部分可观测随机混合系统，该系统能够同时描述机器人动力学、$\ltlf$任务规范以及环境状态变量的不确定性。我们提出了一种基于混合系统结构的实时算法，该算法结合了决策制定技术的有效性与基于采样的运动规划方法。我们证明了该算法的可靠性与渐近最优性。实验结果表明，我们的算法在不确定环境中具有显著效能，且始终优于基准方法。

TLDR: The paper proposes an anytime algorithm for integrated task and kinodynamic motion planning under semantic uncertainty, modeling the problem as a Partially Observable Stochastic Hybrid System and proving soundness and asymptotic optimality.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种在语义不确定性下进行任务和动力学运动规划集成的方法，将问题建模为部分可观测随机混合系统，并证明了算法的可靠性和渐近最优性。

Authors: Qi Heng Ho, Zachary N. Sunberg, Morteza Lahijanian

Behavioral Score Diffusion: Model-Free Trajectory Planning via Kernel-Based Score Estimation from Data

Abstract (English): Diffusion-based trajectory optimization has emerged as a powerful planning paradigm, but existing methods require either learned score networks trained on large datasets or analytical dynamics models for score computation. We introduce \emph{Behavioral Score Diffusion} (BSD), a training-free and model-free trajectory planner that computes the diffusion score function directly from a library of trajectory data via kernel-weighted estimation. At each denoising step, BSD retrieves relevant trajectories using a triple-kernel weighting scheme -- diffusion proximity, state context, and goal relevance -- and computes a Nadaraya-Watson estimate of the denoised trajectory. The diffusion noise schedule naturally controls kernel bandwidths, creating a multi-scale nonparametric regression: broad averaging of global behavioral patterns at high noise, fine-grained local interpolation at low noise. This coarse-to-fine structure handles nonlinear dynamics without linearization or parametric assumptions. Safety is preserved by applying shielded rollout on kernel-estimated state trajectories, identical to existing model-based approaches. We evaluate BSD on four robotic systems of increasing complexity (3D--6D state spaces) in a parking scenario. BSD with fixed bandwidth achieves 98.5\% of the model-based baseline's average reward across systems while requiring no dynamics model, using only 1{,}000 pre-collected trajectories. BSD substantially outperforms nearest-neighbor retrieval (18--63\% improvement), confirming that the diffusion denoising mechanism is essential for effective data-driven planning.

摘要（中文）: 基于扩散的轨迹优化已成为一种强大的规划范式，但现有方法需要依赖在大型数据集上训练的学习型评分网络，或依靠解析动力学模型进行评分计算。本文提出一种免训练且免模型的轨迹规划器——行为评分扩散（BSD），它通过核加权估计直接从轨迹数据集中计算扩散评分函数。在每次去噪步骤中，BSD利用三重核加权方案（扩散邻近度、状态上下文与目标相关性）检索相关轨迹，并计算去噪轨迹的纳达拉亚-瓦特森估计。扩散噪声调度自然控制核带宽，形成一种多尺度非参数回归：在强噪声下对全局行为模式进行广泛平均，在弱噪声下进行细粒度的局部插值。这种从粗到精的结构无需线性化或参数化假设即可处理非线性动力学。通过在内核估计状态轨迹上应用屏蔽式滚算（与现有基于模型的方法相同），系统安全性得到保障。我们在停车场景中针对四个复杂度递增的机器人系统（3D-6D状态空间）评估BSD。结果表明：在仅使用1,000条预收集轨迹且无需动力学模型的情况下，采用固定带宽的BSD可达到基于模型基线平均奖励的98.5%。BSD显著优于最近邻检索方法（提升18-63%），证实了扩散去噪机制对数据驱动规划的有效性至关重要。

TLDR: Presents Behavioral Score Diffusion, a model-free, training-free trajectory planner for robots that uses kernel-based score estimation directly from a trajectory library, eliminating the need for learned models or analytical dynamics, and demonstrates effectiveness in robotic parking scenarios.

简要说明: 提出行为分数扩散，一种用于机器人的无模型、免训练轨迹规划器，通过基于核的分数估计直接从轨迹库中规划，无需学习模型或解析动力学，并在机器人停车场景中证明了其有效性。

Authors: Shihao Li, Jiachen Li, Jiamin Xu, Dongmei Chen

A Dual-Stream Transformer Architecture for Illumination-Invariant TIR-LiDAR Person Tracking

Abstract (English): Robust person tracking is a critical capability for autonomous mobile robots operating in diverse and unpredictable environments. While RGB-D tracking has shown high precision, its performance severely degrades under challenging illumination conditions, such as total darkness or intense backlighting. To achieve all-weather robustness, this paper proposes a novel Thermal-Infrared and Depth (TIR-D) tracking architecture that leverages the standard sensor suite of SLAM-capable robots, namely LiDAR and TIR cameras. A major challenge in TIR-D tracking is the scarcity of annotated multi-modal datasets. To address this, we introduce a sequential knowledge transfer strategy that evolves structural priors from a large-scale thermal-trained model into the TIR-D domain. By employing a differential learning rate strategy -- referred to as ``Fine-grained Differential Learning Rate Strategy'' -- we effectively preserve pre-trained feature extraction capabilities while enabling rapid adaptation to geometric depth cues. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed TIR-D tracker achieves superior performance, with an Average Overlap (AO) of 0.700 and a Success Rate (SR) of 58.7\%, significantly outperforming conventional RGB-transfer and single-modality baselines. Our approach provides a practical and resource-efficient solution for robust human-following in all-weather robotics applications.

摘要（中文）: 稳健的人员跟踪是自主移动机器人在多样且不可预测环境中运行的关键能力。尽管RGB-D跟踪已展现出高精度，但在极端光照条件下（如完全黑暗或强烈逆光），其性能会严重下降。为实现全天候鲁棒性，本文提出一种新颖的热红外与深度（TIR-D）跟踪架构，该架构利用了具备SLAM能力的机器人标准传感器套件——即激光雷达和热红外相机。TIR-D跟踪面临的主要挑战在于缺乏带标注的多模态数据集。为此，我们引入一种顺序知识迁移策略，将大规模热红外训练模型中的结构先验知识逐步迁移至TIR-D领域。通过采用差异学习率策略——称为“细粒度差异学习率策略”——我们有效保留了预训练特征提取能力，同时快速适应几何深度信息。实验结果表明，所提出的TIR-D跟踪器以0.700的平均重叠度（AO）和58.7%的成功率（SR）实现了卓越性能，显著优于传统的RGB迁移方法和单模态基线。该方法为全天候机器人应用中稳健的人体跟随提供了实用且资源高效的解决方案。

TLDR: Proposes a thermal-infrared and depth (TIR-D) tracker for robust all-weather person tracking on mobile robots, using sequential knowledge transfer and a differential learning rate strategy to adapt a pre-trained model to LiDAR data.

简要说明: 提出一种用于移动机器人的热红外与深度（TIR-D）人员跟踪器，通过序列知识迁移和差异化学习率策略，将预训练模型适配到LiDAR数据，以实现全天候的鲁棒跟踪。

Authors: Yuki Minase, Kanji Tanaka

Real Time Local Wind Inference for Robust Autonomous Navigation

Abstract (English): This thesis presents a solution that enables aerial robots to reason about surrounding wind flow fields in real time using on board sensors and embedded flight hardware. The core novelty of this research is the fusion of range measurements with sparse in situ wind measurements to predict surrounding flow fields. We aim to address two fundamental questions: first, the sufficiency of topographical data for accurate wind prediction in dense urban environments; and second, the utility of learned wind models for motion planning with an emphasis on energy efficiency and obstacle avoidance. Drawing on tools from deep learning, fluid mechanics, and optimal control, we establish a framework for local wind prediction using navigational LiDAR, and then incorporate local wind model priors into a receding-horizon optimal controller to study how local wind knowledge affects energy use and robustness during autonomous navigation. Through simulated demonstrations in diverse urban wind scenarios we evaluate the predictive capabilities of the wind predictor, and quantify improvements to autonomous urban navigation in terms of crash rates and energy consumption when local wind information is integrated into the motion planning. Sub-scale free flight experiments in an open-air wind tunnel demonstrate that these algorithms can run in real time on an embedded flight computer with sufficient bandwidth for stable control of a small aerial robot. Philosophically, this thesis contributes a new paradigm for localized wind inference and motion planning in unknown windy environments. By enabling robots to rapidly assess local wind conditions without prior environmental knowledge, this research accelerates the introduction of aerial robots into increasingly challenging environments.

摘要（中文）: 本研究提出一种解决方案，使空中机器人能够利用机载传感器与嵌入式飞行硬件实时推断周围风流场。本研究的核心创新在于融合距离测量与稀疏原位风场测量数据以预测周边流场。我们旨在解决两个根本性问题：第一，在密集城市环境中地形数据对于精准风场预测的充分性；第二，学习型风场模型在运动规划中的应用价值，重点关注能量效率与障碍物规避。本研究整合深度学习、流体力学与最优控制领域的工具，建立了基于导航激光雷达的局地风场预测框架，进而将局地风场先验模型纳入滚动时域最优控制器，以探究局地风场认知如何影响自主导航过程中的能量消耗与系统鲁棒性。通过在多样化城市风场场景中的仿真验证，我们评估了风场预测器的性能，并量化了将局地风场信息融入运动规划后对城市自主导航在碰撞率与能耗方面的改善效果。露天风洞中的亚尺度自由飞行实验表明，这些算法能够在嵌入式飞行计算机上实时运行，其带宽足以支持小型空中机器人的稳定控制。从学理层面，本研究贡献了一种适用于未知风环境的局地风场推断与运动规划新范式。通过使机器人在无需先验环境知识的条件下快速评估局地风场状况，该研究推动了空中机器人向更具挑战性环境的应用拓展。

TLDR: This thesis develops a method for aerial robots to predict local wind fields in real-time using onboard sensors and uses this information to improve energy-efficient and robust motion planning for autonomous navigation in urban environments.

简要说明: 本论文提出了一种方法，使空中机器人能够使用机载传感器实时预测局部风场，并利用该信息改进城市环境中自主导航的能量效率和鲁棒性运动规划。

Authors: Spencer Folk

Flow-based Policy With Distributional Reinforcement Learning in Trajectory Optimization

Abstract (English): Reinforcement Learning (RL) has proven highly effective in addressing complex control and decision-making tasks. However, in most traditional RL algorithms, the policy is typically parameterized as a diagonal Gaussian distribution, which constrains the policy from capturing multimodal distributions, making it difficult to cover the full range of optimal solutions in multi-solution problems, and the return is reduced to a mean value, losing its multimodal nature and thus providing insufficient guidance for policy updates. In response to these problems, we propose a RL algorithm termed flow-based policy with distributional RL (FP-DRL). This algorithm models the policy using flow matching, which offers both computational efficiency and the capacity to fit complex distributions. Additionally, it employs a distributional RL approach to model and optimize the entire return distribution, thereby more effectively guiding multimodal policy updates and improving agent performance. Experimental trails on MuJoCo benchmarks demonstrate that the FP-DRL algorithm achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in most MuJoCo control tasks while exhibiting superior representation capability of the flow policy.

摘要（中文）: 强化学习在解决复杂控制与决策任务中已被证明具有极高效率。然而在多数传统强化学习算法中，策略通常被参数化为对角高斯分布，这种形式限制了策略捕捉多模态分布的能力，难以覆盖多解问题中的全部最优解，同时回报被简化为单一均值，丧失了其多模态特性，从而无法为策略更新提供充分指导。针对这些问题，我们提出了一种基于流匹配策略与分布强化学习相结合的算法（FP-DRL）。该算法通过流匹配技术对策略进行建模，兼具计算效率与拟合复杂分布的能力；同时采用分布强化学习方法对完整回报分布进行建模与优化，从而更有效地指导多模态策略更新并提升智能体性能。在MuJoCo基准测试中的实验表明，FP-DRL算法在多数MuJoCo控制任务中达到了最先进的性能水平，同时展现出流策略优越的表征能力。

TLDR: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning algorithm that combines a flow-based policy for fitting complex distributions with distributional RL for optimizing the entire return distribution, achieving state-of-the-art results on MuJoCo control tasks.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种强化学习算法，结合基于流的策略以拟合复杂分布和分布式RL以优化整个回报分布，在MuJoCo控制任务中实现了最先进的性能。

Authors: Ruijie Hao, Longfei Zhang, Yang Dai, Yang Ma, Xingxing Liang, Guangquan Cheng

EgoSim: Egocentric World Simulator for Embodied Interaction Generation

Abstract (English): We introduce EgoSim, a closed-loop egocentric world simulator that generates spatially consistent interaction videos and persistently updates the underlying 3D scene state for continuous simulation. Existing egocentric simulators either lack explicit 3D grounding, causing structural drift under viewpoint changes, or treat the scene as static, failing to update world states across multi-stage interactions. EgoSim addresses both limitations by modeling 3D scenes as updatable world states. We generate embodiment interactions via a Geometry-action-aware Observation Simulation model, with spatial consistency from an Interaction-aware State Updating module. To overcome the critical data bottleneck posed by the difficulty in acquiring densely aligned scene-interaction training pairs, we design a scalable pipeline that extracts static point clouds, camera trajectories, and embodiment actions from in-the-wild large-scale monocular egocentric videos. We further introduce EgoCap, a capture system that enables low-cost real-world data collection with uncalibrated smartphones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EgoSim significantly outperforms existing methods in terms of visual quality, spatial consistency, and generalization to complex scenes and in-the-wild dexterous interactions, while supporting cross-embodiment transfer to robotic manipulation. Codes and datasets will be open soon. The project page is at egosimulator.github.io.

摘要（中文）: 我们提出EgoSim——一种闭环的以自我为中心的世界模拟器，能够生成空间一致的交互视频，并持续更新底层三维场景状态以实现连续模拟。现有的以自我为中心模拟器要么缺乏明确的三维基础，导致视角变化下的结构漂移；要么将场景视为静态，无法在多阶段交互中更新世界状态。EgoSim通过将三维场景建模为可更新的世界状态，解决了这两类局限。我们通过几何动作感知的观测模拟模型生成具身交互，其空间一致性由交互感知状态更新模块保障。针对密集对齐的场景-交互训练数据获取困难所形成的关键数据瓶颈，我们设计了一种可扩展的流程，能够从野外大规模单目以自我为中心视频中提取静态点云、相机轨迹与具身动作。我们还开发了EgoCap采集系统，支持使用未校准智能手机进行低成本现实世界数据采集。大量实验表明，EgoSim在视觉质量、空间一致性、对复杂场景及野外灵巧交互的泛化能力方面显著优于现有方法，同时支持跨具身迁移至机器人操作任务。代码与数据集即将开源，项目页面位于egosimulator.github.io。

TLDR: EgoSim is a closed-loop egocentric world simulator that generates spatially consistent interaction videos and updates underlying 3D scene states, supporting cross-embodiment transfer to robotic manipulation.

简要说明: EgoSim是一个闭环的以自我为中心的世界模拟器，可生成空间一致的交互视频并更新底层3D场景状态，支持跨具身智能体转移至机器人操控。

Authors: Jinkun Hao, Mingda Jia, Ruiyan Wang, Xihui Liu, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma, Jiangmiao Pang, Xudong Xu

A ROS 2 Wrapper for Florence-2: Multi-Mode Local Vision-Language Inference for Robotic Systems

Abstract (English): Foundation vision-language models are becoming increasingly relevant to robotics because they can provide richer semantic perception than narrow task-specific pipelines. However, their practical adoption in robot software stacks still depends on reproducible middleware integrations rather than on model quality alone. Florence-2 is especially attractive in this regard because it unifies captioning, optical character recognition, open-vocabulary detection, grounding and related vision-language tasks within a comparatively manageable model size. This article presents a ROS 2 wrapper for Florence-2 that exposes the model through three complementary interaction modes: continuous topic-driven processing, synchronous service calls and asynchronous actions. The wrapper is designed for local execution and supports both native installation and Docker container deployment. It also combines generic JSON outputs with standard ROS 2 message bindings for detection-oriented tasks. A functional validation is reported together with a throughput study on several GPUs, showing that local deployment is feasible with consumer grade hardware. The repository is publicly available here: https://github.com/JEDominguezVidal/florence2_ros2_wrapper

摘要（中文）: 基础视觉语言模型因其能提供比狭窄任务特定流水线更丰富的语义感知，正逐渐成为机器人学领域的重要工具。然而，这些模型在机器人软件栈中的实际应用，不仅取决于模型质量，还依赖于可复现的中间件集成。在这方面，Florence-2 模型尤为引人注目，它将图像描述、光学字符识别、开放词汇检测、定位及相关视觉语言任务统一于相对可控的模型规模内。本文介绍了一种基于 ROS 2 的 Florence-2 封装器，该封装器通过三种互补的交互模式提供服务：持续话题驱动处理、同步服务调用和异步动作执行。该封装器设计用于本地运行，同时支持原生安装和 Docker 容器部署，并为面向检测的任务提供通用 JSON 输出与标准 ROS 2 消息绑定的结合方案。研究通过功能验证及多款 GPU 的吞吐量测试表明，该封装器可在消费级硬件上实现本地部署。项目代码库已公开：https://github.com/JEDominguezVidal/florence2_ros2_wrapper

TLDR: A ROS 2 wrapper for the Florence-2 vision-language model, enabling local, multi-modal perception tasks (captioning, detection, grounding) to be integrated into robotic systems via topic, service, and action interfaces.

简要说明: 为 Florence-2 视觉语言模型开发了一个 ROS 2 包装器，通过话题、服务和动作接口，支持将本地多模态感知任务（如描述、检测、接地）集成到机器人系统中。

Authors: J. E. Domínguez-Vidal

Stein Variational Uncertainty-Adaptive Model Predictive Control

Abstract (English): We propose a Stein variational distributionally robust controller for nonlinear dynamical systems with latent parametric uncertainty. The method is an alternative to conservative worst-case ambiguity-set optimization with a deterministic particle-based approximation of a task-dependent uncertainty distribution, enabling the controller to concentrate on parameter sensitivities that most strongly affect closed-loop performance. Our method yields a controller that is robust to latent parameter uncertainty by coupling optimal control with Stein variational inference, and avoiding restrictive parametric assumptions on the uncertainty model while preserving computational parallelism. In contrast to classical DRO, which can sacrifice nominal performance through worst-case design, we find our approach achieves robustness by shaping the control law around relevant uncertainty that are most critical to the task objective. The proposed framework therefore reconciles robust control and variational inference in a single decision-theoretic formulation for broad classes of control systems with parameter uncertainty. We demonstrate our approach on representative control problems that empirically illustrate improved performance-robustness tradeoffs over nominal, ensemble, and classical distributionally robust baselines.

摘要（中文）: 针对存在潜在参数不确定性的非线性动力系统，我们提出一种基于斯坦变分的分布鲁棒控制器。该方法摒弃了传统保守的、最坏情况下的模糊集优化，转而采用任务相关不确定性分布的确定性粒子近似，使控制器能够聚焦于对闭环性能影响最显著的系统参数敏感性。通过将最优控制与斯坦变分推理相结合，所提出的方法在保持计算并行性的同时，避免了对不确定性模型的限制性参数假设，从而生成对潜在参数不确定性具备鲁棒性的控制器。与经典分布鲁棒优化方法（通常会因最坏情况设计而牺牲标称性能）不同，我们的方法通过围绕对任务目标最关键的特定不确定性来构建控制律，从而实现鲁棒性。该框架首次将鲁棒控制与变分推理统一于适用于广泛参数不确定控制系统的单一决策理论表述中。我们在代表性控制问题上验证了该方法的有效性，实证结果表明其在性能与鲁棒性权衡方面优于标称控制、集成控制及经典分布鲁棒基线方法。

TLDR: The paper proposes a Stein variational distributionally robust controller for nonlinear dynamical systems with latent parametric uncertainty, which shapes the control law around task-relevant uncertainties to improve the performance-robustness trade-off.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于具有潜在参数不确定性的非线性动力系统的Stein变分分布鲁棒控制器，通过围绕任务相关的关键不确定性塑造控制律，以改善性能与鲁棒性的权衡。

Authors: Hrishikesh Sathyanarayan, Ian Abraham

Neural-Assisted in-Motion Self-Heading Alignment

Abstract (English): Autonomous platforms operating in the oceans require accurate navigation to successfully complete their mission. In this regard, the initial heading estimation accuracy and the time required to achieve it play a critical role. The initial heading is traditionally estimated by model-based approaches employing orientation decomposition. However, methods such as the dual vector decomposition and optimized attitude decomposition achieve satisfactory heading accuracy only after long alignment times. To allow rapid and accurate initial heading estimation, we propose an end-to-end, model-free, neural-assisted framework using the same inputs as the model-based approaches. Our proposed approach was trained and evaluated on real-world dataset captured by an autonomous surface vehicle. Our approach shows a significant accuracy improvement over the model-based approaches achieving an average absolute error improvement of 53%. Additionally, our proposed approach was able to reduce the alignment time by up to 67%. Thus, by employing our proposed approach, the reduction in alignment time and improved accuracy allow for a shorter deployment time of an autonomous platform and increased navigation accuracy during the mission.

摘要（中文）: 在海洋中运行的自主平台需要精确导航以成功完成任务。在这方面，初始航向估计的准确性及其所需时间起着关键作用。传统上，初始航向通过基于模型的方法进行估计，这类方法采用方向分解。然而，诸如双矢量分解和优化姿态分解等方法只有在较长的对准时间后才能达到满意的航向精度。为实现快速且准确的初始航向估计，我们提出了一种端到端、无模型、神经辅助的框架，其使用与基于模型的方法相同的输入。我们提出的方法通过在自主水面船捕获的真实数据集上进行训练和评估验证。实验结果表明，该方法相比于基于模型的方法在精度上有显著提升，平均绝对误差降低了53%。此外，所提方法能够将对准时间最多减少67%。因此，通过采用本文提出的方法，对准时间的缩短和精度的提高使得自主平台的部署时间更短，并在任务期间提升了导航精度。

TLDR: Proposes a neural network model to improve the speed and accuracy of initial heading estimation for autonomous marine vehicles, using real-world data from an autonomous surface vehicle.

简要说明: 提出一种神经网络模型，用于提高自主海洋航行器初始航向估计的速度和准确性，并使用了自主水面航行器的真实世界数据进行验证。

Authors: Zeev Yampolsky, Felipe O. Silva, Adriano Frutuoso, Itzik Klein

Infinite-Horizon Ergodic Control via Kernel Mean Embeddings

Abstract (English): This paper derives an infinite-horizon ergodic controller based on kernel mean embeddings for long-duration coverage tasks on general domains. While existing kernel-based ergodic control methods provide strong coverage guarantees on general coverage domains, their practical use has been limited to sub-ergodic, finite-time horizons due to intractable computational scaling, prohibiting its use for long-duration coverage. We resolve this scaling by deriving an infinite-horizon ergodic controller equipped with an extended kernel mean embedding error visitation state that recursively records state visitation. This extended state decouples past visitation from future control synthesis and expands ergodic control to infinite-time settings. In addition, we present a variation of the controller that operates on a receding-horizon control formulation with the extended error state. We demonstrate theoretical proof of asymptotic convergence of the derived controller and show preservation of ergodic coverage guarantees for a class of 2D and 3D coverage problems.

摘要（中文）: 本文提出了一种基于核均值嵌入的无限时遍历控制器，用于处理一般域上的长期覆盖任务。现有的基于核的遍历控制方法虽然在一般覆盖域上提供了强有力的覆盖保证，但由于计算复杂度难以处理，其实际应用仅限于次遍历的有限时域，无法适用于长期覆盖任务。我们通过引入一种扩展的核均值嵌入误差访问状态来解决这一扩展性问题，该状态递归记录状态访问历史。这种扩展状态将过去的访问与未来的控制合成解耦，并将遍历控制推广到无限时域场景。此外，我们提出了一种基于扩展误差状态、采用滚动时域控制框架的控制器变体。我们通过理论证明推导出控制器的渐近收敛性，并在一系列二维和三维覆盖问题中验证了其遍历覆盖保证的保持性。

TLDR: This paper introduces an infinite-horizon ergodic controller using kernel mean embeddings to solve the computational scaling problem for long-duration coverage tasks, with proofs of asymptotic convergence and demonstrations on 2D/3D problems.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于核均值嵌入的无限时域遍历控制器，用于解决长期覆盖任务中的计算复杂度问题，并在2D/3D问题上证明了渐近收敛性。

Authors: Christian Hughes, Ian Abraham

LiPS: Lightweight Panoptic Segmentation for Resource-Constrained Robotics

Abstract (English): Panoptic segmentation is a key enabler for robotic perception, as it unifies semantic understanding with object-level reasoning. However, the increasing complexity of state-of-the-art models makes them unsuitable for deployment on resource-constrained platforms such as mobile robots. We propose a novel approach called LiPS that addresses the challenge of efficient-to-compute panoptic segmentation with a lightweight design that retains query-based decoding while introducing a streamlined feature extraction and fusion pathway. It aims at providing a strong panoptic segmentation performance while substantially lowering the computational demands. Evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that LiPS attains accuracy comparable to much heavier baselines, while providing up to 4.5 higher throughput, measured in frames per second, and requiring nearly 6.8 times fewer computations. This efficiency makes LiPS a highly relevant bridge between modern panoptic models and real-world robotic applications.

摘要（中文）: 全景分割作为机器人感知的关键赋能技术，将语义理解与物体级推理统一于一体。然而，现有先进模型日益增长的复杂性使其难以部署在移动机器人等资源受限平台上。我们提出一种名为LiPS的新型方法，通过轻量化设计解决高效全景分割的挑战——在保留基于查询的解码机制的同时，引入精简的特征提取与融合路径。该方法旨在提供强大的全景分割性能，同时显著降低计算需求。在标准基准测试上的评估表明，LiPS实现了与计算量更大的基线模型相当的精度，同时帧率吞吐量提升达4.5倍，计算量减少近6.8倍。这种高效性使LiPS成为连接现代全景分割模型与真实世界机器人应用的重要桥梁。

TLDR: The paper proposes LiPS, a lightweight panoptic segmentation model designed for efficient deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms, achieving performance comparable to heavier models with significantly higher throughput and lower computational cost.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种名为 LiPS 的轻量级全景分割模型，专为资源受限的机器人平台高效部署而设计，在吞吐量和计算成本方面显著优于现有模型，同时保持相当的准确率。

Authors: Calvin Galagain, Martyna Poreba, François Goulette, Cyrill Stachniss

Certificate-Driven Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Path Finding with Inheritable Factorization

Abstract (English): Multi-agent coordination in automated warehouses and logistics is commonly modeled as the Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) problem. Closed-loop MAPF algorithms improve scalability by planning only the next movement and replanning online, but this finite-horizon viewpoint can be shortsighted and makes it difficult to preserve global guarantees and exploit compositional structure. This issue is especially visible in Anytime Closed-Loop Conflict-Based Search (ACCBS), which applies Conflict-Based Search (CBS) over dynamically extended finite horizons but, under finite computational budgets, may terminate with short active prefixes in dense instances. We introduce certificate trajectories and their associated fleet budget as a general mechanism for filtering closed-loop updates. A certificate provides a conflict-free fallback plan and a monotone upper bound on the remaining cost; accepting only certificate-improving updates yields completeness. The same budget information induces a budget-limited factorization that enables global, inheritable decomposition across timesteps. Instantiating the framework on ACCBS yields Certificate-Driven Conflict-Based Search (CDCBS). Experiments on benchmark maps show that CDCBS achieves more consistent solution quality than ACCBS, particularly in dense settings, while the proposed factorization reduces effective group size.

摘要（中文）: 自动化仓库与物流中的多智能体协同问题通常被建模为多智能体路径规划问题。闭环MAPF算法通过仅规划下一动作并在线重规划来提高可扩展性，但这种有限视野的视角可能缺乏远见，难以保持全局保证并利用组合结构。这一问题在"随时闭环冲突搜索"算法中尤为明显，该算法在动态扩展的有限视野上应用冲突搜索方法，但在有限计算预算下，可能在高密度场景中以较短的活跃前缀终止规划。 我们引入证书轨迹及其关联的舰队预算作为筛选闭环更新的通用机制。证书提供了无冲突的备用方案及剩余成本的单调上界；仅接受能改善证书的更新可确保算法完备性。同样的预算信息可导出预算约束的因子分解，实现跨时间步的全局可继承分解。将该框架应用于ACCBS算法，我们提出了证书驱动的冲突搜索算法。在基准地图上的实验表明，CDCBS在保证解质量一致性方面优于ACCBS，尤其在高密度场景中，同时所提出的因子分解机制有效降低了协作组规模。

TLDR: This paper introduces a certificate-driven framework for improving the online planning and scalability of multi-agent path finding, specifically enhancing the Anytime Closed-Loop Conflict-Based Search algorithm.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种证书驱动的框架，用于改进多智能体路径规划中的在线规划和可扩展性，特别增强了Anytime Closed-Loop Conflict-Based Search算法。

Authors: Jiarui Li, Runyu Zhang, Gioele Zardini

ReinDriveGen: Reinforcement Post-Training for Out-of-Distribution Driving Scene Generation

Abstract (English): We present ReinDriveGen, a framework that enables full controllability over dynamic driving scenes, allowing users to freely edit actor trajectories to simulate safety-critical corner cases such as front-vehicle collisions, drifting cars, vehicles spinning out of control, pedestrians jaywalking, and cyclists cutting across lanes. Our approach constructs a dynamic 3D point cloud scene from multi-frame LiDAR data, introduces a vehicle completion module to reconstruct full 360° geometry from partial observations, and renders the edited scene into 2D condition images that guide a video diffusion model to synthesize realistic driving videos. Since such edited scenarios inevitably fall outside the training distribution, we further propose an RL-based post-training strategy with a pairwise preference model and a pairwise reward mechanism, enabling robust quality improvement under out-of-distribution conditions without ground-truth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReinDriveGen outperforms existing approaches on edited driving scenarios and achieves state-of-the-art results on novel ego viewpoint synthesis.

摘要（中文）: 本文提出ReinDriveGen框架，该框架实现了对动态驾驶场景的完全可控性，允许用户自由编辑交通参与者的运动轨迹，以模拟前车碰撞、车辆漂移、失控旋转、行人乱穿马路、自行车横穿车道等安全关键场景。我们的方法从多帧激光雷达数据构建动态三维点云场景，引入车辆补全模块以根据部分观测数据重建完整360°几何结构，并将编辑后的场景渲染为二维条件图像，以引导视频扩散模型生成逼真的驾驶视频。由于此类编辑场景不可避免地超出训练数据分布，我们进一步提出基于强化学习的后训练策略，该策略结合成对偏好模型与成对奖励机制，能够在无真值监督的情况下，针对分布外场景实现稳健的质量提升。大量实验表明，ReinDriveGen在编辑驾驶场景任务中优于现有方法，并在新型自车视角合成任务中取得了最先进的性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning post-training framework for generating out-of-distribution driving scenarios, such as collisions and pedestrian jaywalking, using a video diffusion model guided by edited 3D scene point clouds.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的后训练框架，用于生成分布外驾驶场景（如碰撞、行人乱穿马路等），通过编辑3D点云场景来指导视频扩散模型生成逼真视频。

Authors: Hao Zhang, Lue Fan, Weikang Bian, Zehuan Wu, Lewei Lu, Zhaoxiang Zhang, Hongsheng Li

ReMoGen: Real-time Human Interaction-to-Reaction Generation via Modular Learning from Diverse Data

Abstract (English): Human behaviors in real-world environments are inherently interactive, with an individual's motion shaped by surrounding agents and the scene. Such capabilities are essential for applications in virtual avatars, interactive animation, and human-robot collaboration. We target real-time human interaction-to-reaction generation, which generates the ego's future motion from dynamic multi-source cues, including others' actions, scene geometry, and optional high-level semantic inputs. This task is fundamentally challenging due to (i) limited and fragmented interaction data distributed across heterogeneous single-person, human-human, and human-scene domains, and (ii) the need to produce low-latency yet high-fidelity motion responses during continuous online interaction. To address these challenges, we propose ReMoGen (Reaction Motion Generation), a modular learning framework for real-time interaction-to-reaction generation. ReMoGen leverages a universal motion prior learned from large-scale single-person motion datasets and adapts it to target interaction domains through independently trained Meta-Interaction modules, enabling robust generalization under data-scarce and heterogeneous supervision. To support responsive online interaction, ReMoGen performs segment-level generation together with a lightweight Frame-wise Segment Refinement module that incorporates newly observed cues at the frame level, improving both responsiveness and temporal coherence without expensive full-sequence inference. Extensive experiments across human-human, human-scene, and mixed-modality interaction settings show that ReMoGen produces high-quality, coherent, and responsive reactions, while generalizing effectively across diverse interaction scenarios.

摘要（中文）: 现实环境中的人类行为本质上是交互式的，个体的运动受到周围智能体与场景的塑造。这种能力对于虚拟化身、交互式动画和人机协作等应用至关重要。本研究聚焦于实时的人类交互-反应生成任务，即从动态多源线索（包括他人动作、场景几何结构及可选的高层语义输入）中生成自身未来运动。该任务面临两大根本挑战：（一）交互数据有限且分散于异质的单人、人-人及人-场景领域；（二）需要在连续在线交互过程中产生低延迟、高保真的运动响应。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了ReMoGen（反应运动生成）——一个用于实时交互-反应生成的模块化学习框架。该框架通过从大规模单人运动数据中学习的通用运动先验，借助独立训练的元交互模块适应目标交互领域，从而在数据稀缺和异质监督条件下实现稳健泛化。为支持响应式在线交互，ReMoGen采用分段式生成策略，并结合轻量级帧级分段优化模块，该模块能在帧级别整合新观测到的线索，在不依赖高成本全序列推理的情况下，同步提升系统响应能力与时间连贯性。在人-人、人-场景及多模态交互场景中进行的大量实验表明，ReMoGen能够生成高质量、连贯且响应迅速的反应动作，并在多样化的交互场景中展现出良好的泛化能力。

TLDR: Proposes a modular framework for real-time human motion generation from multi-source interaction cues, using a universal motion prior and domain-specific modules for generalization in data-scarce settings, with potential applications in human-robot collaboration.

简要说明: 提出一个模块化框架，用于从多源交互线索中实时生成人体运动，利用通用运动先验和特定领域模块实现数据稀缺环境下的泛化，适用于人机协作等领域。

Authors: Yaoqin Ye, Yiteng Xu, Qin Sun, Xinge Zhu, Yujing Sun, Yuexin Ma

A 4D Representation for Training-Free Agentic Reasoning from Monocular Laparoscopic Video

Abstract (English): Spatiotemporal reasoning is a fundamental capability for artificial intelligence (AI) in soft tissue surgery, paving the way for intelligent assistive systems and autonomous robotics. While 2D vision-language models show increasing promise at understanding surgical video, the spatial complexity of surgical scenes suggests that reasoning systems may benefit from explicit 4D representations. Here, we propose a framework for equipping surgical agents with spatiotemporal tools based on an explicit 4D representation, enabling AI systems to ground their natural language reasoning in both time and 3D space. Leveraging models for point tracking, depth, and segmentation, we develop a coherent 4D model with spatiotemporally consistent tool and tissue semantics. A Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) then acts as an agent on tools derived from the explicit 4D representation (e.g., trajectories) without any fine-tuning. We evaluate our method on a new dataset of 134 clinically relevant questions and find that the combination of a general purpose reasoning backbone and our 4D representation significantly improves spatiotemporal understanding and allows for 4D grounding. We demonstrate that spatiotemporal intelligence can be "assembled" from 2D MLLMs and 3D computer vision models without additional training. Code, data, and examples are available at https://tum-ai.github.io/surg4d/

摘要（中文）: 时空推理是人工智能在软组织手术中的一项核心能力，为智能辅助系统与自主机器人技术铺平了道路。虽然二维视觉语言模型在理解手术视频方面展现出日益广阔的前景，但手术场景的空间复杂性表明，推理系统可能受益于显式的四维表征。本文提出一个框架，基于显式四维表征为手术智能体配备时空推理工具，使人工智能系统能够将其自然语言推理建立在时间与三维空间的双重基础上。利用点跟踪、深度估计与分割模型，我们构建了一个具有时空一致性的工具与组织语义的连贯四维模型。随后，一个多模态大语言模型作为智能体，直接基于显式四维表征（如轨迹）导出的工具进行推理，无需任何微调。我们在包含134个临床相关问题的新数据集上评估了所提方法，发现通用推理主干与四维表征的结合显著提升了时空理解能力，并实现了四维语义关联。实验证明，时空智能无需额外训练即可从二维多模态大语言模型与三维计算机视觉模型中“组装”实现。代码、数据及示例详见 https://tum-ai.github.io/surg4d/。

TLDR: This paper proposes a framework for surgical AI agents using a 4D representation (3D space + time) built from 2D video and computer vision models, enabling training-free natural language reasoning for spatiotemporal tasks in soft tissue surgery.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种用于手术AI智能体的框架，该框架利用从2D视频和计算机视觉模型构建的4D表示（3D空间+时间），实现了在软组织手术中对时空任务进行免训练的自然语言推理。

Authors: Maximilian Fehrentz, Nicolas Stellwag, Robert Wiebe, Nicole Thorisch, Fabian Grob, Patrick Remerscheid, Ken-Joel Simmoteit, Benjamin D. Killeen, Christian Heiliger, Nassir Navab

Towards Viewpoint-Robust End-to-End Autonomous Driving with 3D Foundation Model Priors

Abstract (English): Robust trajectory planning under camera viewpoint changes is important for scalable end-to-end autonomous driving. However, existing models often depend heavily on the camera viewpoints seen during training. We investigate an augmentation-free approach that leverages geometric priors from a 3D foundation model. The method injects per-pixel 3D positions derived from depth estimates as positional embeddings and fuses intermediate geometric features through cross-attention. Experiments on the VR-Drive camera viewpoint perturbation benchmark show reduced performance degradation under most perturbation conditions, with clear improvements under pitch and height perturbations. Gains under longitudinal translation are smaller, suggesting that more viewpoint-agnostic integration is needed for robustness to camera viewpoint changes.

摘要（中文）: 在相机视角变化下进行稳健的轨迹规划对于可扩展的端到端自动驾驶具有重要意义。然而，现有模型往往严重依赖训练期间所见的相机视角。本研究探索了一种免增强方法，该方法利用来自三维基础模型的几何先验知识。该技术通过注入从深度估计中提取的像素级三维位置作为位置编码，并借助交叉注意力机制融合中间几何特征。在VR-Drive相机视角扰动基准测试中的实验表明，在大多数扰动条件下模型性能下降幅度减小，尤其在俯仰角与高度扰动场景下改善明显。纵向平移条件下的增益相对较小，这表明需要更具视角无关性的集成方法以实现对相机视角变化的鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method to improve the robustness of end-to-end autonomous driving models to camera viewpoint changes by integrating 3D geometric priors from a foundation model, without data augmentation.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种方法，通过集成来自基础模型的3D几何先验知识来提升端到端自动驾驶模型对相机视角变化的鲁棒性，且无需数据增强。

Authors: Hiroki Hashimoto, Hiromichi Goto, Hiroyuki Sugai, Hiroshi Kera, Kazuhiko Kawamoto

Safe learning-based control via function-based uncertainty quantification

Abstract (English): Uncertainty quantification is essential when deploying learning-based control methods in safety-critical systems. This is commonly realized by constructing uncertainty tubes that enclose the unknown function of interest, e.g., the reward and constraint functions or the underlying dynamics model, with high probability. However, existing approaches for uncertainty quantification typically rely on restrictive assumptions on the unknown function, such as known bounds on functional norms or Lipschitz constants, and struggle with discontinuities. In this paper, we model the unknown function as a random function from which independent and identically distributed realizations can be generated, and construct uncertainty tubes via the scenario approach that hold with high probability and rely solely on the sampled realizations. We integrate these uncertainty tubes into a safe Bayesian optimization algorithm, which we then use to safely tune control parameters on a real Furuta pendulum.

摘要（中文）: 在安全关键系统中部署基于学习的控制方法时，不确定性量化至关重要。这通常通过构建不确定性管来实现，该管以高概率包围目标未知函数，如奖励函数、约束函数或底层动力学模型。然而，现有的不确定性量化方法通常依赖于对未知函数的严格假设，例如函数范数或李普希茨常数的已知界限，且难以处理不连续性。本文中，我们将未知函数建模为随机函数，可从中生成独立同分布的实现样本，并利用场景方法构建仅依赖于采样实现的不确定性管，确保其以高概率成立。我们将这些不确定性管集成到一种安全贝叶斯优化算法中，并应用于真实Furuta摆的控制参数安全调优。

TLDR: The paper proposes a method for safe learning-based control using function-based uncertainty quantification via a scenario approach, and applies it to safely tune control parameters on a real Furuta pendulum.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种基于场景方法的安全学习控制方法，通过函数不确定性量化，并应用于真实Furuta摆的安全控制参数调整。

Authors: Abdullah Tokmak, Toni Karvonen, Thomas B. Schön, Dominik Baumann

Full-Gradient Successor Feature Representations

Abstract (English): Successor Features (SF) combined with Generalized Policy Improvement (GPI) provide a robust framework for transfer learning in Reinforcement Learning (RL) by decoupling environment dynamics from reward functions. However, standard SF learning methods typically rely on semi-gradient Temporal Difference (TD) updates. When combined with non-linear function approximation, semi-gradient methods lack robust convergence guarantees and can lead to instability, particularly in the multi-task setting where accurate feature estimation is critical for effective GPI. Inspired by Full Gradient DQN, we propose Full-Gradient Successor Feature Representations Q-Learning (FG-SFRQL), an algorithm that optimizes the successor features by minimizing the full Mean Squared Bellman Error. Unlike standard approaches, our method computes gradients with respect to parameters in both the online and target networks. We provide a theoretical proof of almost-sure convergence for FG-SFRQL and demonstrate empirically that minimizing the full residual leads to superior sample efficiency and transfer performance compared to semi-gradient baselines in both discrete and continuous domains.

摘要（中文）: 后继特征与广义策略改进相结合，通过将环境动态与奖励函数解耦，为强化学习中的迁移学习提供了稳健框架。然而，标准后继特征学习方法通常依赖于半梯度时序差分更新。当与非线性函数逼近结合使用时，半梯度方法缺乏可靠的收敛保证，并可能导致不稳定，特别是在多任务场景中——此时准确的特征估计对广义策略改进至关重要。受全梯度深度Q网络启发，我们提出全梯度后继特征表示Q学习算法，该算法通过最小化全均方贝尔曼误差来优化后继特征。与标准方法不同，本方法同时计算在线网络和目标网络参数的梯度。我们为全梯度后继特征表示Q学习提供了几乎必然收敛的理论证明，并通过实验验证：在离散和连续领域中，相较于半梯度基线方法，最小化全残差能带来更优的样本效率和迁移性能。

TLDR: Proposes FG-SFRQL, a method for learning successor features using full gradient updates, offering theoretical convergence guarantees and improved sample efficiency/transfer for multi-task RL.

简要说明: 提出FG-SFRQL方法，通过全梯度更新学习后继特征，提供理论收敛保证，在离散和连续域中展现出比半梯度基线更优的样本效率和迁移性能。

Authors: Ritish Shrirao, Aditya Priyadarshi, Raghuram Bharadwaj Diddigi

Data-Driven Reachability Analysis via Diffusion Models with PAC Guarantees

Abstract (English): We present a data-driven framework for reachability analysis of nonlinear dynamical systems that requires no explicit model. A denoising diffusion probabilistic model learns the time-evolving state distribution of a dynamical system from trajectory data alone. The predicted reachable set takes the form of a sublevel set of a nonconformity score derived from the reconstruction error, with the threshold calibrated via the Learn Then Test procedure so that the probability of excluding a reachable state is bounded with high probability. Experiments on three nonlinear systems, a forced Duffing oscillator, a planar quadrotor, and a high-dimensional reaction-diffusion system, confirm that the empirical miss rate remains below the Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) bound while scaling to state dimensions beyond the reach of classical grid-based and polynomial methods.

摘要（中文）: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的非线性动态系统可达性分析框架，该框架无需显式模型。通过去噪扩散概率模型，仅依据轨迹数据即可学习动态系统随时间演化的状态分布。预测的可达集采用重构误差导出的非一致性分数的子水平集形式，其阈值通过"学习后测试"程序进行校准，以确保排除可达状态的概率在高置信度下受控。在三个非线性系统——受迫杜芬振子、平面四旋翼飞行器以及高维反应扩散系统上的实验表明，该框架在扩展到超出传统网格法和多项式方法处理能力的高维状态空间时，其经验漏报率仍能保持在概率近似正确界限以下。

TLDR: This paper presents a data-driven framework for reachability analysis of nonlinear dynamical systems using diffusion models, with PAC guarantees, tested on systems like a planar quadrotor.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于扩散模型的数据驱动框架，用于非线性动力系统的可达性分析，具有PAC保证，并在平面四旋翼等系统上进行了验证。

Authors: Yanliang Huang, Peng Xie, Wenyuan Wu, Zhuoqi Zeng, Amr Alanwar

ProOOD: Prototype-Guided Out-of-Distribution 3D Occupancy Prediction

Abstract (English): 3D semantic occupancy prediction is central to autonomous driving, yet current methods are vulnerable to long-tailed class bias and out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs, often overconfidently assigning anomalies to rare classes. We present ProOOD, a lightweight, plug-and-play method that couples prototype-guided refinement with training-free OOD scoring. ProOOD comprises (i) prototype-guided semantic imputation that fills occluded regions with class-consistent features, (ii) prototype-guided tail mining that strengthens rare-class representations to curb OOD absorption, and (iii) EchoOOD, which fuses local logit coherence with local and global prototype matching to produce reliable voxel-level OOD scores. Extensive experiments on five datasets demonstrate that ProOOD achieves state-of-the-art performance on both in-distribution 3D occupancy prediction and OOD detection. On SemanticKITTI, it surpasses baselines by +3.57% mIoU overall and +24.80% tail-class mIoU; on VAA-KITTI, it improves AuPRCr by +19.34 points, with consistent gains across benchmarks. These improvements yield more calibrated occupancy estimates and more reliable OOD detection in safety-critical urban driving. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/7uHeng/ProOOD.

摘要（中文）: 三维语义占据预测是自动驾驶的核心任务，然而现有方法容易受到长尾类别偏差和分布外（OOD）输入的影响，常常将异常数据过度自信地归类为罕见类别。本文提出ProOOD，一种轻量级即插即用方法，通过原型引导优化与免训练的OOD评分机制相结合。ProOOD包含三个核心模块：（1）原型引导的语义填补，利用类别一致特征填充被遮挡区域；（2）原型引导的尾部挖掘，强化罕见类别表征以抑制OOD吸收；（3）EchoOOD模块，融合局部逻辑一致性与局部全局原型匹配，生成可靠的体素级OOD评分。在五个数据集上的大量实验表明，ProOOD在分布内三维占据预测和OOD检测方面均达到最先进性能。在SemanticKITTI数据集上，其整体mIoU超越基线方法3.57%，尾部类别mIoU提升24.80%；在VAA-KITTI数据集上，AuPRCr指标提升19.34分，且在多个基准测试中均保持稳定增益。这些改进为安全关键的城市驾驶场景提供了更精准的占据估计和更可靠的OOD检测能力。源代码已公开于https://github.com/7uHeng/ProOOD。

TLDR: ProOOD improves 3D semantic occupancy prediction and OOD detection for autonomous driving by using prototype-guided refinement and a novel training-free OOD scoring method.

简要说明: ProOOD通过原型引导的精炼和一种无需训练的新颖OOD评分方法，提升了自动驾驶中的3D语义占用预测和OOD检测性能。
