Authors: Yuheng Zhang, Mengfei Duan, Kunyu Peng, Yuhang Wang, Di Wen, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool, Kailun Yang

An Integrated Soft Robotic System for Measuring Vital Signs in Search and Rescue Environments

Abstract (English): Robots are frequently utilized in search-and-rescue operations. In recent years, significant advancements have been made in the field of victim assessment. However, there are still open issues regarding heart rate measurement, and no studies have been found that assess pressure in post-disaster scenarios. This work designs a soft gripper and integrates it into a mobile robotic system, thereby creating a device capable of measuring the pulse and blood pressure of victims in post-disaster environments. The gripper is designed to envelop the victim's arm and inflate like a sphygmomanometer, facilitated by a specialized portability system. The utilization of different signal processing algorithms has enabled the attainment of a pulse bias of \qty{4}{\bpm} and a bias of approximately \qty{5}{\mmHg} for systolic and diastolic pressures. The findings, in conjunction with the other statistical data and the validation of homoscedasticity in the error terms, prove the system's capacity to accurately determine heart rate and blood pressure, thereby rendering it suitable for search and rescue operations. Finally, a post-disaster has been employed as a test to validate the functionality of the entire system and to demonstrate its capacity to adapt to various victim positions, its measurement speed, and its safety for victims.

摘要（中文）: 机器人在搜救行动中已得到广泛应用。近年来，遇险者评估领域取得了显著进展。然而，心率测量方面仍存在未解决的问题，且尚未发现针对灾后场景压力评估的研究。本研究设计了一种软体抓取器，并将其集成到移动机器人系统中，从而创建了一种能够在灾后环境中测量遇险者脉搏和血压的装置。该抓取器设计用于包裹遇险者手臂，并借助专用便携系统实现类似血压计的充气功能。通过采用不同的信号处理算法，系统实现了脉搏测量误差为4次/分钟，收缩压与舒张压测量误差约为5毫米汞柱。研究结果结合其他统计数据及误差项同方差性的验证，证明了该系统能够准确测定心率和血压，从而适用于搜救行动。最后，通过模拟灾后场景测试验证了整套系统的功能，并展示了其适应不同遇险者体位的能力、测量速度以及对遇险者的安全性。

TLDR: This paper presents a soft gripper integrated into a mobile robotic system for measuring pulse and blood pressure of victims in search-and-rescue scenarios, achieving clinically relevant accuracy.

简要说明: 本研究提出了一种集成到移动机器人系统中的软体抓取器，用于在搜救场景中测量受害者的脉搏和血压，并达到了临床相关的精度。

Authors: Jorge Francisco García-Samartín, Christyan Cruz Ulloa, Andrés Sánchez-Silva, Jaime del Cerro, Antonio Barrientos

A Dual-Action Fabric-Based Soft Robotic Glove for Ergonomic Hand Rehabilitation

Abstract (English): Hand impairment following neurological disorders substantially limits independence in activities of daily living, motivating the development of effective assistive and rehabilitation strategies. Soft robotic gloves have attracted growing interest in this context, yet persistent challenges in customization, ergonomic fit, and flexion-extension actuation constrain their clinical utility. Here, we present a dual-action fabric-based soft robotic glove incorporating customized actuators aligned with individual finger joints. The glove comprises five independently controlled dual-action actuators supporting finger flexion and extension, together with a dedicated thumb abduction actuator. Leveraging computer numerical control heat sealing technology, we fabricated symmetrical-chamber actuators that adopt a concave outer surface upon inflation, thereby maximizing finger contact area and improving comfort. Systematic characterization confirmed that the actuators generate sufficient joint moment and fingertip force for ADL-relevant tasks, and that the complete glove system produces adequate grasping force for common household objects. A preliminary study with ten healthy subjects demonstrated that active glove assistance significantly reduces forearm muscle activity during object manipulation. A pilot feasibility study with three individuals with cervical spinal cord injury across seven functional tasks indicated that glove assistance promotes more natural grasp patterns and reduces reliance on tenodesis grasp, although at the cost of increased task completion time attributable to the current actuation interface. This customizable, ergonomic design represents a practical step toward personalized hand rehabilitation and assistive robotics.

摘要（中文）: 神经系统疾病导致的手部功能障碍严重限制了日常生活的独立性，这推动了对有效辅助与康复策略的研究。在此背景下，软体机器人手套日益受到关注，但定制化、人体工学适配以及屈伸驱动等方面的持续挑战制约了其临床实用性。本文提出一种基于纺织材料的双作用软体机器人手套，其搭载的定制化执行器与手指各关节一一对应。该手套包含五个独立控制的双作用执行器，分别支持手指屈曲与伸展，并配备专用的拇指外展执行器。利用计算机数控热封技术，我们制造了具有对称腔室的执行器，其在充气时呈现凹形外表面，从而最大化手指接触面积并提升舒适度。系统性能测试表明，执行器能产生满足日常生活相关任务所需的关节力矩与指尖力，完整手套系统对常见家用物品可产生足够的抓握力。一项针对十名健康受试者的初步研究表明，在操作物体时，手套的主动辅助能显著降低前臂肌肉活动度。针对三名颈脊髓损伤患者开展的七项功能任务的初步可行性研究显示，手套辅助能促进更自然的抓握模式并减少对肌腱固定式抓握的依赖，但由于当前驱动接口的限制，任务完成时间有所增加。这种可定制化且符合人体工学的设计，为个性化手部康复与辅助机器人技术迈出了实用化的一步。

TLDR: A customizable soft robotic glove with dual-action actuators assists hand rehabilitation and grasp tasks, reducing forearm muscle activity and enabling more natural grasp patterns.

简要说明: 一款基于织物的可定制软体机器人手套，具有双重驱动执行器，用于辅助手部康复和抓握任务，减少前臂肌肉活动，实现更自然的抓握模式。

Authors: Rui Chen, Firman Isma Serdana, Domenico Chiaradia, Xianlong Mai, Elena Losanno, Gabriele Righi, Claudia De Santis, Federica Serra, Vincent Mendez, Cristian Camardella, Daniele Leonardis, Giulio Del Popolo, Silvestro Micera, Antonio Frisoli

Reachability-Aware Time Scaling for Path Tracking

Abstract (English): This paper studies tracking of collision-free waypoint paths produced by an offline planner for a planar double-integrator system with bounded speed and acceleration. Because sampling-based planners must route around obstacles, the resulting waypoint paths can contain sharp turns and high-curvature regions, so one-step reachability under acceleration limits becomes critical even when the path geometry is collision-free. We build on a pure-pursuit-style, reachability-guided quadratic-program (QP) tracker with a one-step acceleration margin. Offline, we evaluate this margin along a spline fitted to the waypoint path and update a scalar speed-scaling profile so that the required one-step acceleration remains below the available bound. Online, the same look-ahead tracking structure is used to track the scaled reference.

摘要（中文）: 本文研究针对具有有界速度与加速度的平面双积分器系统，对离线规划器生成的无碰撞航点路径进行跟踪的问题。基于采样的规划器在避障过程中形成的航点路径可能包含急转弯与高曲率区域，因此即使路径几何形状本身无碰撞，在加速度限制下的单步可达性仍至关重要。我们基于一种纯追踪式、具有单步加速度裕度的可达性引导二次规划跟踪器，离线阶段通过对拟合航点路径的样条曲线评估该裕度，并更新标量速度缩放曲线，使所需单步加速度始终低于可用界限。在线阶段，采用相同的前瞻跟踪结构对缩放后的参考路径进行跟踪。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method for scaling the speed profile of a pre-planned waypoint path to ensure that a planar double-integrator system can track it without violating acceleration constraints, using a reachability-guided quadratic-program tracker.

简要说明: 本文提出一种方法，通过可达性引导的二次规划跟踪器，对预先规划的路径点路径进行速度缩放，以确保平面双积分器系统能在不违反加速度约束的情况下进行跟踪。

Authors: Hossein Gholampour, Logan E. Beaver

Play-Testing REMind: Evaluating an Educational Robot-Mediated Role-Play Game

Abstract (English): This paper presents REMind, an innovative educational robot-mediated role-play game designed to support anti-bullying bystander intervention among children. REMind invites players to observe a bullying scenario enacted by social robots, reflect on the perspectives of the characters, and rehearse defending strategies by puppeteering a robotic avatar. We evaluated REMind through a mixed-methods play-testing study with 18 children aged 9--10. The findings suggest that the experience supported key learning goals related to self-efficacy, perspective-taking, understanding outcomes of defending, and intervention strategies. These results highlight the promise of Robot-Mediated Applied Drama (RMAD) as a novel pedagogical framework to support Social-Emotional Learning.

摘要（中文）: 本文介绍了REMind，这是一款创新的教育机器人中介角色扮演游戏，旨在支持儿童反欺凌旁观者干预。REMind通过社交机器人演绎的欺凌情境，邀请玩家观察并反思角色立场，同时通过操控机器人化身来演练防御策略。我们通过混合方法对18名9至10岁儿童进行游戏测试研究，评估了REMind的效果。研究结果表明，该体验有助于提升与自我效能、观点采择、理解防御行为后果及干预策略相关的关键学习目标。这些发现凸显了机器人中介应用戏剧作为一种支持社会情感学习的新型教学框架的潜力。

TLDR: Paper introduces REMind, an educational role-play game using social robots to teach anti-bullying bystander intervention to children, evaluated in a study with 9-10 year olds.

Authors: Elaheh Sanoubari, Neil Fernandes, Keith Rebello, Alicia Pan, Andrew Houston, Kerstin Dautenhahn

Neural Harmonic Textures for High-Quality Primitive Based Neural Reconstruction

Abstract (English): Primitive-based methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting have recently become the state-of-the-art for novel-view synthesis and related reconstruction tasks. Compared to neural fields, these representations are more flexible, adaptive, and scale better to large scenes. However, the limited expressivity of individual primitives makes modeling high-frequency detail challenging. We introduce Neural Harmonic Textures, a neural representation approach that anchors latent feature vectors on a virtual scaffold surrounding each primitive. These features are interpolated within the primitive at ray intersection points. Inspired by Fourier analysis, we apply periodic activations to the interpolated features, turning alpha blending into a weighted sum of harmonic components. The resulting signal is then decoded in a single deferred pass using a small neural network, significantly reducing computational cost. Neural Harmonic Textures yield state-of-the-art results in real-time novel view synthesis while bridging the gap between primitive- and neural-field-based reconstruction. Our method integrates seamlessly into existing primitive-based pipelines such as 3DGUT, Triangle Splatting, and 2DGS. We further demonstrate its generality with applications to 2D image fitting and semantic reconstruction.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 基于图元的方法（如3D高斯泼溅）近年来已成为新视角合成及相关重建任务的前沿技术。与神经场相比，这类表征方式更具灵活性、适应性，并能更好地扩展至大场景。然而，单个图元的有限表达能力使其难以建模高频细节。我们提出神经谐波纹理，这是一种将潜在特征向量锚定于每个图元外围虚拟支架的神经表征方法。这些特征在光线交点处由图元内部插值生成。受傅里叶分析启发，我们对插值后的特征施加周期性激活，将透明度混合转换为谐波分量的加权和。随后通过小型神经网络在单次延迟计算中解码生成信号，显著降低了计算成本。神经谐波纹理在实时新视角合成中取得了领先成果，同时弥合了基于图元与基于神经场的重建方法之间的差距。该方法可无缝集成到现有图元流程中，如3DGUT、三角泼溅和2DGS。我们进一步通过二维图像拟合和语义重建应用证明了其通用性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Neural Harmonic Textures, a neural representation that combines primitive-based methods with neural fields to improve high-frequency detail modeling in novel-view synthesis and 3D reconstruction.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种名为神经谐波纹理的神经表示方法，通过结合基于基元的方法和神经场，在新型视图合成和3D重建中更好地建模高频细节。

Authors: Jorge Condor, Nicolas Moenne-Loccoz, Merlin Nimier-David, Piotr Didyk, Zan Gojcic, Qi Wu

Lightweight Prompt-Guided CLIP Adaptation for Monocular Depth Estimation

Abstract (English): Leveraging the rich semantic features of vision-language models (VLMs) like CLIP for monocular depth estimation tasks is a promising direction, yet often requires extensive fine-tuning or lacks geometric precision. We present a parameter-efficient framework, named MoA-DepthCLIP, that adapts pretrained CLIP representations for monocular depth estimation with minimal supervision. Our method integrates a lightweight Mixture-of-Adapters (MoA) module into the pretrained Vision Transformer (ViT-B/32) backbone combined with selective fine-tuning of the final layers. This design enables spatially-aware adaptation, guided by a global semantic context vector and a hybrid prediction architecture that synergizes depth bin classification with direct regression. To enhance structural accuracy, we employ a composite loss function that enforces geometric constraints. On the NYU Depth V2 benchmark, MoA-DepthCLIP achieves competitive results, significantly outperforming the DepthCLIP baseline by improving the $δ_1$ accuracy from 0.390 to 0.745 and reducing the RMSE from 1.176 to 0.520. These results are achieved while requiring substantially few trainable parameters, demonstrating that lightweight, prompt-guided MoA is a highly effective strategy for transferring VLM knowledge to fine-grained monocular depth estimation tasks.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 利用CLIP等视觉语言模型（VLM）的丰富语义特征进行单目深度估计任务，是一个极具前景的研究方向，但通常需要大量微调或缺乏几何精度。我们提出了一种参数高效的框架——MoA-DepthCLIP，该框架能够以最小监督的方式，将预训练的CLIP表征迁移至单目深度估计任务中。我们的方法通过在预训练的视觉Transformer（ViT-B/32）骨干网络中集成轻量级混合适配器模块，并配合对最后几层的选择性微调来实现。该设计由全局语义上下文向量和混合预测架构引导，实现空间感知的自适应，并协同利用深度分类与直接回归进行预测。为提升结构准确性，我们采用了一种复合损失函数以强化几何约束。在NYU Depth V2基准测试中，MoA-DepthCLIP取得了具有竞争力的结果，显著超越了DepthCLIP基线模型：将$δ_1$准确率从0.390提升至0.745，同时将RMSE从1.176降低至0.520。这些结果是在所需可训练参数大幅减少的情况下实现的，表明轻量级、提示引导的混合适配器是一种将VLM知识迁移至细粒度单目深度估计任务的高效策略。

TLDR: Proposes MoA-DepthCLIP, a lightweight, prompt-guided adaptation of CLIP for monocular depth estimation using a Mixture-of-Adapters and hybrid prediction, achieving strong performance on NYU Depth V2 with few parameters.

简要说明: 提出MoA-DepthCLIP，一种轻量级、提示引导的CLIP自适应方法，用于单目深度估计，通过混合适配器和混合预测实现，在NYU Depth V2上取得优异性能且参数少。

Authors: Reyhaneh Ahani Manghotay, Jie Liang

Automated Framework to Evaluate and Harden LLM System Instructions against Encoding Attacks

Abstract (English): System Instructions in Large Language Models (LLMs) are commonly used to enforce safety policies, define agent behavior, and protect sensitive operational context in agentic AI applications. These instructions may contain sensitive information such as API credentials, internal policies, and privileged workflow definitions, making system instruction leakage a critical security risk highlighted in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Without incurring the overhead costs of reasoning models, many LLM applications rely on refusal-based instructions that block direct requests for system instructions, implicitly assuming that prohibited information can only be extracted through explicit queries. We introduce an automated evaluation framework that tests whether system instructions remain confidential when extraction requests are re-framed as encoding or structured output tasks. Across four common models and 46 verified system instructions, we observe high attack success rates (> 0.7) for structured serialization where models refuse direct extraction requests but disclose protected content in the requested serialization formats. We further demonstrate a mitigation strategy based on one-shot instruction reshaping using a Chain-of-Thought reasoning model, indicating that even subtle changes in wording and structure of system instructions can significantly reduce attack success rate without requiring model retraining.

摘要（中文）: 大语言模型中的系统指令常用于强化安全策略、定义智能体行为，以及在自主AI应用中保护敏感操作上下文。这些指令可能包含API凭证、内部策略和特权工作流定义等敏感信息，使得系统指令泄露成为OWASP大语言模型应用十大安全风险中的关键隐患。为规避推理模型的高成本开销，当前许多大语言模型应用依赖基于拒绝的指令机制来拦截直接获取系统指令的请求，其隐含假设是受保护信息仅能通过显式查询提取。本文提出一种自动化评估框架，用于测试当提取请求被重构为编码或结构化输出任务时，系统指令的保密性是否仍能维持。通过对四种常见模型和46条已验证系统指令的实验，我们观察到在结构化序列化场景中，攻击成功率始终较高（>0.7）：模型虽拒绝直接提取请求，却会以要求的序列化格式泄露受保护内容。我们进一步提出基于单样本指令重构的缓解策略，该策略利用思维链推理模型实现，结果表明即使仅对系统指令的措辞和结构进行细微调整，也能在不重新训练模型的情况下显著降低攻击成功率。

TLDR: This paper presents an automated framework to test and improve the security of LLM system instructions against attacks that extract sensitive information through encoding or structured output tasks.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种自动化框架，用于测试和增强LLM系统指令的安全性，以抵御通过编码或结构化输出任务提取敏感信息的攻击。

Authors: Anubhab Sahu, Diptisha Samanta, Reza Soosahabi

Omni-SimpleMem: Autoresearch-Guided Discovery of Lifelong Multimodal Agent Memory

Abstract (English): AI agents increasingly operate over extended time horizons, yet their ability to retain, organize, and recall multimodal experiences remains a critical bottleneck. Building effective lifelong memory requires navigating a vast design space spanning architecture, retrieval strategies, prompt engineering, and data pipelines; this space is too large and interconnected for manual exploration or traditional AutoML to explore effectively. We deploy an autonomous research pipeline to discover Omni-SimpleMem, a unified multimodal memory framework for lifelong AI agents. Starting from a naïve baseline (F1=0.117 on LoCoMo), the pipeline autonomously executes ${\sim}50$ experiments across two benchmarks, diagnosing failure modes, proposing architectural modifications, and repairing data pipeline bugs, all without human intervention in the inner loop. The resulting system achieves state-of-the-art on both benchmarks, improving F1 by +411% on LoCoMo (0.117$\to$0.598) and +214% on Mem-Gallery (0.254$\to$0.797) relative to the initial configurations. Critically, the most impactful discoveries are not hyperparameter adjustments: bug fixes (+175%), architectural changes (+44%), and prompt engineering (+188% on specific categories) each individually exceed the cumulative contribution of all hyperparameter tuning, demonstrating capabilities fundamentally beyond the reach of traditional AutoML. We provide a taxonomy of six discovery types and identify four properties that make multimodal memory particularly suited for autoresearch, offering guidance for applying autonomous research pipelines to other AI system domains. Code is available at this https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleMem.

摘要（中文）: AI智能体在越来越长的时间跨度内运行，但其保留、组织与回忆多模态体验的能力仍是一个关键瓶颈。构建有效的终身记忆系统需探索一个广阔的设计空间，涵盖架构、检索策略、提示工程与数据管道；这一空间过于庞大且相互关联，难以通过手动探索或传统AutoML进行有效探索。本研究部署了一个自主研究流程，以发现Omni-SimpleMem——一个用于终身AI智能体的统一多模态记忆框架。从一个简单基线开始（在LoCoMo基准上F1分数为0.117），该流程在两个基准测试中自主执行了约50次实验，诊断失败模式、提出架构改进方案并修复数据管道错误，且所有内部循环均无需人工干预。最终系统在两项基准测试中均达到最优水平：相较于初始配置，在LoCoMo上将F1分数提升了411%（0.117→0.598），在Mem-Gallery上提升了214%（0.254→0.797）。关键发现是，最具影响力的改进并非来自超参数调整：错误修复（+175%）、架构调整（+44%）及特定类别的提示工程优化（+188%）各自对性能提升的贡献均超过所有超参数调优的累积效果，这证明了其能力已远超传统AutoML范畴。本研究提出了六种发现类型的分类体系，并归纳了使多模态记忆系统特别适合自主研究的四个特性，为将自主研究流程应用于其他AI系统领域提供指导。代码已发布于https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleMem。

TLDR: This paper presents Omni-SimpleMem, a multimodal memory framework for lifelong AI agents, autonomously discovered and optimized through an automated research pipeline, achieving state-of-the-art results on agent memory benchmarks.

简要说明: 本文提出了Omni-SimpleMem，这是一个通过自动化研究流程自主发现和优化的终身AI智能体多模态记忆框架，在智能体记忆基准测试中取得了最先进的结果。

Authors: Jiaqi Liu, Zipeng Ling, Shi Qiu, Yanqing Liu, Siwei Han, Peng Xia, Haoqin Tu, Zeyu Zheng, Cihang Xie, Charles Fleming, Mingyu Ding, Huaxiu Yao

IWP: Token Pruning as Implicit Weight Pruning in Large Vision Language Models

Abstract (English): Large Vision Language Models show impressive performance across image and video understanding tasks, yet their computational cost grows rapidly with the number of visual tokens. Existing token pruning methods mitigate this issue through empirical approaches while overlooking the internal mechanism of attention. In this paper, we propose a novel training free token pruning framework grounded in the dual form perspective of attention. We reformulate attention as an implicit linear layer whose weight matrix is the sum of rank 1 outer products, each generated by a single token's key value pair. Token pruning thus reduces to selecting an optimal subset of these rank 1 updates that best approximates the original dual weight matrix. Extending this perspective to standard softmax attention in LVLMs, we derive a novel metric quantifying both a token's information magnitude and information duplication. To efficiently select the subset with the proposed metric, we introduce Progressive Chunked Maximal Marginal Relevance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a better trade off between performance and efficiency, while providing another perspective on existing pruning approaches.

摘要（中文）: 大型视觉语言模型在图像和视频理解任务中展现出令人瞩目的性能，但其计算成本随视觉标记数量的增加而迅速增长。现有的标记剪枝方法通过经验性策略缓解这一问题，却往往忽视了注意力机制的内在机理。本文基于注意力对偶形式的视角，提出一种无需训练的新型标记剪枝框架。我们将注意力重新表述为一个隐式线性层，其权重矩阵由多个秩为1的外积求和构成，每个外积由单个标记的键值对生成。标记剪枝因此转化为从这些秩1更新中选择一个最优子集，以最佳逼近原始对偶权重矩阵。将此视角延伸至大型视觉语言模型中的标准软注意力机制，我们推导出一种新的量化指标，可同时衡量标记的信息量级与信息冗余度。为基于该指标高效选取子集，我们提出了渐进式分块最大边际相关性算法。大量实验表明，我们的方法在性能与效率之间实现了更优的平衡，同时为现有剪枝方法提供了新的理论视角。

TLDR: The paper proposes a training-free token pruning method for Large Vision-Language Models by viewing attention as an implicit linear layer and selecting tokens to best approximate its dual weight matrix, aiming to improve efficiency with minimal performance loss.

简要说明: 本文提出一种无需训练的大型视觉语言模型令牌剪枝方法，从注意力对偶形式的角度将令牌剪枝转化为选择最优的秩1更新子集，以提高模型效率。

Authors: Dong-Jae Lee, Sunghyun Baek, Junmo Kim

Executing as You Generate: Hiding Execution Latency in LLM Code Generation

Abstract (English): Current LLM-based coding agents follow a serial execution paradigm: the model first generates the complete code, then invokes an interpreter to execute it. This sequential workflow leaves the executor idle during generation and the generator idle during execution, resulting in unnecessary end-to-end latency. We observe that, unlike human developers, LLMs produce code tokens sequentially without revision, making it possible to execute code as it is being generated. We formalize this parallel execution paradigm, modeling it as a three-stage pipeline of generation, detection, and execution, and derive closed-form latency bounds that characterize its speedup potential and operating regimes. We then present Eager, a concrete implementation featuring AST-based chunking, dynamic batching with gated execution, and early error interruption. We evaluate Eager across four benchmarks, seven LLMs, and three execution environments. Results show that Eager reduces the non-overlapped execution latency by up to 99.9% and the end-to-end latency by up to 55% across seven LLMs and four benchmarks.

摘要（中文）: 现有基于大型语言模型的编码代理遵循串行执行范式：模型先生成完整代码，再调用解释器执行。这种顺序工作流导致生成阶段执行器闲置、执行阶段生成器闲置，从而产生不必要的端到端延迟。我们观察到，与人类开发者不同，大型语言模型无需修改即可顺序生成代码令牌，这使得在代码生成过程中同步执行成为可能。我们将这种并行执行范式形式化，将其建模为生成、检测与执行的三阶段流水线，并通过闭式延迟边界刻画其加速潜力与运行区间。随后提出具体实现方案Eager，该方案具备基于抽象语法树的代码块划分、带门控执行的动态批处理以及早期错误中断等核心机制。我们在四个基准测试集、七种大型语言模型及三种执行环境中对Eager进行评估。实验结果表明，在七种大型语言模型与四个基准测试中，Eager将非重叠执行延迟降低最高达99.9%，端到端延迟降低最高达55%。

TLDR: Introduces a parallel execution paradigm and system called 'Eager' to reduce latency in LLM-based code generation by executing code as it is generated, rather than waiting for the full generation.

简要说明: 提出了一种名为'Eager'的并行执行范式和系统，通过在生成代码时执行代码（而非等待完整生成）来降低LLM代码生成的整体延迟。

Authors: Zhensu Sun, Zhihao Lin, Zhi Chen, Chengran Yang, Mingyi Zhou, Li Li, David Lo

Signals: Trajectory Sampling and Triage for Agentic Interactions

Abstract (English): Agentic applications based on large language models increasingly rely on multi-step interaction loops involving planning, action execution, and environment feedback. While such systems are now deployed at scale, improving them post-deployment remains challenging. Agent trajectories are voluminous and non-deterministic, and reviewing each one, whether through human review or auxiliary LLMs, is slow and cost-prohibitive. We propose a lightweight, signal-based framework for triaging agentic interaction trajectories. Our approach computes cheap, broadly applicable signals from live interactions and attaches them as structured attributes for trajectory triage, identifying interactions likely to be informative without affecting online agent behavior. We organize signals into a coarse-grained taxonomy spanning interaction (misalignment, stagnation, disengagement, satisfaction), execution (failure, loop), and environment (exhaustion), designed for computation without model calls. In a controlled annotation study on $τ$-bench, a widely used benchmark for tool-augmented agent evaluation, we show that signal-based sampling achieves an 82\% informativeness rate compared to 74\% for heuristic filtering and 54\% for random sampling, with a 1.52x efficiency gain per informative trajectory. The advantage is robust across reward strata and task domains, confirming that signals provide genuine per-trajectory informativeness gains rather than merely oversampling obvious failures. These results show that lightweight signals can serve as practical sampling infrastructure for agentic systems, and suggest a path toward preference data construction and post-deployment optimization.

摘要（中文）: 基于大语言模型的智能体应用日益依赖包含规划、动作执行与环境反馈的多步交互循环。尽管此类系统已大规模部署，但其部署后的改进仍面临挑战：智能体轨迹数据量庞大且具有不确定性，通过人工审查或辅助大语言模型逐条分析的方式效率低下且成本高昂。我们提出一种轻量级、基于信号的智能体交互轨迹分类框架。该方法从实时交互中计算廉价且广泛适用的信号，并将其作为结构化属性附加至轨迹以实现分类，从而在不影响在线智能体行为的前提下识别可能蕴含信息的交互。我们将信号组织为粗粒度分类体系，涵盖交互（失准、停滞、脱离、满意度）、执行（失败、循环）及环境（资源耗尽）等维度，设计时无需模型调用即可完成计算。在广泛使用的工具增强智能体评估基准$τ$-bench上进行的受控标注研究表明：基于信号采样的信息获取率达82%，显著优于启发式过滤的74%和随机采样的54%，且每条信息轨迹的获取效率提升1.52倍。该优势在不同奖励层级与任务领域中均保持稳健，证实信号能真实提升单条轨迹的信息价值，而非仅对明显失败案例的过采样。这些结果表明，轻量级信号可作为智能体系统的实用采样基础设施，并为偏好数据构建与部署后优化提供可行路径。

TLDR: The paper proposes a lightweight signal-based framework for efficiently sampling and triaging informative trajectories in agentic interaction loops, improving post-deployment optimization without online overhead.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于信号的轻量级框架，用于高效采样和分类智能体交互轨迹中的关键信息，从而在不影响在线行为的情况下改进部署后优化。

Authors: Shuguang Chen, Adil Hafeez, Salman Paracha

The Geometry of Compromise: Unlocking Generative Capabilities via Controllable Modality Alignment

Abstract (English): Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP learn a shared embedding space for images and text, yet their representations remain geometrically separated, a phenomenon known as the modality gap. This gap limits tasks requiring cross-modal interchangeability, such as captioning and joint clustering. Existing post-processing approaches can partially improve cross-modal compatibility; however, we show through geometric analysis that they primarily reduce the global centroid offset while leaving the underlying distributional mismatch intact. We decompose the modality gap into a Centroid Gap and a Distribution Gap, and demonstrate that the Distribution Gap is the true predictor of cross-modal task quality ($R^2 = 0.986$), whereas the commonly used Raw Gap is misleading ($R^2 = 0.691$). Motivated by this observation, we propose TPC-CMA (Three-Phase Curriculum for Cross-Modal Alignment), a fine-tuning framework that explicitly reduces both components. The proposed CMA jointly mitigates centroid offsets and reshapes the distributional structure, while a three-phase curriculum with gradient-aware scheduling progressively introduces alignment during training to enable stable optimization. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves cross-modal alignment. With $α_{\text{target}}{=}0.05$, the modality gap is reduced by 66.6\% with only 4.84\% accuracy drop. Under stronger alignment ($α_{\text{target}}{=}0.5$), the gap is reduced by 82.3\%, clustering ARI improves from 0.318 to 0.516, and captioning CIDEr increases by 57.1\% over the original model. Our code and pre-trained models will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）: 如CLIP等视觉语言模型（VLMs）学习了一个图像与文本的共享嵌入空间，但其表征在几何上仍存在分离现象，即所谓的模态鸿沟。该鸿沟限制了需要跨模态互换性的任务，如图片描述和联合聚类。现有的后处理方法可以部分改善跨模态兼容性；然而，通过几何分析我们发现，这些方法主要减少了全局质心偏移，而未能解决内在的分布不匹配问题。本文将模态鸿沟分解为质心鸿沟与分布鸿沟，并证明分布鸿沟是跨模态任务质量的真实预测指标（决定系数 $R^2 = 0.986$），而常用的原始鸿沟则具有误导性（$R^2 = 0.691$）。基于此发现，我们提出TPC-CMA（面向跨模态对齐的三阶段课程学习框架），这是一种显式减少两个分量的微调方法。该框架通过联合优化质心偏移和重构分布结构来改善对齐，同时采用梯度感知调度的三阶段课程学习策略，在训练过程中逐步引入对齐目标以实现稳定优化。实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了跨模态对齐效果。在 $α_{\text{目标}}{=}0.05$ 的设置下，模态鸿沟降低了66.6%，而准确率仅下降4.84%。在更强对齐条件下（$α_{\text{目标}}{=}0.5$），模态鸿沟减少82.3%，聚类调整兰德指数从0.318提升至0.516，图片描述的CIDEr分数相比原始模型提高了57.1%。我们的代码与预训练模型将在论文录用后公开。

TLDR: This paper proposes a fine-tuning framework to close the modality gap in Vision-Language Models by decomposing it into centroid and distribution gaps, significantly improving cross-modal alignment for tasks like captioning and clustering.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种微调框架，将视觉-语言模型中的模态鸿沟分解为质心鸿沟和分布鸿沟，通过减少两者来显著提升跨模态对齐能力，在图像描述和聚类等任务上取得改进。

Authors: Hongyuan Liu, Qinli Yang, Wen Li, Zhong Zhang, Jiaming Liu, Wei Han, Zhili Qin, Jinxia Guo, Junming Shao

Hybrid Energy-Based Models for Physical AI: Provably Stable Identification of Port-Hamiltonian Dynamics

Abstract (English): Energy-based models (EBMs) implement inference as gradient descent on a learned Lyapunov function, yielding interpretable, structure-preserving alternatives to black-box neural ODEs and aligning naturally with physical AI. Yet their use in system identification remains limited, and existing architectures lack formal stability guarantees that globally preclude unstable modes. We address this gap by introducing an EBM framework for system identification with stable, dissipative, absorbing invariant dynamics. Unlike classical global Lyapunov stability, absorbing invariance expands the class of stability-preserving architectures, enabling more flexible and expressive EBMs. We extend EBM theory to nonsmooth activations by establishing negative energy dissipation via Clarke derivatives and deriving new conditions for radial unboundedness, exposing a stability-expressivity tradeoff in standard EBMs. To overcome this, we introduce a hybrid architecture with a dynamical visible layer and static hidden layers, prove absorbing invariance under mild assumptions, and show that these guarantees extend to port-Hamiltonian EBMs. Experiments on metric-deformed multi-well and ring systems validate the approach, showcasing how our hybrid EBM architecture combines expressivity with sound and provable safety guarantees by design.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 基于能量的模型（EBMs）通过在学习得到的李雅普诺夫函数上执行梯度下降来实现推理，从而为黑箱神经常微分方程提供了可解释、结构保持的替代方案，并与物理人工智能自然契合。然而，其在系统辨识中的应用仍较为有限，且现有架构缺乏能够全局排除不稳定模式的形式稳定性保证。本文通过提出一种具有稳定、耗散、吸收不变动态的系统辨识EBM框架，弥补了这一不足。与经典的全局李雅普诺夫稳定性不同，吸收不变性扩展了保持稳定性的架构类别，从而实现了更灵活、表达能力更强的EBMs。我们通过基于克拉克导数建立负能量耗散并推导径向无界的新条件，将EBM理论拓展至非光滑激活函数，揭示了标准EBMs中稳定性与表达性之间的权衡。为克服这一局限，我们引入一种具有动态可见层与静态隐藏层的混合架构，证明其在温和假设下具备吸收不变性，并指出这些保证可推广至端口-哈密顿EBMs。在度量形变多势阱与环形系统上的实验验证了该方法的有效性，展示了我们的混合EBM架构如何通过设计，将表达能力与可靠且可证明的安全性保障相结合。

TLDR: The paper introduces a hybrid energy-based model framework for identifying port-Hamiltonian dynamical systems with formal stability guarantees, using absorbing invariance to expand the class of stable architectures while preserving expressivity.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种用于识别端口哈密顿动力系统的混合能量基模型框架，该框架具有形式化稳定性保证，通过吸收不变性扩展了稳定架构的类别，同时保持了表达能力。

Authors: Simone Betteti, Luca Laurenti

Open-Set Supervised 3D Anomaly Detection: An Industrial Dataset and a Generalisable Framework for Unknown Defects

Abstract (English): Although self-supervised 3D anomaly detection assumes that acquiring high-precision point clouds is computationally expensive, in real manufacturing scenarios it is often feasible to collect a limited number of anomalous samples. Therefore, we study open-set supervised 3D anomaly detection, where the model is trained with only normal samples and a small number of known anomalous samples, aiming to identify unknown anomalies at test time. We present Open-Industry, a high-quality industrial dataset containing 15 categories, each with five real anomaly types collected from production lines. We first adapt general open-set anomaly detection methods to accommodate 3D point cloud inputs better. Building upon this, we propose Open3D-AD, a point-cloud-oriented approach that leverages normal samples, simulated anomalies, and partially observed real anomalies to model the probability density distributions of normal and anomalous data. Then, we introduce a simple Correspondence Distributions Subsampling to reduce the overlap between normal and non-normal distributions, enabling stronger dual distributions modeling. Based on these contributions, we establish a comprehensive benchmark and evaluate the proposed method extensively on Open-Industry as well as established datasets including Real3D-AD and Anomaly-ShapeNet. Benchmark results and ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of Open3D-AD and further reveal the potential of open-set supervised 3D anomaly detection.

摘要（中文）: 尽管自监督三维异常检测通常假设获取高精度点云计算成本高昂，但在实际制造场景中，采集有限数量的异常样本往往是可行的。因此，我们研究开放集监督式三维异常检测，该模型仅使用正常样本和少量已知异常样本进行训练，旨在测试阶段识别未知异常。我们提出Open-Industry数据集——一个包含15个类别的高质量工业数据集，每个类别涵盖从生产线上收集的五种真实异常类型。我们首先将通用开放集异常检测方法进行调整，以更好地适应三维点云输入。在此基础上，我们提出Open3D-AD方法：一种面向点云的技术，通过利用正常样本、模拟异常和部分观测到的真实异常，对正常与异常数据的概率密度分布进行建模。随后，我们引入一种简单的对应分布子采样策略，以减小正常与非正常分布之间的重叠，从而实现更强大的双分布建模。基于这些贡献，我们建立了完整的基准测试体系，并在Open-Industry及现有数据集（包括Real3D-AD和Anomaly-ShapeNet）上对所提方法进行了广泛评估。基准测试结果与消融实验证明了Open3D-AD的有效性，并进一步揭示了开放集监督式三维异常检测的潜力。

TLDR: This paper introduces a dataset and a method for supervised 3D anomaly detection using point clouds, focusing on identifying unknown defects in industrial manufacturing scenarios.

简要说明: 本文介绍了用于工业制造场景下，基于点云的有监督3D异常检测的数据集和方法，旨在识别未知缺陷。

Authors: Hanzhe Liang, Luocheng Zhang, Junyang Xia, HanLiang Zhou, Bingyang Guo, Yingxi Xie, Can Gao, Ruiyun Yu, Jinbao Wang, Pan Li

PDA: Text-Augmented Defense Framework for Robust Vision-Language Models against Adversarial Image Attacks

Abstract (English): Vision-language models (VLMs) are vulnerable to adversarial image perturbations. Existing works based on adversarial training against task-specific adversarial examples are computationally expensive and often fail to generalize to unseen attack types. To address these limitations, we introduce Paraphrase-Decomposition-Aggregation (PDA), a training-free defense framework that leverages text augmentation to enhance VLM robustness under diverse adversarial image attacks. PDA performs prompt paraphrasing, question decomposition, and consistency aggregation entirely at test time, thus requiring no modification on the underlying models. To balance robustness and efficiency, we instantiate PDA as invariants that reduce the inference cost while retaining most of its robustness gains. Experiments on multiple VLM architectures and benchmarks for visual question answering, classification, and captioning show that PDA achieves consistent robustness gains against various adversarial perturbations while maintaining competitive clean accuracy, establishing a generic, strong and practical defense framework for VLMs during inference.

摘要（中文）: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）易受对抗性图像扰动的影响。现有基于任务特定对抗样本的对抗训练方法计算成本高昂，且通常难以泛化至未见过的攻击类型。针对这些局限性，我们提出一种无需训练的多功能防御框架——复述-分解-聚合（PDA）。该框架通过文本增强技术，在多样化对抗性图像攻击下提升视觉语言模型的鲁棒性。PDA框架在测试阶段完全通过提示复述、问题分解和一致性聚合实现防御，无需修改底层模型。为平衡鲁棒性与效率，我们将PDA实例化为轻量化变体，在保持绝大部分鲁棒性增益的同时显著降低推理成本。在视觉问答、分类和描述生成等任务的多基准测试中，针对多种视觉语言模型架构的实验表明，PDA能够持续提升模型对抗各类扰动的鲁棒性，同时保持具有竞争力的清洁样本准确率，为视觉语言模型在推理阶段提供了通用、强效且实用的防御框架。

TLDR: Proposes a training-free defense framework (PDA) that uses text augmentation at inference to improve the robustness of Vision-Language Models against adversarial image attacks, evaluated on VQA, classification, and captioning tasks.

简要说明: 提出了一种免训练的防御框架（PDA），通过文本增强提高视觉语言模型在推理阶段对对抗性图像攻击的鲁棒性，并在视觉问答、分类和字幕生成等任务上进行了评估。

Authors: Jingning Xu, Haochen Luo, Chen Liu

Benchmarking and Mechanistic Analysis of Vision-Language Models for Cross-Depiction Assembly Instruction Alignment

Abstract (English): 2D assembly diagrams are often abstract and hard to follow, creating a need for intelligent assistants that can monitor progress, detect errors, and provide step-by-step guidance. In mixed reality settings, such systems must recognize completed and ongoing steps from the camera feed and align them with the diagram instructions. Vision Language Models (VLMs) show promise for this task, but face a depiction gap because assembly diagrams and video frames share few visual features. To systematically assess this gap, we construct IKEA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,623 questions across 6 task types on 29 IKEA furniture products, and evaluate 19 VLMs (2B-38B) under three alignment strategies. Our key findings: (1) assembly instruction understanding is recoverable via text, but text simultaneously degrades diagram-to-video alignment; (2) architecture family predicts alignment accuracy more strongly than parameter count; (3) video understanding remains a hard bottleneck unaffected by strategy. A three-level mechanistic analysis further reveals that diagrams and video occupy disjoint ViT subspaces, and that adding text shifts models from visual to text-driven reasoning. These results identify visual encoding as the primary target for improving cross-depiction robustness. Project page: https://ryenhails.github.io/IKEA-Bench/

摘要（中文）: 二维组装图通常较为抽象且难以理解，这催生了对于智能辅助系统的需求，这类系统能够监测组装进度、检测错误并提供分步指导。在混合现实环境中，此类系统必须从摄像头画面中识别已完成和进行中的步骤，并将其与图示说明对齐。视觉语言模型在该任务中展现出潜力，但由于组装图与视频帧之间共享的视觉特征极少，面临着表征鸿沟的挑战。为系统评估这一差距，我们构建了IKEA-Bench基准测试集，涵盖29款宜家家具产品的6类任务共计1623个问题，并在三种对齐策略下评估了19个参数量级从2B到38B的视觉语言模型。主要发现包括：（1）通过文本可恢复组装指令理解，但文本会同时削弱图示与视频的对齐能力；（2）模型架构家族对对齐准确性的预测力强于参数数量；（3）视频理解仍是难以突破的瓶颈，且不受策略影响。三级机制分析进一步表明，图示与视频在视觉Transformer的子空间中占据分离区域，而添加文本会使模型从视觉驱动转向文本驱动推理。这些结果表明视觉编码是提升跨表征鲁棒性的核心优化方向。项目页面：https://ryenhails.github.io/IKEA-Bench/

TLDR: The paper introduces IKEA-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models on aligning abstract 2D assembly diagrams with real-world video frames, finding that visual encoding is the primary bottleneck for cross-depiction robustness.

简要说明: 该论文提出了IKEA-Bench，一个用于评估视觉语言模型在将抽象2D组装图与真实世界视频帧对齐方面性能的基准，发现视觉编码是跨描绘鲁棒性的主要瓶颈。

Authors: Zhuchenyang Liu, Yao Zhang, Yu Xiao

TTA-Vid: Generalized Test-Time Adaptation for Video Reasoning

Abstract (English): Recent video reasoning models have shown strong results on temporal and multimodal understanding, yet they depend on large-scale supervised data and multi-stage training pipelines, making them costly to train and difficult to adapt to new domains. In this work, we leverage the paradigm of Test-Time Reinforcement Learning on video-language data to allow for adapting a pretrained model to incoming video samples at test-time without explicit labels. The proposed test-time adaptation for video approach (TTA-Vid) combines two components that work simultaneously: (1) a test-time adaptation that performs step-by-step reasoning at inference time on multiple frame subsets. We then use a batch-aware frequency-based reward computed across different frame subsets as pseudo ground truth to update the model. It shows that the resulting model trained on a single batch or even a single sample from a dataset, is able to generalize at test-time to the whole dataset and even across datasets. Because the adaptation occurs entirely at test time, our method requires no ground-truth annotations or dedicated training splits. Additionally, we propose a multi-armed bandit strategy for adaptive frame selection that learns to prioritize informative frames, guided by the same reward formulation. Our evaluation shows that TTA-Vid yields consistent improvements across various video reasoning tasks and is able to outperform current state-of-the-art methods trained on large-scale data. This highlights the potential of test-time reinforcement learning for temporal multimodal understanding.

摘要（中文）: 最近的视频推理模型在时序和多模态理解上取得了显著成果，但其依赖大规模监督数据与多阶段训练流程，导致训练成本高昂且难以适应新领域。本研究利用视频语言数据的测试时强化学习范式，使预训练模型能够在无明确标注的情况下，针对输入视频样本在测试阶段进行自适应调整。所提出的视频测试时自适应方法（TTA-Vid）融合了两个协同工作的组件：（1）通过测试时自适应机制，在推理阶段对多组帧子集执行逐步推理，并利用跨帧子集计算的批次感知频率奖励作为伪真值来更新模型。实验表明，仅使用单批次甚至单样本数据训练的模型，能够在测试阶段泛化至整个数据集乃至跨数据集场景。由于自适应过程完全在测试时进行，该方法无需真实标注或专用训练数据分割。此外，我们提出一种基于多臂老虎机策略的自适应帧选择方法，该策略通过相同奖励机制引导模型优先学习信息量丰富的帧。评估结果显示，TTA-Vid在多种视频推理任务中持续提升性能，并能够超越当前基于大规模数据训练的最先进方法，这证明了测试时强化学习在时序多模态理解领域的应用潜力。

TLDR: The paper proposes TTA-Vid, a test-time reinforcement learning method for adapting pretrained video-language models to unlabeled video samples at inference time, using batch-aware rewards and adaptive frame selection.

简要说明: 该论文提出TTA-Vid方法，这是一种测试时强化学习范式，用于在推理时让预训练的视频-语言模型适应无标签的视频样本，利用批感知奖励和自适应帧选择策略。

Authors: Soumya Shamarao Jahagirdar, Edson Araujo, Anna Kukleva, M. Jehanzeb Mirza, Saurabhchand Bhati, Samuel Thomas, Brian Kingsbury, Rogerio Feris, James R. Glass, Hilde Kuehne

STAR: Mitigating Cascading Errors in Spatial Reasoning via Turn-point Alignment and Segment-level DPO

Abstract (English): Structured spatial navigation is a core benchmark for Large Language Models (LLMs) spatial reasoning. Existing paradigms like Visualization-of-Thought (VoT) are prone to cascading errors in complex topologies. To solve this, we propose STAR, a two-stage framework grounded on topological anchors, and introduce the RedMaze-23K dataset with human-inspired turnpoint annotations. The first stage uses supervised fine-tuning to help models internalize spatial semantics and prune redundant paths. The second adopts Spatial-aware Segment-level Direct Preference Optimization (SDPO) to refine self-correction in long-horizon navigation. Experiments show STAR achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models: its 32B variant outperforms DeepSeek-V3 (29.27% vs. 25.00%) and reaches 82.4% of GPT-4's performance.

摘要（中文）: 结构化空间导航是评估大语言模型空间推理能力的核心基准。现有范式如思维可视化在复杂拓扑结构中容易产生级联误差。为解决此问题，我们提出了基于拓扑锚点的两阶段框架STAR，并构建了包含人类启发性转向点标注的RedMaze-23K数据集。第一阶段通过监督微调使模型内化空间语义并剪除冗余路径；第二阶段采用空间感知分段直接偏好优化，提升长视野导航中的自我校正能力。实验表明，STAR在开源模型中达到最先进性能：其320亿参数版本以29.27%的准确率超越DeepSeek-V3（25.00%），达到GPT-4性能的82.4%。

TLDR: The paper proposes a two-stage framework (STAR) to improve spatial reasoning in LLMs for navigation tasks, using supervised fine-tuning and a novel spatial-aware DPO to mitigate cascading errors in complex environments.

简要说明: 本文提出一个两阶段框架（STAR）来提升大语言模型在导航任务中的空间推理能力，通过有监督微调和一种新颖的空间感知DPO来缓解复杂环境中的级联错误。

Authors: Pukun Zhao, Longxiang Wang, Chen Chen, Peicheng Wang, Fanqing Zhou, Runze Li, Haojian Huang

Bridging the Simulation-to-Experiment Gap with Generative Models using Adversarial Distribution Alignment

Abstract (English): A fundamental challenge in science and engineering is the simulation-to-experiment gap. While we often possess prior knowledge of physical laws, these physical laws can be too difficult to solve exactly for complex systems. Such systems are commonly modeled using simulators, which impose computational approximations. Meanwhile, experimental measurements more faithfully represent the real world, but experimental data typically consists of observations that only partially reflect the system's full underlying state. We propose a data-driven distribution alignment framework that bridges this simulation-to-experiment gap by pre-training a generative model on fully observed (but imperfect) simulation data, then aligning it with partial (but real) observations of experimental data. While our method is domain-agnostic, we ground our approach in the physical sciences by introducing Adversarial Distribution Alignment (ADA). This method aligns a generative model of atomic positions -- initially trained on a simulated Boltzmann distribution -- with the distribution of experimental observations. We prove that our method recovers the target observable distribution, even with multiple, potentially correlated observables. We also empirically validate our framework on synthetic, molecular, and experimental protein data, demonstrating that it can align generative models with diverse observables. Our code is available at https://kaityrusnelson.com/ada/.

摘要（中文）: 科学和工程领域的一个根本性挑战在于模拟与实验之间的差距。尽管我们通常对物理定律拥有先验知识，但这些物理定律在求解复杂系统时往往过于困难，难以精确解析。此类系统通常使用模拟器进行建模，但模拟器会引入计算近似。与此同时，实验测量能更真实地反映现实世界，但实验数据通常仅包含部分反映系统完整底层状态的观测结果。我们提出了一种数据驱动的分布对齐框架，该框架通过在完全观测（但不完美）的模拟数据上预训练生成模型，再将其与部分（但真实）的实验观测数据进行对齐，从而弥合这一模拟与实验的差距。尽管我们的方法适用于不同领域，但我们在物理科学中引入了对抗性分布对齐（ADA）来具体实现该方法。该方法将原子位置的生成模型（最初基于模拟的玻尔兹曼分布训练）与实验观测数据的分布进行对齐。我们证明，即使存在多个潜在相关的观测变量，我们的方法也能恢复目标观测分布。我们还在合成数据、分子数据以及实验蛋白质数据上进行了实证验证，结果表明该方法能够将生成模型与多样化的观测数据对齐。相关代码可在 https://kaityrusnelson.com/ada/ 获取。

TLDR: The paper proposes a domain-agnostic method, Adversarial Distribution Alignment (ADA), to bridge the simulation-to-experiment gap by aligning generative models pre-trained on simulation data with partial experimental observations, validated on synthetic, molecular, and experimental protein data.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种领域无关的方法，即对抗性分布对齐，通过将预训练在模拟数据上的生成模型与部分实验观测数据对齐，以弥合仿真到实验的鸿沟，并在合成、分子和实验蛋白质数据上进行了验证。

Authors: Kai Nelson, Tobias Kreiman, Sergey Levine, Aditi S. Krishnapriyan

A Survey of On-Policy Distillation for Large Language Models

Abstract (English): Knowledge distillation has become a primary mechanism for transferring reasoning and domain expertise from frontier Large Language Models (LLMs) to smaller, deployable students. However, the dominant paradigm remains \textit{off-policy}: students train on static teacher-generated data and never encounter their own errors during learning. This train--test mismatch, an instance of \textit{exposure bias}, causes prediction errors to compound autoregressively at inference time. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) addresses this by letting the student generate its own trajectories and receive teacher feedback on these self-generated outputs, grounding distillation in the theory of interactive imitation learning. Despite rapid growth spanning divergence minimization, reward-guided learning, and self-play, the OPD literature remains fragmented with no unified treatment. This survey provides the first comprehensive overview of OPD for LLMs. We introduce a unified $f$-divergence framework over on-policy samples and organize the landscape along three orthogonal dimensions: \emph{feedback signal} (logit-based, outcome-based, or self-play), \emph{teacher access} (white-box, black-box, or teacher-free), and \emph{loss granularity} (token-level, sequence-level, or hybrid). We systematically analyze representative methods, examine industrial deployments, and identify open problems including distillation scaling laws, uncertainty-aware feedback, and agent-level distillation.

摘要（中文）: 知识蒸馏已成为将前沿大语言模型的推理能力与领域专长迁移至小型可部署模型的主要机制。然而，当前主流范式仍以离线策略为主：学生模型在静态的教师生成数据上进行训练，在学习过程中从未接触自身错误。这种训练与推理的错位（即暴露偏差的一种表现）会导致预测误差在自回归推理过程中不断累积。在线策略蒸馏通过让学生模型生成自身轨迹并接收教师对这些自生成输出的反馈，将蒸馏过程建立在交互式模仿学习理论基础上，从而解决了上述问题。尽管该领域在散度最小化、奖励引导学习和自我博弈等方向快速发展，但相关研究仍处于碎片化状态，缺乏统一的理论框架。本文首次系统综述了大语言模型的在线策略蒸馏方法：我们引入了基于在线策略样本的f-散度统一框架，并沿三个正交维度梳理研究脉络：反馈信号（基于逻辑值、基于结果或自我博弈）、教师访问权限（白盒、黑盒或无教师）以及损失粒度（词元级、序列级或混合级）。我们系统分析了代表性方法，考察了工业部署实践，并指出包括蒸馏缩放定律、不确定性感知反馈和智能体级蒸馏在内的开放性问题。

TLDR: This survey paper introduces a unified framework for On-Policy Distillation (OPD) in LLMs, categorizing methods by feedback signal, teacher access, and loss granularity to address exposure bias in knowledge transfer.

简要说明: 本文综述了大型语言模型中的策略蒸馏方法，提出了一个统一的框架，按反馈信号、教师访问和损失粒度对方法进行分类，以解决知识转移中的暴露偏差问题。

Authors: Mingyang Song, Mao Zheng

Internal State-Based Policy Gradient Methods for Partially Observable Markov Potential Games

Abstract (English): This letter studies multi-agent reinforcement learning in partially observable Markov potential games. Solving this problem is challenging due to partial observability, decentralized information, and the curse of dimensionality. First, to address the first two challenges, we leverage the common information framework, which allows agents to act based on both shared and local information. Second, to ensure tractability, we study an internal state that compresses accumulated information, preventing it from growing unboundedly over time. We then implement an internal state-based natural policy gradient method to find Nash equilibria of the Markov potential game. Our main contribution is to establish a non-asymptotic convergence bound for this method. Our theoretical bound decomposes into two interpretable components: a statistical error term that also arises in standard Markov potential games, and an approximation error capturing the use of finite-state controllers. Finally, simulations across multiple partially observable environments demonstrate that the proposed method using finite-state controllers achieves consistent improvements in performance compared to the setting where only the current observation is used.

摘要（中文）: 本文研究了部分可观测马尔可夫势博弈中的多智能体强化学习问题。由于部分可观测性、信息分散性以及维度灾难的存在，解决该问题具有挑战性。首先，为应对前两个挑战，我们利用共同信息框架，使智能体能够基于共享信息和局部信息做出决策。其次，为确保计算可行性，我们研究了一种压缩累积信息的内部状态表示方法，防止其随时间无限增长。随后，我们实现了基于内部状态的自然策略梯度算法来求解马尔可夫势博弈的纳什均衡。本文的主要贡献在于为该算法建立了非渐近收敛界。我们的理论界可分解为两个可解释的组成部分：标准马尔可夫势博弈中存在的统计误差项，以及表征有限状态控制器使用效果的近似误差项。最后，通过在多个部分可观测环境中的仿真实验表明，与仅使用当前观测信息的设定相比，采用有限状态控制器的所提方法在性能上实现了持续提升。

TLDR: Proposes a natural policy gradient method for multi-agent reinforcement learning in partially observable Markov potential games, using an internal state compression mechanism and establishing a non-asymptotic convergence bound.

简要说明: 针对部分可观测马尔可夫势博弈，提出一种基于内部状态的自然策略梯度方法，使用内部状态压缩机制并建立了非渐近收敛界。

Authors: Wonseok Yang, Thinh T. Doan

MVNN: A Measure-Valued Neural Network for Learning McKean-Vlasov Dynamics from Particle Data

Abstract (English): Collective behaviors that emerge from interactions are fundamental to numerous biological systems. To learn such interacting forces from observations, we introduce a measure-valued neural network that infers measure-dependent interaction (drift) terms directly from particle-trajectory observations. The proposed architecture generalizes standard neural networks to operate on probability measures by learning cylindrical features, using an embedding network that produces scalable distribution-to-vector representations. On the theory side, we establish well-posedness of the resulting dynamics and prove propagation-of-chaos for the associated interacting-particle system. We further show universal approximation and quantitative approximation rates under a low-dimensional measure-dependence assumption. Numerical experiments on first and second order systems, including deterministic and stochastic Motsch-Tadmor dynamics, two-dimensional attraction-repulsion aggregation, Cucker-Smale dynamics, and a hierarchical multi-group system, demonstrate accurate prediction and strong out-of-distribution generalization.

摘要（中文）: 集体行为源于个体间的相互作用，是众多生物系统的核心特征。为了从观测数据中学习此类相互作用力，我们提出了一种测度值神经网络，该网络能够直接从粒子轨迹观测数据中推断出依赖于测度的相互作用（漂移）项。该架构通过嵌入网络学习柱面特征，生成可扩展的分布到向量表示，从而将标准神经网络推广至概率测度空间。在理论层面，我们证明了所推导动力系统的适定性，并对相关相互作用粒子系统验证了混沌传播定理。在低维测度依赖假设下，我们进一步证明了该方法的普适逼近能力与定量逼近速率。通过一阶与二阶系统（包括确定性及随机的Motsch-Tadmor动力学、二维吸引-排斥聚集系统、Cucker-Smale动力学以及分层多群组系统）的数值实验，验证了该方法具有精确预测能力与强大的分布外泛化性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces a measure-valued neural network (MVNN) to learn interaction dynamics in collective systems from particle trajectory data, proving theoretical guarantees and demonstrating strong generalization across various simulated multi-particle systems.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种测度值神经网络（MVNN），用于从粒子轨迹数据中学习集体系统的交互动力学，证明了理论保证，并在多个模拟的多粒子系统中展示了强大的泛化能力。

Authors: Liyao Lyu, Xinyue Yu, Hayden Schaeffer

VRUD: A Drone Dataset for Complex Vehicle-VRU Interactions within Mixed Traffic

Abstract (English): The Operational Design Domain (ODD) of urbanoriented Level 4 (L4) autonomous driving, especially for autonomous robotaxis, confronts formidable challenges in complex urban mixed traffic environments. These challenges stem mainly from the high density of Vulnerable Road Users (VRUs) and their highly uncertain and unpredictable interaction behaviors. However, existing open-source datasets predominantly focus on structured scenarios such as highways or regulated intersections, leaving a critical gap in data representing chaotic, unstructured urban environments. To address this, this paper proposes an efficient, high-precision method for constructing drone-based datasets and establishes the Vehicle-Vulnerable Road User Interaction Dataset (VRUD), as illustrated in Figure 1. Distinct from prior works, VRUD is collected from typical "Urban Villages" in Shenzhen, characterized by loose traffic supervision and extreme occlusion. The dataset comprises 4 hours of 4K/30Hz recording, containing 11,479 VRU trajectories and 1,939 vehicle trajectories. A key characteristic of VRUD is its composition: VRUs account for about 87% of all traffic participants, significantly exceeding the proportions in existing benchmarks. Furthermore, unlike datasets that only provide raw trajectories, we extracted 4,002 multi-agent interaction scenarios based on a novel Vector Time to Collision (VTTC) threshold, supported by standard OpenDRIVE HD maps. This study provides valuable, rare edge-case resources for enhancing the safety performance of ADS in complex, unstructured urban environments. To facilitate further research, we have made the VRUD dataset open-source at: https://zzi4.github.io/VRUD/.

摘要（中文）: 面向城市应用的L4级自动驾驶（尤其是自动驾驶出租车）的操作设计域，在复杂的城市混合交通环境中面临着严峻挑战。这些挑战主要源于高密度的弱势道路使用者及其高度不确定、不可预测的交互行为。然而，现有开源数据集主要集中于高速公路或规范交叉口等结构化场景，缺乏对混乱、非结构化城市环境的数据表征。为此，本文提出了一种高效、高精度的无人机数据集构建方法，并建立了车辆-弱势道路使用者交互数据集（VRUD），如图1所示。与以往研究不同，VRUD采集自深圳典型的“城中村”区域，其特点是交通监管松散、遮挡现象严重。该数据集包含4小时4K/30Hz的视频记录，涵盖了11,479条弱势道路使用者轨迹和1,939条车辆轨迹。VRUD的一个关键特征在于其构成：弱势道路使用者约占所有交通参与者的87%，显著超过现有基准数据集的比例。此外，不同于仅提供原始轨迹的数据集，我们基于新型矢量碰撞时间阈值提取了4,002个多智能体交互场景，并辅以标准OpenDRIVE高精地图支持。本研究为提升自动驾驶系统在复杂非结构化城市环境中的安全性能提供了宝贵且稀缺的边缘场景资源。为促进进一步研究，我们已将VRUD数据集开源发布在：https://zzi4.github.io/VRUD/。

TLDR: The paper introduces a new drone-based dataset, VRUD, focusing on complex vehicle-VRU interactions in unstructured urban traffic environments, providing edge-case data for autonomous driving safety.

简要说明: 本文介绍了VRUD，一个基于无人机收集的新数据集，专注于非结构化城市交通环境中车辆与弱势道路使用者的复杂交互，为自动驾驶系统在复杂环境中的安全性提供了边缘案例数据。

Authors: Ziyu Wang, Hongrui Kou, Cheng Wang, Ruochen Li, Hubert P. H. Shum, Amir Atapour-Abarghouei, Yuxin Zhang

PanoAir: A Panoramic Visual-Inertial SLAM with Cross-Time Real-World UAV Dataset

Abstract (English): Accurate pose estimation is fundamental for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) applications, where Visual-Inertial SLAM (VI-SLAM) provides a cost-effective solution for localization and mapping. However, existing VI-SLAM methods mainly rely on sensors with limited fields of view (FoV), which can lead to drift and even failure in complex UAV scenarios. Although panoramic cameras provide omnidirectional perception to improve robustness, panoramic VI-SLAM and corresponding real-world datasets for UAVs remain underexplored. To address this limitation, we first construct a real-world panoramic visual-inertial dataset covering diverse flight conditions, including varying illumination, altitudes, trajectory lengths, and motion dynamics. To achieve accurate and robust pose estimation under such challenging UAV scenarios, we propose a panoramic VI-SLAM framework that exploits the omnidirectional FoV via the proposed panoramic feature extraction and panoramic loop closure, enhancing feature constraints and ensuring global consistency. Extensive experiments on both the proposed dataset and public benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves superior accuracy, robustness, and consistency compared to existing approaches. Moreover, deployment on embedded platform validates its practical applicability, achieving comparable computational efficiency to PC implementations. The source code and dataset are publicly available at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lG1Upn6yi-N6tYpEHAt6dfR1uhzNtWbT/view

摘要（中文）: 精准的姿态估计是无人机应用的基础，其中视觉-惯性SLAM（VI-SLAM）为定位与建图提供了一种经济高效的解决方案。然而，现有VI-SLAM方法主要依赖视场范围有限的传感器，在复杂的无人机应用场景中可能导致漂移甚至失效。虽然全景相机能够提供全方位感知以提升鲁棒性，但面向无人机的全景VI-SLAM技术及相应的真实场景数据集仍待深入研究。针对这一局限，我们首先构建了涵盖多种飞行条件的真实场景全景视觉-惯性数据集，包括不同光照、飞行高度、轨迹长度与运动动态。为在此类具有挑战性的无人机场景中实现精准鲁棒的姿态估计，我们提出了一种全景VI-SLAM框架，通过所设计的全景特征提取与全景回环检测机制充分利用全方位视场，从而增强特征约束并保障全局一致性。在自建数据集及公开基准测试上的大量实验表明，本方法相较于现有方法具有更高的精度、鲁棒性与一致性。此外，在嵌入式平台上的部署验证了其实际适用性，其计算效率与个人计算机实现版本相当。源代码与数据集已公开于https://drive.google.com/file/d/1lG1Upn6yi-N6tYpEHAt6dfR1uhzNtWbT/view。

TLDR: This paper proposes a panoramic visual-inertial SLAM framework for UAVs and introduces a corresponding real-world dataset to improve robustness and accuracy in challenging flight conditions.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种用于无人机的全景视觉惯性SLAM框架，并引入了一个相应的真实世界数据集，以提升在复杂飞行条件下的鲁棒性和定位精度。

Authors: Yiyang Wu, Xiaohu Zhang, Yanjin Du, Tongsu Zhang, Chujun Li, Siyang Chen, Guoyi Zhang, Xiangpeng Xu

DVGT-2: Vision-Geometry-Action Model for Autonomous Driving at Scale

Abstract (English): End-to-end autonomous driving has evolved from the conventional paradigm based on sparse perception into vision-language-action (VLA) models, which focus on learning language descriptions as an auxiliary task to facilitate planning. In this paper, we propose an alternative Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) paradigm that advocates dense 3D geometry as the critical cue for autonomous driving. As vehicles operate in a 3D world, we think dense 3D geometry provides the most comprehensive information for decision-making. However, most existing geometry reconstruction methods (e.g., DVGT) rely on computationally expensive batch processing of multi-frame inputs and cannot be applied to online planning. To address this, we introduce a streaming Driving Visual Geometry Transformer (DVGT-2), which processes inputs in an online manner and jointly outputs dense geometry and trajectory planning for the current frame. We employ temporal causal attention and cache historical features to support on-the-fly inference. To further enhance efficiency, we propose a sliding-window streaming strategy and use historical caches within a certain interval to avoid repetitive computations. Despite the faster speed, DVGT-2 achieves superior geometry reconstruction performance on various datasets. The same trained DVGT-2 can be directly applied to planning across diverse camera configurations without fine-tuning, including closed-loop NAVSIM and open-loop nuScenes benchmarks.

摘要（中文）: 端到端自动驾驶已从传统的稀疏感知范式发展为视觉-语言-动作模型，其核心是通过学习语言描述作为辅助任务来促进规划。本文提出一种新的视觉-几何-动作范式，主张将稠密三维几何作为自动驾驶的关键线索。由于车辆运行在三维世界中，我们认为稠密三维几何能为决策提供最全面的信息。然而，现有几何重建方法大多依赖对多帧输入进行计算密集的批量处理，无法适用于在线规划。为此，我们提出流式驾驶视觉几何变换器，以在线方式处理输入数据，并同时输出当前帧的稠密几何结构与轨迹规划。我们采用时序因果注意力机制并缓存历史特征，以支持实时推理。为进一步提升效率，我们提出滑动窗口流式策略，利用特定时间区间内的历史缓存避免重复计算。尽管速度更快，DVGT-2在多个数据集上实现了更优的几何重建性能。训练完成的DVGT-2无需微调即可直接应用于不同摄像头配置的规划任务，包括闭环NAVSIM与开环nuScenes基准测试。

TLDR: Proposes a Vision-Geometry-Action (VGA) model for end-to-end autonomous driving, using a streaming transformer to output dense 3D geometry and planning online for improved efficiency.

简要说明: 提出了一个用于端到端自动驾驶的视觉-几何-动作（VGA）模型，使用流式Transformer在线输出密集3D几何和规划以提高效率。

Authors: Sicheng Zuo, Zixun Xie, Wenzhao Zheng, Shaoqing Xu, Fang Li, Hanbing Li, Long Chen, Zhi-Xin Yang, Jiwen Lu

Bench2Drive-VL: Benchmarks for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving with Vision-Language Models

Abstract (English): With the rise of vision-language models (VLM), their application for autonomous driving (VLM4AD) has gained significant attention. Meanwhile, in autonomous driving, closed-loop evaluation has become widely recognized as a more reliable validation method than open-loop evaluation, as it can evaluate the performance of the model under cumulative errors and out-of-distribution inputs. However, existing VLM4AD benchmarks evaluate the model`s scene understanding ability under open-loop, i.e., via static question-answer (QA) dataset. This kind of evaluation fails to assess the VLMs performance under out-of-distribution states rarely appeared in the human collected datasets.To this end, we present Bench2Drive-VL, an extension of Bench2Drive that brings closed-loop evaluation to VLM-based driving, which introduces: (1) DriveCommenter, a closed-loop generator that automatically generates diverse, behavior-grounded question-answer pairs for all driving situations in CARLA,including severe off-route and off-road deviations previously unassessable in simulation. (2) A unified protocol and interface that allows modern VLMs to be directly plugged into the Bench2Drive closed-loop environment to compare with traditional agents. (3) A flexible reasoning and control framework, supporting multi-format visual inputs and configurable graph-based chain-of-thought execution. (4) A complete development ecosystem. Together, these components form a comprehensive closed-loop benchmark for VLM4AD. All codes and annotated datasets are open sourced.

摘要（中文）: 随着视觉-语言模型（VLM）的兴起，其在自动驾驶领域的应用（VLM4AD）已受到广泛关注。与此同时，在自动驾驶中，闭环评估因其能够评估模型在累积误差和分布外输入下的性能，已被公认为比开环评估更可靠的验证方法。然而，现有的VLM4AD基准测试仍采用开环方式评估模型的场景理解能力，即通过静态问答数据集进行评估。这种评估方式无法评估VLM在人类采集数据集中极少出现的分布外状态下的表现。为此，我们提出了Bench2Drive-VL，这是Bench2Drive的扩展版本，将闭环评估引入基于VLM的驾驶系统。该框架包括：（1）DriveCommenter——一个闭环生成器，能够为CARLA仿真环境中的所有驾驶场景自动生成多样化、基于行为的问答对，涵盖以往仿真中无法评估的严重偏离路线和越野等异常情况；（2）统一的协议和接口，允许现代VLM直接接入Bench2Drive闭环环境，与传统智能体进行对比；（3）灵活的推理与控制框架，支持多格式视觉输入和可配置的图式思维链执行；（4）完整的开发生态系统。这些组件共同构成了VLM4AD的综合闭环基准测试平台。所有代码和标注数据集均已开源。

TLDR: This paper introduces Bench2Drive-VL, a benchmark for closed-loop evaluation of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in autonomous driving within the CARLA simulator.

简要说明: 本文提出了Bench2Drive-VL基准，用于在CARLA模拟器中对自动驾驶的视觉语言模型进行闭环评估。

Authors: Xiaosong Jia, Yuqian Shao, Zhenjie Yang, Qifeng Li, Zhiyuan Zhang, Junchi Yan

A wearable haptic device for edge and surface simulation

Abstract (English): Object manipulation is fundamental to virtual reality (VR) applications, yet conventional fingertip haptic devices fail to render certain tactile features relevant for immersive and precise interactions, as i.e. detection of edges. This paper presents a compact, lightweight fingertip haptic device (24.3 g) that delivers distinguishable surface and edge contact feedback through a novel dual-motor mechanism. Pressure distribution characterization using a 6 x 6 flexible sensor array demonstrates distinct contact patterns between the two stimulation modes. A preliminary user study with five participants achieved 93% average classification accuracy across four conditions (edge/surface contact with light/heavy pressure), with mean response times of 2.79 seconds. The results indicate that the proposed device can effectively convey edge and surface tactile cues, potentially enhancing object manipulation fidelity in VR environments.

摘要（中文）: 物体操控是虚拟现实应用的基础，然而传统指尖触觉设备无法呈现某些对于沉浸式精准交互至关重要的触觉特征（如边缘检测）。本文提出了一种紧凑轻量化的指尖触觉设备（24.3克），通过创新的双电机驱动机制，可提供可区分的表面接触与边缘接触反馈。利用6×6柔性传感器阵列进行的压力分布特性测试表明，两种刺激模式产生了显著不同的接触特征图谱。针对五名参与者的初步用户研究显示，在四种实验条件（轻压/重压下的边缘/表面接触）中平均分类准确率达到93%，平均响应时间为2.79秒。实验结果表明，该设备能够有效传递边缘与表面触觉信息，有望提升虚拟现实环境中物体操控的逼真度。

TLDR: This paper presents a lightweight fingertip haptic device designed to simulate edge and surface contact for enhanced object manipulation in virtual reality environments.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种轻量化指尖触觉设备，旨在通过模拟边缘和表面接触来增强虚拟现实环境中的物体操作沉浸感。

Authors: Rui Chen, Xianlong Mai, Alireza Sanaei, Domenico Chiaradia, Antonio Frisoli, Daniele Leonardis

Simulating Realistic LiDAR Data Under Adverse Weather for Autonomous Vehicles: A Physics-Informed Learning Approach

Abstract (English): Accurate LiDAR simulation is crucial for autonomous driving, especially under adverse weather conditions. Existing methods struggle to capture the complex interactions between LiDAR signals and atmospheric phenomena, leading to unrealistic representations. This paper presents a physics-informed learning framework (PICWGAN) for generating realistic LiDAR data under adverse weather conditions. By integrating physicsdriven constraints for modeling signal attenuation and geometryconsistent degradations into a physics-informed learning pipeline, the proposed method reduces the sim-to-real gap. Evaluations on real-world datasets (CADC for snow, Boreas for rain) and the VoxelScape dataset show that our approach closely mimics realworld intensity patterns. Quantitative metrics, including MSE, SSIM, KL divergence, and Wasserstein distance, demonstrate statistically consistent intensity distributions. Additionally, models trained on data enhanced by our framework outperform baselines in downstream 3D object detection, achieving performance comparable to models trained on real-world data. These results highlight the effectiveness of the proposed approach in improving the realism of LiDAR data and enabling robust perception under adverse weather conditions.

摘要（中文）: 准确的激光雷达模拟对于自动驾驶至关重要，尤其是在恶劣天气条件下。现有方法难以捕捉激光雷达信号与大气现象之间的复杂相互作用，导致模拟结果不够真实。本文提出了一种基于物理信息的学习框架（PICWGAN），用于在恶劣天气条件下生成逼真的激光雷达数据。该方法通过将物理驱动的信号衰减建模约束和几何一致性退化特征整合到物理信息学习流程中，有效缩小了仿真与真实场景之间的差距。在真实数据集（CADC用于雪天、Boreas用于雨天）及VoxelScape数据集上的评估表明，我们的方法能高度还原真实世界中的激光雷达强度分布特征。量化指标（包括均方误差、结构相似性指数、KL散度与Wasserstein距离）证实了生成数据在强度分布上具有统计一致性。此外，使用基于本框架增强数据训练的模型在下游三维目标检测任务中表现优于基准方法，其性能达到与使用真实数据训练模型相当的水平。这些结果充分证明了所提方法在提升激光雷达数据真实性和增强恶劣天气下感知鲁棒性方面的有效性。

TLDR: This paper presents a physics-informed learning framework (PICWGAN) to generate realistic LiDAR data under adverse weather conditions like rain and snow, aiming to reduce the sim-to-real gap for autonomous vehicle perception.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种物理信息学习框架（PICWGAN），用于在雨雪等恶劣天气条件下生成逼真的激光雷达数据，旨在缩小自动驾驶感知的仿真与现实差距。

Authors: Vivek Anand, Bharat Lohani, Rakesh Mishra, Gaurav Pandey

Bistable Quad-Nets Composed of Four-Bar Linkages

Abstract (English): We study mechanical structures composed of spatial four-bar linkages that are bistable, that is, they allow for two distinct configurations. They have an interpretation as quad nets in the Study quadric which can be used to prove existence of arbitrarily large structures of this type. We propose a purely geometric construction of such examples, starting from infinitesimally flexible quad nets in Euclidean space and applying Whiteley de-averaging. This point of view situates the problem within the broader framework of discrete differential geometry and enables the construction of bistable structures from well-known classes of quad nets, such as discrete minimal surfaces. The proposed construction does not rely on numerical optimization and allows control over axis positions and snap angles.

摘要（中文）: 我们研究了由空间四连杆机构组成的双稳态机械结构，即这些结构允许存在两种不同构型。它们可被解释为Study二次曲面中的四边形网格，该性质可用于证明此类结构存在任意大规模的可能性。我们提出了一种纯几何构造方法：从欧几里得空间中的无限柔顺四边形网格出发，通过应用Whiteley去平均化操作实现。这一视角将问题置于离散微分几何的更广泛框架中，使得从已知的四边形网格类型（如离散极小曲面）构造双稳态结构成为可能。所提出的构造方法不依赖数值优化，并能实现对轴线位置和跳跃角度的精确控制。

TLDR: This paper presents a geometric construction method for creating bistable mechanical structures using spatial four-bar linkages, framed within discrete differential geometry and enabling the construction of large-scale structures from known quad net classes like discrete minimal surfaces.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于空间四连杆机构的几何构造方法，用于构建双稳态机械结构，将问题置于离散微分几何框架下，可从离散极小曲面等已知四边形网类构造大规模结构，不依赖数值优化。

Authors: Gudrun Szewieczek, Daniel Huczala, Martin Pfurner, Hans-Peter Schröcker

Go Big or Go Home: Simulating Mobbing Behavior with Braitenbergian Robots

Abstract (English): We used the Webots robotics simulation platform to simulate a dyadic avoiding and mobbing predator behavior in a group of Braitenbergian robots. Mobbing is an antipredator adaptation used by some animals in which the individuals cooperatively attack or harass a predator to protect themselves. One way of coordinating a mobbing attack is using mobbing calls to summon other individuals of the mobbing species. We imitated this mechanism and simulated Braitenbergian robots that use mobbing calls when they face a light source (representing an inanimate predator) and mob it if they can summon allies, otherwise, they escape from it. We explore the effects of range of mobbing call (infinite range, mid-range and low-range) and the size of the robot group (ten robots vs three) on the overall success of mobbing. Our results suggest that both variables have significant impacts. This work has implications for simulations of action selection in artificial life and designing control architectures for autonomous agents.

摘要（中文）: 本研究利用Webots机器人仿真平台，模拟了布雷顿伯格机器人群体中的二元天敌回避与围捕行为。围捕是某些动物为抵御天敌演化出的适应性行为，个体通过合作攻击或骚扰天敌以实现自我保护。协调围捕攻击的方式之一是通过召唤鸣叫聚集同类个体。我们借鉴该机制，模拟了布雷顿伯格机器人在面对光源（代表无生命天敌）时发出召唤鸣叫的行为模式：若能召集同伴则实施围捕，否则选择逃离。本研究重点探究了召唤鸣叫的作用范围（无限范围、中距范围与短距范围）以及机器人群体规模（十台与三台对比）对围捕成功率的影响。实验结果表明这两个变量均产生显著影响。本工作对人工生命的行为选择仿真及自主智能体控制架构设计具有参考意义。

TLDR: This paper simulates mobbing behavior in a group of simple Braitenberg robots, exploring how call range and group size affect cooperative attack success against a simulated predator.

简要说明: 这篇论文模拟了群体中简单Braitenberg机器人的围攻行为，探究了召唤范围和群体规模对模拟捕食者协同攻击成功率的影响。

Authors: Elaheh Sanoubari

HippoCamp: Benchmarking Contextual Agents on Personal Computers

Abstract (English): We present HippoCamp, a new benchmark designed to evaluate agents' capabilities on multimodal file management. Unlike existing agent benchmarks that focus on tasks like web interaction, tool use, or software automation in generic settings, HippoCamp evaluates agents in user-centric environments to model individual user profiles and search massive personal files for context-aware reasoning. Our benchmark instantiates device-scale file systems over real-world profiles spanning diverse modalities, comprising 42.4 GB of data across over 2K real-world files. Building upon the raw files, we construct 581 QA pairs to assess agents' capabilities in search, evidence perception, and multi-step reasoning. To facilitate fine-grained analysis, we provide 46.1K densely annotated structured trajectories for step-wise failure diagnosis. We evaluate a wide range of state-of-the-art multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and agentic methods on HippoCamp. Our comprehensive experiments reveal a significant performance gap: even the most advanced commercial models achieve only 48.3% accuracy in user profiling, struggling particularly with long-horizon retrieval and cross-modal reasoning within dense personal file systems. Furthermore, our step-wise failure diagnosis identifies multimodal perception and evidence grounding as the primary bottlenecks. Ultimately, HippoCamp exposes the critical limitations of current agents in realistic, user-centric environments and provides a robust foundation for developing next-generation personal AI assistants.

摘要（中文）: 本文提出HippoCamp——一个用于评估智能体多模态文件管理能力的新基准。与现有聚焦通用场景下网络交互、工具使用或软件自动化等任务的智能体基准不同，HippoCamp通过模拟用户画像并在海量个人文件中进行情境感知检索，在用户中心化环境中评估智能体性能。该基准基于跨多模态的真实用户画像构建了设备级文件系统实例，涵盖超过2000个现实文件，数据总量达42.4 GB。基于原始文件数据，我们构建了581组问答对以评估智能体在搜索、证据感知和多步推理方面的能力。为支持细粒度分析，我们提供了4.61万条密集标注的结构化轨迹数据用于逐步故障诊断。我们在HippoCamp上评估了多种前沿多模态大语言模型及智能体方法，综合实验结果显示显著的性能差距：即使在用户画像建模任务中，最先进的商用模型准确率仅达48.3%，在密集个人文件系统内进行长程检索和跨模态推理时表现尤为困难。进一步的逐步故障诊断表明，多模态感知与证据定位是当前主要瓶颈。HippoCamp揭示了现有智能体在真实用户中心化环境中的关键局限，为开发下一代个人人工智能助手奠定了坚实基础。

TLDR: Presents a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal AI agents on user-centric file management tasks, focusing on user profiling, search, and reasoning within dense personal file systems.

简要说明: 提出了一个用于评估多模态AI代理在用户为中心的、密集个人文件系统中的文件管理任务的新基准，侧重于用户画像、搜索和推理能力。

Authors: Zhe Yang, Shulin Tian, Kairui Hu, Shuai Liu, Hoang-Nhat Nguyen, Yichi Zhang, Zujin Guo, Mengying Yu, Zinan Zhang, Jingkang Yang, Chen Change Loy, Ziwei Liu

Therefore I am. I Think

Abstract (English): We consider the question: when a large language reasoning model makes a choice, did it think first and then decide to, or decide first and then think? In this paper, we present evidence that detectable, early-encoded decisions shape chain-of-thought in reasoning models. Specifically, we show that a simple linear probe successfully decodes tool-calling decisions from pre-generation activations with very high confidence, and in some cases, even before a single reasoning token is produced. Activation steering supports this causally: perturbing the decision direction leads to inflated deliberation, and flips behavior in many examples (between 7 - 79% depending on model and benchmark). We also show through behavioral analysis that, when steering changes the decision, the chain-of-thought process often rationalizes the flip rather than resisting it. Together, these results suggest that reasoning models can encode action choices before they begin to deliberate in text.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 我们探讨这样一个问题：当大型语言推理模型做出选择时，它是先思考再决定，还是先决定再思考？本文提出证据表明，在推理模型中，可检测的、提前编码的决策会塑造其思维链过程。具体而言，我们证明了一个简单的线性探针能够以极高的置信度从生成前的激活状态中解码工具调用决策，在某些情况下，甚至在第一个推理标记产生之前即可实现。激活导向在因果上支持这一结论：干扰决策方向会导致过度推理，并在许多实例中翻转模型行为（翻转比例在7%至79%之间，具体取决于模型和基准测试）。通过行为分析我们还发现，当导向改变决策时，思维链过程往往倾向于合理化这种翻转而非抵制它。综合来看，这些结果表明，推理模型在开始文本层面的推理之前，可能已预先编码了行动选择。

TLDR: This paper investigates the decision-making process in large language reasoning models, showing that detectable early decisions shape chain-of-thought reasoning and can be steered before text-based deliberation begins.

简要说明: 本文研究了大型语言推理模型的决策过程，表明可检测的早期决策塑造了思维链推理，并且可以在基于文本的思考开始之前被引导。

Authors: Esakkivel Esakkiraja, Sai Rajeswar, Denis Akhiyarov, Rajagopal Venkatesaramani

ORBIT: Scalable and Verifiable Data Generation for Search Agents on a Tight Budget

Abstract (English): Search agents, which integrate language models (LMs) with web search, are becoming crucial for answering complex user queries. Constructing training datasets for deep research tasks, involving multi-step retrieval and reasoning, remains challenging due to expensive human annotation, or cumbersome prerequisites. In this work, we introduce ORBIT, a training dataset with 20K reasoning-intensive queries with short verifiable answers, generated using a frugal framework without relying on paid API services. The modular framework relies on four stages: seed creation, question-answer pair generation, and two stages of verification: self and external. ORBIT spans 15 domains and each training pair requires 4-5 reasoning steps, with external search verification required from the complete web. We train Qwen3-4B as the base model on ORBIT using GRPO and evaluate it on Wikipedia question answering tasks. Extensive experiment results demonstrate that ORBIT-4B achieves strong performance among sub-4B LLMs as search agents, proving the utility of synthetic datasets. Our framework, code and datasets are open-sourced and available publicly.

摘要（中文）: 将语言模型（LM）与网络搜索相结合的搜索代理，正逐渐成为回答复杂用户查询的关键工具。针对深度研究任务构建包含多步检索与推理的训练数据集，目前仍面临高成本人工标注或繁琐前提条件的挑战。本文提出了ORBIT，一个包含2万条高推理强度查询（附带简短可验证答案）的训练数据集，该数据集通过一个无需依赖付费API服务的轻量级框架生成。模块化框架包含四个阶段：种子创建、问答对生成，以及两个验证阶段：自我验证与外部验证。ORBIT涵盖15个领域，每个训练样本需要4-5步推理，且需通过完整网络进行外部搜索验证。我们以ORBIT为基础数据集，使用GRPO方法训练Qwen3-4B作为基础模型，并在维基百科问答任务上对其进行评估。大量实验结果表明，ORBIT-4B在4B参数以下的大型语言模型搜索代理中展现出强劲性能，验证了合成数据集的实用性。我们的框架、代码与数据集均已开源并公开提供。

TLDR: The paper introduces ORBIT, a scalable framework for generating synthetic training data for search agents, and demonstrates its effectiveness by training a 4B parameter language model for complex query answering.

简要说明: 本文提出了ORBIT，一个为搜索代理生成合成训练数据的可扩展框架，并通过训练一个40亿参数的语言模型在复杂问答任务上的表现证明了其有效性。

Authors: Nandan Thakur, Zijian Chen, Xueguang Ma, Jimmy Lin

Screening Is Enough

Abstract (English): A core limitation of standard softmax attention is that it does not define a notion of absolute query--key relevance: attention weights are obtained by redistributing a fixed unit mass across all keys according to their relative scores. As a result, relevance is defined only relative to competing keys, and irrelevant keys cannot be explicitly rejected. We introduce Multiscreen, a language-model architecture built around a mechanism we call screening, which enables absolute query--key relevance. Instead of redistributing attention across all keys, screening evaluates each key against an explicit threshold, discarding irrelevant keys and aggregating the remaining keys, thereby removing global competition among keys. Across experiments, Multiscreen achieves comparable validation loss with approximately 40% fewer parameters than a Transformer baseline, enables stable optimization at substantially larger learning rates, maintains strong performance in long-context perplexity, shows little to no degradation in retrieval performance even far beyond the training context length, and reduces inference latency by up to 3.2$\times$ at 100K context length.

摘要（中文）: 标准softmax注意力的核心限制在于，它未定义绝对查询-键相关性机制：注意力权重是通过依据所有键的相对分数重新分配固定单位质量来获得的。其结果是，相关性仅相对于竞争键定义，且无法显式排除无关键。我们提出一种名为“多屏”（Multiscreen）的语言模型架构，其围绕我们称为“筛选”的机制构建，该机制能够实现绝对查询-键相关性。与在所有键之间重新分配注意力不同，筛选机制通过显式阈值评估每个键，丢弃无关键并聚合剩余键，从而消除了键之间的全局竞争。在所有实验中，与Transformer基线相比，Multiscreen仅使用约60%的参数量即可获得相当的验证损失，能在显著更大的学习率下实现稳定优化，在长上下文困惑度评估中保持强劲性能，即使在远超训练上下文长度的情况下检索性能也几乎无衰减，并在100K上下文长度下将推理延迟降低至多3.2倍。

TLDR: The paper introduces Multiscreen, a new language model architecture that replaces standard softmax attention with a 'screening' mechanism that enables absolute query-key relevance by explicitly discarding irrelevant keys, leading to improved efficiency, stable optimization, and faster inference.

简要说明: 该论文提出了Multiscreen，一种新的语言模型架构，它用“筛选”机制取代了标准softmax注意力，通过显式丢弃不相关的键来实现绝对查询-键相关性，从而提高了效率、优化稳定性并加快了推理速度。

Authors: Ken M. Nakanishi

Detecting Multi-Agent Collusion Through Multi-Agent Interpretability

Abstract (English): As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems, they introduce risks of covert coordination that may evade standard forms of human oversight. While linear probes on model activations have shown promise for detecting deception in single-agent settings, collusion is inherently a multi-agent phenomenon, and the use of internal representations for detecting collusion between agents remains unexplored. We introduce NARCBench, a benchmark for evaluating collusion detection under environment distribution shift, and propose five probing techniques that aggregate per-agent deception scores to classify scenarios at the group level. Our probes achieve 1.00 AUROC in-distribution and 0.60--0.86 AUROC when transferred zero-shot to structurally different multi-agent scenarios and a steganographic blackjack card-counting task. We find that no single probing technique dominates across all collusion types, suggesting that different forms of collusion manifest differently in activation space. We also find preliminary evidence that this signal is localised at the token level, with the colluding agent's activations spiking specifically when processing the encoded parts of their partner's message. This work takes a step toward multi-agent interpretability: extending white-box inspection from single models to multi-agent contexts, where detection requires aggregating signals across agents. These results suggest that model internals provide a complementary signal to text-level monitoring for detecting multi-agent collusion, particularly for organisations with access to model activations. Code and data are available at https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench.

摘要（中文）: 随着LLM智能体在多智能体系统中日益广泛的应用，其带来的隐蔽协调风险可能绕过传统的人工监督形式。虽然在单智能体场景中，基于模型激活的线性探针已展现出检测欺骗行为的潜力，但共谋本质上是一种多智能体现象，利用内部表征来检测智能体间共谋的方法仍未被探索。我们提出了NARCBench基准测试，用于评估环境分布变化下的共谋检测能力，并设计了五种通过聚合单智能体欺骗分数来实现群体级场景分类的探针技术。我们的探针在分布内达到1.00 AUROC性能，在零样本迁移到结构完全不同的多智能体场景及隐写式二十一点记牌任务中，仍能保持0.60-0.86 AUROC。研究发现，没有任何单一探针技术能在所有共谋类型中保持绝对优势，这表明不同形式的共谋在激活空间中具有不同的表征模式。我们还发现初步证据表明，相关信号在词元层面具有局部化特征：共谋智能体的激活值会在处理合作伙伴消息的编码部分时出现显著峰值。这项工作向多智能体可解释性迈出了重要一步：将白盒检测方法从单一模型扩展到多智能体场景，其中检测需要聚合跨智能体的信号。这些结果表明，对于能够获取模型内部激活的组织而言，模型内部信息为文本级监控提供了补充信号，有助于检测多智能体共谋。相关代码和数据可在https://github.com/aaronrose227/narcbench获取。

TLDR: This paper investigates methods for detecting collusion among multiple LLM-based agents by analyzing their internal activation patterns, introducing a benchmark for evaluating detection under distribution shift, and finding that aggregated signals from probes can identify multi-agent deception.

简要说明: 该研究通过分析大语言模型智能体的内部激活模式来检测多智能体共谋，提出了一个评估分布偏移下检测性能的基准，并发现聚合的探测信号可以有效识别多智能体欺骗行为。

Authors: Aaron Rose, Carissa Cullen, Brandon Gary Kaplowitz, Christian Schroeder de Witt

Looking into a Pixel by Nonlinear Unmixing -- A Generative Approach

Abstract (English): Due to the large footprint of pixels in remote sensing imagery, hyperspectral unmixing (HU) has become an important and necessary procedure in hyperspectral image analysis. Traditional HU methods rely on a prior spectral mixing model, especially for nonlinear mixtures, which has largely limited the performance and generalization capacity of the unmixing approach. In this paper, we address the challenging problem of hyperspectral nonlinear unmixing (HNU) without explicit knowledge of the mixing model. Inspired by the principle of generative models, where images of the same distribution can be generated as that of the training images without knowing the exact probability distribution function of the image, we develop an invertible mixing-unmixing process via a bi-directional GAN framework, constrained by both the cycle consistency and the linkage between linear and nonlinear mixtures. The combination of cycle consistency and linear linkage provides powerful constraints without requiring an explicit mixing model. We refer to the proposed approach as the linearly-constrained CycleGAN unmixing net, or LCGU net. Experimental results indicate that the proposed LCGU net exhibits stable and competitive performance across different datasets compared with other state-of-the-art model-based HNU methods.

摘要（中文）: 由于遥感影像中像素覆盖范围较大，高光谱解混（HU）已成为高光谱图像分析中一项重要且必要的处理步骤。传统高光谱解混方法依赖先验的光谱混合模型，尤其对于非线性混合场景，这极大限制了解混方法的性能与泛化能力。本文针对高光谱非线性解混（HNU）这一挑战性问题展开研究，在无需显式混合模型先验知识的条件下，基于生成模型的思想——即无需知道图像确切的概率分布函数，即可生成与训练图像相同分布的新图像，我们通过双向生成对抗网络框架构建了可逆的混合-解混过程，并利用循环一致性约束与线性-非线性混合关联性对其进行双重约束。循环一致性与线性关联的结合提供了强有力的约束条件，且无需显式混合模型。我们将所提出的方法称为线性约束循环生成对抗网络解混模型，简称LCGU网络。实验结果表明，与其他先进的基于模型的高光谱非线性解混方法相比，所提出的LCGU网络在不同数据集上均展现出稳定且具有竞争力的性能。

TLDR: Proposes a generative model-based approach for hyperspectral nonlinear unmixing using a bi-directional GAN framework with cycle consistency and linear constraints, without needing an explicit mixing model.

简要说明: 提出一种基于生成模型的高光谱非线性解混方法，使用具有循环一致性和线性约束的双向GAN框架，无需显式混合模型。
