Authors: Md Shadab Alam, Olena Bazilinska, Pavlo Bazilinskyy

ONE-SHOT: Compositional Human-Environment Video Synthesis via Spatial-Decoupled Motion Injection and Hybrid Context Integration

Abstract (English): Recent advances in Video Foundation Models (VFMs) have revolutionized human-centric video synthesis, yet fine-grained and independent editing of subjects and scenes remains a critical challenge. Recent attempts to incorporate richer environment control through rigid 3D geometric compositions often encounter a stark trade-off between precise control and generative flexibility. Furthermore, the heavy 3D pre-processing still limits practical scalability. In this paper, we propose ONE-SHOT, a parameter-efficient framework for compositional human-environment video generation. Our key insight is to factorize the generative process into disentangled signals. Specifically, we introduce a canonical-space injection mechanism that decouples human dynamics from environmental cues via cross-attention. We also propose Dynamic-Grounded-RoPE, a novel positional embedding strategy that establishes spatial correspondences between disparate spatial domains without any heuristic 3D alignments. To support long-horizon synthesis, we introduce a Hybrid Context Integration mechanism to maintain subject and scene consistency across minute-level generations. Experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods, offering superior structural control and creative diversity for video synthesis. Our project has been available on: https://martayang.github.io/ONE-SHOT/.

摘要（中文）: 近期，视频基础模型在人物中心视频合成领域取得了革命性进展，但对主体与场景进行细粒度独立编辑仍是一项关键挑战。当前通过刚性三维几何组合引入更丰富环境控制的尝试，往往面临精确控制与生成灵活性之间的显著权衡。此外，繁重的三维预处理过程仍制约着实际应用的扩展性。本文提出ONE-SHOT——一个参数高效的组合式人物-环境视频生成框架。我们的核心见解在于将生成过程分解为解耦的信号流。具体而言，我们引入规范化空间注入机制，通过交叉注意力实现人物动态与环境线索的解耦。同时提出动态接地旋转位置编码，这是一种新颖的位置嵌入策略，可在无需启发式三维对齐的情况下，建立不同空间域之间的空间对应关系。为支持长时序合成，我们引入混合上下文集成机制，确保在分钟级生成过程中保持主体与场景的一致性。实验表明，本方法显著优于现有先进技术，为视频合成提供了更优越的结构控制与创作多样性。项目已发布于：https://martayang.github.io/ONE-SHOT/。

TLDR: Proposes a parameter-efficient framework for compositional human-environment video synthesis, focusing on disentangling human dynamics and environmental cues for fine-grained control without 3D pre-processing.

简要说明: 提出了一个用于组合式人与环境视频合成的高效参数框架，通过分离人体动态和环境线索实现精细控制，无需3D预处理。

Authors: Fengyuan Yang, Luying Huang, Jiazhi Guan, Quanwei Yang, Dongwei Pan, Jianglin Fu, Haocheng Feng, Wei He, Kaisiyuan Wang, Hang Zhou, Angela Yao

Diff3R: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Uncertainty-aware Differentiable Optimization

Abstract (English): Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) present two main directions: feed-forward models offer fast inference in sparse-view settings, while per-scene optimization yields high-quality renderings but is computationally expensive. To combine the benefits of both, we introduce Diff3R, a novel framework that explicitly bridges feed-forward prediction and test-time optimization. By incorporating a differentiable 3DGS optimization layer directly into the training loop, our network learns to predict an optimal initialization for test-time optimization rather than a conventional zero-shot result. To overcome the computational cost of backpropagating through the optimization steps, we propose computing gradients via the Implicit Function Theorem and a scalable, matrix-free PCG solver tailored for 3DGS optimization. Additionally, we incorporate a data-driven uncertainty model into the optimization process by adaptively controlling how much the parameters are allowed to change during optimization. This approach effectively mitigates overfitting in under-constrained regions and increases robustness against input outliers. Since our proposed optimization layer is model-agnostic, we show that it can be seamlessly integrated into existing feed-forward 3DGS architectures for both pose-given and pose-free methods, providing improvements for test-time optimization.

摘要（中文）: 近年来，三维高斯泼溅技术（3DGS）呈现出两大主流方向：前馈模型在稀疏视角场景中能够实现快速推理，而逐场景优化方法虽能生成高质量渲染结果，但计算成本高昂。为融合二者的优势，本文提出Diff3R——一种创新性框架，通过显式桥接前馈预测与测试时优化。通过将可微分3DGS优化层直接嵌入训练循环，我们的网络能够学习预测适用于测试时优化的最优初始化参数，而非传统零样本推理结果。为克服优化步骤反向传播带来的计算负担，我们提出基于隐函数定理的梯度计算方法，并开发了专为3DGS优化设计的可扩展无矩阵预处理共轭梯度求解器。此外，我们在优化过程中引入数据驱动的不确定性模型，通过自适应控制参数在优化过程中的可变范围，有效缓解欠约束区域的过拟合问题，并增强模型对输入异常值的鲁棒性。由于该优化层具有模型无关性，我们证明其可无缝集成到现有前馈式3DGS架构中，既适用于已知相机位姿的场景，也适用于未知位姿的方法，为测试时优化提供了系统性改进。

TLDR: Diff3R is a novel framework that bridges feed-forward 3D scene reconstruction and computationally expensive test-time optimization by incorporating a differentiable 3D Gaussian Splatting optimization layer into training. It learns to predict an optimal initialization for test-time optimization, integrates an uncertainty model to prevent overfitting, and is model-agnostic, providing improvements for existing pose-given and pose-free methods.

简要说明: Diff3R 是一个新颖框架，通过在训练循环中引入一个可微分的 3D 高斯泼溅优化层，桥接了前馈式 3D 场景重建和计算密集型的测试时优化。它学习为测试时优化预测一个最优初始化，并集成了一个不确定性模型以防止过拟合，且是模型无关的，能为现有方法提供改进。

Authors: Yueh-Cheng Liu, Jozef Hladký, Matthias Nießner, Angela Dai

Forecasting Motion in the Wild

Abstract (English): Visual intelligence requires anticipating the future behavior of agents, yet vision systems lack a general representation for motion and behavior. We propose dense point trajectories as visual tokens for behavior, a structured mid-level representation that disentangles motion from appearance and generalizes across diverse non-rigid agents, such as animals in-the-wild. Building on this abstraction, we design a diffusion transformer that models unordered sets of trajectories and explicitly reasons about occlusion, enabling coherent forecasts of complex motion patterns. To evaluate at scale, we curate 300 hours of unconstrained animal video with robust shot detection and camera-motion compensation. Experiments show that forecasting trajectory tokens achieves category-agnostic, data-efficient prediction, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and generalizes to rare species and morphologies, providing a foundation for predictive visual intelligence in the wild.

摘要（中文）: 视觉智能需要预测智能体的未来行为，然而视觉系统一直缺乏通用的运动与行为表征。我们提出将密集点轨迹作为行为视觉标记——这是一种解耦运动与外观的结构化中层表征，可泛化应用于各类非刚性智能体（如野外动物）。基于这一抽象表示，我们设计了一种扩散变换器，能够对无序轨迹集合进行建模，并显式推理遮挡关系，从而实现对复杂运动模式的连贯预测。为进行大规模评估，我们构建了300小时无约束动物视频数据集，采用鲁棒的镜头检测与相机运动补偿技术。实验表明，轨迹标记预测方法实现了类别无关的数据高效预测，其性能超越当前最优基线，并能泛化至稀有物种与形态结构，为野外环境中的预测性视觉智能奠定了重要基础。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method for forecasting future motion of agents (e.g., animals) in the wild using dense point trajectories as a mid-level representation and a diffusion transformer model.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种利用密集点轨迹作为中间表示和扩散Transformer模型，来预测野外智能体（如动物）未来运动的方法。

Authors: Neerja Thakkar, Shiry Ginosar, Jacob Walker, Jitendra Malik, Joao Carreira, Carl Doersch

ACT Now: Preempting LVLM Hallucinations via Adaptive Context Integration

Abstract (English): Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from severe hallucination issues. Existing mitigation strategies predominantly rely on isolated, single-step states to enhance visual focus or suppress strong linguistic priors. However, these static approaches neglect dynamic context changes across the generation process and struggles to correct inherited information loss. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Context inTegration (ACT), a training-free inference intervention method that mitigates hallucination through the adaptive integration of contextual information. Specifically, we first propose visual context exploration, which leverages spatio-temporal profiling to adaptively amplify attention heads responsible for visual exploration. To further facilitate vision-language alignment, we propose semantic context aggregation that marginalizes potential semantic queries to effectively aggregate visual evidence, thereby resolving the information loss caused by the discrete nature of token prediction. Extensive experiments across diverse LVLMs demonstrate that ACT significantly reduces hallucinations and achieves competitive results on both discriminative and generative benchmarks, acting as a robust and highly adaptable solution without compromising fundamental generation capabilities.

摘要（中文）: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）普遍面临严重的幻觉问题。现有的缓解策略主要依赖于孤立的单步状态来增强视觉聚焦或抑制强语言先验。然而，这些静态方法忽略了生成过程中动态上下文的变化，且难以纠正固有的信息损失。为克服这一局限，我们提出自适应上下文集成（ACT）——一种无需训练、通过自适应整合上下文信息来缓解幻觉的推理干预方法。具体而言，我们首先提出视觉上下文探索，该方法利用时空分析自适应放大负责视觉探索的注意力头。为进一步促进视觉-语言对齐，我们提出语义上下文聚合，通过对潜在语义查询进行边缘化来有效整合视觉证据，从而解决由词元预测离散性导致的信息丢失问题。基于多种LVLMs的大量实验表明，ACT能显著减少幻觉，在判别性和生成性基准测试中均取得优异结果，是一种不损害基础生成能力的鲁棒且适应性强的解决方案。

TLDR: Proposes Adaptive Context Integration (ACT), a training-free inference intervention method that reduces hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models by adaptively amplifying visual attention and aggregating semantic context.

简要说明: 提出自适应上下文集成方法ACT，这是一种无需训练的推理干预方法，通过自适应放大视觉注意力和聚合语义上下文来减少大视觉语言模型中的幻觉。

Authors: Bei Yan, Yuecong Min, Jie Zhang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen

DLWM: Dual Latent World Models enable Holistic Gaussian-centric Pre-training in Autonomous Driving

Abstract (English): Vision-based autonomous driving has gained much attention due to its low costs and excellent performance. Compared with dense BEV (Bird's Eye View) or sparse query models, Gaussian-centric method is a comprehensive yet sparse representation by describing scene with 3D semantic Gaussians. In this paper, we introduce DLWM, a novel paradigm with Dual Latent World Models specifically designed to enable holistic gaussian-centric pre-training in autonomous driving using two stages. In the first stage, DLWM predicts 3D Gaussians from queries by self-supervised reconstructing multi-view semantic and depth images. Equipped with fine-grained contextual features, in the second stage, two latent world models are trained separately for temporal feature learning, including Gaussian-flow-guided latent prediction for downstream occupancy perception and forecasting tasks, and ego-planning-guided latent prediction for motion planning. Extensive experiments in SurroundOcc and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate that DLWM shows significant performance gains across Gaussian-centric 3D occupancy perception, 4D occupancy forecasting and motion planning tasks.

摘要（中文）: 基于视觉的自动驾驶技术因其低成本与卓越性能而备受关注。与稠密鸟瞰图或稀疏查询模型相比，以高斯分布为核心的方法通过三维语义高斯模型描述场景，形成了一种全面而稀疏的表示体系。本文提出DLWM——一种基于双潜在世界模型的新型范式，专门设计用于通过两阶段实现自动驾驶领域中以高斯分布为核心的整体预训练。在第一阶段，DLWM通过自监督重构多视角语义与深度图像，从查询中预测三维高斯分布。在获得细粒度上下文特征后，第二阶段分别训练两个潜在世界模型以进行时序特征学习：包括为下游占据感知与预测任务设计的高斯流引导潜在预测模型，以及为运动规划设计的自车规划引导潜在预测模型。在SurroundOcc和nuScenes基准测试中的大量实验表明，DLWM在以高斯分布为核心的三维占据感知、四维占据预测和运动规划任务中均展现出显著的性能提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces DLWM, a dual latent world model framework for autonomous driving that uses Gaussian-centric representations to perform 3D occupancy perception, forecasting, and motion planning via self-supervised and task-specific training.

简要说明: 本文提出DLWM，一种用于自动驾驶的双重潜在世界模型框架，通过高斯中心表示，利用自监督和任务特定训练执行3D占用感知、预测和运动规划。

Authors: Yiyao Zhu, Ying Xue, Haiming Zhang, Guangfeng Jiang, Wending Zhou, Xu Yan, Jiantao Gao, Yingjie Cai, Bingbing Liu, Zhen Li, Shaojie Shen

EmoScene: A Dual-space Dataset for Controllable Affective Image Generation

Abstract (English): Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved high visual fidelity, yet precise control over scene semantics and fine-grained affective tone remains challenging. Human visual affect arises from the rapid integration of contextual meaning, including valence, arousal, and dominance, with perceptual cues such as color harmony, luminance contrast, texture variation, curvature, and spatial layout. However, current text-to-image models rarely represent affective and perceptual factors within a unified representation, which limits their ability to synthesize scenes with coherent and nuanced emotional intent. To address this gap, we construct EmoScene, a large-scale dual-space emotion dataset that jointly encodes affective dimensions and perceptual attributes, with contextual semantics provided as supporting annotations. EmoScene contains 1.2M images across more than three hundred real-world scene categories, each annotated with discrete emotion labels, continuous VAD values, perceptual descriptors and textual captions. Multi-space analyses reveal how discrete emotions occupy the VAD space and how affect systematically correlates with scene-level perceptual factors. To benchmark EmoScene, we provide a lightweight reference baseline that injects dual-space controls into a frozen diffusion backbone via shallow cross-attention modulation, serving as a reproducible probe of affect controllability enabled by dual-space supervision.

摘要（中文）: 文本到图像扩散模型在视觉保真度方面已取得较高成就，但在场景语义与细粒度情感基调的精确控制上仍面临挑战。人类视觉情感产生于语境意义（包括情感效价、唤醒度与支配度）与感知线索（如色彩协调性、亮度对比度、纹理变化、曲率特征和空间布局）的快速整合过程。然而，当前文本到图像模型很少在统一表征中同时体现情感维度与感知要素，这限制了其合成具有连贯且细腻情感意图场景的能力。为弥补这一缺陷，我们构建了EmoScene——一个大规模双空间情感数据集，该数据集联合编码情感维度与感知属性，并以辅助标注形式提供语境语义信息。EmoScene包含超过三百个真实场景类别的120万张图像，每张图像均标注有离散情感标签、连续VAD值、感知描述符及文本描述。多空间分析揭示了离散情感在VAD空间中的分布规律，以及情感如何与场景级感知因素形成系统性关联。为建立EmoScene基准，我们提出了一种轻量级参考基线方案：通过浅层交叉注意力调制将双空间控制注入冻结的扩散模型主干，以此作为可复现的探测手段，验证双空间监督范式对情感可控性的赋能效果。

TLDR: Introduces EmoScene, a large-scale dual-space dataset for controllable affective image generation, correlating emotional dimensions with perceptual scene attributes to improve text-to-image models' emotional control.

简要说明: 介绍EmoScene，一个用于可控情感图像生成的大规模双空间数据集，将情感维度与场景感知属性相关联，以改进文本到图像模型的情感控制能力。

Authors: Li He, Longtai Zhang, Wenqiang Zhang, Yan Wang, Lizhe Qi

ProCap: Projection-Aware Captioning for Spatial Augmented Reality

Abstract (English): Spatial augmented reality (SAR) directly projects digital content onto physical scenes using projectors, creating immersive experience without head-mounted displays. However, for SAR to support intelligent interaction, such as reasoning about the scene or answering user queries, it must semantically distinguish between the physical scene and the projected content. Standard Vision Language Models (VLMs) struggle with this virtual-physical ambiguity, often confusing the two contexts. To address this issue, we introduce ProCap, a novel framework that explicitly decouples projected content from physical scenes. ProCap employs a two-stage pipeline: first it visually isolates virtual and physical layers via automated segmentation; then it uses region-aware retrieval to avoid ambiguous semantic context due to projection distortion. To support this, we present RGBP (RGB + Projections), the first large-scale SAR semantic benchmark dataset, featuring 65 diverse physical scenes and over 180,000 projections with dense, decoupled annotations. Finally, we establish a dual-captioning evaluation protocol using task-specific tokens to assess physical scene and projection descriptions independently. Our experiments show that ProCap provides a robust semantic foundation for future SAR research. The source code, pre-trained models and the RGBP dataset are available on the project page: https://ZimoCao.github.io/ProCap/.

摘要（中文）: 空间增强现实（SAR）利用投影仪将数字内容直接投射至物理场景，无需头戴式显示设备即可营造沉浸式体验。然而，要使SAR支持智能交互（如场景推理或用户问答），系统必须能够从语义层面区分物理场景与投射内容。标准的视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理这种虚实模糊性时面临挑战，常混淆两种语境。为解决此问题，我们提出ProCap——一种显式解耦投射内容与物理场景的新型框架。该框架采用两阶段流程：首先通过自动分割在视觉层面分离虚拟层与物理层；随后利用区域感知检索技术避免因投影变形导致的语义语境歧义。为支持此研究，我们构建了首个大规模SAR语义基准数据集RGBP（RGB+投射数据），包含65个多样化物理场景及超过18万条投射数据，并配备解耦的密集标注。此外，我们建立了基于任务特定标记的双重描述评估协议，可独立评估物理场景与投射内容的描述质量。实验表明，ProCap为未来SAR研究提供了坚实的语义基础。项目源代码、预训练模型及RGBP数据集可通过项目页面获取：https://ZimoCao.github.io/ProCap/。

TLDR: ProCap is a framework and dataset for spatial augmented reality (SAR) that uses a two-stage pipeline to visually separate and semantically caption projected content from physical scenes, addressing ambiguity in standard Vision-Language Models.

简要说明: ProCap 是一个面向空间增强现实（SAR）的框架和数据集，采用两阶段流程从视觉上分离投影内容与物理场景并进行语义描述，以解决标准视觉语言模型中的虚拟-物理歧义问题。

Authors: Zimo Cao, Yuchen Deng, Haibin Ling, Bingyao Huang

Shape Representation using Gaussian Process mixture models

Abstract (English): Traditional explicit 3D representations, such as point clouds and meshes, demand significant storage to capture fine geometric details and require complex indexing systems for surface lookups, making functional representations an efficient, compact, and continuous alternative. In this work, we propose a novel, object-specific functional shape representation that models surface geometry with Gaussian Process (GP) mixture models. Rather than relying on computationally heavy neural architectures, our method is lightweight, leveraging GPs to learn continuous directional distance fields from sparsely sampled point clouds. We capture complex topologies by anchoring local GP priors at strategic reference points, which can be flexibly extracted using any structural decomposition method (e.g. skeletonization, distance-based clustering). Extensive evaluations on the ShapeNetCore and IndustryShapes datasets demonstrate that our method can efficiently and accurately represent complex geometries.

摘要（中文）: 传统显式三维表示（如点云和网格）需要大量存储空间来捕捉精细几何细节，且依赖复杂索引系统进行表面查找，这使得函数式表示成为一种高效、紧凑且连续的表达方式。本研究提出了一种新颖的、面向特定物体的函数式形状表示方法，采用高斯过程混合模型对表面几何进行建模。与依赖计算密集型神经架构的方法不同，本方法通过轻量化的高斯过程从稀疏采样的点云中学习连续方向距离场。我们通过在策略性参考点处锚定局部高斯过程先验来捕捉复杂拓扑结构，这些参考点可通过任意结构分解方法（如骨架化、基于距离的聚类）灵活提取。在ShapeNetCore和IndustryShapes数据集上的广泛实验表明，本方法能够高效且精确地表示复杂几何形状。

TLDR: The paper proposes a lightweight, object-specific functional shape representation using Gaussian Process mixture models to learn continuous directional distance fields from sparse point clouds, efficiently capturing complex geometries.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种使用高斯过程混合模型的轻量级、对象特定功能形状表示方法，从稀疏点云中学习连续方向距离场，以高效捕捉复杂几何结构。

Authors: Panagiotis Sapoutzoglou, George Terzakis, Georgios Floros, Maria Pateraki

Sparkle: A Robust and Versatile Representation for Point Cloud based Human Motion Capture

Abstract (English): Point cloud-based motion capture leverages rich spatial geometry and privacy-preserving sensing, but learning robust representations from noisy, unstructured point clouds remains challenging. Existing approaches face a struggle trade-off between point-based methods (geometrically detailed but noisy) and skeleton-based ones (robust but oversimplified). We address the fundamental challenge: how to construct an effective representation for human motion capture that can balance expressiveness and robustness. In this paper, we propose Sparkle, a structured representation unifying skeletal joints and surface anchors with explicit kinematic-geometric factorization. Our framework, SparkleMotion, learns this representation through hierarchical modules embedding geometric continuity and kinematic constraints. By explicitly disentangling internal kinematic structure from external surface geometry, SparkleMotion achieves state-of-the-art performance not only in accuracy but crucially in robustness and generalization under severe domain shifts, noise, and occlusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate our superiority across diverse sensor types and challenging real-world scenarios.

摘要（中文）: 摘要：基于点云的运动捕捉技术利用丰富的空间几何特征和隐私保护型传感方式，但如何从带噪声的非结构化点云中学习鲁棒表征仍然面临挑战。现有方法在基于点云的方法（几何细节丰富但噪声敏感）与基于骨架的方法（鲁棒但过度简化）之间难以取得平衡。本文致力于解决这一核心问题：如何构建能够兼顾表达力与鲁棒性的人体运动捕捉表征。我们提出Sparkle表征——一种通过显式运动学-几何因子分解将骨骼关节点与表面锚点统一的结构化表征。我们的框架SparkleMotion通过嵌入几何连续性与运动学约束的层级化模块学习该表征。通过显式解耦内部运动学结构与外部表面几何特征，SparkleMotion不仅在精度上达到先进水平，更在剧烈域偏移、噪声和遮挡条件下的鲁棒性与泛化能力上取得关键突破。大量实验验证了我们在多种传感器类型及复杂现实场景中的综合优势。

TLDR: The paper proposes a novel structured representation and framework for human motion capture from point clouds, aiming to balance geometric detail and robustness for handling noise and domain shifts.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种新的结构化表示和框架，用于从点云中捕捉人体运动，旨在平衡几何细节和鲁棒性，以处理噪声和域偏移。

Authors: Yiming Ren, Yujing Sun, Aoru Xue, Kwok-Yan Lam, Yuexin Ma

MotionGrounder: Grounded Multi-Object Motion Transfer via Diffusion Transformer

Abstract (English): Motion transfer enables controllable video generation by transferring temporal dynamics from a reference video to synthesize a new video conditioned on a target caption. However, existing Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based methods are limited to single-object videos, restricting fine-grained control in real-world scenes with multiple objects. In this work, we introduce MotionGrounder, a DiT-based framework that firstly handles motion transfer with multi-object controllability. Our Flow-based Motion Signal (FMS) in MotionGrounder provides a stable motion prior for target video generation, while our Object-Caption Alignment Loss (OCAL) grounds object captions to their corresponding spatial regions. We further propose a new Object Grounding Score (OGS), which jointly evaluates (i) spatial alignment between source video objects and their generated counterparts and (ii) semantic consistency between each generated object and its target caption. Our experiments show that MotionGrounder consistently outperforms recent baselines across quantitative, qualitative, and human evaluations.

摘要（中文）: 运动迁移技术通过将参考视频中的时序动态转移到目标文本描述的视频生成中，实现可控视频合成。然而，现有基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的方法局限于处理单一对象视频，难以对现实场景中多对象视频进行细粒度控制。本研究提出MotionGrounder——首个基于DiT框架、具备多对象可控能力的运动迁移系统。该框架中设计的流式运动信号（FMS）为目标视频生成提供了稳定的运动先验，而对象-文本对齐损失（OCAL）则将对象描述文本与其对应空间区域进行锚定。我们进一步提出新的对象定位评分（OGS），该指标联合评估（i）源视频对象与生成对象间的空间对齐度，以及（ii）各生成对象与目标文本描述的语义一致性。实验表明，MotionGrounder在定量评估、定性分析和人工评价中均持续优于现有基线方法。

TLDR: MotionGrounder is a Diffusion Transformer-based framework for multi-object motion transfer in video generation, enabling fine-grained control of multiple objects through stable motion priors and object-caption alignment.

简要说明: MotionGrounder 是一个基于扩散Transformer的框架，用于视频生成中的多物体运动迁移，通过稳定的运动先验和物体-描述对齐，实现对多物体的细粒度控制。

Authors: Samuel Teodoro, Yun Chen, Agus Gunawan, Soo Ye Kim, Jihyong Oh, Munchurl Kim

Continual Vision-Language Learning for Remote Sensing: Benchmarking and Analysis

Abstract (English): Current remote sensing vision-language models (RS VLMs) demonstrate impressive performance in image interpretation but rely on static training data, limiting their ability to accommodate continuously emerging sensing modalities and downstream tasks. This exposes a fundamental challenge: enabling RS VLMs to continually adapt without catastrophic forgetting. Despite its practical importance, the continual learning capability of RS VLMs remains underexplored, and no dedicated benchmark currently exists. In this work, we present CLeaRS, a comprehensive benchmark for continual vision-language learning in remote sensing. CLeaRS comprises 10 curated subsets with over 207k image-text pairs, spanning diverse interpretation tasks, sensing modalities, and application scenarios. We further define three evaluation protocols: long-horizon, modality-incremental, and task-incremental settings, to systematically assess continual adaptation. Extensive benchmarking of diverse vision-language models reveals catastrophic forgetting across all settings. Moreover, representative continual learning methods, when adapted to RS VLMs, exhibit limited effectiveness in handling task, instruction, and modality transitions. Our findings underscore the need for developing continual learning methods tailored to RS VLMs.

摘要（中文）: 当前遥感视觉语言模型在图像解译方面展现出卓越性能，但依赖静态训练数据，限制了其适应持续涌现的新型感知模态与下游任务的能力。这揭示了一个根本性挑战：如何使遥感视觉语言模型实现持续适应而不发生灾难性遗忘。尽管该问题具有重要实际意义，遥感视觉语言模型的持续学习能力仍未被充分探索，且目前缺乏专门的评测基准。本研究提出CLeaRS——一个面向遥感领域的综合性持续视觉语言学习基准。CLeaRS包含10个精选子集，涵盖超过20.7万组图像-文本对，涉及多种解译任务、感知模态和应用场景。我们进一步定义了三类评估协议：长周期评估、模态增量评估与任务增量评估，以系统化衡量持续适应能力。通过对多种视觉语言模型进行广泛测试，发现所有评估场景下均存在灾难性遗忘现象。此外，当代表性持续学习方法适配至遥感视觉语言模型时，在处理任务、指令与模态转换方面表现出有限效能。我们的研究结果强调，亟需开发针对遥感视觉语言模型特性设计的持续学习方法。

TLDR: Introduces a benchmark for continual vision-language learning in remote sensing, showing catastrophic forgetting in current models and highlighting the need for tailored continual learning methods.

简要说明: 为遥感领域提出一个持续视觉-语言学习基准，展示当前模型的灾难性遗忘问题，并强调需要专门针对性的持续学习方法。

Authors: Xingxing Weng, Ruifeng Ni, Chao Pang, XiangYu Hao, Yishan Wang, Xiaokang Zhang, Wei Xu, Gui-Song Xia

Multimodal Language Models Cannot Spot Spatial Inconsistencies

Abstract (English): Spatial consistency is a fundamental property of the visual world and a key requirement for models that aim to understand physical reality. Despite recent advances, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often struggle to reason about 3D geometry across multiple views. Rather than asking models to describe scene attributes, we introduce a more challenging task: given two views of the same scene, identify the object that violates 3D motion consistency. We propose a simple and scalable method for generating realistic, spatially inconsistent image pairs from multi-view scenes, enabling systematic evaluation of this capability. Our results show that state-of-the-art MLLMs significantly underperform human observers and exhibit substantial variability across different scene attributes, revealing a fragile and incomplete understanding of 3D structure. We hope our findings underscore the need for approaches that develop a more deeply grounded understanding of the physical world.

摘要（中文）: 空间一致性是视觉世界的基本属性，也是旨在理解物理现实的模型的关键要求。尽管近期取得了进展，但多模态大语言模型在跨多视角进行三维几何推理时仍面临困难。不同于要求模型描述场景属性，我们引入了一项更具挑战性的任务：给定同一场景的两个视角，识别违反三维运动一致性的物体。我们提出了一种简单且可扩展的方法，用于从多视角场景中生成真实且空间不一致的图像对，从而系统评估该能力。实验结果表明，当前最先进的多模态大语言模型显著落后于人类观察者，且在不同场景属性上表现出巨大差异，揭示其对三维结构的理解是脆弱且不完整的。我们希望这些发现能强调需要开发更深入理解物理世界的方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models' ability to identify spatial inconsistencies between two views of a scene, finding they perform poorly.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一个评估多模态大语言模型在识别多视角场景中空间不一致性方面能力的基准，发现其表现不佳。

Authors: Om Khangaonkar, Hadi J. Rad, Hamed Pirsiavash

An Approach to Enriching Surgical Video Datasets for Fine-Grained Spatial-Temporal Understanding of Vision-Language Models

Abstract (English): Surgical video understanding is a crucial prerequisite for advancing Computer-Assisted Surgery. While vision-language models (VLMs) have recently been applied to the surgical domain, existing surgical vision-language datasets lack in capturing and evaluating complex, interleaved spatial-temporal dynamics. Creating large scale datasets that accurately represent fine-grained spatial-temporal relationships in surgical videos is challenging due to costly manual annotations or error-prone generation using large language models. To address this gap, we introduce the SurgSTU-Pipeline, a deterministic generation pipeline featuring temporal and spatial continuity filtering to reliably create surgical datasets for fine-grained spatial-temporal multimodal understanding. Applying this pipeline to publicly available surgical datasets, we create the SurgSTU dataset, comprising 7515 video clips densely extended with 150k fine-grained spatial-temporal question-answer samples. Our comprehensive evaluation shows that while state-of-the-art generalist VLMs struggle in zero-shot settings, their spatial-temporal capabilities can be improved through in-context learning. A fine-tuned VLM on the SurgSTU training dataset achieves highest performance among all spatial-temporal tasks, validating the dataset's efficacy to improve spatial-temporal understanding of VLMs in surgical videos. Code will be made publicly available.

摘要（中文）: 手术视频理解是推动计算机辅助手术发展的关键前提。尽管视觉语言模型最近已被应用于手术领域，但现有手术视觉语言数据集在捕捉和评估复杂的交织时空动态方面存在不足。由于手动标注成本高昂或使用大语言模型生成易出错，创建能准确反映手术视频中细粒度时空关系的大规模数据集颇具挑战。为填补这一空白，我们提出了SurgSTU-Pipeline——一种确定性生成流程，通过时空连续性过滤技术，可靠地创建用于细粒度时空多模态理解的手术数据集。将该流程应用于公开手术数据集，我们构建了SurgSTU数据集，包含7515个视频片段及密集扩展的15万个细粒度时空问答样本。综合评估表明，虽然当前先进的通用视觉语言模型在零样本设置下表现欠佳，但通过上下文学习可以提升其时空理解能力。在SurgSTU训练数据集上微调的视觉语言模型在所有时空任务中均取得最优性能，验证了该数据集对提升手术视频时空理解能力的有效性。代码将公开发布。

TLDR: This paper introduces a pipeline and dataset (SurgSTU) to enhance fine-grained spatial-temporal understanding of vision-language models in surgical videos, improving VLM performance through in-context learning and fine-tuning.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种流程和数据集（SurgSTU），以增强手术视频中视觉语言模型的细粒度时空理解能力，通过上下文学习和微调提升VLM性能。

Authors: Lennart Maack, Alexander Schlaefer

PrivHAR-Bench: A Graduated Privacy Benchmark Dataset for Video-Based Action Recognition

Abstract (English): Existing research on privacy-preserving Human Activity Recognition (HAR) typically evaluates methods against a binary paradigm: clear video versus a single privacy transformation. This limits cross-method comparability and obscures the nuanced relationship between privacy strength and recognition utility. We introduce \textit{PrivHAR-Bench}, a multi-tier benchmark dataset designed to standardize the evaluation of the \textit{Privacy-Utility Trade-off} in video-based action recognition. PrivHAR-Bench applies a graduated spectrum of visual privacy transformations: from lightweight spatial obfuscation to cryptographic block permutation, to a curated subset of 15 activity classes selected for human articulation diversity. Each of the 1,932 source videos is distributed across 9 parallel tiers of increasing privacy strength, with additional background-removed variants to isolate the contribution of human motion features from contextual scene bias. We provide lossless frame sequences, per-frame bounding boxes, estimated pose keypoints with joint-level confidence scores, standardized group-based train/test splits, and an evaluation toolkit computing recognition accuracy and privacy metrics. Empirical validation using R3D-18 demonstrates a measurable and interpretable degradation curve across tiers, with within-tier accuracy declining from 88.8\% (clear) to 53.5\% (encrypted, background-removed) and cross-domain accuracy collapsing to 4.8\%, establishing PrivHAR-Bench as a controlled benchmark for comparing privacy-preserving HAR methods under standardized conditions. The dataset, generation pipeline, and evaluation code are publicly available.

摘要（中文）: 现有关于隐私保护人体活动识别（HAR）的研究通常在二元范式下评估方法：即清晰视频与单一隐私转换的对比。这限制了不同方法间的可比性，并模糊了隐私强度与识别效用间的微妙关系。我们引入了 \textit{PrivHAR-Bench}——一个多层级基准数据集，旨在标准化基于视频的动作识别中 \textit{隐私-效用权衡} 的评估。PrivHAR-Bench 应用了渐进式的视觉隐私转换谱系：从轻量级空间模糊化到加密块置换，并针对人体关节活动多样性精选了15个动作类别。总计1,932个源视频均被处理为9个并行层级，隐私强度逐级递增，并额外提供背景去除版本以隔离人体运动特征与场景背景偏差的影响。我们提供无损帧序列、逐帧边界框、带有关节置信度分数的估计姿态关键点、标准化的分组训练/测试划分，以及计算识别准确率与隐私指标的评估工具包。使用R3D-18模型进行的实证验证显示，各层级间存在可测量且可解释的性能衰减曲线：层内准确率从88.8%（清晰视频）下降至53.5%（加密且背景去除版本），而跨域准确率骤降至4.8%，这确立了PrivHAR-Bench作为在标准化条件下比较隐私保护HAR方法的可控基准。数据集、生成流程及评估代码均已公开。

TLDR: This paper introduces PrivHAR-Bench, a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate the privacy-utility trade-off in video-based human action recognition, featuring a graduated spectrum of visual privacy transformations on a curated set of activity videos.

简要说明: 本文提出了PrivHAR-Bench，这是一个用于评估视频行为识别中隐私-效用权衡的基准数据集，它对一组精选的活动视频应用了从轻微到加密的渐进式隐私保护变换。

Authors: Samar Ansari

TP-Seg: Task-Prototype Framework for Unified Medical Lesion Segmentation

Abstract (English): Building a unified model with a single set of parameters to efficiently handle diverse types of medical lesion segmentation has become a crucial objective for AI-assisted diagnosis. Existing unified segmentation approaches typically rely on shared encoders across heterogeneous tasks and modalities, which often leads to feature entanglement, gradient interference, and suboptimal lesion discrimination. In this work, we propose TP-Seg, a task-prototype framework for unified medical lesion segmentation. On one hand, the task-conditioned adapter effectively balances shared and task-specific representations through a dual-path expert structure, enabling adaptive feature extraction across diverse medical imaging modalities and lesion types. On the other hand, the prototype-guided task decoder introduces learnable task prototypes as semantic anchors and employs a cross-attention mechanism to achieve fine-grained modeling of task-specific foreground and background semantics. Without bells and whistles, TP-Seg consistently outperforms specialized, general and unified segmentation methods across 8 different medical lesion segmentation tasks covering multiple imaging modalities, demonstrating strong generalization, scalability and clinical applicability.

摘要（中文）: 构建一个具有单一参数集的统一模型以高效处理多种类型的医学病灶分割，已成为AI辅助诊断的关键目标。现有的统一分割方法通常依赖于跨异构任务和模态的共享编码器，这往往导致特征纠缠、梯度干扰和病灶识别能力欠佳。本研究提出TP-Seg，一种用于统一医学病灶分割的任务原型框架。一方面，任务条件适配器通过双路径专家结构有效平衡共享与任务特定表征，实现跨多模态医学影像和病灶类型的自适应特征提取；另一方面，原型引导的任务解码器引入可学习的任务原型作为语义锚点，并采用交叉注意力机制实现对任务特定前景与背景语义的细粒度建模。无需复杂修饰，TP-Seg在涵盖多种成像模态的8个不同医学病灶分割任务中，持续超越专用模型、通用模型及统一分割方法，展现出强大的泛化能力、可扩展性和临床适用性。

TLDR: Proposes TP-Seg, a task-prototype framework for unified medical lesion segmentation, using task-conditioned adapters and prototype-guided decoders to improve performance across diverse imaging modalities and lesion types.

简要说明: 提出了TP-Seg，一个用于统一医学病灶分割的任务原型框架，通过任务条件适配器和原型引导的解码器来提升跨多种影像模态和病灶类型的性能。

Authors: Jiawei Xu, Qiangqiang Zhou, Dandan Zhu, Yong Chen, Yugen Yi, Xiaoqi Zhao

CL-VISTA: Benchmarking Continual Learning in Video Large Language Models

Abstract (English): Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) require continual learning to adapt to non-stationary real-world data. However, existing benchmarks fall short of evaluating modern foundation models: many still rely on models without large-scale pre-training, and prevailing benchmarks typically partition a single dataset into sub-tasks, resulting in high task redundancy and negligible forgetting on pre-trained Video-LLMs. To address these limitations, we propose CL-VISTA, a benchmark tailored for continual video understanding of Video-LLMs. By curating 8 diverse tasks spanning perception, understanding, and reasoning, CL-VISTA induces substantial distribution shifts that effectively expose catastrophic forgetting. To systematically assess CL methods, we establish a comprehensive evaluation framework comprising 6 distinct protocols across 3 critical dimensions: performance, computational efficiency, and memory footprint. Notably, the performance dimension incorporates a general video understanding assessment to assess whether CL methods genuinely enhance foundational intelligence or merely induce task-specific overfitting. Extensive benchmarking of 10 mainstream CL methods reveals a fundamental trade-off: no single approach achieves universal superiority across all dimensions. Methods that successfully mitigate catastrophic forgetting tend to compromise generalization or incur prohibitive computational and memory overheads. We hope CL-VISTA provides critical insights for advancing continual learning in multimodal foundation models.

摘要（中文）: 视频大语言模型需要持续学习以应对现实世界中非平稳的数据流。然而，现有基准测试在评估现代基础模型方面存在不足：许多仍依赖未经过大规模预训练的模型，且主流基准通常将单一数据集分割为子任务，导致任务冗余度高，并在预训练视频大语言模型上表现出可忽略的遗忘现象。为突破这些局限，我们提出CL-VISTA——一个专为视频大语言模型持续视频理解而设计的基准测试。通过精心构建涵盖感知、理解与推理的8个多样化任务，CL-VISTA引发显著的分布偏移，从而有效暴露灾难性遗忘问题。为系统评估持续学习方法，我们建立了一套包含6种不同协议的全面评估框架，涵盖性能、计算效率与内存占用三大关键维度。值得注意的是，性能维度引入了通用视频理解评估，以检验持续学习方法是否真正提升基础智能而非仅导致任务特定过拟合。对10种主流持续学习方法的广泛测试揭示了一个根本性权衡：没有任何方法能在所有维度上实现普遍优越性。成功缓解灾难性遗忘的方法往往需以牺牲泛化能力为代价，或承受高昂的计算与内存开销。我们希望CL-VISTA能为推进多模态基础模型的持续学习研究提供关键见解。

TLDR: The paper introduces CL-VISTA, a benchmark for evaluating continual learning in Video Large Language Models across diverse tasks, revealing trade-offs between forgetting mitigation, generalization, and computational cost.

简要说明: 本文提出了CL-VISTA，一个用于评估视频大语言模型持续学习能力的基准，旨在揭示不同方法在缓解遗忘、泛化能力和计算开销之间的权衡。

Authors: Haiyang Guo, Yichen Shi, Fei Zhu, Wenzhuo Liu, Hongbo Zhao, Fanhu Zeng, Shijie Ma, Da-Han Wang, Xu-Yao Zhang

DirectFisheye-GS: Enabling Native Fisheye Input in Gaussian Splatting with Cross-View Joint Optimization

Abstract (English): 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has enabled efficient 3D scene reconstruction from everyday images with real-time, high-fidelity rendering, greatly advancing VR/AR applications. Fisheye cameras, with their wider field of view (FOV), promise high-quality reconstructions from fewer inputs and have recently attracted much attention. However, since 3DGS relies on rasterization, most subsequent works involving fisheye camera inputs first undistort images before training, which introduces two problems: 1) Black borders at image edges cause information loss and negate the fisheye's large FOV advantage; 2) Undistortion's stretch-and-interpolate resampling spreads each pixel's value over a larger area, diluting detail density -- causes 3DGS overfitting these low-frequency zones, producing blur and floating artifacts. In this work, we integrate fisheye camera model into the original 3DGS framework, enabling native fisheye image input for training without preprocessing. Despite correct modeling, we observed that the reconstructed scenes still exhibit floaters at image edges: Distortion increases toward the periphery, and 3DGS's original per-iteration random-selecting-view optimization ignores the cross-view correlations of a Gaussian, leading to extreme shapes (e.g., oversized or elongated) that degrade reconstruction quality. To address this, we introduce a feature-overlap-driven cross-view joint optimization strategy that establishes consistent geometric and photometric constraints across views-a technique equally applicable to existing pinhole-camera-based pipelines. Our DirectFisheye-GS matches or surpasses state-of-the-art performance on public datasets.

摘要（中文）: 3D高斯溅射(3DGS)实现了从日常图像中进行高效3D场景重建，具备实时高保真渲染能力，极大推动了VR/AR应用发展。鱼眼相机因其更宽的视场角，能够以更少的输入实现高质量重建，近期受到广泛关注。然而，由于3DGS依赖栅格化技术，大多数涉及鱼眼相机输入的后续研究在训练前会先对图像进行去畸变处理，这引发了两个问题：1) 图像边缘的黑边会导致信息丢失，抵消鱼眼大视场角的优势；2) 去畸变过程中的拉伸-插值重采样会将每个像素值分散到更大区域，降低细节密度——导致3DGS过度拟合这些低频区域，产生模糊和漂浮伪影。本研究将鱼眼相机模型整合到原始3DGS框架中，实现了无需预处理的原始鱼眼图像输入训练。尽管建模正确，我们观察到重建场景在图像边缘仍存在漂浮物：畸变随边缘区域增大而增强，而3DGS原有的每轮迭代随机选视角优化策略忽略了高斯分布跨视角相关性，导致产生极端形状（如超大或过度拉长）从而降低重建质量。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种特征重叠驱动的跨视角联合优化策略，建立跨视角间一致的几何与光度约束——该技术同样适用于现有基于针孔相机的处理流程。我们的DirectFisheye-GS在公开数据集上达到或超越了当前最优性能水平。

TLDR: This paper proposes DirectFisheye-GS, a method that integrates a fisheye camera model into 3D Gaussian Splatting for 3D scene reconstruction, enabling native fisheye input and a cross-view joint optimization strategy to reduce artifacts.

简要说明: 本文提出了DirectFisheye-GS，将鱼眼相机模型集成到3D高斯泼溅中进行场景重建，支持原生鱼眼图像输入，并引入跨视图联合优化策略以减少伪影。

Authors: Zhengxian Yang, Fei Xie, Xutao Xue, Rui Zhang, Taicheng Huang, Yang Liu, Mengqi Ji, Tao Yu

TALENT: Target-aware Efficient Tuning for Referring Image Segmentation

Abstract (English): Referring image segmentation aims to segment specific targets based on a natural text expression. Recently, parameter-efficient tuning (PET) has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, existing PET-based methods often suffer from the fact that visual features can't emphasize the text-referred target instance but activate co-category yet unrelated objects. We analyze and quantify this problem, terming it the `non-target activation' (NTA) issue. To address this, we propose a novel framework, TALENT, which utilizes target-aware efficient tuning for PET-based RIS. Specifically, we first propose a Rectified Cost Aggregator (RCA) to efficiently aggregate text-referred features. Then, to calibrate `NTA' into accurate target activation, we adopt a Target-aware Learning Mechanism (TLM), including contextual pairwise consistency learning and target-centric contrastive learning. The former uses the sentence-level text feature to achieve a holistic understanding of the referent and constructs a text-referred affinity map to optimize the semantic association of visual features. The latter further enhances target localization to discover the distinct instance while suppressing associations with other unrelated ones. The two objectives work in concert and address `NTA' effectively. Extensive evaluations show that TALENT outperforms existing methods across various metrics (e.g., 2.5\% mIoU gains on G-Ref val set). Our codes will be released at: https://github.com/Kimsure/TALENT.

摘要（中文）: 指向性图像分割旨在根据自然语言表达分割特定目标。近年来，参数高效调优（PET）已成为一种颇具前景的研究范式。然而，现有基于PET的方法常面临视觉特征难以聚焦文本所指目标实例，反而激活同类但无关物体的问题。我们对此现象进行了分析与量化，并将其定义为“非目标激活”（NTA）问题。为解决该问题，我们提出了新型框架TALENT，通过目标感知高效调优实现基于PET的指向性图像分割。具体而言，我们首先设计了一种校正成本聚合器（RCA）以高效聚合文本相关特征；随后，为将“非目标激活”校准为目标精准激活，我们引入了目标感知学习机制（TLM），包含上下文配对一致性学习与目标中心对比学习。前者利用句子级文本特征实现对指代目标的整体理解，并构建文本指代关联图以优化视觉特征的语义关联；后者则进一步强化目标定位能力，在凸显特定实例的同时抑制与其他无关对象的关联。二者协同作用，有效解决了“非目标激活”问题。大量实验表明，TALENT在多项指标上均优于现有方法（例如在G-Ref验证集上mIoU指标提升2.5%）。代码已发布于：https://github.com/Kimsure/TALENT。

TLDR: Proposes TALENT, a target-aware parameter-efficient tuning method for referring image segmentation that addresses the 'non-target activation' issue using a rectified cost aggregator and a target-aware learning mechanism.

简要说明: 提出了TALENT方法，一种用于参考图像分割的目标感知参数高效微调方法，通过修正成本聚合器和目标感知学习机制来解决'非目标激活'问题。

Authors: Shuo Jin, Siyue Yu, Bingfeng Zhang, Chao Yao, Meiqin Liu, Jimin Xiao

Fluently Lying: Adversarial Robustness Can Be Substrate-Dependent

Abstract (English): The primary tools used to monitor and defend object detectors under adversarial attack assume that when accuracy degrades, detection count drops in tandem. This coupling was assumed, not measured. We report a counterexample observed on a single model: under standard PGD, EMS-YOLO, a spiking neural network (SNN) object detector, retains more than 70% of its detections while mAP collapses from 0.528 to 0.042. We term this count-preserving accuracy collapse Quality Corruption (QC), to distinguish it from the suppression that dominates untargeted evaluation. Across four SNN architectures and two threat models (l-infinity and l-2), QC appears only in one of the four detectors tested (EMS-YOLO). On this model, all five standard defense components fail to detect or mitigate QC, suggesting the defense ecosystem may rely on a shared assumption calibrated on a single substrate. These results provide, to our knowledge, the first evidence that adversarial failure modes can be substrate-dependent.

摘要（中文）: 用于监控和防御对抗攻击下目标检测器的主要工具，默认准确率下降时检测数量会同步减少。这种关联性是被假设而非实际测量的。我们报告在单个模型上观察到的反例：在标准PGD攻击下，脉冲神经网络目标检测器EMS-YOLO的检测数量保留了70%以上，而mAP指标却从0.528骤降至0.042。我们将这种数量保持而精度崩溃的现象称为“质量腐化”，以区别于在非定向评估中占主导的“抑制效应”。通过对四种SNN架构和两种威胁模型（l-无穷和l-2范数）的测试，质量腐化仅出现在四种检测器中的一种（EMS-YOLO）上。在该模型上，所有五种标准防御组件均未能检测或缓解质量腐化，这表明防御生态系统可能依赖于针对单一基础模型校准的共享假设。据我们所知，这些结果首次证明了对抗性失效模式可能具有基础模型依赖性。

TLDR: This paper investigates adversarial failure modes in Spiking Neural Network (SNN) object detectors, identifying a 'Quality Corruption' effect where detection count remains high but accuracy collapses, and finds this phenomenon to be substrate-dependent.

简要说明: 本文研究了脉冲神经网络（SNN）目标检测器中的对抗性故障模式，发现一种'质量腐败'现象，即检测数量保持高位但准确率崩溃，且该现象具有底物依赖性。

Authors: Daye Kang, Hyeongboo Baek

Reliev3R: Relieving Feed-forward Reconstruction from Multi-View Geometric Annotations

Abstract (English): With recent advances, Feed-forward Reconstruction Models (FFRMs) have demonstrated great potential in reconstruction quality and adaptiveness to multiple downstream tasks. However, the excessive reliance on multi-view geometric annotations, e.g. 3D point maps and camera poses, makes the fully-supervised training scheme of FFRMs difficult to scale up. In this paper, we propose Reliev3R, a weakly-supervised paradigm for training FFRMs from scratch without cost-prohibitive multi-view geometric annotations. Relieving the reliance on geometric sensory data and compute-exhaustive structure-from-motion preprocessing, our method draws 3D knowledge directly from monocular relative depths and image sparse correspondences given by zero-shot predictions of pretrained models. At the core of Reliev3R, we design an ambiguity-aware relative depth loss and a trigonometry-based reprojection loss to facilitate supervision for multi-view geometric consistency. Training from scratch with the less data, Reliev3R catches up with its fully-supervised sibling models, taking a step towards low-cost 3D reconstruction supervisions and scalable FFRMs.

摘要（中文）: 近年来，前馈重建模型在重建质量与对多下游任务的适应性方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，这类模型对多视图几何标注（如三维点云图与相机位姿）的过度依赖，使得其全监督训练方案难以大规模扩展。本文提出Reliev3R——一种弱监督训练范式，可在无需昂贵多视图几何标注的情况下从头训练前馈重建模型。该方法通过消除对几何传感数据与计算密集的运动恢复结构预处理流程的依赖，直接利用预训练模型零样本预测生成的单目相对深度与图像稀疏对应关系来提取三维知识。Reliev3R的核心在于设计了模糊感知相对深度损失与基于三角关系的重投影损失，从而为多视图几何一致性提供有效的监督信号。在数据量更少的情况下，通过从头训练，Reliev3R达到了与全监督基准模型相当的性能，为低成本三维重建监督与可扩展的前馈重建模型迈出了重要一步。

TLDR: A weakly-supervised training method for feed-forward 3D reconstruction models that reduces reliance on costly multi-view geometric annotations by using zero-shot predictions from pretrained models.

简要说明: 一种用于前馈式3D重建模型的弱监督训练方法，通过使用预训练模型的零样本预测，减少对昂贵多视图几何标注的依赖。

Authors: Youyu Chen, Junjun Jiang, Yueru Luo, Kui Jiang, Xianming Liu, Xu Yan, Dave Zhenyu Chen

AceTone: Bridging Words and Colors for Conditional Image Grading

Abstract (English): Color affects how we interpret image style and emotion. Previous color grading methods rely on patch-wise recoloring or fixed filter banks, struggling to generalize across creative intents or align with human aesthetic preferences. In this study, we propose AceTone, the first approach that supports multimodal conditioned color grading within a unified framework. AceTone formulates grading as a generative color transformation task, where a model directly produces 3D-LUTs conditioned on text prompts or reference images. We develop a VQ-VAE based tokenizer which compresses a $3\times32^3$ LUT vector to 64 discrete tokens with $ΔE<2$ fidelity. We further build a large-scale dataset, AceTone-800K, and train a vision-language model to predict LUT tokens, followed by reinforcement learning to align outputs with perceptual fidelity and aesthetics. Experiments show that AceTone achieves state-of-the-art performance on both text-guided and reference-guided grading tasks, improving LPIPS by up to 50% over existing methods. Human evaluations confirm that AceTone's results are visually pleasing and stylistically coherent, demonstrating a new pathway toward language-driven, aesthetic-aligned color grading.

摘要（中文）: 色彩影响着我们对图像风格与情感的理解。现有调色方法多依赖分块重着色或固定滤镜库，难以适应多样化创作意图或契合人类审美偏好。本研究提出首个支持多模态条件调色的统一框架AceTone，将调色任务构建为生成式色彩转换过程，通过模型直接生成基于文本提示或参考图像的3D-LUT。我们开发了基于VQ-VAE的编码器，将$3\times32^3$维LUT向量压缩至64个离散表征单元，在$ΔE<2$的色彩保真度下实现高效编码。进一步构建大规模数据集AceTone-800K，训练视觉语言模型预测LUT表征单元，并引入强化学习机制使输出结果同时满足感知保真度与美学要求。实验表明，AceTone在文本引导与参考引导的调色任务中均达到最优性能，较现有方法将LPIPS指标提升超50%。人工评估证实AceTone生成结果兼具视觉美感与风格一致性，为语言驱动、审美对齐的智能调色开辟了新路径。

TLDR: AceTone introduces a multimodal framework for color grading that generates 3D-LUTs conditioned on text or reference images, using a VQ-VAE tokenizer and vision-language model trained with reinforcement learning for aesthetic alignment.

简要说明: AceTone 提出了一种多模态色彩分级框架，能够根据文本或参考图像生成 3D-LUT，采用了 VQ-VAE 分词器和视觉语言模型，并结合强化学习进行美学对齐训练。

Authors: Tianren Ma, Mingxiang Liao, Xijin Zhang, Qixiang Ye

RT-GS: Gaussian Splatting with Reflection and Transmittance Primitives

Abstract (English): Gaussian Splatting is a powerful tool for reconstructing diffuse scenes, but it struggles to simultaneously model specular reflections and the appearance of objects behind semi-transparent surfaces. These specular reflections and transmittance are essential for realistic novel view synthesis, and existing methods do not properly incorporate the underlying physical processes to simulate them. To address this issue, we propose RT-GS, a unified framework that integrates a microfacet material model and ray tracing to jointly model specular reflection and transmittance in Gaussian Splatting. We accomplish this by using separate Gaussian primitives for reflections and transmittance, which allow modeling distant reflections and reconstructing objects behind transparent surfaces concurrently. We utilize a differentiable ray tracing framework to obtain the specular reflection and transmittance appearance. Our experiments demonstrate that our method successfully produces reflections and recovers objects behind transparent surfaces in complex environments, achieving significant qualitative improvements over prior methods where these specular light interactions are prominent.

摘要（中文）: 高斯溅射是重建漫射场景的有力工具，但在同时建模镜面反射与半透明表面后方物体外观时存在困难。这些镜面反射与透射现象对于实现逼真的新视角合成至关重要，而现有方法未能充分结合底层物理过程进行模拟。为解决此问题，我们提出RT-GS这一统一框架，通过集成微表面材质模型与光线追踪技术，在高斯溅射中实现镜面反射与透射的联合建模。我们采用分离的高斯基元分别处理反射与透射现象，从而实现对远处反射的建模与透明表面后方物体的同步重建。通过可微分光线追踪框架，我们精确获取镜面反射与透射的外观表现。实验结果表明，本方法在复杂环境中成功生成反射效果并重建透明表面后的物体，在镜面光交互作用显著的场景中，较现有方法实现了质的提升。

TLDR: RT-GS introduces a new method for 3D scene reconstruction using Gaussian Splatting, which separately models specular reflections and light transmittance through transparent surfaces via a differentiable ray-tracing framework to improve novel view synthesis.

简要说明: RT-GS提出了一种基于高斯泼溅的3D场景重建新方法，通过可微分光线追踪框架分别建模镜面反射和光线在半透明表面的透射，以提升新视角合成的质量。

Authors: Kunnong Zeng, Chensheng Peng, Yichen Xie, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Cem Yuksel

RegFormer: Transferable Relational Grounding for Efficient Weakly-Supervised Human-Object Interaction Detection

Abstract (English): Weakly-supervised Human-Object Interaction (HOI) detection is essential for scalable scene understanding, as it learns interactions from only image-level annotations. Due to the lack of localization signals, prior works typically rely on an external object detector to generate candidate pairs and then infer their interactions through pairwise reasoning. However, this framework often struggles to scale due to the substantial computational cost incurred by enumerating numerous instance pairs. In addition, it suffers from false positives arising from non-interactive combinations, which hinder accurate instance-level HOI reasoning. To address these issues, we introduce Relational Grounding Transformer (RegFormer), a versatile interaction recognition module for efficient and accurate HOI reasoning. Under image-level supervision, RegFormer leverages spatially grounded signals as guidance for the reasoning process and promotes locality-aware interaction learning. By learning localized interaction cues, our module distinguishes humans, objects, and their interactions, enabling direct transfer from image-level interaction reasoning to precise and efficient instance-level reasoning without additional training. Our extensive experiments and analyses demonstrate that RegFormer effectively learns spatial cues for instance-level interaction reasoning, operates with high efficiency, and even achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Our code is available at https://github.com/mlvlab/RegFormer.

摘要（中文）: 弱监督人物-物体交互检测对于可扩展的场景理解至关重要，它仅通过图像级标注学习交互关系。由于缺乏定位信号，先前研究通常依赖外部物体检测器生成候选对象对，再通过成对推理推断其交互关系。然而，这种框架在枚举大量实例对时会产生巨大计算成本，导致可扩展性受限。此外，非交互组合产生的误检会阻碍准确的实例级交互推理。为解决这些问题，我们提出关系定位变换器——这是一种高效的交互识别模块，能够实现准确的人物-物体交互推理。在图像级监督下，该模块利用空间定位信号引导推理过程，促进局部感知的交互学习。通过学习局部化的交互线索，我们的模块能够区分人物、物体及其交互关系，实现从图像级交互推理到精准高效的实例级推理的直接迁移，无需额外训练。大量实验与分析表明，我们的模块能有效学习实例级交互推理的空间线索，以高效率运行，其性能甚至可与全监督模型相媲美。代码已开源。

TLDR: RegFormer is a weakly-supervised transformer model for efficient Human-Object Interaction detection that learns to ground interaction cues spatially, enabling direct transfer to instance-level reasoning without extra training.

简要说明: RegFormer是一种用于弱监督人-物交互检测的高效Transformer模型，它学习空间定位交互线索，无需额外训练即可直接迁移到实例级推理。

Authors: Jihwan Park, Chanhyeong Yang, Jinyoung Park, Taehoon Song, Hyunwoo J. Kim

PET-DINO: Unifying Visual Cues into Grounding DINO with Prompt-Enriched Training

Abstract (English): Open-Set Object Detection (OSOD) enables recognition of novel categories beyond fixed classes but faces challenges in aligning text representations with complex visual concepts and the scarcity of image-text pairs for rare categories. This results in suboptimal performance in specialized domains or with complex objects. Recent visual-prompted methods partially address these issues but often involve complex multi-modal designs and multi-stage optimizations, prolonging the development cycle. Additionally, effective training strategies for data-driven OSOD models remain largely unexplored. To address these challenges, we propose PET-DINO, a universal detector supporting both text and visual prompts. Our Alignment-Friendly Visual Prompt Generation (AFVPG) module builds upon an advanced text-prompted detector, addressing the limitations of text representation guidance and reducing the development cycle. We introduce two prompt-enriched training strategies: Intra-Batch Parallel Prompting (IBP) at the iteration level and Dynamic Memory-Driven Prompting (DMD) at the overall training level. These strategies enable simultaneous modeling of multiple prompt routes, facilitating parallel alignment with diverse real-world usage scenarios. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that PET-DINO exhibits competitive zero-shot object detection capabilities across various prompt-based detection protocols. These strengths can be attributed to inheritance-based philosophy and prompt-enriched training strategies, which play a critical role in building an effective generic object detector. Project page: https://fuweifuvtoo.github.io/pet-dino.

摘要（中文）: 开放集目标检测（OSOD）能够识别超出固定类别的新颖类别，但面临着将文本表示与复杂视觉概念对齐的挑战，以及稀有类别图像-文本对的稀缺性问题。这导致在专业领域或处理复杂对象时性能表现不佳。近期的视觉提示方法部分解决了这些问题，但通常涉及复杂的多模态设计和多阶段优化，延长了开发周期。此外，针对数据驱动的OSOD模型的有效训练策略仍很大程度上未被探索。为应对这些挑战，我们提出PET-DINO——一种同时支持文本和视觉提示的通用检测器。我们提出的对齐友好视觉提示生成（AFVPG）模块基于先进的文本提示检测器，解决了文本表示引导的局限性，并缩短了开发周期。我们引入了两种提示增强的训练策略：迭代级的批内并行提示（IBP）和整体训练级的动态记忆驱动提示（DMD）。这些策略能够同时建模多种提示路径，促进与多样化现实应用场景的并行对齐。综合实验表明，PET-DINO在各种基于提示的检测协议中展现出具有竞争力的零样本目标检测能力。这些优势可归因于基于继承的设计理念和提示增强的训练策略，它们对构建有效的通用目标检测器起到关键作用。项目页面：https://fuweifuvtoo.github.io/pet-dino。

TLDR: PET-DINO is a universal object detector for open-set detection that supports both text and visual prompts, using novel prompt-enriched training strategies to improve zero-shot capabilities.

简要说明: PET-DINO是一个支持文本和视觉提示的通用开放集目标检测器，通过新颖的提示增强训练策略提升零样本能力。

Authors: Weifu Fu, Jinyang Li, Bin-Bin Gao, Jialin Li, Yuhuan Lin, Hanqiu Deng, Wenbing Tao, Yong Liu, Chengjie Wang

All Roads Lead to Rome: Incentivizing Divergent Thinking in Vision-Language Models

Abstract (English): Recent studies have demonstrated that Reinforcement Learning (RL), notably Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), can intrinsically elicit and enhance the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, despite the promise, the underlying mechanisms that drive the effectiveness of RL models as well as their limitations remain underexplored. In this paper, we highlight a fundamental behavioral distinction between RL and base models, where the former engages in deeper yet narrow reasoning, while base models, despite less refined along individual path, exhibit broader and more diverse thinking patterns. Through further analysis of training dynamics, we show that GRPO is prone to diversity collapse, causing models to prematurely converge to a limited subset of reasoning strategies while discarding the majority of potential alternatives, leading to local optima and poor scalability. To address this, we propose Multi-Group Policy Optimization (MUPO), a simple yet effective approach designed to incentivize divergent thinking across multiple solutions, and demonstrate its effectiveness on established benchmarks. Project page: https://xytian1008.github.io/MUPO/

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 近期研究表明，强化学习（RL），尤其是组相对策略优化（GRPO），能够从本质上激发并增强视觉语言模型（VLMs）的推理能力。然而，尽管前景广阔，驱动强化学习模型有效性的内在机制及其局限性仍缺乏深入探索。本文揭示了强化学习模型与基础模型之间存在的基本行为差异：前者倾向于深入而狭窄的推理，而基础模型尽管在单一路径上的推理不够精细，却展现出更广泛且多样化的思维模式。通过对训练动态的进一步分析，我们发现GRPO容易陷入多样性崩溃，导致模型过早收敛至有限的推理策略子集，而丢弃了大部分潜在替代方案，从而陷入局部最优且可扩展性较差。为解决这一问题，我们提出了多组策略优化（MUPO），这是一种简单而有效的方法，旨在激励针对多个解决方案的多样化思维，并在已有基准测试中验证了其有效性。项目页面：https://xytian1008.github.io/MUPO/

TLDR: This paper proposes a method to improve the diversity of reasoning in Vision-Language Models trained with RL, which is prone to premature convergence on narrow strategies, and suggests a new approach for encouraging multiple solution paths.

简要说明: 本文提出一种方法，用于改善基于强化学习训练的视觉语言模型推理的多样性，这类模型易过早收敛于狭窄的策略，并提出一种新方法来鼓励模型探索多种解决方案路径。

Authors: Xinyu Tian, Shu Zou, Zhaoyuan Yang, Mengqi He, Peter Tu, Jing Zhang

The 1st Winner for 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Challenge: Strong MLLMs Meet SAM3 for Referring Video Object Segmentation

Abstract (English): This report presents our winning solution to the 5th PVUW MeViS-Text Challenge. The track studies referring video object segmentation under motion-centric language expressions, where the model must jointly understand appearance, temporal behavior, and object interactions. To address this problem, we build a fully training-free pipeline that combines strong multimodal large language models with SAM3. Our method contains three stages. First, Gemini-3.1 Pro decomposes each target event into instance-level grounding targets, selects the frame where the target is most clearly visible, and generates a discriminative description. Second, SAM3-agent produces a precise seed mask on the selected frame, and the official SAM3 tracker propagates the mask through the whole video. Third, a refinement stage uses Qwen3.5-Plus and behavior-level verification to correct ambiguous or semantically inconsistent predictions. Without task-specific fine-tuning, our method ranks first on the PVUW 2026 MeViS-Text test set, achieving a Final score of 0.909064 and a J&F score of 0.7897. The code is available at https://github.com/Moujuruo/MeViSv2_Track_Solution_2026.

摘要（中文）: 本报告介绍了我们在第五届PVUW MeViS-Text挑战赛中的获胜方案。该赛道研究以运动为中心的语言表达下的视频目标分割任务，模型需要同时理解外观特征、时序行为及目标间交互关系。为解决此问题，我们构建了一个完全无需训练的流程，将强大的多模态大语言模型与SAM3相结合。我们的方法包含三个阶段：首先，Gemini-3.1 Pro将每个目标事件分解为实例级定位目标，选择目标最清晰可见的帧，并生成判别性描述；其次，SAM3代理在选定帧上生成精确的初始掩膜，并由官方SAM3跟踪器将掩膜传播至整个视频；最后，通过Qwen3.5-Plus结合行为级验证的优化阶段，对模糊或语义不一致的预测结果进行修正。在不进行任务特定微调的情况下，我们的方法在PVUW 2026 MeViS-Text测试集上排名第一，最终得分为0.909064，J&F得分为0.7897。相关代码已发布于https://github.com/Moujuruo/MeViSv2_Track_Solution_2026。

TLDR: Winning, training-free method for referring video object segmentation uses MLLMs to decompose motion-centric language, SAM3 for segmentation and tracking, and refinement with LLM-based verification.

简要说明: 这是一个针对视频指代分割的获奖方案，无需训练，通过多模态大模型分解运动语言描述，结合SAM3进行分割与跟踪，并利用LLM进行验证和精修。

Authors: Xusheng He, Canyang Wu, Jinrong Zhang, Weili Guan, Jianlong Wu, Liqiang Nie

Advancing Complex Video Object Segmentation via Tracking-Enhanced Prompt: The 1st Winner for 5th PVUW MOSE Challenge

Abstract (English): In the Complex Video Object Segmentation task, researchers are required to track and segment specific targets within cluttered environments, which rigorously tests a method's capability for target comprehension and environmental adaptability. Although SAM3, the current state-of-the-art solution, exhibits unparalleled segmentation performance and robustness on conventional targets, it underperforms on tiny and semantic-dominated objects. The root cause of this limitation lies in SAM3's insufficient comprehension of these specific target types. To address this issue, we propose TEP: Advancing Complex Video Object Segmentation via Tracking-Enhanced Prompts. As a training-free approach, TEP leverages external tracking models and Multimodal Large Language Models to introduce tracking-enhanced prompts, thereby alleviating the difficulty SAM3 faces in understanding these challenging targets. Our method achieved first place (56.91%) on the test set of the PVUW Challenge 2026: Complex Video Object Segmentation Track.

摘要（中文）: 在复杂视频目标分割任务中，研究人员需在杂乱环境中对特定目标进行跟踪与分割，这对算法的目标理解能力与环境适应能力提出了严苛考验。当前最先进的解决方案SAM3在常规目标上展现出卓越的分割性能与鲁棒性，但在微小目标及语义主导型目标上表现欠佳，其根本原因在于对这些特定目标类型的理解能力不足。为解决此问题，我们提出TEP：通过跟踪增强提示改进复杂视频目标分割。作为一种无需训练的方法，TEP借助外部跟踪模型与多模态大语言模型引入跟踪增强提示，从而缓解SAM3在处理这类挑战性目标时的理解困境。我们的方法在PVUW 2026挑战赛：复杂视频目标分割赛道的测试集上取得了第一名的成绩（56.91%）。

TLDR: This paper introduces TEP, a training-free method using external tracking models and Multimodal Large Language Models to generate tracking-enhanced prompts, improving the segmentation of tiny and semantic-dominated objects in complex video object segmentation.

简要说明: 本文提出了TEP，一种无需训练的方法，利用外部跟踪模型和多模态大语言模型生成跟踪增强提示，以改进复杂视频目标分割中微小和语义主导物体的分割性能。

Authors: Jinrong Zhang, Canyang Wu, Xusheng He, Weili Guan, Jianlong Wu, Liqiang Nie

Mine-JEPA: In-Domain Self-Supervised Learning for Mine-Like Object Classification in Side-Scan Sonar

Abstract (English): Side-scan sonar (SSS) mine classification is a challenging maritime vision problem characterized by extreme data scarcity and a large domain gap from natural images. While self-supervised learning (SSL) and general-purpose vision foundation models have shown strong performance in general vision and several specialized domains, their use in SSS remains largely unexplored. We present Mine-JEPA, the first in-domain SSL pipeline for SSS mine classification, using SIGReg, a regularization-based SSL loss, to pretrain on only 1,170 unlabeled sonar images. In the binary mine vs. non-mine setting, Mine-JEPA achieves an F1 score of 0.935, outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.922), a foundation model pretrained on 1.7B images. For 3-class mine-like object classification, Mine-JEPA reaches 0.820 with synthetic data augmentation, again outperforming fine-tuned DINOv3 (0.810). We further observe that applying in-domain SSL to foundation models degrades performance by 10--13 percentage points, suggesting that stronger pretrained models do not always benefit from additional domain adaptation. In addition, Mine-JEPA with a compact ViT-Tiny backbone achieves competitive performance while using 4x fewer parameters than DINOv3. These results suggest that carefully designed in-domain self-supervised learning is a viable alternative to much larger foundation models in data-scarce maritime sonar imagery.

摘要（中文）: 侧扫声纳水雷分类是海洋视觉领域一项极具挑战性的任务，其特点是数据极度匮乏且与自然图像存在显著领域差异。尽管自监督学习与通用视觉基础模型在通用视觉及若干专业领域已展现出强大性能，但其在侧扫声纳领域的应用仍鲜有探索。本文提出Mine-JEPA——首个面向侧扫声纳水雷分类的领域内自监督学习框架，通过基于正则化的自监督损失函数SIGReg，仅使用1170张未标记声纳图像进行预训练。在二分类（水雷/非水雷）场景中，Mine-JEPA取得0.935的F1分数，优于在17亿图像上预训练的基础模型DINOv3微调版本（0.922）。针对三类水雷状物体分类任务，Mine-JEPA结合合成数据增强达到0.820的F1分数，同样超越微调DINOv3模型（0.810）。研究进一步发现，对基础模型施加领域内自监督学习会导致性能下降10-13个百分点，表明更强的预训练模型未必能从额外的领域适应中获益。此外，采用紧凑型ViT-Tiny架构的Mine-JEPA在参数量比DINOv3减少4倍的同时仍保持竞争优势。这些结果表明，在数据稀缺的海洋声纳图像领域，精心设计的领域内自监督学习可作为超大规模基础模型的有效替代方案。

TLDR: This paper introduces Mine-JEPA, an in-domain self-supervised learning pipeline for classifying mine-like objects in side-scan sonar imagery, achieving competitive performance with a compact model despite extreme data scarcity.

简要说明: 本文提出了Mine-JEPA，一种用于侧扫声纳图像中水雷样物体分类的域内自监督学习管道，在数据极其稀缺的情况下，使用紧凑模型实现了具有竞争力的性能。

Authors: Taeyoun Kwon, Youngwon Choi, Hyeonyu Kim, Myeongkyun Cho, Junhyeok Choi, Moon Hwan Kim

mmAnomaly: Leveraging Visual Context for Robust Anomaly Detection in the Non-Visual World with mmWave Radar

Abstract (English): mmWave radar enables human sensing in non-visual scenarios-e.g., through clothing or certain types of walls-where traditional cameras fail due to occlusion or privacy limitations. However, robust anomaly detection with mmWave remains challenging, as signal reflections are influenced by material properties, clutter, and multipath interference, producing complex, non-Gaussian distortions. Existing methods lack contextual awareness and misclassify benign signal variations as anomalies. We present mmAnomaly, a multi-modal anomaly detection framework that combines mmWave radar with RGBD input to incorporate visual context. Our system extracts semantic cues-such as scene geometry and material properties-using a fast ResNet-based classifier, and uses a conditional latent diffusion model to synthesize the expected mmWave spectrum for the given visual context. A dual-input comparison module then identifies spatial deviations between real and generated spectra to localize anomalies. We evaluate mmAnomaly on two multi-modal datasets across three applications: concealed weapon localization, through-wall intruder localization, and through-wall fall localization. The system achieves up to 94% F1 score and sub-meter localization error, demonstrating robust generalization across clothing, occlusions, and cluttered environments. These results establish mmAnomaly as an accurate and interpretable framework for context-aware anomaly detection in mmWave sensing.

摘要（中文）: 毫米波雷达能够在非视觉场景下实现人体感知，例如穿透衣物或某些类型的墙壁，而传统摄像头因遮挡或隐私限制无法在此类场景中发挥作用。然而，毫米波信号反射易受材料特性、环境杂波和多径干扰的影响，导致复杂且非高斯分布的信号畸变，这使得基于毫米波雷达的稳健异常检测仍然面临挑战。现有方法缺乏上下文感知能力，常将良性信号变化误判为异常。本文提出了mmAnomaly，一种多模态异常检测框架，通过融合毫米波雷达与RGBD输入来整合视觉上下文信息。该系统采用基于快速ResNet的分类器提取语义线索（如场景几何结构与材料属性），并利用条件潜在扩散模型为给定视觉场景生成预期的毫米波频谱。随后，通过双输入比较模块计算真实频谱与生成频谱之间的空间偏差，从而定位异常。我们在两个多模态数据集上针对三项应用对mmAnomaly进行了评估：隐蔽武器定位、穿墙入侵者定位和穿墙跌倒定位。该系统实现了最高94%的F1分数和亚米级定位误差，在衣物遮挡、复杂遮挡和杂乱环境等场景下均表现出稳健的泛化能力。这些结果证实了mmAnomaly可作为毫米波传感领域中具备上下文感知能力、准确且可解释的异常检测框架。

TLDR: mmAnomaly is a multi-modal framework that uses RGBD visual context and a conditional latent diffusion model to guide mmWave radar for robust anomaly detection in non-visual scenarios, such as locating concealed weapons or through-wall intruders.

简要说明: mmAnomaly 是一个多模态框架，它利用 RGBD 视觉上下文和条件潜在扩散模型来引导毫米波雷达，用于非视觉场景（如定位隐藏武器或穿墙入侵者）的鲁棒异常检测。

Authors: Tarik Reza Toha, Shao-Jung, Lu, Mahathir Monjur, Shahriar Nirjon

UCMNet: Uncertainty-Aware Context Memory Network for Under-Display Camera Image Restoration

Abstract (English): Under-display cameras (UDCs) allow for full-screen designs by positioning the imaging sensor underneath the display. Nonetheless, light diffraction and scattering through the various display layers result in spatially varying and complex degradations, which significantly reduce high-frequency details. Current PSF-based physical modeling techniques and frequency-separation networks are effective at reconstructing low-frequency structures and maintaining overall color consistency. However, they still face challenges in recovering fine details when dealing with complex, spatially varying degradation. To solve this problem, we propose a lightweight \textbf{U}ncertainty-aware \textbf{C}ontext-\textbf{M}emory \textbf{Network} (\textbf{UCMNet}), for UDC image restoration. Unlike previous methods that apply uniform restoration, UCMNet performs uncertainty-aware adaptive processing to restore high-frequency details in regions with varying degradations. The estimated uncertainty maps, learned through an uncertainty-driven loss, quantify spatial uncertainty induced by diffraction and scattering, and guide the Memory Bank to retrieve region-adaptive context from the Context Bank. This process enables effective modeling of the non-uniform degradation characteristics inherent to UDC imaging. Leveraging this uncertainty as a prior, UCMNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks with 30\% fewer parameters than previous models. Project page: \href{https://kdhrick2222.github.io/projects/UCMNet/}{https://kdhrick2222.github.io/projects/UCMNet}.

摘要（中文）: 屏下摄像头通过将成像传感器置于显示屏下方实现了全面屏设计。然而，光线穿过不同显示层时产生的衍射和散射会导致空间上复杂多变的图像退化，显著削弱高频细节。当前基于点扩散函数的物理建模技术和频域分离网络能有效重建低频结构并保持整体色彩一致性，但在处理复杂且空间变化的退化时，恢复精细细节仍面临挑战。为解决此问题，我们提出了一种轻量化的**不确定性感知上下文记忆网络**，用于屏下摄像头图像恢复。与先前采用均匀恢复的方法不同，该网络通过不确定性感知的自适应处理来恢复不同退化区域的高频细节。通过不确定性驱动损失学习得到的不确定性图可量化衍射与散射引发的空间不确定性，并引导记忆库从上下文库中检索区域自适应内容，从而有效建模屏下摄像成像固有的非均匀退化特性。借助该不确定性先验，该网络以比先前模型少30%的参数，在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。项目页面：https://kdhrick2222.github.io/projects/UCMNet/。

TLDR: The paper proposes a lightweight uncertainty-aware network (UCMNet) for under-display camera image restoration, which adaptively processes regions with varying degradations to recover fine details, achieving state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种轻量级不确定性感知网络（UCMNet），用于屏下摄像头图像恢复，通过自适应处理不同退化区域来恢复精细细节，以更少的参数实现了最先进的性能。

Authors: Daehyun Kim, Youngmin Kim, Yoon Ju Oh, Tae Hyun Kim

Dynamic Graph Neural Network with Adaptive Features Selection for RGB-D Based Indoor Scene Recognition

Abstract (English): Multi-modality of color and depth, i.e., RGB-D, is of great importance in recent research of indoor scene recognition. In this kind of data representation, depth map is able to describe the 3D structure of scenes and geometric relations among objects. Previous works showed that local features of both modalities are vital for promotion of recognition accuracy. However, the problem of adaptive selection and effective exploitation on these key local features remains open in this field. In this paper, a dynamic graph model is proposed with adaptive node selection mechanism to solve the above problem. In this model, a dynamic graph is built up to model the relations among objects and scene, and a method of adaptive node selection is proposed to take key local features from both modalities of RGB and depth for graph modeling. After that, these nodes are grouped by three different levels, representing near or far relations among objects. Moreover, the graph model is updated dynamically according to attention weights. Finally, the updated and optimized features of RGB and depth modalities are fused together for indoor scene recognition. Experiments are performed on public datasets including SUN RGB-D and NYU Depth v2. Extensive results demonstrate that our method has superior performance when comparing to state-of-the-arts methods, and show that the proposed method is able to exploit crucial local features from both modalities of RGB and depth.

摘要（中文）: 颜色与深度的多模态（即RGB-D）在室内场景识别的近期研究中具有重要意义。在此类数据表示中，深度图能够描述场景的三维结构及物体间的几何关系。先前的研究表明，两种模态的局部特征对提升识别精度至关重要。然而，如何自适应地选择并有效利用这些关键局部特征仍是该领域尚未解决的问题。本文提出一种带有自适应节点选择机制的动态图模型来解决上述问题。该模型通过构建动态图来建模物体与场景之间的关联关系，并提出一种自适应节点选择方法，从RGB和深度两种模态中提取关键局部特征用于图建模。随后，这些节点被划分为三个不同层级，以表征物体间的远近关系。此外，图模型会根据注意力权重进行动态更新。最终，将更新优化后的RGB与深度模态特征融合，实现室内场景识别。我们在SUN RGB-D和NYU Depth v2等公开数据集上进行了实验。大量结果表明，与现有先进方法相比，本方法具有更优性能，并证明其能够有效利用RGB和深度两种模态中的关键局部特征。

TLDR: This paper proposes a dynamic graph neural network with adaptive node selection to fuse RGB and depth features for indoor scene recognition, achieving state-of-the-art results on SUN RGB-D and NYU Depth v2.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种具有自适应节点选择的动态图神经网络，用于融合RGB和深度特征进行室内场景识别，在SUN RGB-D和NYU Depth v2数据集上取得了最优性能。

Authors: Qiong Liu, Ruofei Xiong, Xingzhen Chen, Muyao Peng, You Yang

VADMamba++: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection via Hybrid Modeling in Grayscale Space

Abstract (English): VADMamba pioneered the introduction of Mamba to Video Anomaly Detection (VAD), achieving high accuracy and fast inference through hybrid proxy tasks. Nevertheless, its heavy reliance on optical flow as auxiliary input and inter-task fusion scoring constrains its applicability to a single proxy task. In this paper, we introduce VADMamba++, an efficient VAD method based on the Gray-to-RGB paradigm that enforces a Single-Channel to Three-Channel reconstruction mapping, designed for a single proxy task and operating without auxiliary inputs. This paradigm compels inferring color appearances from grayscale structures, allowing anomalies to be more effectively revealed through dual inconsistencies between structure and chromatic cues. Specifically, VADMamba++ reconstructs grayscale frames into the RGB space to simultaneously discriminate structural geometry and chromatic fidelity, thereby enhancing sensitivity to explicit visual anomalies. We further design a hybrid modeling backbone that integrates Mamba, CNN, and Transformer modules to capture diverse normal patterns while suppressing the appearance of anomalies. Furthermore, an intra-task fusion scoring strategy integrates explicit future-frame prediction errors with implicit quantized feature errors, further improving accuracy under a single task setting. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that VADMamba++ outperforms state-of-the-art methods while meeting performance and efficiency, especially under a strict single-task setting with only frame-level inputs.

摘要（中文）: VADMamba首次将Mamba模型引入视频异常检测领域，通过混合代理任务实现了高精度与快速推理。然而，其严重依赖光流作为辅助输入及任务间融合评分策略，限制了其在单一代理任务中的应用。本文提出VADMamba++，一种基于灰度到RGB范式的高效视频异常检测方法。该范式通过强制单通道到三通道的重建映射机制，专为单一代理任务设计且无需辅助输入。该范式迫使模型从灰度结构推断色彩外观，使异常能够通过结构线索与色彩线索间的双重不一致性更有效地暴露。具体而言，VADMamba++将灰度帧重构至RGB空间，以同时判别结构几何与色彩保真度，从而增强对显式视觉异常的敏感性。我们进一步设计了融合Mamba、CNN与Transformer模块的混合建模主干网络，以捕获多样化的正常模式并抑制异常特征的出现。此外，任务内融合评分策略整合了显式的未来帧预测误差与隐式的量化特征误差，在单一任务设置下进一步提升检测精度。在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，VADMamba++在满足性能与效率要求的同时优于现有先进方法，尤其在仅使用帧级输入的严格单任务设置下表现突出。

TLDR: VADMamba++ is a video anomaly detection method that uses a Gray-to-RGB reconstruction task and a hybrid Mamba-CNN-Transformer backbone to identify anomalies without auxiliary inputs like optical flow.

简要说明: VADMamba++ 是一种视频异常检测方法，使用灰阶到RGB的重建任务和混合 Mamba-CNN-Transformer 主干网络，在无需光流等辅助输入的情况下识别异常。

Authors: Jihao Lyu, Minghua Zhao, Jing Hu, Yifei Chen, Shuangli Du, Cheng Shi

Label-efficient underwater species classification with semi-supervised learning on frozen foundation model embeddings

Abstract (English): Automated species classification from underwater imagery is bottlenecked by the cost of expert annotation, and supervised models trained on one dataset rarely transfer to new conditions. We investigate whether semi-supervised methods operating on frozen foundation model embeddings can close this annotation gap with minimal labeling effort. Using DINOv3 ViT-B embeddings with no fine-tuning, we propagate a small set of labeled seeds through unlabeled data via nearest-neighbor-based self-training and evaluate on the AQUA20 benchmark (20 marine species). With fewer than 5% of the training labels, self-training on frozen embeddings closes much of the gap to a fully supervised ConvNeXt baseline trained on the entire labeled dataset; at full supervision, the gap narrows to a few percentage points, with several species exceeding the supervised baseline. Class separability in the embedding space, measured by ROC-AUC, is high even at extreme label scarcity, indicating that the frozen representations capture discriminative structure well before decision boundaries can be reliably estimated. Our approach requires no training, no domain-specific data engineering, and no underwater-adapted models, establishing a practical, immediately deployable baseline for label-efficient marine species recognition. All results are reported on the held-out test set over 100 random seed initializations.

摘要（中文）: 摘要：水下图像自动物种分类受限于专家标注成本，且基于单一数据集训练的监督模型难以迁移至新环境。本研究探讨基于冻结基础模型嵌入的半监督方法能否以最少标注量弥补这一差距。我们使用未经微调的DINOv3 ViT-B嵌入表示，通过基于最近邻的自训练方法将少量标注样本信息传播至未标注数据，并在AQUA20基准数据集（20种海洋物种）上评估效果。结果显示：仅使用不足5%的训练标注量，基于冻结嵌入的自训练方法即可大幅缩小与全监督ConvNeXt基线模型（使用完整标注数据训练）的差距；在完全监督条件下，两者差距缩小至几个百分点，部分物种分类效果甚至超过监督基线。通过ROC-AUC度量的嵌入空间类别可分性在极端标注稀缺条件下仍保持较高水平，表明冻结表示在决策边界可被可靠估计之前已能有效捕捉判别性结构。该方法无需训练过程、无需领域特定数据工程、亦无需水下适配模型，为标签高效的海洋物种识别提供了一个实用且可即时部署的基线。所有结果均通过对100次随机种子初始化的保留测试集计算得出。

TLDR: A semi-supervised learning method using frozen DINOv3 ViT-B embeddings achieves label-efficient marine species classification, nearly matching the performance of a fully supervised baseline on the AQUA20 benchmark with only 5% of the labels.

简要说明: 该研究使用冻结的DINOv3 ViT-B嵌入，通过半监督学习方法，仅用5%的标注数据，在AQUA20海洋物种分类基准上实现了接近全监督基线的性能。

Authors: Thomas Manuel Rost

Excite, Attend and Segment (EASe): Domain-Agnostic Fine-Grained Mask Discovery with Feature Calibration and Self-Supervised Upsampling

Abstract (English): Unsupervised segmentation approaches have increasingly leveraged foundation models (FM) to improve salient object discovery. However, these methods often falter in scenes with complex, multi-component morphologies, where fine-grained structural detail is indispensable. Many state-of-the-art unsupervised segmentation pipelines rely on mask discovery approaches that utilize coarse, patch-level representations. These coarse representations inherently suppress the fine-grained detail required to resolve such complex morphologies. To overcome this limitation, we propose Excite, Attend and Segment (EASe), an unsupervised domain-agnostic semantic segmentation framework for easy fine-grained mask discovery across challenging real-world scenes. EASe utilizes novel Semantic-Aware Upsampling with Channel Excitation (SAUCE) to excite low-resolution FM feature channels for selective calibration and attends across spatially-encoded image and FM features to recover full-resolution semantic representations. Finally, EASe segments the aggregated features into multi-granularity masks using a novel training-free Cue-Attentive Feature Aggregator (CAFE) which leverages SAUCE attention scores as a semantic grouping signal. EASe, together with SAUCE and CAFE, operate directly at pixel-level feature representations to enable accurate fine-grained dense semantic mask discovery. Our evaluation demonstrates superior performance of EASe over previous state-of-the-arts (SOTAs) across major standard benchmarks and diverse datasets with complex morphologies. Code is available at https://ease-project.github.io

摘要（中文）: 无监督分割方法日益借助基础模型来提升显著对象发现能力。然而这些方法在处理具有复杂多组件形态的场景时常显乏力，而此类场景中的细粒度结构细节至关重要。当前多数先进的无监督分割流程依赖于基于粗糙块级表示的掩码发现方法，这类粗糙表征本质上压制了解析复杂形态所需的细粒度细节。为克服此局限，我们提出激发、关注与分割框架——一种面向复杂真实场景、易于实现细粒度掩码发现的无监督领域无关语义分割框架。该框架通过新型语义感知通道激发上采样技术，对低分辨率基础模型特征通道进行选择性校准激发，并利用空间编码的图像与基础模型特征进行跨维度关注，以恢复全分辨率语义表征。最后，框架通过创新的免训练线索关注特征聚合器，将聚合特征分割为多粒度掩码，该聚合器以语义感知通道激发上采样的关注分数作为语义分组信号。该框架及其核心技术组件直接在像素级特征表征上操作，实现了精确的细粒度稠密语义掩码发现。实验评估表明，在主要标准基准测试及包含复杂形态的多样化数据集中，该框架均优于以往先进方法。代码发布于https://ease-project.github.io。

TLDR: This paper introduces EASe, a novel unsupervised domain-agnostic semantic segmentation framework that uses a novel upsampling and attention mechanism to enable fine-grained mask discovery in complex scenes with intricate morphologies, significantly improving performance on standard benchmarks.

简要说明: 本文提出了EASe，一种新颖的、与领域无关的无监督语义分割框架，它利用新的上采样和注意力机制，在具有复杂形态的场景中实现细粒度掩码发现，显著提升了在标准基准测试上的性能。

Authors: Deepank Singh, Anurag Nihal, Vedhus Hoskere

RawGen: Learning Camera Raw Image Generation

Abstract (English): Cameras capture scene-referred linear raw images, which are processed by onboard image signal processors (ISPs) into display-referred 8-bit sRGB outputs. Although raw data is more faithful for low-level vision tasks, collecting large-scale raw datasets remains a major bottleneck, as existing datasets are limited and tied to specific camera hardware. Generative models offer a promising way to address this scarcity -- however, existing diffusion frameworks are designed to synthesize photo-finished sRGB images rather than physically consistent linear representations. This paper presents RawGen, to our knowledge the first diffusion-based framework enabling text-to-raw generation for arbitrary target cameras, alongside sRGB-to-raw inversion. RawGen leverages the generative priors of large-scale sRGB diffusion models to synthesize physically meaningful linear outputs, such as CIE XYZ or camera-specific raw representations, via specialized processing in latent and pixel spaces. To handle unknown and diverse ISP pipelines and photo-finishing effects in diffusion-model training data, we build a many-to-one inverse-ISP dataset where multiple sRGB renditions of the same scene generated using diverse ISP parameters are anchored to a common scene-referred target. Fine-tuning a conditional denoiser and specialized decoder on this dataset allows RawGen to obtain camera-centric linear reconstructions that effectively invert the rendering pipeline. We demonstrate RawGen's superior performance over traditional inverse-ISP methods that assume a fixed ISP. Furthermore, we show that augmenting training pipelines with RawGen's scalable, text-driven synthetic data can benefit downstream low-level vision tasks.

摘要（中文）: 相机捕捉到的是场景参考的线性原始图像，这些图像由机载图像信号处理器（ISP）处理为显示参考的8位sRGB输出。尽管原始数据在低级视觉任务中更为忠实，但收集大规模原始数据集仍是一个主要瓶颈，因为现有数据集有限且依赖于特定相机硬件。生成模型为解决这一稀缺性问题提供了有前景的途径——然而，现有扩散框架旨在合成经过后期处理的sRGB图像，而非物理一致的线性表示。本文提出的RawGen，据我们所知，是首个基于扩散的框架，能够为任意目标相机实现文本到原始图像的生成，以及sRGB到原始图像的逆转换。RawGen利用大规模sRGB扩散模型的生成先验，通过潜空间和像素空间中的专门处理，合成具有物理意义的线性输出，如CIE XYZ或相机特定的原始表示。为了处理扩散模型训练数据中未知且多样化的ISP流水线和后期处理效果，我们构建了一个多对一逆ISP数据集，其中使用不同ISP参数生成的同一场景的多个sRGB渲染版本被锚定到共同的场景参考目标。在此数据集上微调解码器和专用解码器，使RawGen能够获得以相机为中心的线性重建，有效逆渲染流水线。我们展示了RawGen优于传统假设固定ISP的逆ISP方法的性能。此外，我们证明，利用RawGen可扩展的、文本驱动的合成数据增强训练流水线，可以有益于下游低级视觉任务。

TLDR: RawGen is a diffusion-based framework for text-to-raw image generation and sRGB-to-raw inversion, designed to synthesize physically consistent linear camera representations for arbitrary cameras.

简要说明: RawGen 是一种基于扩散的框架，用于从文本生成原始图像和将 sRGB 图像反转为原始图像，旨在为任意相机合成物理上一致的线性相机表示。
