Authors: Longwei Xu, Feng Feng, Shaojie Zhang, Xin Chen, Hang Li, Anan Du, Hailong Yu, Pei Fu, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan

S0 Tuning: Zero-Overhead Adaptation of Hybrid Recurrent-Attention Models

Abstract (English): Using roughly 48 execution-verified HumanEval training solutions, tuning a single initial state matrix per recurrent layer, with zero inference overhead, outperforms LoRA by +10.8 pp (p < 0.001) on HumanEval. The method, which we call S0 tuning, optimizes one state matrix per recurrent layer while freezing all model weights. On Qwen3.5-4B (GatedDeltaNet hybrid), S0 tuning improves greedy pass@1 by +23.6 +/- 1.7 pp (10 seeds). On FalconH1-7B (Mamba-2 hybrid), S0 reaches 71.8% +/- 1.3 and LoRA reaches 71.4% +/- 2.4 (3 seeds), statistically indistinguishable at this sample size while requiring no weight merging. Cross-domain transfer is significant on MATH-500 (+4.8 pp, p = 0.00002, 8 seeds) and GSM8K (+2.8 pp, p = 0.0003, 10 seeds); a text-to-SQL benchmark (Spider) shows no transfer, consistent with the trajectory-steering mechanism. A prefix-tuning control on a pure Transformer (Qwen2.5-3B) degrades performance by -13.9 pp under all nine configurations tested. On Qwen3.5, a per-step state-offset variant reaches +27.1 pp, above both S0 and LoRA but with per-step inference cost. Taken together, the results show that recurrent state initialization is a strong zero-inference-overhead PEFT surface for hybrid language models when verified supervision is scarce. The tuned state is a ~48 MB file; task switching requires no weight merging or model reload. Code and library: https://github.com/jackyoung27/s0-tuning.

摘要（中文）: 基于约48个经过执行验证的HumanEval训练样本，通过为每个循环层仅调整一个初始状态矩阵（推理零开销），本方法在HumanEval上以+10.8个百分点（p < 0.001）的表现优于LoRA。我们将此方法称为S0调优，它在冻结所有权重参数的同时，为每个循环层优化一个状态矩阵。在Qwen3.5-4B（GatedDeltaNet混合架构）上，S0调优使贪婪解码的pass@1指标提升+23.6 ± 1.7个百分点（10次随机种子）。在FalconH1-7B（Mamba-2混合架构）上，S0达到71.8% ± 1.3，LoRA达到71.4% ± 2.4（3次随机种子），在当前样本量下统计无显著差异，且无需权重合并。跨领域迁移能力在MATH-500（+4.8个百分点，p = 0.00002，8次随机种子）和GSM8K（+2.8个百分点，p = 0.0003，10次随机种子）上表现显著；文本到SQL基准测试（Spider）未显示迁移效应，这与轨迹导向机制相符。在纯Transformer架构（Qwen2.5-3B）上进行的前缀调优对照组，在全部九种配置下均出现性能下降（-13.9个百分点）。在Qwen3.5上，逐步状态偏移变体达到+27.1个百分点，优于S0和LoRA，但需承担单步推理开销。综合结果表明，在验证监督数据稀缺时，循环状态初始化是混合语言模型中一种强效的零推理开销参数高效微调方案。调优后的状态文件约48 MB；任务切换无需权重合并或模型重载。代码与库：https://github.com/jackyoung27/s0-tuning。

TLDR: The paper introduces S0 tuning, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for hybrid recurrent-attention models that optimizes initial state matrices with zero inference overhead, showing strong performance on code generation and math reasoning benchmarks.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于混合循环注意力模型的高效参数微调方法S0 tuning，该方法通过优化初始状态矩阵实现零推理开销，在代码生成和数学推理基准测试中表现出色。

Authors: Jack Young

Property-Level Flood Risk Assessment Using AI-Enabled Street-View Lowest Floor Elevation Extraction and ML Imputation Across Texas

Abstract (English): This paper argues that AI-enabled analysis of street-view imagery, complemented by performance-gated machine-learning imputation, provides a viable pathway for generating building-specific elevation data at regional scale for flood risk assessment. We develop and apply a three-stage pipeline across 18 areas of interest (AOIs) in Texas that (1) extracts LFE and the height difference between street grade and the lowest floor (HDSL) from Google Street View imagery using the Elev-Vision framework, (2) imputes missing HDSL values with Random Forest and Gradient Boosting models trained on 16 terrain, hydrologic, geographic, and flood-exposure features, and (3) integrates the resulting elevation dataset with Fathom 1-in-100 year inundation surfaces and USACE depth-damage functions to estimate property-specific interior flood depth and expected loss. Across 12,241 residential structures, street-view imagery was available for 73.4% of parcels and direct LFE/HDSL extraction was successful for 49.0% (5,992 structures). Imputation was retained for 13 AOIs where cross-validated performance was defensible, with selected models achieving R suqre values from 0.159 to 0.974; five AOIs were explicitly excluded from prediction because performance was insufficient. The results show that street-view-based elevation mapping is not universally available for every property, but it is sufficiently scalable to materially improve regional flood-risk characterization by moving beyond hazard exposure to structure-level estimates of interior inundation and expected damage. Scientifically, the study advances LFE estimation from a pilot-scale proof of concept to a regional, end-to-end workflow. Practically, it offers a replicable framework for jurisdictions that lack comprehensive Elevation Certificates but need parcel-level information to support mitigation, planning, and flood-risk management.

摘要（中文）: 本文提出，基于街景图像的人工智能分析辅以性能门控的机器学习插补方法，为区域尺度洪水风险评估中生成建筑级高程数据提供了可行路径。我们在德克萨斯州18个关注区域开发并应用了一套三阶段流程：(1)利用Elev-Vision框架从谷歌街景图像中提取最低楼面高程（LFE）及街道标高与最低楼层高度差（HDSL）；(2)基于16个地形、水文、地理及洪水暴露特征训练的随机森林与梯度提升模型，对缺失HDSL值进行插补；(3)将生成的高程数据集与Fathom百年一遇淹没面、美国陆军工程兵团深度-损失函数相结合，估算单体建筑的内部洪水深度与预期损失。在12,241处住宅建筑中，73.4%地块可获得街景图像，其中49.0%（5,992栋建筑）成功实现LFE/HDSL直接提取。在13个交叉验证性能达标的研究区域中保留插补数据，所选模型R平方值介于0.159至0.974之间；另有5个区域因性能不足被明确排除在预测范围外。结果表明，基于街景的高程测绘虽无法覆盖所有建筑，但其扩展性足以推动区域洪水风险表征从灾害暴露评估提升至建筑内部淹没与预期损失估算层面，实现实质性改进。在科学层面，本研究将LFE估算从试点概念验证推进为区域性端到端工作流程；在实践层面，为缺乏完整高程证书但需地块级数据支持减灾、规划与洪水风险管理的行政区域提供了可复现的操作框架。

TLDR: This paper proposes an AI and ML pipeline to extract building elevation data from street-view imagery for flood risk assessment at a regional scale, integrating it with flood models to estimate property-level damage.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种AI和ML流程，从街景图像中提取建筑高程数据，用于区域尺度的洪水风险评估，并结合洪水模型估算房产级损失。

Authors: Xiangpeng Li, Yu-Hsuan Ho, Sam D Brody, Ali Mostafavi

Reconsidering Dependency Networks from an Information Geometry Perspective

Abstract (English): Dependency networks (Heckerman et al., 2000) provide a flexible framework for modeling complex systems with many variables by combining independently learned local conditional distributions through pseudo-Gibbs sampling. Despite their computational advantages over Bayesian and Markov networks, the theoretical foundations of dependency networks remain incomplete, primarily because their model distributions -- defined as stationary distributions of pseudo-Gibbs sampling -- lack closed-form expressions. This paper develops an information-geometric analysis of pseudo-Gibbs sampling, interpreting each sampling step as an m-projection onto a full conditional manifold. Building on this interpretation, we introduce the full conditional divergence and derive an upper bound that characterizes the location of the stationary distribution in the space of probability distributions. We then reformulate both structure and parameter learning as optimization problems that decompose into independent subproblems for each node, and prove that the learned model distribution converges to the true underlying distribution as the number of training samples grows to infinity. Experiments confirm that the proposed upper bound is tight in practice.

摘要（中文）: 依赖网络（Heckerman等人，2000）通过伪吉布斯采样结合独立学习的局部条件分布，为建模多变量复杂系统提供了一种灵活的框架。尽管其在计算上优于贝叶斯网络和马尔可夫网络，依赖网络的理论基础仍不完善，主要因为其模型分布——即伪吉布斯采样的平稳分布——缺乏闭式表达式。本文对伪吉布斯采样进行了信息几何分析，将每一步采样解释为向全条件流形的m投影。基于这一解释，我们引入了全条件散度，并推导出一个描述平稳分布概率分布空间位置的上界。随后，我们将结构和参数学习重构为可分解为各节点独立子问题的优化问题，并证明当训练样本数量趋于无穷时，学习得到的模型分布收敛于真实潜在分布。实验证实所提出的上界在实践中是紧致的。

TLDR: This paper provides a new information-geometric analysis of dependency networks, establishing theoretical guarantees for learning and convergence.

简要说明: 本文从信息几何角度重新审视了依赖网络，为其学习和收敛提供了新的理论分析及保证。

Authors: Kazuya Takabatake, Shotaro Akaho

Generalization Bounds for Spectral GNNs via Fourier Domain Analysis

Abstract (English): Spectral graph neural networks learn graph filters, but their behavior with increasing depth and polynomial order is not well understood. We analyze these models in the graph Fourier domain, where each layer becomes an element-wise frequency update, separating the fixed spectrum from trainable parameters and making depth and order explicit. In this setting, we show that Gaussian complexity is invariant under the Graph Fourier Transform, which allows us to derive data-dependent, depth, and order-aware generalization bounds together with stability estimates. In the linear case, our bounds are tighter, and on real graphs, the data-dependent term correlates with the generalization gap across polynomial bases, highlighting practical choices that avoid frequency amplification across layers.

摘要（中文）: 谱图神经网络通过学习图滤波器进行工作，但关于其随深度和多项式阶数增加而表现出的行为，目前尚未得到充分理解。我们在图傅里叶域中对这些模型进行分析，其中每一层都成为一个逐元素的频率更新，从而将固定频谱与可训练参数分离开，并使深度和阶数变得明确。在此设定下，我们证明了高斯复杂度在图傅里叶变换下保持不变，这使得我们能够导出依赖于数据、深度和阶数的泛化界以及稳定性估计。在线性情况下，我们得到的界更为紧凑；而在实际图中，依赖于数据的项与不同多项式基之间的泛化差距相关，这突显了在实践中可避免层间频率放大的选择。

TLDR: This paper analyzes spectral graph neural networks in the graph Fourier domain, providing theoretical generalization bounds and stability estimates for model depth and polynomial order.

简要说明: 本文在图傅里叶域分析谱图神经网络，为模型深度和多项式阶数提供了理论泛化界限和稳定性估计。

Authors: Vahan A. Martirosyan, Daniele Malitesta, Hugues Talbot, Jhony H. Giraldo, Fragkiskos D. Malliaros

Event Embedding of Protein Networks : Compositional Learning of Biological Function

Abstract (English): In this work, we study whether enforcing strict compositional structure in sequence embeddings yields meaningful geometric organization when applied to protein-protein interaction networks. Using Event2Vec, an additive sequence embedding model, we train 64-dimensional representations on random walks from the human STRING interactome, and compare against a DeepWalk baseline based on Word2Vec, trained on the same walks. We find that compositional structure substantially improves pathway coherence (30.2$\times$ vs 2.9$\times$ above random), functional analogy accuracy (mean similarity 0.966 vs 0.650), and hierarchical pathway organization, while geometric properties such as norm--degree anticorrelation are shared with or exceeded by the non-compositional baseline. These results indicate that enforced compositionality specifically benefits relational and compositional reasoning tasks in biological networks.

摘要（中文）: 在本研究中，我们探讨了在序列嵌入中强制施加严格的组合结构，应用于蛋白质相互作用网络时是否能产生有意义的几何组织。我们使用加法序列嵌入模型Event2Vec，基于人类STRING相互作用组的随机游走训练了64维向量表示，并与在相同游走序列上训练的Word2Vec基准模型DeepWalk进行对比。研究发现，组合结构显著提升了通路连贯性（相比随机基准提升30.2倍 vs 2.9倍）、功能类比准确性（平均相似度0.966 vs 0.650）以及层次化通路组织能力，而范数与度值的负相关等几何特性则与非组合基准模型相当或更优。这些结果表明，强制组合性特别有助于生物网络中的关系推理和组合推理任务。

TLDR: This paper proposes a compositional embedding model, Event2Vec, for protein-protein interaction networks, showing improved performance on biological pathway coherence and functional analogy tasks compared to a non-compositional baseline.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于蛋白质相互作用网络的组合嵌入模型Event2Vec，与非组合基线相比，在生物通路连贯性和功能类比任务上表现出更好的性能。

Authors: Antonin Sulc

Fatigue-Aware Learning to Defer via Constrained Optimisation

Abstract (English): Learning to defer (L2D) enables human-AI cooperation by deciding when an AI system should act autonomously or defer to a human expert. Existing L2D methods, however, assume static human performance, contradicting well-established findings on fatigue-induced degradation. We propose Fatigue-Aware Learning to Defer via Constrained Optimisation (FALCON), which explicitly models workload-varying human performance using psychologically grounded fatigue curves. FALCON formulates L2D as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) whose state includes both task features and cumulative human workload, and optimises accuracy under human-AI cooperation budgets via PPO-Lagrangian training. We further introduce FA-L2D, a benchmark that systematically varies fatigue dynamics from near-static to rapidly degrading regimes. Experiments across multiple datasets show that FALCON consistently outperforms state-of-the-art L2D methods across coverage levels, generalises zero-shot to unseen experts with different fatigue patterns, and demonstrates the advantage of adaptive human-AI collaboration over AI-only or human-only decision-making when coverage lies strictly between 0 and 1.

摘要（中文）: 学习推迟决策（L2D）技术通过判断人工智能系统应在何时自主行动或推迟至人类专家决策，实现了人机协同。然而，现有L2D方法假设人类表现恒定不变，这与疲劳导致表现下降的公认结论相矛盾。我们提出基于约束优化的疲劳感知推迟决策方法（FALCON），该方法运用心理学基础的疲劳曲线对随工作量变化的人类表现进行显式建模。FALCON将L2D构建为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），其状态同时包含任务特征与人类累计工作量，并通过PPO-Lagrangian训练在既定人机协同资源约束下优化决策准确率。我们还建立了FA-L2D基准测试，系统模拟从近似稳定到快速衰退的多种疲劳动态场景。在多数据集上的实验表明：FALCON在不同覆盖率水平上均优于当前最先进的L2D方法；能零样本泛化至具有不同疲劳模式的未知专家；当覆盖率严格介于0到1之间时，自适应人机协作展现出优于纯AI决策或纯人工决策的显著优势。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method for human-AI collaboration that explicitly models human fatigue and optimizes when to defer decisions using a constrained optimization approach.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过心理学的疲劳曲线显式建模人类表现，并使用约束优化来决定何时将决策权交给人类专家，以优化人机协作的准确性。

Authors: Zheng Zhang, Cuong C. Nguyen, David Rosewarne, Kevin Wells, Gustavo Carneiro

Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning

Abstract (English): Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become a central post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. Yet existing methods share a common blind spot: they optimize policies based on instantaneous group-level or batch-level statistics without ever verifying whether the resulting update actually improved the model. This open-loop design -- updating in isolation at each step, guided only by within-group (batch) reward signals -- means optimization can drift or collapse with no mechanism to detect and correct these failures. We argue that the missing ingredient is policy improvement feedback: the ability to measure and optimize inter-iteration progress directly. To this end, we introduce Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning (PIRL), a framework that replaces surrogate reward maximization with the explicit objective of maximizing cumulative policy improvement across iterations, and prove this temporal objective is perfectly aligned with maximizing final task performance. Building on PIRL, we propose Policy Improvement Policy Optimization (PIPO), which implements closed-loop optimization through retrospective verification. At each iteration, PIPO evaluates whether the previous update yielded genuine improvement against a sliding-window historical baseline, then actively reinforces beneficial updates and suppresses the harmful ones -- transforming an open-loop process into a self-correcting one. We provide theoretical analysis showing that PIPO performs ascent on the PIRL objective in expectation, and experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate improved stability and performance over GRPO and its variants.

摘要（中文）: 强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）已成为提升大语言模型推理能力的核心后训练范式。然而现有方法存在一个共同的盲区：它们基于瞬时群体层面或批次层面的统计指标优化策略，却从未验证所得到的更新是否真正提升了模型性能。这种开环设计——每一步仅在组内（批次）奖励信号的引导下独立更新——意味着优化过程可能漂移或崩溃，而缺乏检测和纠正这些失败的机制。我们认为缺失的关键要素是策略改进反馈：即直接衡量和优化迭代间进展的能力。为此，我们提出策略改进强化学习（PIRL），该框架以最大化跨迭代累积策略改进的显式目标替代替代奖励最大化，并证明这种时序目标与最大化最终任务性能完全一致。基于PIRL框架，我们进一步提出策略改进策略优化（PIPO），通过回顾性验证实现闭环优化。在每次迭代中，PIPO根据滑动窗口历史基线评估前次更新是否产生真实改进，随后主动强化有益更新并抑制有害更新，从而将开环过程转化为具备自我校正能力的优化系统。理论分析表明PIPO在期望意义上实现了PIRL目标的梯度上升，数学推理基准测试实验证明其相对于GRPO及其变体在稳定性和性能上均有提升。

TLDR: The paper introduces Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning (PIRL), a framework for RL with verifiable rewards that focuses on maximizing cumulative policy improvement across iterations rather than surrogate rewards, and proposes a practical algorithm PIPO for closed-loop optimization.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种基于策略改进的强化学习框架PIRL，其核心是跨迭代最大化累积策略改进，而非最大化替代奖励，并提出了PIPO算法进行闭环优化。

Authors: Huaiyang Wang, Xiaojie Li, Deqing Wang, Haoyi Zhou, Zixuan Huang, Yaodong Yang, Jianxin Li, Yikun Ban

Stochastic Attention: Connectome-Inspired Randomized Routing for Expressive Linear-Time Attention

Abstract (English): The whole-brain connectome of a fruit fly comprises over 130K neurons connected with a probability of merely 0.02%, yet achieves an average shortest path of only 4.4 hops. Despite being highly structured at the circuit level, the network's long-range connections are broadly distributed across brain regions, functioning as stochastic shortcuts that enable efficient global communication. Inspired by this observation, we propose Stochastic Attention (SA), a drop-in enhancement for sliding-window attention (SWA) that applies a random permutation to the token sequence before windowed attention and restores the original order afterward. This transforms the fixed local window into a stochastic global one within the same $O(nw)$ per-layer budget. Through depth, independently sampled permutations yield exponentially growing receptive fields, achieving full sequence coverage in $O(\log_w n)$ layers versus $O(n/w)$ for SWA. We validate SA in two settings: pre-training language models from scratch, where a gated SA + SWA combination achieves the best average zero-shot accuracy, and training-free inference on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-30B-A3B, where SA consistently outperforms SWA and matches or exceeds Mixture of Block Attention at comparable compute budgets. These results suggest that connectome-inspired stochastic routing is a practical primitive for improving the expressivity of efficient attention, complementary to existing linear and sparse approaches.

摘要（中文）: 果蝇全脑连接组包含超过13万个神经元，连接概率仅为0.02%，但其平均最短路径长度仅为4.4跳。尽管该网络在环路层面具有高度结构化的特征，其长程连接却广泛分布于脑区之间，作为随机捷径实现了高效的全局通信。受此启发，我们提出随机注意力机制，作为滑动窗口注意力的即插即用增强方案：该方法在窗口注意力计算前对标记序列进行随机排列，计算后恢复原始顺序。在保持每层$O(nw)$计算复杂度的前提下，将固定的局部窗口转化为随机的全局窗口。通过深度堆叠，独立采样的排列可产生指数级增长的感受野，仅需$O(\log_w n)$层即可实现全序列覆盖，而滑动窗口注意力需要$O(n/w)$层。我们在两种场景中验证了该机制：在语言模型从头预训练中，门控随机注意力与滑动窗口注意力的组合取得了最佳平均零样本准确率；在千问3-8B和千问3-30B-A3B的免训练推理中，随机注意力在同等计算预算下持续优于滑动窗口注意力，并达到或超过混合分块注意力的性能。这些结果表明，受连接组启发的随机路由机制是提升高效注意力表达能力的实用基础单元，可与现有线性和稀疏方法形成互补。

TLDR: The paper proposes a new attention mechanism inspired by brain connectivity, improving efficiency and expressivity for language models, with no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.

简要说明: 本文提出一种受大脑连接启发的注意力机制，旨在提高语言模型的效率和表达能力，但未直接涉及机器人或具身AI。

Authors: Zehao Jin, Yanan Sui

Performance of Neural and Polynomial Operator Surrogates

Abstract (English): We consider the problem of constructing surrogate operators for parameter-to-solution maps arising from parametric partial differential equations, where repeated forward model evaluations are computationally expensive. We present a systematic empirical comparison of neural operator surrogates, including a reduced-basis neural operator trained with $L^2_μ$ and $H^1_μ$ objectives and the Fourier neural operator, against polynomial surrogate methods, specifically a reduced-basis sparse-grid surrogate and a reduced-basis tensor-train surrogate. All methods are evaluated on a linear parametric diffusion problem and a nonlinear parametric hyperelasticity problem, using input fields with algebraically decaying spectral coefficients at varying rates of decay $s$. To enable fair comparisons, we analyze ensembles of surrogate models generated by varying hyperparameters and compare the resulting Pareto frontiers of cost versus approximation accuracy, decomposing cost into contributions from data generation, setup, and evaluation. Our results show that no single method is universally superior. Polynomial surrogates achieve substantially better data efficiency for smooth input fields ($s \geq 2$), with convergence rates for the sparse-grid surrogate in agreement with theoretical predictions. For rough inputs ($s \leq 1$), the Fourier neural operator displays the fastest convergence rates. Derivative-informed training consistently improves data efficiency over standard $L^2_μ$ training, providing a competitive alternative for rough inputs in the low-data regime when Jacobian information is available at reasonable cost. These findings highlight the importance of matching the surrogate methodology to the regularity of the problem as well as accuracy demands and computational constraints of the application.

摘要（中文）: 本文研究为参数偏微分方程中的参数-解映射构建代理算子的问题，其正演模型重复计算代价高昂。我们对神经算子代理方法进行了系统性实证比较，包括使用 $L^2_μ$ 和 $H^1_μ$ 目标函数训练的降基神经算子及傅里叶神经算子，并将其与多项式代理方法（特别是降基稀疏网格代理和降基张量列车代理）进行对比。所有方法均在具有代数衰减谱系数（衰减率 $s$ 可变）的线性参数扩散问题和非线性参数超弹性问题上进行评估。为实现公平比较，我们通过超参数调优生成代理模型集合，分析计算成本与近似精度的帕累托前沿，并将成本分解为数据生成、模型构建和模型评估三部分。结果表明，不存在普遍最优的单一方法：对于光滑输入场（$s \geq 2$），多项式代理方法具有显著更好的数据效率，稀疏网格代理的收敛速率与理论预测一致；对于粗糙输入场（$s \leq 1$），傅里叶神经算子展现出最快的收敛速度；导数信息训练相较标准 $L^2_μ$ 训练能持续提升数据效率，当雅可比信息获取成本可控时，该方法可为低数据量场景下的粗糙输入问题提供有竞争力的解决方案。这些发现表明，代理方法的选择需综合考虑问题正则性、精度需求及应用场景的计算约束。

TLDR: This paper empirically compares neural operator and polynomial surrogate methods for solving parametric PDEs, evaluating their performance on smooth and rough input fields, highlighting trade-offs in data efficiency and computational cost.

简要说明: 本文对参数化PDE求解的神经算子与多项式代理方法进行了实证比较，评估它们在光滑和粗糙输入场上的性能，强调了数据效率和计算成本之间的权衡。

Authors: Josephine Westermann, Benno Huber, Thomas O'Leary-Roseberry, Jakob Zech

Embedded Variational Neural Stochastic Differential Equations for Learning Heterogeneous Dynamics

Abstract (English): This study examines the challenges of modeling complex and noisy data related to socioeconomic factors over time, with a focus on data from various districts in Odisha, India. Traditional time-series models struggle to capture both trends and variations together in this type of data. To tackle this, a Variational Neural Stochastic Differential Equation (V-NSDE) model is designed that combines the expressive dynamics of Neural SDEs with the generative capabilities of Variational Autoencoders (VAEs). This model uses an encoder and a decoder. The encoder takes the initial observations and district embeddings and translates them into a Gaussian distribution, which determines the mean and log-variance of the first latent state. Then the obtained latent state initiates the Neural SDE, which utilize neural networks to determine the drift and diffusion functions that govern continuous-time latent dynamics. These governing functions depend on the time index, latent state, and district embedding, which help the model learn the unique characteristics specific to each district. After that, using a probabilistic decoder, the observations are reconstructed from the latent trajectory. The decoder outputs a mean and log-variance for each time step, which follows the Gaussian likelihood. The Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) training loss improves by adding a KL-divergence regularization term to the negative log-likelihood (nll). The obtained results demonstrate the effective learning of V-NSDE in recognizing complex patterns over time, yielding realistic outcomes that include clear trends and random fluctuations across different areas.

摘要（中文）: 本研究探讨了随时间变化的社会经济因素相关复杂噪声数据的建模挑战，重点关注印度奥里萨邦各地区的实际数据。传统时间序列模型难以同时捕捉此类数据的整体趋势与局部波动。为此，我们设计了一种变分神经随机微分方程模型，该模型融合了神经随机微分方程的表达动力学特性与变分自编码器的生成能力。该模型采用编码器-解码器结构：编码器通过初始观测数据和地区嵌入向量生成高斯分布，以确定初始潜在状态的均值与对数方差；所获潜在状态随后启动神经随机微分方程，该方程通过神经网络构建支配连续时间潜在动态的漂移函数与扩散函数。这些控制函数依赖于时间索引、潜在状态及地区嵌入向量，使模型能学习各地区的独特特征。随后通过概率解码器从潜在轨迹重构观测数据，解码器为每个时间步输出符合高斯似然分布的均值与对数方差。通过在负对数似然函数中引入KL散度正则化项，证据下界训练损失得到优化。实验结果表明，该模型能有效学习随时间变化的复杂模式，生成包含清晰趋势与区域随机波动的真实仿真结果。

TLDR: This paper proposes a Variational Neural Stochastic Differential Equation (V-NSDE) model to capture complex and noisy spatio-temporal patterns in socioeconomic data, focusing on district-specific trends in Odisha, India.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种变分神经随机微分方程（V-NSDE）模型，用于捕捉社会经济数据中复杂且有噪声的时空模式，重点关注印度奥里萨邦的地区特异性趋势。

Authors: Sandeep Kumar Samota, Reema Gupta, Snehashish Chakraverty

Chameleons do not Forget: Prompt-Based Online Continual Learning for Next Activity Prediction

Abstract (English): Predictive process monitoring (PPM) focuses on predicting future process trajectories, including next activity predictions. This is crucial in dynamic environments where processes change or face uncertainty. However, current frameworks often assume a static environment, overlooking dynamic characteristics and concept drifts. This results in catastrophic forgetting, where training while focusing merely on new data distribution negatively impacts the performance on previously learned data distributions. Continual learning addresses, among others, the challenges related to mitigating catastrophic forgetting. This paper proposes a novel approach called Continual Next Activity Prediction with Prompts (CNAPwP), which adapts the DualPrompt algorithm for next activity prediction to improve accuracy and adaptability while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. We introduce new datasets with recurring concept drifts, alongside a task-specific forgetting metric that measures the prediction accuracy gap between initial occurrence and subsequent task occurrences. Extensive testing on three synthetic and two real-world datasets representing several setups of recurrent drifts shows that CNAPwP achieves SOTA or competitive results compared to five baselines, demonstrating its potential applicability in real-world scenarios. An open-source implementation of our method, together with the datasets and results, is available at: https://github.com/SvStraten/CNAPwP.

摘要（中文）: 预测性流程监控（PPM）专注于预测未来流程轨迹，包括下一活动预测。这在流程动态变化或面临不确定性的环境中至关重要。然而，当前框架通常假设静态环境，忽略了动态特性和概念漂移，导致灾难性遗忘问题——即仅针对新数据分布进行训练时，会对先前学习的数据分布性能产生负面影响。持续学习致力于解决缓解灾难性遗忘等挑战。本文提出了一种名为“基于提示的持续下一活动预测（CNAPwP）”的新方法，该方法通过适配DualPrompt算法进行下一活动预测，在提高准确性和适应性的同时减轻灾难性遗忘。我们引入了具有重复概念漂移的新数据集，并设计了一种任务特定的遗忘度量指标，用于衡量首次出现与后续任务出现之间的预测准确度差距。通过在三个合成数据集和两个真实数据集上进行的广泛测试（涵盖多种重复漂移场景），结果表明CNAPwP相比五种基线方法取得了最先进或具有竞争力的结果，证明了其在现实场景中的潜在适用性。本方法的开源实现、数据集及结果发布于：https://github.com/SvStraten/CNAPwP。

TLDR: This paper proposes a prompt-based continual learning method for next activity prediction in business processes, focusing on mitigating catastrophic forgetting under concept drift, using synthetic and real-world datasets.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于提示的持续学习方法，用于业务流程中的下一活动预测，重点解决概念漂移下的灾难性遗忘问题，并使用了合成和真实世界数据集。

Authors: Marwan Hassani, Tamara Verbeek, Sjoerd van Straten

Representation choice shapes the interpretation of protein conformational dynamics

Abstract (English): Molecular dynamics simulations provide detailed trajectories at the atomic level, but extracting interpretable and robust insights from these high-dimensional data remains challenging. In practice, analyses typically rely on a single representation. Here, we show that representation choice is not neutral: it fundamentally shapes the conformational organization, similarity relationships, and apparent transitions inferred from identical simulation data. To complement existing representations, we introduce Orientation features, a geometrically grounded, rotation-aware encoding of protein backbone. We compare it against common descriptions across three dynamical regimes: fast-folding proteins, large-scale domain motions, and protein-protein association. Across these systems, we find that different representations emphasize complementary aspects of conformational space, and that no single representation provides a complete picture of the underlying dynamics. To facilitate systematic comparison, we developed ManiProt, a library for efficient computation and analysis of multiple protein representations. Our results motivate a comparative, representation-aware framework for the interpretation of molecular dynamics simulations.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 分子动力学模拟在原子层面提供详细的轨迹数据，然而从这些高维数据中提取可解释且稳健的洞察仍具挑战性。实践中，分析通常依赖于单一表征方式。本文研究表明，表征选择并非中性：它从根本上塑造了从相同模拟数据中推断出的构象组织、相似性关系及表观转变过程。 为补充现有表征方法，我们提出“定向特征”——一种基于几何原理、具有旋转感知的蛋白质主链编码方式。我们将其与常见描述方法在三种动态体系中进行比较：快速折叠蛋白、大尺度结构域运动及蛋白质-蛋白质结合过程。在这些体系中，不同表征方式凸显了构象空间的不同侧面，且单一表征均无法完整反映底层动态过程。 为促进系统性比较，我们开发了ManiProt工具库，用于高效计算和分析多种蛋白质表征。本研究结果推动了一种基于比较的、具有表征感知能力的分子动力学模拟解释框架的发展。

TLDR: This paper demonstrates that the choice of representation significantly influences the interpretation of protein conformational dynamics derived from molecular dynamics simulations. It introduces a new rotation-aware encoding and a library for systematic comparison of protein representations.

简要说明: 本文研究证明，在分子动力学模拟中，表征选择对蛋白质构象动力学的解释有根本性影响。作者提出了一种新的旋转感知编码方法，并开发了一个用于系统比较蛋白质表征的库。

Authors: Axel Giottonini, Thomas Lemmin

Lipschitz Dueling Bandits over Continuous Action Spaces

Abstract (English): We study for the first time, stochastic dueling bandits over continuous action spaces with Lipschitz structure, where feedback is purely comparative. While dueling bandits and Lipschitz bandits have been studied separately, their combination has remained unexplored. We propose the first algorithm for Lipschitz dueling bandits, using round-based exploration and recursive region elimination guided by an adaptive reference arm. We develop new analytical tools for relative feedback and prove a regret bound of $\tilde O\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}\right)$, where $d_z$ is the zooming dimension of the near-optimal region. Further, our algorithm takes only logarithmic space in terms of the total time horizon, best achievable by any bandit algorithm over a continuous action space.

摘要（中文）: 我们首次研究了具有Lipschitz结构的连续动作空间随机对决赌博问题，其反馈纯粹为比较式反馈。尽管对决赌博机和Lipschitz赌博机已分别被研究，但二者的结合尚未被探索。我们提出了针对Lipschitz对决赌博机的首个算法，该算法采用基于轮次的探索和由自适应参考臂引导的递归区域消除策略。我们针对相对反馈开发了新的分析工具，并证明了其遗憾上界为$\tilde O\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}\right)$，其中$d_z$为近优区域的缩放维度。此外，该算法在总时间跨度上仅需对数级别的存储空间，这是连续动作空间上任何赌博机算法所能达到的最佳存储效率。

TLDR: The paper introduces the first algorithm for Lipschitz dueling bandits over continuous action spaces, providing a regret bound and logarithmic space complexity.

简要说明: 本文首次针对连续动作空间上的Lipschitz对决多臂老虎机问题提出了算法，给出了遗憾界并实现了对数级空间复杂度。

Authors: Mudit Sharma, Shweta Jain, Vaneet Aggarwal, Ganesh Ghalme

Scheduling LLM Inference with Uncertainty-Aware Output Length Predictions

Abstract (English): To schedule LLM inference, the \textit{shortest job first} (SJF) principle is favorable by prioritizing requests with short output lengths to avoid head-of-line (HOL) blocking. Existing methods usually predict a single output length for each request to facilitate scheduling. We argue that such a \textit{point estimate} does not match the \textit{stochastic} decoding process of LLM inference, where output length is \textit{uncertain} by nature and determined by when the end-of-sequence (EOS) token is sampled. Hence, the output length of each request should be fitted with a distribution rather than a single value. With an in-depth analysis of empirical data and the stochastic decoding process, we observe that output length follows a heavy-tailed distribution and can be fitted with the log-t distribution. On this basis, we propose a simple metric called Tail Inflated Expectation (TIE) to replace the output length in SJF scheduling, which adjusts the expectation of a log-t distribution with its tail probabilities to account for the risk that a request generates long outputs. To evaluate our TIE scheduler, we compare it with three strong baselines, and the results show that TIE reduces the per-token latency by $2.31\times$ for online inference and improves throughput by $1.42\times$ for offline data generation.

摘要（中文）: 在LLM推理调度中，采用\textit{最短作业优先}（SJF）原则通过优先处理输出长度较短的请求来避免队头阻塞问题。现有方法通常通过预测单个输出长度来辅助调度。我们认为，这种\textit{点估计}方式与LLM推理的\textit{随机性}解码过程不匹配，因为输出长度本质上具有\textit{不确定性}，其实际值取决于序列结束符采样时机。因此，每个请求的输出长度应拟合为概率分布而非单一数值。通过对实际数据与随机解码过程的深入分析，我们发现输出长度服从重尾分布，可采用对数t分布进行拟合。基于此，我们提出一种称为尾部膨胀期望值的简易指标，用于替代SJF调度中的输出长度参数。该指标通过调整对数t分布的期望值并结合尾部概率，以量化请求生成长输出序列的风险。为评估TIE调度器的性能，我们将其与三种强基线方法进行对比，实验结果表明：TIE在在线推理场景中将单令牌延迟降低$2.31$倍，在离线数据生成任务中使吞吐量提升$1.42$倍。

TLDR: The paper proposes a scheduling method for Large Language Model inference that uses a statistical distribution to model uncertain output lengths, aiming to improve latency and throughput by mitigating head-of-line blocking.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于大语言模型推理的调度方法，利用统计分布对不确定的输出长度进行建模，旨在通过缓解队头阻塞问题来改善延迟和吞吐量。

Authors: Haoyu Zheng, Yongqiang Zhang, Fangcheng Fu, Xiaokai Zhou, Hao Luo, Hongchao Zhu, Yuanyuan Zhu, Hao Wang, Xiao Yan, Jiawei Jiang

Convergence of Byzantine-Resilient Gradient Tracking via Probabilistic Edge Dropout

Abstract (English): We study distributed optimization over networks with Byzantine agents that may send arbitrary adversarial messages. We propose \emph{Gradient Tracking with Probabilistic Edge Dropout} (GT-PD), a stochastic gradient tracking method that preserves the convergence properties of gradient tracking under adversarial communication. GT-PD combines two complementary defense layers: a universal self-centered projection that clips each incoming message to a ball of radius $τ$ around the receiving agent, and a fully decentralized probabilistic dropout rule driven by a dual-metric trust score in the decision and tracking channels. This design bounds adversarial perturbations while preserving the doubly stochastic mixing structure, a property often lost under robust aggregation in decentralized settings. Under complete Byzantine isolation ($p_b=0$), GT-PD converges linearly to a neighborhood determined solely by stochastic gradient variance. For partial isolation ($p_b>0$), we introduce \emph{Gradient Tracking with Probabilistic Edge Dropout and Leaky Integration} (GT-PD-L), which uses a leaky integrator to control the accumulation of tracking errors caused by persistent perturbations and achieves linear convergence to a bounded neighborhood determined by the stochastic variance and the clipping-to-leak ratio. We further show that under two-tier dropout with $p_h=1$, isolating Byzantine agents introduces no additional variance into the honest consensus dynamics. Experiments on MNIST under Sign Flip, ALIE, and Inner Product Manipulation attacks show that GT-PD-L outperforms coordinate-wise trimmed mean by up to 4.3 percentage points under stealth attacks.

摘要（中文）: 本文研究存在拜占庭节点（可能发送任意对抗性消息）的网络环境下的分布式优化问题。我们提出一种随机梯度跟踪方法——**概率边丢弃梯度追踪算法**，该方法在对抗性通信环境下仍能保持梯度追踪的收敛特性。该算法融合了两种互补的防御机制：一是通用的自中心投影机制，将每个接收消息裁剪到接收节点半径$τ$的球域内；二是基于决策与跟踪通道双度量信任分数的完全分布式概率丢弃规则。该设计能在保证双随机混合结构的前提下限制对抗性扰动，而这一特性在去中心化场景的鲁棒聚合中常被破坏。在完全拜占庭隔离情况下，该算法线性收敛至仅由随机梯度方差决定的邻域内；针对部分隔离场景，我们提出**概率边丢弃与泄漏积分梯度追踪算法**，通过泄漏积分器控制持续扰动引起的跟踪误差累积，实现线性收敛至由随机方差及裁剪-泄漏比决定的有限邻域。进一步证明，在$p_h=1$的双层丢弃机制下，隔离拜占庭节点不会向诚实节点共识动力学引入额外方差。在MNIST数据集上针对符号翻转、ALIE及内积操纵攻击的实验表明，该算法在隐蔽攻击下的性能较坐标维度截断均值法提升最高达4.3个百分点。

TLDR: The paper proposes a robust distributed optimization algorithm, Gradient Tracking with Probabilistic Edge Dropout, to defend against Byzantine agents in networked systems. It is not directly related to robotics or embodied AI, focusing on mathematical theory and security in distributed computing.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的分布式优化算法，即带有概率边丢弃的梯度追踪，用于防御网络系统中的拜占庭代理。它不直接涉及机器人学或具身AI，专注于分布式计算中的数学理论和安全性。

Authors: Amirhossein Dezhboro, Fateme Maleki, Arman Adibi, Erfan Amini, Jose E. Ramirez-Marquez

Shapley-Guided Neural Repair Approach via Derivative-Free Optimization

Abstract (English): DNNs are susceptible to defects like backdoors, adversarial attacks, and unfairness, undermining their reliability. Existing approaches mainly involve retraining, optimization, constraint-solving, or search algorithms. However, most methods rely on gradient calculations, restricting applicability to specific activation functions (e.g., ReLU), or use search algorithms with uninterpretable localization and repair. Furthermore, they often lack generalizability across multiple properties. We propose SHARPEN, integrating interpretable fault localization with a derivative-free optimization strategy. First, SHARPEN introduces a Deep SHAP-based localization strategy quantifying each layer's and neuron's marginal contribution to erroneous outputs. Specifically, a hierarchical coarse-to-fine approach reranks layers by aggregated impact, then locates faulty neurons/filters by analyzing activation divergences between property-violating and benign states. Subsequently, SHARPEN incorporates CMA-ES to repair identified neurons. CMA-ES leverages a covariance matrix to capture variable dependencies, enabling gradient-free search and coordinated adjustments across coupled neurons. By combining interpretable localization with evolutionary optimization, SHARPEN enables derivative-free repair across architectures, being less sensitive to gradient anomalies and hyperparameters. We demonstrate SHARPEN's effectiveness on three repair tasks. Balancing property repair and accuracy preservation, it outperforms baselines in backdoor removal (+10.56%), adversarial mitigation (+5.78%), and unfairness repair (+11.82%). Notably, SHARPEN handles diverse tasks, and its modular design is plug-and-play with different derivative-free optimizers, highlighting its flexibility.

摘要（中文）: 深度神经网络易受后门、对抗性攻击及不公平性等缺陷影响，其可靠性因此受到削弱。现有方法主要涉及重训练、优化、约束求解或搜索算法。然而，大多数方法依赖梯度计算，限制了其对于特定激活函数（如ReLU）的适用性；或采用搜索算法，其定位与修复过程缺乏可解释性。此外，这些方法往往难以泛化至多种属性修复任务。本文提出SHARPEN方法，将可解释的故障定位与无导数优化策略相结合。首先，SHARPEN引入基于深度SHAP的定位策略，量化各层及神经元对错误输出的边际贡献。具体而言，通过分层粗粒度到细粒度的策略，先按聚合影响力重排网络层，再通过分析违反属性样本与良性样本的激活差异定位故障神经元/滤波器。随后，SHARPEN集成CMA-ES算法修复已识别的神经元。CMA-ES利用协方差矩阵捕捉变量间依赖关系，实现无需梯度的搜索，并能对耦合神经元进行协同调整。通过将可解释定位与进化优化相结合，SHARPEN实现了跨网络架构的无导数修复，对梯度异常与超参数敏感性较低。我们在三项修复任务中验证了SHARPEN的有效性。该方法在修复属性与保持精度间取得平衡，在后门移除（+10.56%）、对抗性缓解（+5.78%）及不公平性修复（+11.82%）任务中均优于基线方法。值得注意的是，SHARPEN可处理多种任务，其模块化设计支持即插即用式集成不同无导数优化器，体现了该方法的灵活性。

TLDR: This paper presents SHARPEN, a method for neural network repair that uses Shapley values for fault localization and derivative-free optimization (CMA-ES) for parameter adjustment. It demonstrates effectiveness on tasks like backdoor removal and adversarial mitigation, but does not mention robotics or embodied AI applications.

简要说明: 本文提出SHARPEN方法，一种通过Shapley值进行故障定位并结合无导数优化（CMA-ES）进行参数调整的神经网络修复方法。该方法在修复后门攻击、对抗性攻击等任务上有效，但未提及机器人或具身AI应用。

Authors: Xinyu Sun, Wanwei Liu, Haoang Chi, Tingyu Chen, Xiaoguang Mao, Shangwen Wang, Lei Bu, Jingyi Wang, Yang Tan, Zhenyi Qi

GUIDE: Reinforcement Learning for Behavioral Action Support in Type 1 Diabetes

Abstract (English): Type 1 Diabetes (T1D) management requires continuous adjustment of insulin and lifestyle behaviors to maintain blood glucose within a safe target range. Although automated insulin delivery (AID) systems have improved glycemic outcomes, many patients still fail to achieve recommended clinical targets, warranting new approaches to improve glucose control in patients with T1D. While reinforcement learning (RL) has been utilized as a promising approach, current RL-based methods focus primarily on insulin-only treatment and do not provide behavioral recommendations for glucose control. To address this gap, we propose GUIDE, an RL-based decision-support framework designed to complement AID technologies by providing behavioral recommendations to prevent abnormal glucose events. GUIDE generates structured actions defined by intervention type, magnitude, and timing, including bolus insulin administration and carbohydrate intake events. GUIDE integrates a patient-specific glucose level predictor trained on real-world continuous glucose monitoring data and supports both offline and online RL algorithms within a unified environment. We evaluate both off-policy and on-policy methods across 25 individuals with T1D using standardized glycemic metrics. Among the evaluated approaches, the CQL-BC algorithm demonstrates the highest average time-in-range, reaching 85.49% while maintaining low hypoglycemia exposures. Behavioral similarity analysis further indicates that the learned CQL-BC policy preserves key structural characteristics of patient action patterns, achieving a mean cosine similarity of 0.87 $\pm$ 0.09 across subjects. These findings suggest that conservative offline RL with a structured behavioral action space can provide clinically meaningful and behaviorally plausible decision support for personalized diabetes management.

摘要（中文）: 1型糖尿病（T1D）的管理需要持续调整胰岛素和生活方式行为，以维持血糖处于安全目标范围内。尽管自动胰岛素输注系统已改善了血糖控制效果，但许多患者仍未能达到推荐的临床目标，因此需要新的方法来提升1型糖尿病患者的血糖管理水平。强化学习作为一种有前景的方法已被应用，但当前基于强化学习的方法主要聚焦于仅使用胰岛素的治疗方案，未能为血糖控制提供行为建议。为填补这一空白，我们提出了GUIDE——一个基于强化学习的决策支持框架，旨在通过提供行为建议预防异常血糖事件，以补充自动胰岛素输注技术的不足。GUIDE可生成由干预类型、强度与时间定义的结构化行动，包括速效胰岛素注射和碳水化合物摄入事件。该框架整合了基于真实世界连续血糖监测数据训练的患者特异性血糖水平预测器，并在统一环境中同时支持离线和在线强化学习算法。我们使用标准化血糖指标对25名1型糖尿病患者评估了离轨策略与同轨策略方法。在所有评估方法中，CQL-BC算法实现了最高的平均血糖达标时间百分比，达到85.49%，同时保持较低的低血糖暴露风险。行为相似性分析进一步表明，学习所得的CQL-BC策略保留了患者行为模式的关键结构特征，在受试者间达到0.87±0.09的平均余弦相似度。这些发现表明，采用结构化行为动作空间的保守离线强化学习方法，能够为个性化糖尿病管理提供具有临床意义且行为模式合理的决策支持。

TLDR: This paper proposes GUIDE, an RL-based framework for personalized behavioral action support in Type 1 Diabetes management, generating insulin and carbohydrate intake recommendations.

简要说明: 该论文提出GUIDE，一个用于1型糖尿病个性化管理的强化学习框架，用于生成胰岛素和碳水化合物摄入的行为建议。

Authors: Saman Khamesian, Sri Harini Balaji, Di Yang Shi, Stephanie M. Carpenter, Daniel E. Rivera, W. Bradley Knox, Peter Stone, Hassan Ghasemzadeh

Deep Learning-Accelerated Surrogate Optimization for High-Dimensional Well Control in Stress-Sensitive Reservoirs

Abstract (English): Production optimization in stress-sensitive unconventional reservoirs is governed by a nonlinear trade-off between pressure-driven flow and stress-induced degradation of fracture conductivity and matrix permeability. While higher drawdown improves short-term production, it accelerates permeability loss and reduces long-term recovery. Identifying optimal, time-varying control strategies requires repeated evaluations of fully coupled flow-geomechanics simulators, making conventional optimization computationally expensive. We propose a deep learning-based surrogate optimization framework for high-dimensional well control. Unlike prior approaches that rely on predefined control parameterizations or generic sampling, our method treats well control as a continuous, high-dimensional problem and introduces a problem-informed sampling strategy that aligns training data with trajectories encountered during optimization. A neural network proxy is trained to approximate the mapping between bottomhole pressure trajectories and cumulative production using data from a coupled flow-geomechanics model. The proxy is embedded within a constrained optimization workflow, enabling rapid evaluation of control strategies. Across multiple initializations, the surrogate achieves agreement with full-physics solutions within 2-5 percent, while reducing computational cost by up to three orders of magnitude. Discrepancies are mainly associated with trajectories near the boundary of the training distribution and local optimization effects. This framework shows that combining surrogate modeling with problem-informed sampling enables scalable and reliable optimization for high-dimensional, simulator-based problems, with broader applicability to PDE-constrained systems.

摘要（中文）: 应力敏感性非常规油藏的生产优化，受制于压力驱动流动与应力诱导的裂缝导流能力及基质渗透率衰减之间的非线性权衡。提高生产压差虽然能提升短期产量，却会加速渗透率损失，降低长期采收率。识别最优的时变控制策略需要对全耦合的流动-地质力学模拟器进行反复评估，这使得传统优化方法的计算成本高昂。 本文提出一种基于深度学习的高维井控代理优化框架。与以往依赖预定义控制参数化或通用采样的方法不同，本研究将井控处理为连续高维问题，并引入一种问题导向的采样策略，使训练数据与优化过程中遇到的轨迹相匹配。通过使用耦合流动-地质力学模型的数据，训练神经网络代理来近似模拟井底压力轨迹与累计产量之间的映射关系。 该代理模型被嵌入约束优化工作流程中，实现对控制策略的快速评估。在多种初始化条件下，代理模型与全物理模拟结果的吻合度误差在2%-5%以内，同时计算成本降低达三个数量级。差异主要出现在训练分布边界附近的轨迹以及局部优化效应的影响区域。 本框架表明，将代理模型与问题导向采样相结合，能够为基于模拟器的高维问题提供可扩展且可靠的优化方案，并在偏微分方程约束系统中具有更广泛的适用性。

TLDR: A deep learning-based surrogate optimization framework for high-dimensional well control in oil reservoirs, using a neural network proxy to approximate the physics simulation and reduce computational cost.

简要说明: 一个用于油气藏高维井控的深度学习代理优化框架，使用神经网络代理近似物理模拟，以降低计算成本。

Authors: Mahammad Valiyev, Jodel Cornelio, Behnam Jafarpour

Is One Token All It Takes? Graph Pooling Tokens for LLM-based GraphQA

Abstract (English): The integration of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Large Language Models (LLMs) has emerged as a promising paradigm for Graph Question Answering (GraphQA). However, effective methods for encoding complex structural information into the LLM's latent space remain an open challenge. Current state-of-the-art architectures, such as G-Retriever, typically rely on standard GNNs and aggressive mean pooling to compress entire graph substructures into a single token, creating a severe information bottleneck. This work mitigates this bottleneck by investigating two orthogonal strategies: (1) increasing the bandwidth of the graph-to-LLM interface via multi-token pooling, and (2) enhancing the semantic quality of the graph encoder via global attention mechanisms. We evaluate a suite of hierarchical pruning and clustering-based pooling operators including Top-k, SAGPool, DiffPool, MinCutPool, and Virtual Node Pooling (VNPool) to project graph data into multiple learnable tokens. Empirically, we demonstrate that while pooling introduces significant instability during soft prompt tuning, the application of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) effectively stabilizes specific hierarchical projections (notably VNPool and pruning methods), though dense clustering operators remain challenging. This stabilization allows compressed representations to rival full-graph baselines (achieving ~73% Hit@1 on WebQSP). Conceptually, we demonstrate that a Graph Transformer with VNPool implementation functions structurally as a single-layer Perceiver IO encoder. Finally, we adapt the FandE (Features and Edges) Score to the generative GraphQA domain. Our analysis reveals that the GraphQA benchmark suffers from representational saturation, where target answers are often highly correlated with isolated node features. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Agrover112/G-Retriever/tree/all_good/

摘要（中文）: 将图神经网络（GNN）与大型语言模型（LLM）相融合已成为图问答（GraphQA）领域一种颇具前景的范式。然而，如何将复杂的结构信息有效编码至LLM的潜在空间中，仍是当前亟待解决的关键问题。现有的先进架构（如G-Retriever）通常依赖标准GNN和激进的均值池化操作，将完整的图子结构压缩为单一令牌，从而造成严重的信息瓶颈。本研究通过探索两种正交策略缓解这一瓶颈：（1）采用多令牌池化技术扩展图到LLM的接口带宽；（2）通过全局注意力机制提升图编码器的语义质量。我们评估了一系列基于层级剪枝和聚类的池化算子，包括Top-k、SAGPool、DiffPool、MinCutPool以及虚拟节点池化（VNPool），以将图数据映射至多个可学习令牌。实验表明，虽然池化操作在软提示调优过程中会引发显著的不稳定性，但低秩自适应（LoRA）技术的应用能有效稳定特定的层级投影（特别是VNPool和剪枝方法），尽管密集聚类算子仍面临挑战。这种稳定性使得压缩表征能够媲美全图基线方法（在WebQSP数据集上达到约73%的Hit@1指标）。从概念上，我们论证了采用VNPool的图变换器在结构上等效于单层Perceiver IO编码器。最后，我们将FandE（特征与边）评分方法适配至生成式图问答领域。分析表明，当前图问答基准测试存在表征饱和现象，即目标答案往往与孤立节点特征高度相关。项目实现代码已发布于https://github.com/Agrover112/G-Retriever/tree/all_good/。

TLDR: This paper proposes methods to improve Graph Question Answering (GraphQA) by using multi-token pooling and enhanced graph encoders to better integrate graph data with Large Language Models, without any direct application to robotics or embodied AI.

简要说明: 该论文提出了通过多令牌池化和增强图编码器来改进图问答（GraphQA）的方法，以更好地将图数据与大型语言模型整合，没有直接应用于机器人或具身人工智能。

Authors: Ankit Grover, Lodovico Giaretta, Rémi Bourgerie, Sarunas Girdzijauskas

When Career Data Runs Out: Structured Feature Engineering and Signal Limits for Founder Success Prediction

Abstract (English): Predicting startup success from founder career data is hard. The signal is weak, the labels are rare (9%), and most founders who succeed look almost identical to those who fail. We engineer 28 structured features directly from raw JSON fields -- jobs, education, exits -- and combine them with a deterministic rule layer and XGBoost boosted stumps. Our model achieves Val F0.5 = 0.3030, Precision = 0.3333, Recall = 0.2222 -- a +17.7pp improvement over the zero-shot LLM baseline. We then run a controlled experiment: extract 9 features from the prose field using Claude Haiku, at 67% and 100% dataset coverage. LLM features capture 26.4% of model importance but add zero CV signal (delta = -0.05pp). The reason is structural: anonymised_prose is generated from the same JSON fields we parse directly -- it is a lossy re-encoding, not a richer source. The ceiling (CV ~= 0.25, Val ~= 0.30) reflects the information content of this dataset, not a modeling limitation. In characterizing where the signal runs out and why, this work functions as a benchmark diagnostic -- one that points directly to what a richer dataset would need to include.

摘要（中文）: 基于创始人职业数据预测初创企业成功是困难的：信号微弱，正标签稀缺（9%），且成功者与失败者的特征高度相似。我们直接从原始JSON字段（工作经历、教育背景、退出记录）中构建了28个结构化特征，结合确定性规则层与XGBoost提升树桩模型。该模型实现了验证集F0.5=0.3030、精确率=0.3333、召回率=0.2222，较零样本大语言模型基线提升17.7个百分点。随后我们进行了对照实验：使用Claude Haiku从文本描述字段中提取9个特征，数据覆盖率为67%和100%。大语言模型特征贡献了26.4%的模型重要性，但未带来交叉验证信号增益（增量=-0.05个百分点）。其根源在于数据结构：匿名化文本字段本身源于我们直接解析的JSON数据，属于有损重编码而非更丰富的信号源。当前模型性能天花板（交叉验证集约0.25，验证集约0.30）反映了数据集固有的信息局限，而非建模缺陷。本研究通过界定信号衰减的边界与成因，构建了基准诊断框架——为构建更丰富的数据集指明了方向。

TLDR: This paper predicts startup success from founder career data, finding that structured features from JSON fields outperform LLM-generated features due to dataset limitations.

简要说明: 本文通过创始人职业数据预测初创企业成功，发现从JSON字段提取的结构化特征优于LLM生成的特征，原因在于数据集的信息限制。

Authors: Yagiz Ihlamur

Vocal Prognostic Digital Biomarkers in Monitoring Chronic Heart Failure: A Longitudinal Observational Study

Abstract (English): Objective: This study aimed to evaluate which voice features can predict health deterioration in patients with chronic HF. Background: Heart failure (HF) is a chronic condition with progressive deterioration and acute decompensations, often requiring hospitalization and imposing substantial healthcare and economic burdens. Current standard-of-care (SoC) home monitoring, such as weight tracking, lacks predictive accuracy and requires high patient engagement. Voice is a promising non-invasive biomarker, though prior studies have mainly focused on acute HF stages. Methods: In a 2-month longitudinal study, 32 patients with HF collected daily voice recordings and SoC measures of weight and blood pressure at home, with biweekly questionnaires for health status. Acoustic analysis generated detailed vowel and speech features. Time-series features were extracted from aggregated lookback windows (e.g., 7 days) to predict next-day health status. Explainable machine learning with nested cross-validation identified top vocal biomarkers, and a case study illustrated model application. Results: A total of 21,863 recordings were analyzed. Acoustic vowel features showed strong correlations with health status. Time-series voice features within the lookback window outperformed corresponding standard care measures, achieving peak sensitivity and specificity of 0.826 and 0.782 versus 0.783 and 0.567 for SoC metrics. Key prognostic voice features identifying deterioration included delayed energy shift, low energy variability, and higher shimmer variability in vowels, along with reduced speaking and articulation rate, lower phonation ratio, decreased voice quality, and increased formant variability in speech. Conclusion: Voice-based monitoring offers a non-invasive approach to detect early health changes in chronic HF, supporting proactive and personalized care.

摘要（中文）: 目的：本研究旨在评估哪些声音特征能够预测慢性心力衰竭（HF）患者的健康状况恶化。 背景：心力衰竭是一种具有进行性恶化和急性失代偿特点的慢性疾病，常需住院治疗，给医疗系统及经济带来沉重负担。目前标准的居家监护方案（如体重监测）预测准确性不足，且对患者参与度要求较高。声音作为一种无创的生物标志物具有潜力，但既往研究多集中于急性心力衰竭阶段。 方法：在一项为期2个月的纵向研究中，32名心力衰竭患者每日居家录制声音并记录标准监护指标（体重、血压），同时每两周填写健康状况问卷。通过声学分析提取元音与言语的详细特征，并基于回溯时间窗口（如7天）提取时间序列特征，以预测次日健康状况。采用可解释性机器学习结合嵌套交叉验证识别关键声音生物标志物，并通过案例研究展示模型应用。 结果：共分析21,863条录音。元音声学特征与健康状况显著相关。回溯窗口内的时间序列声音特征预测效果优于对应的标准监护指标，其峰值敏感度和特异度分别为0.826和0.782，而标准监护指标仅为0.783和0.567。识别健康状况恶化的关键声音特征包括：元音能量延迟转移、低能量变异性和更高的振幅微扰变异，以及言语中的语速与发音速率下降、发声比例降低、语音质量减弱和共振峰变异性增加。 结论：基于声音的监测为慢性心力衰竭的早期健康变化检测提供了一种无创手段，有助于实现主动式、个性化的疾病管理。

TLDR: This study evaluates voice features as non-invasive digital biomarkers for predicting health deterioration in chronic heart failure patients, finding that time-series voice features outperform standard care metrics.

简要说明: 本研究评估了语音特征作为预测慢性心力衰竭患者健康状况恶化的非侵入性数字生物标志物，发现时间序列语音特征优于标准护理指标。

Authors: Fan Wu, Matthias P. Nägele, Daryush D. Mehta, Elgar Fleisch, Frank Ruschitzka, Andreas J. Flammer, Filipe Barata

SAGE: Subsurface AI-driven Geostatistical Extraction with proxy posterior

Abstract (English): Recent advances in generative networks have enabled new approaches to subsurface velocity model synthesis, offering a compelling alternative to traditional methods such as Full Waveform Inversion. However, these approaches predominantly rely on the availability of large-scale datasets of high-quality, geologically realistic subsurface velocity models, which are often difficult to obtain in practice. We introduce SAGE, a novel framework for statistically consistent proxy velocity generation from incomplete observations, specifically sparse well logs and migrated seismic images. During training, SAGE learns a proxy posterior over velocity models conditioned on both modalities (wells and seismic); at inference, it produces full-resolution velocity fields conditioned solely on migrated images, with well information implicitly encoded in the learned distribution. This enables the generation of geologically plausible and statistically accurate velocity realizations. We validate SAGE on both synthetic and field datasets, demonstrating its ability to capture complex subsurface variability under limited observational constraints. Furthermore, samples drawn from the learned proxy distribution can be leveraged to train downstream networks, supporting inversion workflows. Overall, SAGE provides a scalable and data-efficient pathway toward learning geological proxy posterior for seismic imaging and inversion. Repo link: https://github.com/slimgroup/SAGE.

摘要（中文）: 生成式网络的最新进展为地下速度模型合成提供了新方法，成为全波形反演等传统方法的有力替代方案。然而，这些方法主要依赖于大规模、地质真实且高质量的地下速度模型数据集，而此类数据在实际中往往难以获取。我们提出SAGE这一新型框架，用于从不完备观测数据（特指稀疏的测井曲线和偏移地震图像）中生成统计一致性代理速度模型。在训练阶段，SAGE学习基于测井与地震双模态约束的速度模型代理后验分布；在推断阶段，仅通过偏移图像即可生成全分辨率速度场，其中测井信息已隐式编码于学习得到的分布中。这使得生成的地质速度模型既具有地质合理性又满足统计准确性。我们在合成和实际数据集上验证了SAGE的性能，证明其能在有限观测约束下捕捉复杂的地下变异特征。此外，从学习到的代理分布中抽取的样本可用于训练下游网络，从而支持反演工作流程。总体而言，SAGE为地震成像与反演中的地质代理后验分布学习提供了一条可扩展且数据高效的途径。项目代码库：https://github.com/slimgroup/SAGE。

TLDR: This paper introduces SAGE, a framework for generating subsurface velocity models from sparse well logs and seismic images using a learned proxy posterior, validated on synthetic and field data for seismic imaging.

简要说明: 本文介绍SAGE框架，它利用学习的代理后验从稀疏井测和地震图像生成地下速度模型，并在合成和现场数据上进行了地震成像验证。

Authors: Huseyin Tuna Erdinc, Ipsita Bhar, Rafael Orozco, Thales Souza, Felix J. Herrmann

SYNTHONY: A Stress-Aware, Intent-Conditioned Agent for Deep Tabular Generative Models Selection

Abstract (English): Deep generative models for tabular data (GANs, diffusion models, and LLM-based generators) exhibit highly non-uniform behavior across datasets; the best-performing synthesizer family depends strongly on distributional stressors such as long-tailed marginals, high-cardinality categorical, Zipfian imbalance, and small-sample regimes. This brittleness makes practical deployment challenging, especially when users must balance competing objectives of fidelity, privacy, and utility. We study {intent-conditioned tabular synthesis selection}: given a dataset and a user intent expressed as a preference over evaluation metrics, the goal is to select a synthesizer that minimizes regret relative to an intent-specific oracle. We propose {stress profiling}, a synthesis-specific meta-feature representation that quantifies dataset difficulty along four interpretable stress dimensions, and integrate it into {SYNTHONY}, a selection framework that matches stress profiles against a calibrated capability registry of synthesizer families. Across a benchmark of 7 datasets, 10 synthesizers, and 3 intents, we demonstrate that stress-based meta-features are highly predictive of synthesizer performance: a $k$NN selector using these features achieves strong Top-1 selection accuracy, substantially outperforming zero-shot LLM selectors and random baselines. We analyze the gap between meta-feature-based and capability-based selection, identifying the hand-crafted capability registry as the primary bottleneck and motivating learned capability representations as a direction for future work.

摘要（中文）: 表格数据的深度生成模型（包括GANs、扩散模型及基于LLM的生成器）在不同数据集上表现出高度非均匀性；性能最优的合成器类别严重依赖于分布压力因素，如长尾边缘分布、高基数分类变量、齐夫不平衡以及小样本场景。这种脆弱性使得实际部署面临挑战，尤其在用户需权衡保真度、隐私性和实用性等多重目标时。本文研究{意图条件化的表格合成选择}：给定一个数据集以及用户以评估指标偏好形式表达的意图，目标在于选择一个合成器，使其相对于特定意图的“预言机”模型的遗憾最小化。我们提出{压力画像}——一种针对合成任务设计的元特征表示方法，通过四个可解释的压力维度量化数据集难度，并将其整合至{SYNTHONY}选择框架中，该框架将压力画像与经过校准的合成器家族能力注册表进行匹配。基于涵盖7个数据集、10种合成器及3种意图的基准测试，我们证明基于压力的元特征对合成器性能具有高度预测性：使用这些特征的$k$近邻选择器在Top-1选择准确率上表现优异，显著优于零样本LLM选择器和随机基线。我们进一步分析了基于元特征与基于能力的选择方法之间的差距，指出人工构建的能力注册表是主要瓶颈，并提出将学习型能力表征作为未来研究方向。

TLDR: Proposes a framework for selecting the best deep generative model for tabular data synthesis based on dataset stress profiles and user intent, outperforming LLM-based and random selection.

简要说明: 提出了一种基于数据集应力特征和用户意图的框架，用于选择最佳表格数据生成模型，其性能优于基于LLM的选择和随机选择。

Authors: Hochan Son, Xiaofeng Lin, Jason Ni, Guang Cheng

Neural Collapse Dynamics: Depth, Activation, Regularisation, and Feature Norm Threshold

Abstract (English): Neural collapse (NC) -- the convergence of penultimate-layer features to a simplex equiangular tight frame -- is well understood at equilibrium, but the dynamics governing its onset remain poorly characterised. We identify a simple and predictive regularity: NC occurs when the mean feature norm reaches a model-dataset-specific critical value, fn*, that is largely invariant to training conditions. This value concentrates tightly within each (model, dataset) pair (CV < 8%); training dynamics primarily affect the rate at which fn approaches fn*, rather than the value itself. In standard training trajectories, the crossing of fn below fn* consistently precedes NC onset, providing a practical predictor with a mean lead time of 62 epochs (MAE 24 epochs). A direct intervention experiment confirms fn* is a stable attractor of the gradient flow -- perturbations to feature scale are self-corrected during training, with convergence to the same value regardless of direction (p>0.2). Completing the (architecture)x(dataset) grid reveals the paper's strongest result: ResNet-20 on MNIST gives fn* = 5.867 -- a +458% architecture effect versus only +68% on CIFAR-10. The grid is strongly non-additive; fn* cannot be decomposed into independent architecture and dataset contributions. Four structural regularities emerge: (1) depth has a non-monotonic effect on collapse speed; (2) activation jointly determines both collapse speed and fn*; (3) weight decay defines a three-regime phase diagram -- too little slows, an optimal range is fastest, and too much prevents collapse; (4) width monotonically accelerates collapse while shifting fn* by at most 13%. These results establish feature-norm dynamics as an actionable diagnostic for predicting NC timing, suggesting that norm-threshold behaviour is a general mechanism underlying delayed representational reorganisation in deep networks.

摘要（中文）: 神经坍塌（NC）——即倒数第二层特征收敛于单纯形等角紧框架的现象——在平衡状态下已有充分理解，但其发生过程的动力学机制仍缺乏明确表征。我们发现一种简单且具有预测性的规律：当平均特征范数达到模型-数据集特定的临界值（fn*）时，NC即会发生，该临界值对训练条件基本保持恒定。该数值在每对（模型，数据集）组合中呈现高度集中性（变异系数<8%）；训练动态主要影响fn趋近fn*的速率，而非临界值本身。在标准训练轨迹中，fn低于fn*的交叉点始终先于NC发生，这为预测NC提供了平均62个周期（MAE 24周期）的领先时间指标。直接干预实验证实fn*是梯度流的稳定吸引子——对特征尺度的扰动会在训练过程中自我修正，无论扰动方向如何都会收敛至同一临界值（p>0.2）。通过完整构建（架构）×（数据集）网格，本文揭示了最显著的结论：ResNet-20在MNIST数据集上fn* = 5.867，与CIFAR-10仅+68%的架构效应相比，此处架构效应达到+458%。该网格具有强烈非加性特征；fn*无法分解为独立的架构与数据集贡献值。我们归纳出四项结构性规律：（1）深度对坍塌速度具有非单调影响；（2）激活函数共同决定坍塌速度与fn*；（3）权重衰减形成三阶段相图——衰减过小会延缓坍塌，适量区间速度最快，过度衰减则阻碍坍塌发生；（4）宽度会单调加速坍塌，同时使fn*偏移幅度不超过13%。这些发现确立了特征范数动态可作为预测NC时机的可操作诊断指标，表明范数阈值行为是深度网络中延迟表征重组现象背后的普遍机制。

TLDR: This paper investigates the dynamics of Neural Collapse, a phenomenon in deep networks, and identifies a critical feature-norm threshold that predicts its onset, which is largely invariant to training conditions. The findings are derived from experiments with standard architectures and datasets like MNIST and CIFAR-10, showing how factors like depth, activation, and regularization affect the phenomenon.

简要说明: 该研究探讨了深度网络中神经崩溃的动态过程，发现其发生可通过一个对训练条件不敏感的关键特征范数阈值来预测，并在MNIST和CIFAR-10等标准数据集上验证了网络深度、激活函数和正则化等因素的影响。

Authors: Anamika Paul Rupa

Unsupervised 4D Flow MRI Velocity Enhancement and Unwrapping Using Divergence-Free Neural Networks

Abstract (English): This work introduces an unsupervised Divergence and Aliasing-Free neural network (DAF-FlowNet) for 4D Flow Magnetic Resonance Imaging (4D Flow MRI) that jointly enhances noisy velocity fields and corrects phase wrapping artifacts. DAF-FlowNet parameterizes velocities as the curl of a vector potential, enforcing mass conservation by construction and avoiding explicit divergence-penalty tuning. A cosine data-consistency loss enables simultaneous denoising and unwrapping from wrapped phase images. On synthetic aortic 4D Flow MRI generated from computational fluid dynamics, DAF-FlowNet achieved lower errors than existing techniques (up to 11% lower velocity normalized root mean square error, 11% lower directional error, and 44% lower divergence relative to the best-performing alternative across noise levels), with robustness to moderate segmentation perturbations. For unwrapping, at peak velocity/velocity-encoding ratios of 1.4 and 2.1, DAF-FlowNet achieved 0.18% and 5.2% residual wrapped voxels, representing reductions of 72% and 18% relative to the best alternative method, respectively. In scenarios with both noise and aliasing, the proposed single-stage formulation outperformed a state-of-the-art sequential pipeline (up to 15% lower velocity normalized root mean square error, 11% lower directional error, and 28% lower divergence). Across 10 hypertrophic cardiomyopathy patient datasets, DAF-FlowNet preserved fine-scale flow features, corrected aliased regions, and improved internal flow consistency, as indicated by reduced inter-plane flow bias in aortic and pulmonary mass-conservation analyses recommended by the 4D Flow MRI consensus guidelines. These results support DAF-FlowNet as a framework that unifies velocity enhancement and phase unwrapping to improve the reliability of cardiovascular 4D Flow MRI.

摘要（中文）: 本研究提出了一种用于四维血流磁共振成像（4D Flow MRI）的无监督散度与混叠消除神经网络（DAF-FlowNet），该网络能够同时增强含噪速度场并校正相位包裹伪影。DAF-FlowNet将速度场参数化为矢量势的旋度，通过结构设计强制保持质量守恒，无需显式调整散度惩罚项。其采用的余弦数据一致性损失函数可直接从包裹相位图像中实现同步去噪与解包裹。在基于计算流体动力学生成的合成主动脉4D Flow MRI数据上，DAF-FlowNet相较于现有技术取得了更低的误差（在不同噪声水平下，相较于最佳对比方法，其速度归一化均方根误差降低达11%，方向误差降低11%，散度值降低44%），并对中度分割扰动具有鲁棒性。在解包裹任务中，当峰值流速与速度编码比值为1.4和2.1时，DAF-FlowNet的残留包裹体素比例分别为0.18%和5.2%，较最优对比方法分别降低72%和18%。在噪声与混叠并存场景下，所提出的单阶段模型优于先进的分步处理流程（速度归一化均方根误差降低达15%，方向误差降低11%，散度值降低28%）。在10组肥厚型心肌病患者数据集中，DAF-FlowNet在保持细微血流特征的同时，有效校正了混叠区域，并通过4D Flow MRI共识指南推荐的主动脉与肺动脉质量守恒分析中平面间流量偏差的降低，证实了其改善了内部血流一致性。这些结果表明，DAF-FlowNet作为统一速度增强与相位解包裹的框架，能够有效提升心血管4D Flow MRI的可靠性。

TLDR: This paper proposes an unsupervised neural network for enhancing and unwrapping 4D Flow MRI velocity fields, enforcing mass conservation and showing improved performance on synthetic and patient cardiovascular data.

简要说明: 本研究提出了一种用于4D血流磁共振成像的无监督神经网络，用于增强和解缠速度场，强制执行质量守恒，并在合成和患者心血管数据上表现出更好的性能。

Authors: Javier Bisbal, Julio Sotelo, Hernán Mella, Oliver Welin Odeback, Joaquín Mura, David Marlevi, Junya Matsuda, Kotomi Iwata, Tetsuro Sekine, Cristian Tejos, Sergio Uribe

Implicit Primal-Dual Interior-Point Methods for Quadratic Programming

Abstract (English): This paper introduces a new method for solving quadratic programs using primal-dual interior-point methods. Instead of handling complementarity as an explicit equation in the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, we ensure that complementarity is implicitly satisfied by construction. This is achieved by introducing an auxiliary variable and relating it to the duals and slacks via a retraction map. Specifically, we prove that the softplus function has favorable numerical properties compared to the commonly used exponential map. The resulting KKT system is guaranteed to be spectrally bounded, thereby eliminating the most pressing limitation of primal-dual methods: ill-conditioning near the solution. These attributes facilitate the solution of the underlying linear system, either by removing the need to compute factorizations at every iteration, enabling factorization-free approaches like indirect solvers, or allowing the solver to achieve high accuracy in low-precision arithmetic. Consequently, this novel perspective opens new opportunities for interior-point methods, especially for solving large-scale problems to high precision.

摘要（中文）: 本文介绍了一种利用原始对偶内点法求解二次规划的新方法。不同于在Karush-Kuhn-Tucker（KKT）条件中将互补性作为显式方程处理，我们通过构造确保互补性被隐式满足。这是通过引入辅助变量，并借助回缩映射将其与对偶变量及松弛变量相关联实现的。具体而言，我们证明了相较于常用的指数映射，softplus函数具有更优越的数值特性。该方法保证生成的KKT系统具有谱有界性，从而消除了原始对偶方法最突出的限制：接近解时的病态性。这些特性显著简化了底层线性系统的求解过程——既可通过消除每次迭代中矩阵分解的需求，实现间接求解器等免分解方法，也能使求解器在低精度算术运算中达到高精度解。因此，这一新颖视角为内点法开辟了新的发展路径，尤其为大规模高精度优化问题的求解提供了新的可能性。

TLDR: This paper presents a new primal-dual interior-point method for quadratic programming that uses an implicit representation to improve numerical stability and enable factorization-free or low-precision solutions.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种新的求解二次规划问题的原对偶内点法，通过隐式表示提高数值稳定性，并支持免分解或低精度求解。

Authors: Jon Arrizabalaga, Zachary Manchester

AdaLoRA-QAT: Adaptive Low-Rank and Quantization-Aware Segmentation

Abstract (English): Chest X-ray (CXR) segmentation is an important step in computer-aided diagnosis, yet deploying large foundation models in clinical settings remains challenging due to computational constraints. We propose AdaLoRA-QAT, a two-stage fine-tuning framework that combines adaptive low-rank encoder adaptation with full quantization-aware training. Adaptive rank allocation improves parameter efficiency, while selective mixed-precision INT8 quantization preserves structural fidelity crucial for clinical reliability. Evaluated across large-scale CXR datasets, AdaLoRA-QAT achieves 95.6% Dice, matching full-precision SAM decoder fine-tuning while reducing trainable parameters by 16.6\times and yielding 2.24\times model compression. A Wilcoxon signed-rank test confirms that quantization does not significantly degrade segmentation accuracy. These results demonstrate that AdaLoRA-QAT effectively balances accuracy, efficiency, and structural trust-worthiness, enabling compact and deployable foundation models for medical image segmentation. Code and pretrained models are available at: https://prantik-pdeb.github.io/adaloraqat.github.io/

摘要（中文）: 胸部X光（CXR）分割是计算机辅助诊断中的重要步骤，但在临床环境中部署大型基础模型仍因计算资源受限而面临挑战。本文提出AdaLoRA-QAT，一种结合自适应低秩编码器适配与全量化感知训练的两阶段微调框架。自适应秩分配提升了参数效率，而选择性混合精度INT8量化则保留了临床可靠性所必需的结构保真度。在大规模CXR数据集上的评估表明，AdaLoRA-QAT实现了95.6%的Dice分数，在可训练参数减少16.6倍、模型压缩率达到2.24倍的同时，性能与全精度SAM解码器微调相当。Wilcoxon符号秩检验证实量化不会显著降低分割精度。这些结果表明，AdaLoRA-QAT有效平衡了准确性、效率与结构可信度，为医学图像分割提供了紧凑且可部署的基础模型。代码与预训练模型公开于：https://prantik-pdeb.github.io/adaloraqat.github.io/

TLDR: Proposes AdaLoRA-QAT, a method combining adaptive low-rank adaptation and quantization-aware training for efficient medical image segmentation with foundation models.

简要说明: 提出了AdaLoRA-QAT方法，该方法结合了自适应低秩适应和量化感知训练，用于基于基础模型的高效医学图像分割。

Authors: Prantik Deb, Srimanth Dhondy, N. Ramakrishna, Anu Kapoor, Raju S. Bapi, Tapabrata Chakraborti

Brainstacks: Cross-Domain Cognitive Capabilities via Frozen MoE-LoRA Stacks for Continual LLM Learning

Abstract (English): We present Brainstacks, a modular architecture for continual multi-domain fine-tuning of large language models that packages domain expertise as frozen adapter stacks composing additively on a shared frozen base at inference. Five interlocking components: (1) MoE-LoRA with Shazeer-style noisy top-2 routing across all seven transformer projections under QLoRA 4-bit quantization with rsLoRA scaling; (2) an inner loop performing residual boosting by freezing trained stacks and adding new ones; (3) an outer loop training sequential domain-specific stacks with curriculum-ordered dependencies; (4) null-space projection via randomized SVD constraining new stacks to subspaces orthogonal to prior directions, achieving zero forgetting in isolation; (5) an outcome-based sigmoid meta-router trained on empirically discovered domain-combination targets that selectively weights stacks, enabling cross-domain composition. Two boundary experiments: (6) PSN pretraining on a randomly initialized model; (7) per-domain RL (DPO/GRPO) validating compatibility with post-SFT alignment. Validated on TinyLlama-1.1B (4 domains, 9 stacks) and Gemma 3 12B IT (5 domains, 10 stacks), MoE-LoRA achieves 2.5x faster convergence than parameter-matched single LoRA, residual boosting breaks through the single-stack ceiling, and the routed system recovers generation quality destroyed by ungated stack accumulation. The central finding: the outcome-based router discovers that domain stacks encode transferable cognitive primitives (instruction-following clarity, numerical reasoning, procedural logic, chain-of-thought structure) rather than domain-specific knowledge, with medical prompts routing to chat+math stacks in 97% of cases despite zero medical data in those stacks.

摘要（中文）: 本文提出Brainstacks，一种用于大语言模型持续多领域微调的模块化架构，其通过将领域专业知识打包为冻结的适配器堆栈，在推理时以叠加方式组合于共享的冻结基座模型之上。架构包含五个核心组件：（1）采用MoE-LoRA结构，在QLoRA 4比特量化与rsLoRA缩放条件下，通过Shazeer式带噪声的top-2路由机制覆盖全部七个Transformer投影层；（2）内部循环通过冻结已训练堆栈并新增堆栈实现残差增强；（3）外部循环按课程顺序依赖关系训练序列化的领域专用堆栈；（4）基于随机化SVD的零空间投影技术，将新堆栈约束至与先前方向正交的子空间，实现完全隔离的零遗忘；（5）基于结果训练的sigmoid元路由器，通过经验发现的领域组合目标选择性加权堆栈，实现跨领域组合能力。两项边界实验验证：（6）在随机初始化模型上进行PSN预训练；（7）基于每领域强化学习（DPO/GRPO）验证其与SFT后对齐技术的兼容性。在TinyLlama-1.1B（4领域，9堆栈）和Gemma 3 12B IT（5领域，10堆栈）上的实验表明：MoE-LoRA收敛速度比参数匹配的单LoRA快2.5倍；残差增强突破了单堆栈性能上限；路由系统可恢复因无门控堆栈累积而破坏的生成质量。核心发现：基于结果的路由器揭示领域堆栈编码的是可迁移的认知基元（如指令跟随清晰度、数值推理、程序逻辑、思维链结构），而非领域特定知识——尽管医学领域数据从未出现在相关堆栈中，医疗提示仍有97%的情况被路由至聊天+数学堆栈组合。

TLDR: The paper introduces Brainstacks, a modular architecture for continual multi-domain fine-tuning of LLMs using frozen MoE-LoRA stacks and a meta-router, focusing on zero-forgetting, compositionality, and the discovery of transferable cognitive primitives, validated on language models like TinyLlama and Gemma.

简要说明: 该论文提出了Brainstacks，一种用于LLMs持续多领域微调的模块化架构，采用冻结的MoE-LoRA栈和元路由器，关注零遗忘、组合性及可迁移认知原语的发现，并在TinyLlama和Gemma等语言模型上得到验证。

Authors: Mohammad R. Abu Ayyash

The Overlooked Repetitive Lengthening Form in Sentiment Analysis

Abstract (English): Individuals engaging in online communication frequently express personal opinions with informal styles (e.g., memes and emojis). While Language Models (LMs) with informal communications have been widely discussed, a unique and emphatic style, the Repetitive Lengthening Form (RLF), has been overlooked for years. In this paper, we explore answers to two research questions: 1) Is RLF important for sentiment analysis (SA)? 2) Can LMs understand RLF? Inspired by previous linguistic research, we curate \textbf{Lengthening}, the first multi-domain dataset with 850k samples focused on RLF for SA. Moreover, we introduce \textbf{Exp}lainable \textbf{Instruct}ion Tuning (\textbf{ExpInstruct}), a two-stage instruction tuning framework aimed to improve both performance and explainability of LLMs for RLF. We further propose a novel unified approach to quantify LMs' understanding of informal expressions. We show that RLF sentences are expressive expressions and can serve as signatures of document-level sentiment. Additionally, RLF has potential value for online content analysis. Our results show that fine-tuned Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) can surpass zero-shot GPT-4 in performance but not in explanation for RLF. Finally, we show ExpInstruct can improve the open-sourced LLMs to match zero-shot GPT-4 in performance and explainability for RLF with limited samples. Code and sample data are available at https://github.com/Tom-Owl/OverlookedRLF

摘要（中文）: 在网络交流中，个体常以非正式形式（如表情包和表情符号）表达个人观点。尽管涉及非正式交流的语言模型已得到广泛讨论，但一种独特且具有强调作用的表达形式——重复延长形式（RLF）——多年来却一直被忽视。本文旨在探究两个研究问题：1）RLF在情感分析（SA）中是否重要？2）语言模型能否理解RLF？基于以往语言学研究的启发，我们构建了首个专注于RLF情感分析的多领域数据集\textbf{Lengthening}，包含85万个样本。此外，我们提出了\textbf{ExpInstruct}（可解释指令微调框架），这是一个两阶段的指令微调框架，旨在提升大型语言模型在RLF处理中的性能与可解释性。我们进一步提出一种新颖的统一方法，用于量化语言模型对非正式表达的理解能力。研究表明，RLF句子具有丰富的表达力，能够作为文档级情感的特征标识。此外，RLF对在线内容分析具有潜在价值。实验结果显示，经过微调的预训练语言模型在RLF任务上性能可超越零样本GPT-4，但在解释性方面仍有不足。最后，我们证明ExpInstruct能够提升开源大型语言模型的性能，使其在有限样本条件下达到与零样本GPT-4相当的RLF处理性能与可解释性。代码及示例数据已发布于https://github.com/Tom-Owl/OverlookedRLF。

TLDR: The paper introduces a new dataset and framework for analyzing a specific type of informal language expression, the Repetitive Lengthening Form (RLF), in the context of sentiment analysis and evaluates Language Models' understanding of it.

简要说明: 本文为情感分析引入了一个专注于重复延长形式（RLF）的新数据集和一个可解释的指令调优框架，旨在提高语言模型对非正式表达的理解和解释能力。

Authors: Lei Wang, Eduard Dragut

Paper Reconstruction Evaluation: Evaluating Presentation and Hallucination in AI-written Papers

Abstract (English): This paper introduces the first systematic evaluation framework for quantifying the quality and risks of papers written by modern coding agents. While AI-driven paper writing has become a growing concern, rigorous evaluation of the quality and potential risks of AI-written papers remains limited, and a unified understanding of their reliability is still lacking. We introduce Paper Reconstruction Evaluation (PaperRecon), an evaluation framework in which an overview (overview.md) is created from an existing paper, after which an agent generates a full paper based on the overview and minimal additional resources, and the result is subsequently compared against the original paper. PaperRecon disentangles the evaluation of the AI-written papers into two orthogonal dimensions, Presentation and Hallucination, where Presentation is evaluated using a rubric and Hallucination is assessed via agentic evaluation grounded in the original paper source. For evaluation, we introduce PaperWrite-Bench, a benchmark of 51 papers from top-tier venues across diverse domains published after 2025. Our experiments reveal a clear trade-off: while both ClaudeCode and Codex improve with model advances, ClaudeCode achieves higher presentation quality at the cost of more than 10 hallucinations per paper on average, whereas Codex produces fewer hallucinations but lower presentation quality. This work takes a first step toward establishing evaluation frameworks for AI-driven paper writing and improving the understanding of its risks within the research community.

摘要（中文）: 本文首次提出了一个系统性评估框架，用于量化现代代码智能体所撰写论文的质量与风险。尽管人工智能驱动的论文写作已日益引发关注，但目前对AI生成论文的质量与潜在风险仍缺乏严谨评估，学界对其可靠性尚未形成统一认知。我们提出论文重构评估框架，该框架首先从现有论文中提取概述文件，随后由智能体基于该概述及有限补充资源生成完整论文，最终将生成结果与原文进行系统对比。该框架将AI生成论文的评估解耦为两个正交维度：呈现质量与事实性幻觉。其中呈现质量通过结构化评分标准衡量，事实性幻觉则依据原文采用智能体驱动的评估方法进行量化。为支撑评估，我们构建了包含51篇论文的基准测试集，所有论文均选自2025年后发表的多领域顶级学术会议。实验结果表明，尽管ClaudeCode与Codex模型均随技术进步有所提升，但两者存在明显权衡：ClaudeCode在呈现质量上更优，但每篇论文平均产生超过10处事实性幻觉；而Codex产生的幻觉较少，但呈现质量较低。本工作为建立AI驱动论文写作的评估框架迈出了第一步，有助于研究界深化对其风险认知。

TLDR: This paper introduces an evaluation framework for AI-written papers, focusing on presentation quality and hallucination rates. It is a meta-evaluation study of AI research tools, not a robotics or embodied AI research paper.

简要说明: 本文提出了一个用于评估AI撰写论文的框架，重点关注呈现质量和幻觉率。这是一项关于AI研究工具的元评估研究，而非机器人或具身AI研究论文。

Authors: Atsuyuki Miyai, Mashiro Toyooka, Zaiying Zhao, Kenta Watanabe, Toshihiko Yamasaki, Kiyoharu Aizawa

Adversarial Moral Stress Testing of Large Language Models

Abstract (English): Evaluating the ethical robustness of large language models (LLMs) deployed in software systems remains challenging, particularly under sustained adversarial user interaction. Existing safety benchmarks typically rely on single-round evaluations and aggregate metrics, such as toxicity scores and refusal rates, which offer limited visibility into behavioral instability that may arise during realistic multi-turn interactions. As a result, rare but high-impact ethical failures and progressive degradation effects may remain undetected prior to deployment. This paper introduces Adversarial Moral Stress Testing (AMST), a stress-based evaluation framework for assessing ethical robustness under adversarial multi-round interactions. AMST applies structured stress transformations to prompts and evaluates model behavior through distribution-aware robustness metrics that capture variance, tail risk, and temporal behavioral drift across interaction rounds. We evaluate AMST on several state-of-the-art LLMs, including LLaMA-3-8B, GPT-4o, and DeepSeek-v3, using a large set of adversarial scenarios generated under controlled stress conditions. The results demonstrate substantial differences in robustness profiles across models and expose degradation patterns that are not observable under conventional single-round evaluation protocols. In particular, robustness has been shown to depend on distributional stability and tail behavior rather than on average performance alone. Additionally, AMST provides a scalable and model-agnostic stress-testing methodology that enables robustness-aware evaluation and monitoring of LLM-enabled software systems operating in adversarial environments.

摘要（中文）: 评估部署于软件系统中的大型语言模型（LLM）的伦理鲁棒性仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在持续的对抗性用户交互场景下。现有的安全基准测试通常依赖单轮评估和聚合指标（如毒性分数和拒绝率），这些方法难以捕捉真实多轮交互中可能发生的行为不稳定现象。因此，在部署之前，一些罕见但高影响力的伦理失误以及渐进式退化效应可能无法被有效检测。本文提出对抗性道德压力测试（AMST），这是一种基于压力的评估框架，用于评估在对抗性多轮交互下的伦理鲁棒性。AMST对提示进行结构化压力变换，并通过分布感知的鲁棒性指标评估模型行为，这些指标能够捕捉多轮交互中的方差、尾部风险以及时间行为漂移。我们在多个前沿大型语言模型上（包括LLaMA-3-8B、GPT-4o和DeepSeek-v3）对AMST进行评估，采用了在可控压力条件下生成的大规模对抗性场景集。实验结果表明，不同模型的鲁棒性表现存在显著差异，并揭示出传统单轮评估协议无法观察到的退化模式。尤其值得注意的是，鲁棒性被证明取决于分布稳定性与尾部行为，而非仅依赖于平均性能。此外，AMST提供了一种可扩展且模型无关的压力测试方法，能够对在对抗性环境中运行的LLM驱动软件系统进行鲁棒性感知的评估与持续监控。

TLDR: The paper introduces Adversarial Moral Stress Testing (AMST), a framework for evaluating the ethical robustness of large language models under sustained, adversarial multi-turn interactions, revealing degradation patterns not captured by standard single-round benchmarks.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种对抗性道德压力测试（AMST）框架，用于评估大语言模型在持续对抗性多轮交互中的伦理稳健性，揭示了标准单轮基准测试无法捕捉的行为退化模式。

Authors: Saeid Jamshidi, Foutse Khomh, Arghavan Moradi Dakhel, Amin Nikanjam, Mohammad Hamdaqa, Kawser Wazed Nafi

Adversarial Attacks in AI-Driven RAN Slicing: SLA Violations and Recovery

Abstract (English): Next-generation (NextG) cellular networks are designed to support emerging applications with diverse data rate and latency requirements, such as immersive multimedia services and large-scale Internet of Things deployments. A key enabling mechanism is radio access network (RAN) slicing, which dynamically partitions radio resources into virtual resource blocks to efficiently serve heterogeneous traffic classes, including enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB), massive machine-type communications (mMTC), and ultra-reliable low-latency communications (URLLC). In this paper, we study the impact of adversarial attacks on AI-driven RAN slicing decisions, where a budget-constrained adversary selectively jams slice transmissions to bias deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based resource allocation, and quantify the resulting service level agreement (SLA) violations and post-attack recovery behavior. Our results indicate that budget-constrained adversarial jamming can induce severe and slice-dependent steady-state SLA violations. Moreover, the DRL agent's reward converges toward the clean baseline only after a non-negligible recovery period.

摘要（中文）: 下一代蜂窝网络旨在支持具有多样化数据速率和延迟需求的新兴应用，例如沉浸式多媒体服务和大规模物联网部署。其关键赋能机制是无线接入网络切片技术，该技术通过动态划分无线电资源为虚拟资源块，以高效服务异构流量类别，包括增强移动宽带、大规模机器类通信和超高可靠低延迟通信。本文研究了对抗性攻击对人工智能驱动的无线接入网络切片决策的影响，其中预算受限的对手通过选择性干扰切片传输来影响基于深度强化学习的资源分配，并量化了由此产生的服务等级协议违反情况以及攻击后的恢复行为。研究结果表明，预算受限的对抗性干扰可导致严重且随切片类型变化的稳态服务等级协议违反。此外，深度强化学习智能体的奖励仅需经过不可忽略的恢复周期后，才能收敛至未受攻击的基准水平。

TLDR: This paper studies adversarial attacks on AI-driven RAN slicing, where a budget-constrained adversary jams transmissions to bias DRL-based resource allocation, causing SLA violations and slow recovery.

简要说明: 本文研究针对AI驱动的RAN网络切片的对抗性攻击，即预算受限的对手通过选择性干扰传输来影响基于深度强化学习的资源分配，导致服务等级协议违约和缓慢的恢复过程。
