Authors: Deemah H. Tashman, Soumaya Cherkaoui

Aligning Recommendations with User Popularity Preferences

Abstract (English): Popularity bias is a pervasive problem in recommender systems, where recommendations disproportionately favor popular items. This not only results in "rich-get-richer" dynamics and a homogenization of visible content, but can also lead to misalignment of recommendations with individual users' preferences for popular or niche content. This work studies popularity bias through the lens of user-recommender alignment. To this end, we introduce Popularity Quantile Calibration, a measurement framework that quantifies misalignment between a user's historical popularity preference and the popularity of their recommendations. Building on this notion of popularity alignment, we propose SPREE, an inference-time mitigation method for sequential recommenders based on activation steering. SPREE identifies a popularity direction in representation space and adaptively steers model activations based on an estimate of each user's personal popularity bias, allowing both the direction and magnitude of steering to vary across users. Unlike global debiasing approaches, SPREE explicitly targets alignment rather than uniformly reducing popularity. Experiments across multiple datasets show that SPREE consistently improves user-level popularity alignment while preserving recommendation quality.

摘要（中文）: 推荐系统中普遍存在流行度偏差问题，即推荐结果过度倾向于热门项目。这不仅会导致"富者愈富"效应和可见内容同质化，还可能使推荐结果与用户个人对热门或小众内容的偏好产生错位。本研究通过用户-推荐对齐的视角来探讨流行度偏差问题。为此，我们提出了流行度分位数校准框架，该测量框架能够量化用户历史流行度偏好与其推荐内容流行度之间的错位程度。基于这种流行度对齐概念，我们提出SPREE方法——一种基于激活导向的序列推荐器推理时缓解技术。SPREE在表征空间中识别流行度方向，并根据对每个用户个人流行度偏差的估计自适应地引导模型激活，使得导向的方向和强度能够随用户动态调整。与全局去偏方法不同，SPREE明确以对齐为目标，而非简单地均匀降低流行度。在多数据集上的实验表明，SPREE在保持推荐质量的同时，能持续提升用户层面的流行度对齐效果。

TLDR: This paper addresses popularity bias in recommender systems by introducing a measurement framework for user-recommender alignment and a novel inference-time mitigation method called SPREE, which adaptively steers model activations based on individual user popularity preferences.

简要说明: 该论文通过引入用户与推荐系统对齐的衡量框架和名为SPREE的推理时缓解方法，解决了推荐系统中的流行度偏差问题，SPREE根据用户个人偏好自适应地调整模型激活。

Authors: Mona Schirmer, Anton Thielmann, Pola Schwöbel, Thomas Martynec, Giuseppe Di Benedetto, Ben London, Yannik Stein

Transfer learning for nonparametric Bayesian networks

Abstract (English): This paper introduces two transfer learning methodologies for estimating nonparametric Bayesian networks under scarce data. We propose two algorithms, a constraint-based structure learning method, called PC-stable-transfer learning (PCS-TL), and a score-based method, called hill climbing transfer learning (HC-TL). We also define particular metrics to tackle the negative transfer problem in each of them, a situation in which transfer learning has a negative impact on the model's performance. Then, for the parameters, we propose a log-linear pooling approach. For the evaluation, we learn kernel density estimation Bayesian networks, a type of nonparametric Bayesian network, and compare their transfer learning performance with the models alone. To do so, we sample data from small, medium and large-sized synthetic networks and datasets from the UCI Machine Learning repository. Then, we add noise and modifications to these datasets to test their ability to avoid negative transfer. To conclude, we perform a Friedman test with a Bergmann-Hommel post-hoc analysis to show statistical proof of the enhanced experimental behavior of our methods. Thus, PCS-TL and HC-TL demonstrate to be reliable algorithms for improving the learning performance of a nonparametric Bayesian network with scarce data, which in real industrial environments implies a reduction in the required time to deploy the network.

摘要（中文）: 本文介绍了两种用于稀缺数据下非参数贝叶斯网络估计的迁移学习方法。我们提出了两种算法：基于约束的结构学习方法（称为PC-stable迁移学习，PCS-TL）和基于评分的方法（称为爬山迁移学习，HC-TL）。同时，针对两种方法中可能出现的负迁移问题——即迁移学习对模型性能产生负面影响的状况，我们分别定义了特定的度量指标加以应对。在参数估计方面，我们提出了一种对数线性池化方法。为进行评估，我们以核密度估计贝叶斯网络（一种非参数贝叶斯网络）为研究对象，将迁移学习性能与独立模型进行对比。实验数据来源于中小型及大型合成网络样本，以及UCI机器学习数据库中的数据集。我们对这些数据集添加噪声并进行修改，以测试方法避免负迁移的能力。最后，通过弗里德曼检验及伯格曼-霍梅尔事后分析，我们提供了统计证据以证明所提方法在实验性能上的提升。结果表明，PCS-TL和HC-TL是提升稀缺数据下非参数贝叶斯网络学习性能的可靠算法，在实际工业环境中应用时可有效缩短网络部署所需时间。

TLDR: The paper proposes two transfer learning algorithms (PCS-TL and HC-TL) for nonparametric Bayesian networks to improve learning with scarce data, focusing on avoiding negative transfer and evaluating with synthetic and UCI datasets.

简要说明: 本文提出了两种用于非参数贝叶斯网络的迁移学习算法（PCS-TL和HC-TL），旨在改善数据稀缺下的学习性能，重点解决负迁移问题，并使用合成数据和UCI数据集进行了评估。

Authors: Rafael Sojo, Pedro Larrañaga, Concha Bielza

WARP: Guaranteed Inner-Layer Repair of NLP Transformers

Abstract (English): Transformer-based NLP models remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, yet existing repair methods face a fundamental trade-off: gradient-based approaches offer flexibility but lack verifiability and often overfit; methods that do provide repair guarantees are restricted to the final layer or small networks, significantly limiting the parameter search space available for repair. We present WARP (Weight-Adjusted Repair with Provability), a constraint-based repair framework that extends repair beyond the last layer of Transformer models. WARP formulates repair as a convex quadratic program derived from a first-order linearization of the logit gap, enabling tractable optimization over a high-dimensional parameter space. Under the condition that the first-order approximation holds, this formulation induces three per-sample guarantees: (i) a positive margin constraint ensuring correct classification on repaired inputs, (ii) preservation constraints over a designated remain set, and (iii) a certified robustness radius derived from Lipschitz continuity. To ensure feasibility across varying model architectures, we introduce a sensitivity-based preprocessing step that conditions the optimization landscape accordingly. We further show that the iterative optimization procedure converges to solutions satisfying all repair constraints under mild assumptions. Empirical evaluation on encoder-only Transformers with varying layer architectures validates that these guarantees hold in practice while improving robustness to adversarial inputs. Our results demonstrate that guaranteed, generalizable Transformer repair is achievable through principled constraint-based optimization.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 基于Transformer的NLP模型仍易受对抗性扰动影响，而现有修复方法面临根本性权衡：基于梯度的方案虽灵活但缺乏可验证性且易过拟合；能提供修复保证的方法则被限制在最终层或小型网络，严重制约了可用于修复的参数搜索空间。本文提出WARP（可验证性权重调整修复），一种基于约束的修复框架，将修复能力扩展至Transformer模型的末层之外。WARP将修复问题转化为由对数间隙一阶线性化推导出的凸二次规划，实现了对高维参数空间的可处理优化。在一阶近似成立的条件下，该形式化方法产生三项样本级保证：（一）通过正间隔约束确保修复输入的正确分类，（二）对指定保留集的保护性约束，（三）基于利普希茨连续性的可证明鲁棒性半径。为确保不同模型架构的可行性，我们引入基于敏感度的预处理步骤以相应调整优化空间。进一步证明在温和假设条件下，迭代优化过程会收敛至满足所有修复约束的解。在不同层架构的仅编码器Transformer上的实证评估表明，这些保证在实践中成立，同时提升了对对抗性输入的鲁棒性。我们的研究证明，通过基于约束的优化原则，可实现具备可验证性、可泛化性的Transformer模型修复。

TLDR: WARP is a method for provably repairing inner layers of Transformer NLP models against adversarial attacks using constraint-based optimization, offering certified robustness guarantees.

简要说明: WARP是一种通过约束优化对Transformer NLP模型的内层进行可证明修复的方法，以防御对抗性攻击，并提供经过认证的鲁棒性保证。

Authors: Hsin-Ling Hsu, Min-Yu Chen, Nai-Chia Chen, Yan-Ru Chen, Yi-Ling Chang, Fang Yu

Investigating Autonomous Agent Contributions in the Wild: Activity Patterns and Code Change over Time

Abstract (English): The rise of large language models for code has reshaped software development. Autonomous coding agents, able to create branches, open pull requests, and perform code reviews, now actively contribute to real-world projects. Their growing role offers a unique and timely opportunity to investigate AI-driven contributions and their effects on code quality, team dynamics, and software maintainability. In this work, we construct a novel dataset of approximately $110,000$ open-source pull requests, including associated commits, comments, reviews, issues, and file changes, collectively representing millions of lines of source code. We compare five popular coding agents, including OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Google Jules, and Devin, examining how their usage differs in various development aspects such as merge frequency, edited file types, and developer interaction signals, including comments and reviews. Furthermore, we emphasize that code authoring and review are only a small part of the larger software engineering process, as the resulting code must also be maintained and updated over time. Hence, we offer several longitudinal estimates of survival and churn rates for agent-generated versus human-authored code. Ultimately, our findings indicate an increasing agent activity in open-source projects, although their contributions are associated with more churn over time compared to human-authored code.

摘要（中文）: 大型代码语言模型的兴起重塑了软件开发格局。能够创建分支、发起拉取请求和进行代码审查的自主编码代理，如今已积极参与现实项目开发。其日益增强的作用为研究AI驱动的代码贡献及其对代码质量、团队协作和软件可维护性的影响提供了独特而及时的契机。在本研究中，我们构建了一个包含约11万条开源拉取请求的新型数据集，涵盖相关提交记录、评论、审阅意见、问题报告和文件变更，共同代表数百万行源代码。我们比较了五种主流编码代理（包括OpenAI Codex、Claude Code、GitHub Copilot、Google Jules和Devin），从合并频率、修改文件类型及开发者互动信号（如评论与审阅）等多个维度分析其使用差异。此外，我们强调代码编写与审查仅是软件工程全流程中的环节之一，生成的代码仍需长期维护与更新。因此，我们通过纵向追踪对比，分别估算了代理生成代码与人工编写代码的存活率与变更率。最终研究表明，尽管开源项目中代理活动日益活跃，但其贡献的代码随时间推移比人工编写的代码更易发生变更。

TLDR: This paper analyzes the contributions of autonomous coding agents in open-source projects, comparing their activity, code changes, and long-term maintainability to human-authored code.

简要说明: 本研究分析了自主编码代理在开源项目中的贡献，比较了它们的活动、代码变更以及与人类编写代码的长期可维护性差异。

Authors: Razvan Mihai Popescu, David Gros, Andrei Botocan, Rahul Pandita, Prem Devanbu, Maliheh Izadi

OkanNet: A Lightweight Deep Learning Architecture for Classification of Brain Tumor from MRI Images

Abstract (English): Medical imaging techniques, especially Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), are accepted as the gold standard in the diagnosis and treatment planning of neurological diseases. However, the manual analysis of MRI images is a time-consuming process for radiologists and is prone to human error due to fatigue. In this study, two different Deep Learning approaches were developed and analyzed comparatively for the automatic detection and classification of brain tumors (Glioma, Meningioma, Pituitary, and No Tumor). In the first approach, a custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture named "OkanNet", which has a low computational cost and fast training time, was designed from scratch. In the second approach, the Transfer Learning method was applied using the 50-layer ResNet-50 [1] architecture, pre-trained on the ImageNet dataset. In experiments conducted on an extended dataset compiled by Masoud Nickparvar containing a total of $7,023$ MRI images, the Transfer Learning-based ResNet-50 model exhibited superior classification performance, achieving $96.49\%$ Accuracy and $0.963$ Precision. In contrast, the custom OkanNet architecture reached an accuracy rate of $88.10\%$; however, it proved to be a strong alternative for mobile and embedded systems with limited computational power by yielding results approximately $3.2$ times faster ($311$ seconds) than ResNet-50 in terms of training time. This study demonstrates the trade-off between model depth and computational efficiency in medical image analysis through experimental data.

摘要（中文）: 医学影像技术，尤其是磁共振成像，被公认为神经系统疾病诊断与治疗规划的金标准。然而，放射科医师对磁共振图像进行人工分析耗时较长，且易因疲劳导致人为误差。本研究针对脑肿瘤的自动检测与分类任务，开发并对比分析了两种不同的深度学习方法。第一种方法从头设计了一种名为“OkanNet”的定制卷积神经网络架构，其计算成本低、训练时间短；第二种方法则采用迁移学习方法，使用了在ImageNet数据集上预训练的50层ResNet-50架构。在基于Masoud Nickparvar整理的总计7,023张磁共振图像扩展数据集上进行的实验中，基于迁移学习的ResNet-50模型展现出优异的分类性能，准确率达到96.49%，精确率为0.963。相比之下，定制的OkanNet架构获得了88.10%的准确率，但其训练时间比ResNet-50快约3.2倍（311秒），被证明是计算能力受限的移动和嵌入式系统的有力替代方案。本研究通过实验数据揭示了医学图像分析中模型深度与计算效率之间的权衡关系。

TLDR: This paper presents a lightweight CNN called OkanNet and a ResNet-50 transfer learning model for classifying brain tumors from MRI images, focusing on a trade-off between accuracy and computational efficiency for medical diagnosis.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种轻量级CNN（OkanNet）和ResNet-50迁移学习模型，用于从MRI图像中分类脑肿瘤，侧重于医疗诊断中准确性和计算效率之间的权衡。

Authors: Okan Uçar, Murat Kurt

KUET at StanceNakba Shared Task: StanceMoE: Mixture-of-Experts Architecture for Stance Detection

Abstract (English): Actor-level stance detection aims to determine an author expressed position toward specific geopolitical actors mentioned or implicated in a text. Although transformer-based models have achieved relatively good performance in stance classification, they typically rely on unified representations that may not sufficiently capture heterogeneous linguistic signals, such as contrastive discourse structures, framing cues, and salient lexical indicators. This motivates the need for adaptive architectures that explicitly model diverse stance-expressive patterns. In this paper, we propose StanceMoE, a context-enhanced Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture built upon a fine-tuned BERT encoder for actor-level stance detection. Our model integrates six expert modules designed to capture complementary linguistic signals, including global semantic orientation, salient lexical cues, clause-level focus, phrase-level patterns, framing indicators, and contrast-driven discourse shifts. A context-aware gating mechanism dynamically weights expert contributions, enabling adaptive routing based on input characteristics. Experiments are conducted on the StanceNakba 2026 Subtask A dataset, comprising 1,401 annotated English texts where the target actor is implicit in the text. StanceMoE achieves a macro-F1 score of 94.26%, outperforming traditional baselines, and alternative BERT-based variants.

摘要（中文）: 参与者立场检测旨在确定文本作者对文本中提及或暗示的特定地缘政治参与者所表达的态度立场。尽管基于Transformer的模型在立场分类任务中已取得相对较好的性能，但它们通常依赖统一的表征方式，可能无法充分捕捉异质的语言信号，例如对比性话语结构、框架化线索以及显著词汇标记。这促使我们需要构建能够显式建模多样化立场表达模式的自适应架构。本文提出StanceMoE，一种基于微调BERT编码器构建的上下文增强混合专家模型架构，专门用于参与者立场检测。该模型整合了六个设计用于捕捉互补语言信号的专家模块，包括全局语义导向、显著词汇标记、子句级焦点、短语级模式、框架化指标以及对比驱动的话语转换。通过上下文感知门控机制动态加权专家贡献，实现基于输入特征的自适应路由。实验在StanceNakba 2026子任务A数据集上进行，该数据集包含1,401篇标注英文文本，其中目标参与者在文本中为隐式表达。StanceMoE取得了94.26%的宏观F1分数，优于传统基线模型及其他基于BERT的变体。

TLDR: The paper proposes a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture called StanceMoE, built on a fine-tuned BERT encoder, for the task of actor-level stance detection in text, specifically on a dataset about geopolitical events.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种基于微调BERT编码器的专家混合架构StanceMoE，用于文本中隐含目标行动者的立场检测任务，并在特定地缘政治事件数据集上进行了评估。

Authors: Abdullah Al Shafi, Md. Milon Islam, Sk. Imran Hossain, K. M. Azharul Hasan

Transforming OPACs into Intelligent Discovery Systems: An AI-Powered, Knowledge Graph-Driven Smart OPAC for Digital Libraries

Abstract (English): Traditional Online Public Access Catalogues (OPACs) are becoming less effective due to the rapid growth of scholarly literature. Conventional search methods, such as keyword indexing and Boolean queries, often fail to support efficient knowledge discovery. This paper proposes a Smart OPAC framework that transforms traditional OPACs into intelligent discovery systems using artificial intelligence and knowledge graph techniques. The framework enables semantic search, thematic filtering, and knowledge graph-based visualization to enhance user interaction and exploration. It integrates multiple open scholarly data sources and applies semantic embeddings to improve relevance and contextual understanding. The system supports exploratory search, semantic navigation, and refined result filtering based on user-defined themes. Quantitative evaluation demonstrates improvements in retrieval efficiency, relevance, and reduction of information overload. The proposed approach offers practical implications for modernizing digital library services and supports next-generation research workflows. Future work includes user-centric evaluation, personalization, and dynamic knowledge graph updates.

摘要（中文）: 传统在线公共检索目录（OPAC）因学术文献的快速增长正逐渐失去检索效能。基于关键词索引和布尔查询的传统检索方法往往难以支持有效的知识发现。本文提出一种智能OPAC框架，通过人工智能与知识图谱技术将传统OPAC升级为智能发现系统。该框架支持语义检索、主题过滤及基于知识图谱的可视化功能，以增强用户交互与探索体验。系统整合多个开放学术数据源，应用语义嵌入技术提升检索相关性与上下文理解能力，支持探索式搜索、语义导航及基于用户自定义主题的精细化结果筛选。定量评估表明，该系统在检索效率、结果相关性及缓解信息过载方面均有显著提升。所提出的方法为数字图书馆服务的现代化改造提供了可行路径，并支持新一代科研工作流程。未来工作将聚焦用户中心化评估、个性化推荐及动态知识图谱更新。

TLDR: This paper proposes an AI-powered, knowledge graph-driven Smart OPAC framework to transform traditional library catalogues into intelligent discovery systems, enhancing search and exploration in digital libraries.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于人工智能和知识图谱的智能OPAC框架，旨在将传统图书馆目录系统转变为支持语义搜索和知识发现的智能系统，以提升数字图书馆服务的效率。

Authors: M. S. Rajeevan, B. Mini Devi

DySCo: Dynamic Semantic Compression for Effective Long-term Time Series Forecasting

Abstract (English): Time series forecasting (TSF) is critical across domains such as finance, meteorology, and energy. While extending the lookback window theoretically provides richer historical context, in practice, it often introduces irrelevant noise and computational redundancy, preventing models from effectively capturing complex long-term dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose a Dynamic Semantic Compression (DySCo) framework. Unlike traditional methods that rely on fixed heuristics, DySCo introduces an Entropy-Guided Dynamic Sampling (EGDS) mechanism to autonomously identify and retain high-entropy segments while compressing redundant trends. Furthermore, we incorporate a Hierarchical Frequency-Enhanced Decomposition (HFED) strategy to separate high-frequency anomalies from low-frequency patterns, ensuring that critical details are preserved during sparse sampling. Finally, a Cross-Scale Interaction Mixer(CSIM) is designed to dynamically fuse global contexts with local representations, replacing simple linear aggregation. Experimental results demonstrate that DySCo serves as a universal plug-and-play module, significantly enhancing the ability of mainstream models to capture long-term correlations with reduced computational cost.

摘要（中文）: 时间序列预测对金融、气象与能源等领域至关重要。理论上延长回看窗口可提供更丰富的历史信息，但在实践中往往引入无关噪声与计算冗余，阻碍模型有效捕捉复杂长期依赖关系。为应对这些挑战，本研究提出动态语义压缩框架。该框架摒弃传统依赖固定启发式规则的方法，引入熵引导动态采样机制，在压缩冗余趋势的同时自主识别并保留高熵片段。此外，我们设计分层频率增强分解策略，将高频异常与低频模式进行分离，确保稀疏采样过程中关键细节得以保留。最后通过跨尺度交互混合器动态融合全局上下文与局部表征，替代传统线性聚合方式。实验结果表明，该框架作为通用即插即用模块，能以更低计算成本显著提升主流模型捕捉长期相关性的能力。

TLDR: Proposes a novel Dynamic Semantic Compression (DySCo) framework for long-term time series forecasting, using entropy-guided sampling and frequency-enhanced decomposition to reduce noise and improve efficiency.

简要说明: 提出了一种用于长期时间序列预测的动态语义压缩框架，利用熵引导采样和频率增强分解来减少噪声并提高效率。

Authors: Xiang Ao, Yinyu Tan, Mengru Chen

RefineRL: Advancing Competitive Programming with Self-Refinement Reinforcement Learning

Abstract (English): While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on complex reasoning tasks such as competitive programming (CP), existing methods predominantly focus on single-attempt settings, overlooking their capacity for iterative refinement. In this paper, we present RefineRL, a novel approach designed to unleash the self-refinement capabilities of LLMs for CP problem solving. RefineRL introduces two key innovations: (1) Skeptical-Agent, an iterative self-refinement agent equipped with local execution tools to validate generated solutions against public test cases of CP problems. This agent always maintains a skeptical attitude towards its own outputs and thereby enforces rigorous self-refinement even when validation suggests correctness. (2) A reinforcement learning (RL) solution to incentivize LLMs to self-refine with only standard RLVR data (i.e., problems paired with their verifiable answers). Extensive experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-4B-2507 demonstrate that our method yields substantial gains: after our RL training, these compact 4B models integrated with the Skeptical-Agent not only outperform much larger 32B models but also approach the single-attempt performance of 235B models. These findings suggest that self-refinement holds considerable promise for scaling LLM reasoning, with significant potential for further advancement.

摘要（中文）: 虽然大语言模型在复杂推理任务（如竞技编程）上已展现出强大性能，但现有方法主要集中于单次尝试场景，忽视了其迭代优化的能力。本文提出RefineRL——一种旨在释放大语言模型在竞技编程问题求解中自我优化能力的新方法。该方法包含两大核心创新：（1）引入具备本地执行工具的迭代式自我优化代理"Skeptical-Agent"，该代理可通过竞技编程问题的公共测试用例验证生成方案，并始终保持对自身输出的审慎态度，即使在验证显示正确的情况下仍坚持严格自我优化；（2）设计强化学习解决方案，激励大语言模型仅使用标准RLVR数据（即问题与可验证答案配对的数据）进行自我优化。基于Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-4B-2507的广泛实验表明，我们的方法带来显著提升：经过强化学习训练后，集成Skeptical-Agent的紧凑4B模型不仅超越了许多32B大型模型，更逼近了235B模型的单次尝试性能。这些发现表明，自我优化机制对于扩展大语言模型推理能力具有重要价值，且存在显著的进一步突破潜力。

TLDR: This paper introduces RefineRL, a self-refinement method using reinforcement learning and a skeptical agent with local execution tools to improve the performance of large language models on competitive programming problems.

简要说明: 这篇论文提出了RefineRL，一种利用强化学习和带有本地执行工具的多疑智能体进行自我优化的方法，旨在提升大语言模型在竞争性编程问题上的表现。

Authors: Shaopeng Fu, Xingxing Zhang, Li Dong, Di Wang, Furu Wei

Scalable Pretraining of Large Mixture of Experts Language Models on Aurora Super Computer

Abstract (English): Pretraining Large Language Models (LLMs) from scratch requires massive amount of compute. Aurora super computer is an ExaScale machine with 127,488 Intel PVC (Ponte Vechio) GPU tiles. In this work, we showcase LLM pretraining on Aurora at the scale of 1000s of GPU tiles. Towards this effort, we developed Optimus, an inhouse training library with support for standard large model training techniques. Using Optimus, we first pretrained Mula-1B, a 1 Billion dense model and Mula-7B-A1B, a 7 Billion Mixture of Experts (MoE) model from scratch on 3072 GPU tiles for the full 4 trillion tokens of the OLMoE-mix-0924 dataset. We then demonstrated model scaling by pretraining three large MoE models Mula-20B-A2B, Mula-100B-A7B, and Mula-220B-A10B till 100 Billion tokens on the same dataset. On our largest model Mula-220B-A10B, we pushed the compute scaling from 384 to 12288 GPU tiles and observed scaling efficiency of around 90% at 12288 GPU tiles. We significantly improved the runtime performance of MoE models using custom GPU kernels for expert computation, and a novel EP-Aware sharded optimizer resulting in training speedups up to 1.71x. As part of the Optimus library, we also developed a robust set of reliability and fault tolerant features to improve training stability and continuity at scale.

摘要（中文）: 从头开始预训练大型语言模型（LLMs）需要巨大的计算资源。Aurora超级计算机是一台拥有127,488个英特尔PVC（Ponte Vechio）GPU单元的超大规模计算系统。本研究展示了在Aurora超级计算机上使用数千个GPU单元进行LLM预训练的实践。为此，我们开发了内部训练库Optimus，该库支持标准的大型模型训练技术。借助Optimus，我们首先在3,072个GPU单元上从头开始预训练了10亿参数的密集模型Mula-1B，以及基于专家混合（MoE）架构的70亿参数模型Mula-7B-A1B，完整训练了OLMoE-mix-0924数据集的全部4万亿个词元。随后，我们通过在同一数据集上预训练三个更大的MoE模型——Mula-20B-A2B、Mula-100B-A7B和Mula-220B-A10B直至1000亿词元，验证了模型的扩展性。在最大的Mula-220B-A10B模型上，我们将计算规模从384个GPU单元扩展至12,288个，并观察到在12,288个GPU单元上达到了约90%的扩展效率。通过使用定制化GPU核心进行专家计算，以及引入一种新颖的专家感知分片优化器（EP-Aware sharded optimizer），我们显著提升了MoE模型的运行时性能，训练加速最高可达1.71倍。作为Optimus库的一部分，我们还开发了一套强大的可靠性与容错功能，以提升大规模训练时的稳定性和连续性。

TLDR: This paper describes the development of the Optimus training library and the pretraining of large-scale Mixture of Experts (MoE) language models on the Aurora supercomputer, focusing on scaling efficiency, custom kernels, and fault tolerance.

简要说明: 本文介绍了在Aurora超级计算机上开发Optimus训练库和预训练大规模MoE语言模型的工作，重点在于扩展效率、自定义内核和容错性。

Authors: Dharma Teja Vooturi, Dhiraj Kalamkar, Dipankar Das, Bharat Kaul

Thinking Wrong in Silence: Backdoor Attacks on Continuous Latent Reasoning

Abstract (English): A new generation of language models reasons entirely in continuous hidden states, producing no tokens and leaving no audit trail. We show that this silence creates a fundamentally new attack surface. ThoughtSteer perturbs a single embedding vector at the input layer; the model's own multi-pass reasoning amplifies this perturbation into a hijacked latent trajectory that reliably produces the attacker's chosen answer, while remaining structurally invisible to every token-level defense. Across two architectures (Coconut and SimCoT), three reasoning benchmarks, and model scales from 124M to 3B parameters, ThoughtSteer achieves >=99% attack success rate with near-baseline clean accuracy, transfers to held-out benchmarks without retraining (94-100%), evades all five evaluated active defenses, and survives 25 epochs of clean fine-tuning. We trace these results to a unifying mechanism: Neural Collapse in the latent space pulls triggered representations onto a tight geometric attractor, explaining both why defenses fail and why any effective backdoor must leave a linearly separable signature (probe AUC>=0.999). Yet a striking paradox emerges: individual latent vectors still encode the correct answer even as the model outputs the wrong one. The adversarial information is not in any single vector but in the collective trajectory, establishing backdoor perturbations as a new lens for mechanistic interpretability of continuous reasoning. Code and checkpoints are available.

摘要（中文）: 新一代语言模型完全在连续隐藏状态中进行推理，不产生任何词元且不留下审计踪迹。本研究揭示这种静默性创造了一个全新的攻击面。ThoughtSteer通过在输入层扰动单个嵌入向量，利用模型自身的多轮推理机制将该扰动放大为被劫持的潜在轨迹，从而可靠地生成攻击者预设的答案，同时保持结构上对所有词元级防御的不可见性。在两种架构（Coconut与SimCoT）、三个推理基准测试集、以及1.24亿至30亿参数的模型规模上，ThoughtSteer实现了≥99%的攻击成功率与接近基准的干净准确率，能够不经重新训练迁移至未见过的基准测试集（94-100%），规避所有五种已评估的主动防御机制，并在25个周期的干净微调后持续有效。我们将这些结果归因于统一机制：潜在空间中的神经坍缩现象将受触发的表征拉向紧凑的几何吸引子，这既解释了防御失效的原因，也说明任何有效后门必须留下线性可分离的签名特征（探测AUC≥0.999）。然而一个显著的悖论随之显现：尽管模型输出错误答案，单个潜在向量仍编码着正确答案。对抗信息并非存在于任何单一向量中，而是蕴含于集体轨迹之中，这确立了后门扰动作为连续推理机制可解释性研究的新透镜。代码与模型检查点已公开。

TLDR: This paper introduces ThoughtSteer, a backdoor attack targeting continuous latent reasoning models that hijacks reasoning trajectories without producing tokens, evading token-level defenses and revealing a new attack surface through latent space geometry.

简要说明: 这篇论文提出了ThoughtSteer，一种针对连续潜在推理模型的后门攻击，它能在不产生令牌的情况下劫持推理轨迹，从而逃避令牌级防御，并通过潜在空间几何揭示了新的攻击面。

Authors: Swapnil Parekh

Spectral Compact Training: Pre-Training Large Language Models via Permanent Truncated SVD and Stiefel QR Retraction

Abstract (English): The memory wall remains the primary bottleneck for training large language models on consumer hardware. We introduce Spectral Compact Training (SCT), a method that replaces dense weight matrices with permanent truncated SVD factors W = U diag(s) V^T, where the full dense matrix is never materialized during training or inference. Gradients flow through the compact spectral factors via standard backpropagation, and U, V are retracted to the Stiefel manifold via QR decomposition after each optimizer step. SCT achieves up to 199x memory reduction per MLP layer at rank 32, enabling full training steps of 70B-parameter architectures on a Steam Deck handheld (7.2 GB peak memory vs. 1,245 GB for dense FP32 training with Adam). Rank-sweep experiments on SmolLM2-1.7B (ranks 32-256, 2000 steps, NVIDIA A100) show that all tested ranks converge to the same loss floor (~4.2-4.5), identifying the learning rate schedule -- not MLP rank -- as the primary bottleneck. Rank 128 emerges as the efficiency sweet spot at 11.7x MLP compression with the lowest perplexity. GPU memory drops 46% at rank 32 while training throughput doubles.

摘要（中文）: 内存瓶颈仍然是消费级硬件上训练大语言模型的主要限制因素。我们提出谱压缩训练方法，该方法使用永久截断的奇异值分解因子W = U diag(s) V^T替代稠密权重矩阵，在整个训练和推理过程中始终无需重构完整稠密矩阵。梯度通过标准反向传播在紧凑谱因子间流动，每个优化器步骤后通过QR分解将U和V回撤至Stiefel流形。在秩为32的设置下，SCT使每个MLP层最高实现199倍内存压缩，支持在Steam Deck掌上设备（峰值内存7.2 GB）上完整训练700亿参数模型，而传统Adam优化器的FP32稠密训练需要1,245 GB内存。在SmolLM2-17亿参数模型上进行的秩扫描实验（秩32-256，2000步，NVIDIA A100）显示，所有测试秩值均收敛至相同损失平台（约4.2-4.5），表明学习率调度——而非MLP秩——是主要瓶颈。秩128以11.7倍MLP压缩率成为效率最优解，其困惑度最低。当秩为32时，GPU内存降低46%，同时训练吞吐量翻倍。

TLDR: Introduces Spectral Compact Training (SCT), a memory-efficient method for training large language models by replacing dense weight matrices with truncated SVD factors, enabling training of large models on resource-constrained hardware.

简要说明: 提出光谱紧凑训练（SCT），这是一种内存高效的方法，通过用截断SVD因子替换稠密权重矩阵来训练大型语言模型，使在资源受限硬件上训练大模型成为可能。

Authors: Björn Roman Kohlberger

A CEFR-Inspired Classification Framework with Fuzzy C-Means To Automate Assessment of Programming Skills in Scratch

Abstract (English): Context: Schools, training platforms, and technology firms increasingly need to assess programming proficiency at scale with transparent, reproducible methods that support personalized learning pathways. Objective: This study introduces a pedagogical framework for Scratch project assessment, aligned with the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR), providing universal competency levels for students and teachers alongside actionable insights for curriculum design. Method: We apply Fuzzy C-Means clustering to 2008246 Scratch projects evaluated via Dr.Scratch, implementing an ordinal criterion to map clusters to CEFR levels (A1-C2), and introducing enhanced classification metrics that identify transitional learners, enable continuous progress tracking, and quantify classification certainty to balance automated feedback with instructor review. Impact: The framework enables diagnosis of systemic curriculum gaps-notably a "B2 bottleneck" where only 13.3% of learners reside due to the cognitive load of integrating Logic Synchronization, and Data Representation--while providing certainty--based triggers for human intervention.

摘要（中文）: 摘要：背景：学校、培训平台与技术企业日益需要采用透明、可复现的方法大规模评估编程能力，以支持个性化学习路径的构建。目标：本研究提出一种基于Scratch项目评估的教学框架，该框架与欧洲共同语言参考标准（CEFR）对标，既为学生与教师提供通用能力等级标准，也为课程设计提供可操作的改进依据。方法：我们采用模糊C均值聚类算法对Dr.Scratch平台评估的2,008,246个Scratch项目进行分析，通过序数化标准将聚类结果映射至CEFR六个等级（A1-C2），并引入增强型分类指标：识别过渡阶段学习者、支持持续进度追踪、量化分类确定度，以平衡自动化反馈与教师人工审阅。影响：该框架能够诊断系统性课程设计缺陷——例如发现仅13.3%学习者达到B2水平的“能力瓶颈”，其根源在于逻辑同步与数据表示整合带来的认知负荷——同时通过基于确定度的触发机制，为人工介入提供精准决策支持。

TLDR: Proposes a framework using Fuzzy C-Means clustering to automatically assess programming skills in Scratch projects, mapping them to CEFR language proficiency levels and providing diagnostic insights for curriculum design.

简要说明: 提出了一个使用模糊C均值聚类对Scratch项目的编程技能进行自动评估的框架，将其映射到CEFR语言熟练度等级，并为课程设计提供诊断性见解。

Authors: Ricardo Hidalgo-Aragón, Jesús M. González-Barahona, Gregorio Robles

CircuitProbe: Predicting Reasoning Circuits in Transformers via Stability Zone Detection

Abstract (English): Transformer language models contain localized reasoning circuits, contiguous layer blocks that improve reasoning when duplicated at inference time. Finding these circuits currently requires brute-force sweeps costing 25 GPU hours per model. We propose CircuitProbe, which predicts circuit locations from activation statistics in under 5 minutes on CPU, providing a speedup of three to four orders of magnitude. We find that reasoning circuits come in two types: stability circuits in early layers, detected through the derivative of representation change, and magnitude circuits in late layers, detected through anomaly scoring. We validate across 9 models spanning 6 architectures, including 2025 models, confirming that CircuitProbe top predictions match or are within 2 layers of the optimal circuit in all validated cases. A scaling experiment across the Qwen 2.5 family reveals that layer duplication consistently benefits models under 3B parameters but degrades performance in 7B+ models, making this a practical scaling technique for small language models. CircuitProbe requires as few as 10 calibration examples and its predictions are stable across English, Hindi, Chinese, and French.

摘要（中文）: Transformer语言模型内部存在局部推理电路，即连续的层块结构，在推理时复制这些层块可提升推理能力。目前定位这类电路需要耗费25 GPU小时进行暴力搜索。本文提出CircuitProbe方法，通过激活统计量在CPU上5分钟内即可预测电路位置，实现3-4个数量级的加速。研究发现推理电路可分为两类：早期层通过表征变化导数检测的稳定性电路，以及后期层通过异常评分检测的幅度电路。我们在涵盖6种架构的9个模型（包括2025模型）上验证发现，CircuitProbe的预测结果在所有验证案例中均与最优电路位置完全吻合或仅相差2层以内。针对Qwen 2.5系列的扩展实验表明，层复制技术能持续提升30亿参数以下模型的性能，但会降低70亿以上参数模型的表现，这使其成为小语言模型实用的扩展技术。CircuitProbe仅需10个校准样本，其预测结果在英语、印地语、中文和法语中均保持稳定。

TLDR: CircuitProbe is a fast method for identifying localized reasoning circuits within transformer language models using activation statistics, significantly reducing the computational cost of finding such circuits for potential inference-time enhancement.

简要说明: CircuitProbe 是一种快速方法，利用激活统计数据识别 Transformer 语言模型中的局部推理电路，大幅降低了为推理时增强寻找此类电路的计算成本。

Authors: Rajkiran Panuganti

Procela: Epistemic Governance in Mechanistic Simulations Under Structural Uncertainty

Abstract (English): Mechanistic simulations typically assume fixed ontologies: variables, causal relationships, and resolution policies are static. This assumption fails when the true causal structure is contested or unidentifiable-as in antimicrobial resistance (AMR) spread, where contact, environmental, and selection ontologies compete. We introduce Procela, a Python framework where variables act as epistemic authorities that maintain complete hypothesis memory, mechanisms encode competing ontologies as causal units, and governance observes epistemic signals and mutates system topology at runtime. This is the first framework where simulations test their own assumptions. We instantiate Procela for AMR in a hospital network with three competing families. Governance detects coverage decay, policy fragility, and runs structural probes. Results show 20.4% error reduction and 69% cumulative regret improvement over baseline. All experiments are reproducible with full auditability. Procela establishes a new paradigm: simulations that model not only the world but their own modeling process, enabling adaptation under structural uncertainty.

摘要（中文）: 机制模拟通常假定固定的本体论：变量、因果关系和解析策略是静态的。当真实的因果结构存在争议或无法识别时，这一假设便不再适用——例如在抗菌素耐药性（AMR）传播中，接触传播、环境传播和选择压力等不同本体论相互竞争。我们提出Procela，一个Python框架：其中变量作为认知权威，维持完整的假设记忆；机制将竞争性本体论编码为因果单元；治理模块则通过观察认知信号，在运行时动态改变系统拓扑结构。这是首个能够自我检验假设的模拟框架。我们将Procela应用于医院网络中的AMR传播问题，实例化了三个竞争性理论家族。治理模块能够检测覆盖度衰减与策略脆弱性，并执行结构探测。实验结果表明，相较于基线方法，该框架实现了20.4%的误差降低和69%的累积遗憾改善。所有实验均具备完全可审计性且可复现。Procela开创了模拟研究的新范式：不仅对现实世界建模，更对其自身的建模过程进行建模，从而实现在结构不确定性条件下的自适应演化。

TLDR: Procela is a novel Python framework for mechanistic simulations that allows for dynamic adaptation under structural uncertainty by modeling competing ontologies and enabling simulations to test their own assumptions.

简要说明: Procela 是一个用于机制模拟的新型 Python 框架，它通过建模相互竞争的学说，并允许模拟测试其自身假设，从而在结构性不确定性下实现动态适应。

Authors: Kinson Vernet

Streaming Model Cascades for Semantic SQL

Abstract (English): Modern data warehouses extend SQL with semantic operators that invoke large language models on each qualifying row, but the per-row inference cost is prohibitive at scale. Model cascades reduce this cost by routing most rows through a fast proxy model and delegating uncertain cases to an expensive oracle. Existing frameworks, however, require global dataset access and optimize a single quality metric, limiting their applicability in distributed systems where data is partitioned across independent workers. We present two adaptive cascade algorithms designed for streaming, per-partition execution in which each worker processes its partition independently without inter-worker communication. SUPG-IT extends the SUPG statistical framework to streaming execution with iterative threshold refinement and joint precision-recall guarantees. GAMCAL replaces user-specified quality targets with a learned calibration model: a Generalized Additive Model maps proxy scores to calibrated probabilities with uncertainty quantification, enabling direct optimization of a cost-quality tradeoff through a single parameter. Experiments on six datasets in a production semantic SQL engine show that both algorithms achieve F1 > 0.95 on every dataset. GAMCAL achieves higher F1 per oracle call at cost-sensitive operating points, while SUPG-IT reaches a higher quality ceiling with formal guarantees on precision and recall.

摘要（中文）: 现代数据仓库通过语义运算符扩展SQL，使得每行符合条件的记录都能调用大型语言模型，但逐行推理的成本在大规模场景下极其高昂。模型级联通过将大多数行路由至快速代理模型，并将不确定案例委派给昂贵的专家模型，从而降低这一成本。然而，现有框架需要全局数据集访问并仅优化单一质量指标，限制了其在数据独立分布于各工作节点的分布式系统中的适用性。本文提出了两种自适应级联算法，专为流式分区执行设计，其中每个工作节点独立处理其分区，无需节点间通信。SUPG-IT将SUPG统计框架扩展至流式执行，通过迭代阈值优化和联合精确率-召回率保证实现动态适应。GAMCAL则用学习型校准模型替代用户指定的质量目标：广义可加模型将代理分数映射为带有不确定性量化的校准概率，从而通过单一参数直接优化成本与质量的权衡。在生产级语义SQL引擎的六个数据集上进行的实验表明，两种算法在所有数据集上均实现F1分数大于0.95。GAMCAL在成本敏感的操作点上实现了更高的单次专家模型调用F1值，而SUPG-IT在精确率与召回率的正式保证下达到了更高的质量上限。

TLDR: This paper introduces adaptive model cascade algorithms for efficient semantic SQL query processing, using fast proxy models and expensive LLM oracles to reduce inference costs in distributed systems, with no explicit connection to robotics or embodied AI.

简要说明: 本文介绍了用于高效语义SQL查询处理的自适应模型级联算法，通过快速代理模型和昂贵的LLM预言机来降低分布式系统中的推理成本，与机器人或具身AI没有明确联系。

Authors: Paweł Liskowski, Kyle Schmaus

Agent psychometrics: Task-level performance prediction in agentic coding benchmarks

Abstract (English): As the focus in LLM-based coding shifts from static single-step code generation to multi-step agentic interaction with tools and environments, understanding which tasks will challenge agents and why becomes increasingly difficult. This is compounded by current practice: agent performance is typically measured by aggregate pass rates on benchmarks, but single-number metrics obscure the diversity of tasks within a benchmark. We present a framework for predicting success or failure on individual tasks tailored to the agentic coding regime. Our approach augments Item Response Theory (IRT) with rich features extracted from tasks, including issue statements, repository contexts, solutions, and test cases, and introduces a novel decomposition of agent ability into LLM and scaffold ability components. This parameterization enables us to aggregate evaluation data across heterogeneous leaderboards and accurately predict task-level performance for unseen benchmarks, as well as unseen LLM-scaffold combinations. Our methods have practical utility for benchmark designers, who can better calibrate the difficulty of their new tasks without running computationally expensive agent evaluations.

摘要（中文）: 随着基于大语言模型的编程关注点从静态单步代码生成转向与工具和环境的代理式多步交互，理解哪些任务将挑战智能体及其原因变得愈发困难。当前实践加剧了这一困境：智能体性能通常通过基准测试中的总体通过率来衡量，但单一数值指标掩盖了基准测试内部任务的多样性。我们提出一个专为代理式编码场景设计的预测个体任务成功与否的框架。该方法通过提取任务中丰富特征（包括问题陈述、代码库上下文、解决方案和测试用例）对项目反应理论进行增强，并创新性地将智能体能力分解为语言模型能力与框架能力两部分。此参数化设计使我们能够整合异构排行榜中的评估数据，准确预测未见过基准测试的任务级性能，以及未知的语言模型-框架组合表现。我们的方法对基准设计者具有实际应用价值，他们无需运行计算成本高昂的智能体评估，即可更好地校准新任务的难度。

TLDR: This paper proposes a framework using Item Response Theory and task features to predict the success or failure of LLM-based coding agents on individual tasks, aiming to help benchmark designers calibrate difficulty without expensive evaluations.

简要说明: 本文提出一个框架，利用项目反应理论和任务特征来预测基于LLM的代码智能体在单个任务上的成功或失败，旨在帮助基准设计者在不进行昂贵评估的情况下校准任务难度。

Authors: Chris Ge, Daria Kryvosheieva, Daniel Fried, Uzay Girit, Kaivalya Hariharan

UniMixer: A Unified Architecture for Scaling Laws in Recommendation Systems

Abstract (English): In recent years, the scaling laws of recommendation models have attracted increasing attention, which govern the relationship between performance and parameters/FLOPs of recommenders. Currently, there are three mainstream architectures for achieving scaling in recommendation models, namely attention-based, TokenMixer-based, and factorization-machine-based methods, which exhibit fundamental differences in both design philosophy and architectural structure. In this paper, we propose a unified scaling architecture for recommendation systems, namely \textbf{UniMixer}, to improve scaling efficiency and establish a unified theoretical framework that unifies the mainstream scaling blocks. By transforming the rule-based TokenMixer to an equivalent parameterized structure, we construct a generalized parameterized feature mixing module that allows the token mixing patterns to be optimized and learned during model training. Meanwhile, the generalized parameterized token mixing removes the constraint in TokenMixer that requires the number of heads to be equal to the number of tokens. Furthermore, we establish a unified scaling module design framework for recommender systems, which bridges the connections among attention-based, TokenMixer-based, and factorization-machine-based methods. To further boost scaling ROI, a lightweight UniMixing module is designed, \textbf{UniMixing-Lite}, which further compresses the model parameters and computational cost while significantly improve the model performance. The scaling curves are shown in the following figure. Extensive offline and online experiments are conducted to verify the superior scaling abilities of \textbf{UniMixer}.

摘要（中文）: 近年来，推荐模型的缩放规律日益受到关注，这些规律支配着推荐系统性能与参数量/浮点运算量之间的关系。目前，实现推荐模型缩放的主流架构主要有三种：基于注意力机制、基于TokenMixer和基于因子分解机的方法，这些方法在设计理念和结构上存在根本差异。本文提出了一种统一的推荐系统缩放架构——\textbf{UniMixer}，旨在提升缩放效率，并为主流缩放模块构建统一的理论框架。通过将基于规则的TokenMixer转化为等效的参数化结构，我们构建了广义参数化特征混合模块，使得令牌混合模式能在模型训练过程中得到优化和学习。同时，广义参数化令牌混合消除了TokenMixer中要求注意力头数量必须等于令牌数量的约束。此外，我们建立了推荐系统统一的缩放模块设计框架，从而弥合了基于注意力机制、基于TokenMixer和基于因子分解机方法之间的联系。为进一步提升缩放回报率，本文设计了轻量级UniMixing模块——\textbf{UniMixing-Lite}，该模块在显著提升模型性能的同时，进一步压缩了模型参数量和计算成本。缩放曲线如下图所示。大量离线与在线实验验证了\textbf{UniMixer}卓越的缩放能力。

TLDR: UniMixer is a unified architecture for scaling laws in recommendation systems, aiming to improve scaling efficiency and unify existing recommendation model architectures.

简要说明: UniMixer 是一个用于推荐系统缩放定律的统一架构，旨在提高缩放效率并统一现有的主流推荐模型架构。

Authors: Mingming Ha, Guanchen Wang, Linxun Chen, Xuan Rao, Yuexin Shi, Tianbao Ma, Zhaojie Liu, Yunqian Fan, Zilong Lu, Yanan Niu, Han Li, Kun Gai

HabitatAgent: An End-to-End Multi-Agent System for Housing Consultation

Abstract (English): Housing selection is a high-stakes and largely irreversible decision problem. We study housing consultation as a decision-support interface for housing selection. Existing housing platforms and many LLM-based assistants often reduce this process to ranking or recommendation, resulting in opaque reasoning, brittle multi-constraint handling, and limited guarantees on factuality. We present HabitatAgent, the first LLM-powered multi-agent architecture for end-to-end housing consultation. HabitatAgent comprises four specialized agent roles: Memory, Retrieval, Generation, and Validation. The Memory Agent maintains multi-layer user memory through internal stages for constraint extraction, memory fusion, and verification-gated updates; the Retrieval Agent performs hybrid vector--graph retrieval (GraphRAG); the Generation Agent produces evidence-referenced recommendations and explanations; and the Validation Agent applies multi-tier verification and targeted remediation. Together, these agents provide an auditable and reliable workflow for end-to-end housing consultation. We evaluate HabitatAgent on 100 real user consultation scenarios (300 multi-turn question--answer pairs) under an end-to-end correctness protocol. A strong single-stage baseline (Dense+Rerank) achieves 75% accuracy, while HabitatAgent reaches 95%.

摘要（中文）: 住房选择是一个高风险且基本上不可逆的决策问题。本文研究住房咨询作为住房选择的决策支持界面。现有的住房平台和许多基于大型语言模型（LLM）的助手常将这一过程简化为排序或推荐，导致推理不透明、多约束处理能力薄弱，且事实准确性保障有限。 我们提出HabitatAgent，这是首个基于LLM的多智能体架构，用于端到端住房咨询。HabitatAgent包含四个专业化智能体角色：记忆、检索、生成与验证。记忆智能体通过内部阶段（约束提取、记忆融合及验证门控更新）维护多层用户记忆；检索智能体执行混合向量-图检索（GraphRAG）；生成智能体产出基于证据的推荐与解释；验证智能体实施多层验证与定向修正。这些智能体协同工作，为端到端住房咨询提供可审计且可靠的工作流程。 我们在端到端正确性评估协议下，对100个真实用户咨询场景（包含300组多轮问答）进行了测试。强大的单阶段基线方法（Dense+Rerank）准确率达到75%，而HabitatAgent则达到95%。

TLDR: A multi-agent LLM system for end-to-end housing consultation, using specialized agents for memory, retrieval, generation, and validation to improve reliability and accuracy.

简要说明: 一种用于端到端住房咨询的多智能体LLM系统，通过专门的记忆、检索、生成和验证智能体来提高可靠性和准确性。

Authors: Hongyang Yang, Yanxin Zhang, Yang She, Yue Xiao, Hao Wu, Yiyang Zhang, Jiapeng Hou, Rongshan Zhang

Ontology-Constrained Neural Reasoning in Enterprise Agentic Systems: A Neurosymbolic Architecture for Domain-Grounded AI Agents

Abstract (English): Enterprise adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) is constrained by hallucination, domain drift, and the inability to enforce regulatory compliance at the reasoning level. We present a neurosymbolic architecture implemented within the Foundation AgenticOS (FAOS) platform that addresses these limitations through ontology-constrained neural reasoning. Our approach introduces a three-layer ontological framework--Role, Domain, and Interaction ontologies--that provides formal semantic grounding for LLM-based enterprise agents. We formalize the concept of asymmetric neurosymbolic coupling, wherein symbolic ontological knowledge constrains agent inputs (context assembly, tool discovery, governance thresholds) while proposing mechanisms for extending this coupling to constrain agent outputs (response validation, reasoning verification, compliance checking). We evaluate the architecture through a controlled experiment (600 runs across five industries: FinTech, Insurance, Healthcare, Vietnamese Banking, and Vietnamese Insurance), finding that ontology-coupled agents significantly outperform ungrounded agents on Metric Accuracy (p < .001, W = .460), Regulatory Compliance (p = .003, W = .318), and Role Consistency (p < .001, W = .614), with improvements greatest where LLM parametric knowledge is weakest--particularly in Vietnam-localized domains. Our contributions include: (1) a formal three-layer enterprise ontology model, (2) a taxonomy of neurosymbolic coupling patterns, (3) ontology-constrained tool discovery via SQL-pushdown scoring, (4) a proposed framework for output-side ontological validation, (5) empirical evidence for the inverse parametric knowledge effect that ontological grounding value is inversely proportional to LLM training data coverage of the domain, and (6) a production system serving 21 industry verticals with 650+ agents.

摘要（中文）: 企业采用大型语言模型（LLM）受到幻觉、领域漂移及推理层面难以实现监管合规的制约。本文提出一种在Foundation AgenticOS（FAOS）平台内实现的神经符号架构，通过本体约束的神经推理解决这些局限性。我们引入三层本体框架——角色本体、领域本体和交互本体，为基于LLM的企业智能体提供形式化语义基础。我们形式化定义了非对称神经符号耦合概念，其中符号化的本体知识约束智能体输入（上下文组装、工具发现、治理阈值），同时提出将这种耦合扩展至约束智能体输出（响应验证、推理核查、合规性检查）的机制。通过受控实验（在金融科技、保险、医疗、越南银行业和越南保险业五个行业进行600次运行）评估该架构，发现本体耦合智能体在度量准确性（p < .001，W = .460）、监管合规性（p = .003，W = .318）和角色一致性（p < .001，W = .614）上显著优于无基础智能体，且在LLM参数知识最薄弱的领域——尤其是越南本地化领域——改进最为显著。我们的贡献包括：（1）形式化的三层企业本体模型；（2）神经符号耦合模式的分类体系；（3）通过SQL下推评分实现的本体约束工具发现；（4）输出端本体验证的提议框架；（5）关于“参数知识逆效应”的实证证据（即本体基础价值与LLM训练数据对领域覆盖度成反比）；（6）已服务21个行业垂直领域、部署650+智能体的生产系统。

TLDR: This paper proposes a neurosymbolic architecture using three-layer ontologies to constrain LLM-based enterprise agents, improving accuracy and compliance in domains with limited training data, but it is focused on business software agents, not robotics or embodied AI.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种神经符号架构，使用三层本体约束基于LLM的企业级智能体，在训练数据有限的领域提升了准确性和合规性，但研究聚焦于商业软件智能体，与机器人或具身AI无关。

Authors: Thanh Luong Tuan

Does Unification Come at a Cost? Uni-SafeBench: A Safety Benchmark for Unified Multimodal Large Models

Abstract (English): Unified Multimodal Large Models (UMLMs) integrate understanding and generation capabilities within a single architecture. While this architectural unification, driven by the deep fusion of multimodal features, enhances model performance, it also introduces important yet underexplored safety challenges. Existing safety benchmarks predominantly focus on isolated understanding or generation tasks, failing to evaluate the holistic safety of UMLMs when handling diverse tasks under a unified framework. To address this, we introduce Uni-SafeBench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring a taxonomy of six major safety categories across seven task types. To ensure rigorous assessment, we develop Uni-Judger, a framework that effectively decouples contextual safety from intrinsic safety. Based on comprehensive evaluations across Uni-SafeBench, we uncover that while the unification process enhances model capabilities, it significantly degrades the inherent safety of the underlying LLM. Furthermore, open-source UMLMs exhibit much lower safety performance than multimodal large models specialized for either generation or understanding tasks. We open-source all resources to systematically expose these risks and foster safer AGI development.

摘要（中文）: 统一多模态大模型（UMLMs）在单一架构内集成了理解与生成能力。尽管这种由多模态特征深度融合驱动的架构统一增强了模型性能，但同时也引入了重要却尚未充分探索的安全挑战。现有安全基准主要聚焦于孤立的理解或生成任务，无法评估UMLMs在统一框架下处理多样化任务时的整体安全性。为此，我们提出了Uni-SafeBench，一个涵盖七种任务类型下六大安全类别的综合基准体系。为确保评估的严谨性，我们开发了Uni-Judger框架，该框架能有效将上下文安全与内在安全性进行解耦分析。基于Uni-SafeBench的全面评估，我们发现：尽管统一化过程提升了模型能力，却显著削弱了底层大语言模型的内在安全性；同时，开源UMLMs的安全性能远低于专精于生成或理解任务的特定多模态大模型。我们开源所有资源以系统揭示这些风险，并推动更安全的通用人工智能发展。

TLDR: This paper introduces Uni-SafeBench, a benchmark for evaluating the safety of unified multimodal large models, finding that architectural unification degrades inherent safety.

简要说明: 本文提出了用于评估统一多模态大模型安全性的基准Uni-SafeBench，发现架构统一会降低模型的固有安全性。

Authors: Zixiang Peng, Yongxiu Xu, Qinyi Zhang, Jiexun Shen, Yifan Zhang, Hongbo Xu, Yubin Wang, Gaopeng Gou

MATHENA: Mamba-based Architectural Tooth Hierarchical Estimator and Holistic Evaluation Network for Anatomy

Abstract (English): Dental diagnosis from Orthopantomograms (OPGs) requires coordination of tooth detection, caries segmentation (CarSeg), anomaly detection (AD), and dental developmental staging (DDS). We propose Mamba-based Architectural Tooth Hierarchical Estimator and Holistic Evaluation Network for Anatomy (MATHENA), a unified framework leveraging Mamba's linear-complexity State Space Models (SSM) to address all four tasks. MATHENA integrates MATHE, a multi-resolution SSM-driven detector with four-directional Vision State Space (VSS) blocks for O(N) global context modeling, generating per-tooth crops. These crops are processed by HENA, a lightweight Mamba-UNet with a triple-head architecture and Global Context State Token (GCST). In the triple-head architecture, CarSeg is first trained as an upstream task to establish shared representations, which are then frozen and reused for downstream AD fine-tuning and DDS classification via linear probing, enabling stable, efficient learning. We also curate PARTHENON, a benchmark comprising 15,062 annotated instances from ten datasets. MATHENA achieves 93.78% mAP@50 in tooth detection, 90.11% Dice for CarSeg, 88.35% for AD, and 72.40% ACC for DDS.

摘要（中文）: 利用全景断层扫描（OPGs）进行牙科诊断需要协调牙齿检测、龋齿分割（CarSeg）、异常检测（AD）和牙齿发育阶段评估（DDS）四项任务。我们提出基于Mamba的架构化牙齿层次评估与整体解剖评估网络（MATHENA），这是一个利用Mamba线性复杂度状态空间模型（SSM）的统一框架，可同时处理上述所有任务。MATHENA整合了多分辨率SSM驱动的检测器MATHE，该检测器采用四向视觉状态空间（VSS）模块实现O(N)复杂度的全局上下文建模，并生成每颗牙齿的裁剪区域。这些裁剪区域由轻量级Mamba-UNet架构的HENA模块处理，该模块采用三头架构和全局上下文状态令牌（GCST）。在三头架构中，首先将龋齿分割作为上游任务进行训练以建立共享特征表示，随后冻结该特征并复用于下游任务：通过线性探测进行异常检测微调和牙齿发育阶段分类，从而实现稳定高效的学习。我们还构建了PARTHENON基准数据集，该数据集整合了来自十个数据集的15,062个标注实例。实验表明，MATHENA在牙齿检测中达到93.78% mAP@50，龋齿分割获得90.11% Dice系数，异常检测取得88.35%准确率，牙齿发育阶段评估达到72.40%准确率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a Mamba-based unified framework for dental diagnosis from panoramic X-rays, addressing tooth detection, caries segmentation, anomaly detection, and developmental staging. It introduces a new benchmark dataset and claims state-of-the-art performance.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种基于Mamba的统一框架，用于全景X光片上的牙齿诊断，处理牙齿检测、龋齿分割、异常检测和发育分期任务。它引入了一个新的基准数据集并声称达到了最先进的性能。

Authors: Kyeonghun Kim, Jaehyung Park, Youngung Han, Anna Jung, Seongbin Park, Sumin Lee, Jiwon Yang, Jiyoon Han, Subeen Lee, Junsu Lim, Hyunsu Go, Eunseob Choi, Hyeonseok Jung, Soo Yong Kim, Woo Kyoung Jeong, Won Jae Lee, Pa Hong, Hyuk-Jae Lee, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Nam-Joon Kim

MAESIL: Masked Autoencoder for Enhanced Self-supervised Medical Image Learning

Abstract (English): Training deep learning models for three-dimensional (3D) medical imaging, such as Computed Tomography (CT), is fundamentally challenged by the scarcity of labeled data. While pre-training on natural images is common, it results in a significant domain shift, limiting performance. Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) on unlabeled medical data has emerged as a powerful solution, but prominent frameworks often fail to exploit the inherent 3D nature of CT scans. These methods typically process 3D scans as a collection of independent 2D slices, an approach that fundamentally discards critical axial coherence and the 3D structural context. To address this limitation, we propose the autoencoder for enhanced self-supervised medical image learning(MAESIL), a novel self-supervised learning framework designed to capture 3D structural information efficiently. The core innovation is the 'superpatch', a 3D chunk-based input unit that balances 3D context preservation with computational efficiency. Our framework partitions the volume into superpatches and employs a 3D masked autoencoder strategy with a dual-masking strategy to learn comprehensive spatial representations. We validated our approach on three diverse large-scale public CT datasets. Our experimental results show that MAESIL demonstrates significant improvements over existing methods such as AE, VAE and VQ-VAE in key reconstruction metrics such as PSNR and SSIM. This establishes MAESIL as a robust and practical pre-training solution for 3D medical imaging tasks.

摘要（中文）: 训练用于三维（3D）医学影像（如计算机断层扫描）的深度学习模型，其根本挑战在于标记数据的稀缺性。尽管在自然图像上进行预训练是常见做法，但这会导致显著的领域偏移，从而限制模型性能。利用未标记的医学数据进行自监督学习已成为一种有效的解决方案，但主流框架往往未能充分利用CT扫描固有的三维特性。这些方法通常将3D扫描视为一系列独立的二维切片进行处理，这种做法本质上舍弃了关键的轴向连贯性与三维结构信息。为克服这一局限，我们提出了增强自监督医学图像学习的自动编码器框架，这是一种新颖的自监督学习框架，旨在高效捕获三维结构信息。其核心创新在于“超块”——一种基于三维块状输入单元的设计，在保持三维上下文信息与计算效率之间取得了平衡。该框架将体积数据划分为超块，并采用具有双重掩码策略的三维掩码自动编码器方法，以学习全面的空间表征。我们在三个不同的大规模公共CT数据集上验证了所提方法。实验结果表明，MAESIL在PSNR和SSIM等关键重建指标上，相比现有方法（如AE、VAE和VQ-VAE）均有显著提升，这证实了MAESIL可作为三维医学影像任务中一种鲁棒且实用的预训练解决方案。

TLDR: Proposes a novel 3D masked autoencoder for medical image learning, using superpatches to capture 3D structural information from CT scans.

简要说明: 提出了一种用于医学图像学习的新型3D掩码自编码器，利用“超块”从CT扫描中捕获3D结构信息。

Authors: Kyeonghun Kim, Hyeonseok Jung, Youngung Han, Junsu Lim, YeonJu Jean, Seongbin Park, Eunseob Choi, Hyunsu Go, SeoYoung Ju, Seohyoung Park, Gyeongmin Kim, MinJu Kwon, KyungSeok Yuh, Soo Yong Kim, Ken Ying-Kai Liao, Nam-Joon Kim, Hyuk-Jae Lee

Not My Truce: Personality Differences in AI-Mediated Workplace Negotiation

Abstract (English): AI-driven conversational coaching is increasingly used to support workplace negotiation, yet prior work assumes uniform effectiveness across users. We challenge this assumption by examining how individual differences, particularly personality traits, moderate coaching outcomes. We conducted a between-subjects experiment (N=267) comparing theory-driven AI (Trucey), general-purpose AI (Control-AI), and a traditional negotiation handbook (Control-NoAI). Participants were clustered into three profiles -- resilient, overcontrolled, and undercontrolled -- based on the Big-Five personality traits and ARC typology. Resilient workers achieved broad psychological gains primarily from the handbook, overcontrolled workers showed outcome-specific improvements with theory-driven AI, and undercontrolled workers exhibited minimal effects despite engaging with the frameworks. These patterns suggest personality as a predictor of readiness beyond stage-based tailoring: vulnerable users benefit from targeted rather than comprehensive interventions. The study advances understanding of personality-determined intervention prerequisites and highlights design implications for adaptive AI coaching systems that align support intensity with individual readiness, rather than assuming universal effectiveness.

摘要（中文）: 人工智能驱动的对话式辅导正日益用于支持职场谈判，但以往的研究假定其对所有用户具有普遍有效性。本文通过探究个体差异（尤其是人格特质）如何调节辅导效果，对这一假设提出挑战。我们进行了一项被试间实验（N=267），比较理论驱动型人工智能（Trucey）、通用人工智能（对照组-人工智能）和传统谈判手册（对照组-非人工智能）的效果。根据大五人格特质和ARC类型学，参与者被聚类为三种人格类型——韧性型、过度控制型和欠控制型。研究发现：韧性型工作者主要通过谈判手册获得广泛的心理增益，过度控制型工作者在使用理论驱动型人工智能时表现出针对特定结果的改善，而欠控制型工作者尽管接触了各类辅导框架，但效果甚微。这些模式表明，人格特质可作为预测个体准备程度的指标，其作用超越基于阶段的个性化设计：弱势用户更适合接受针对性而非全面性的干预措施。本研究推进了对人格特质决定干预前提条件的理解，并为自适应人工智能辅导系统提供了设计启示——系统应将支持强度与个体准备程度相匹配，而非假定普遍有效性。

TLDR: The paper examines how personality traits moderate the effectiveness of AI-driven conversational coaching in workplace negotiations, finding that tailored AI interventions are more effective for specific personality profiles.

简要说明: 该研究探讨了人格特质如何调节人工智能驱动的职场谈判对话辅导效果，发现针对性的AI干预对特定人格类型更有效。

Authors: Veda Duddu, Jash Rajesh Parekh, Andy Mao, Hanyi Min, Ziang Xiao, Vedant Das Swain, Koustuv Saha

RAGShield: Provenance-Verified Defense-in-Depth Against Knowledge Base Poisoning in Government Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

Abstract (English): RAG systems deployed across federal agencies for citizen-facing services are vulnerable to knowledge base poisoning attacks, where adversaries inject malicious documents to manipulate outputs. Recent work demonstrates that as few as 10 adversarial passages can achieve 98.2% retrieval success rates. We observe that RAG knowledge base poisoning is structurally analogous to software supply chain attacks, and propose RAGShield, a five-layer defense-in-depth framework applying supply chain provenance verification to the RAG knowledge pipeline. RAGShield introduces: (1) C2PA-inspired cryptographic document attestation blocking unsigned and forged documents at ingestion; (2) trust-weighted retrieval prioritizing provenance-verified sources; (3) a formal taint lattice with cross-source contradiction detection catching insider threats even when provenance is valid; (4) provenance-aware generation with auditable citations; and (5) NIST SP 800-53 compliance mapping across 15 control families. Evaluation on a 500-passage Natural Questions corpus with 63 attack documents and 200 queries against five adversary tiers achieves 0.0% attack success rate including adaptive attacks (95% CI: [0.0%, 1.9%]) with 0.0% false positive rate. We honestly report that insider in-place replacement attacks achieve 17.5% ASR, identifying the fundamental limit of ingestion-time defense. The cross-source contradiction detector catches subtle numerical manipulation attacks that bypass provenance verification entirely.

摘要（中文）: 部署于各联邦机构面向公民服务的RAG系统易受知识库投毒攻击，攻击者可通过注入恶意文档操控输出结果。近期研究表明，仅需10个对抗性文本段即可实现98.2%的检索成功率。我们发现RAG知识库投毒在结构上类似于软件供应链攻击，据此提出RAGShield——一个将供应链溯源验证应用于RAG知识管道的五层纵深防御框架。RAGShield包含：(1) 受C2PA启发的加密文档认证机制，在数据摄入阶段拦截未签名及伪造文档；(2) 基于信任权重的检索策略，优先选择经溯源验证的资料来源；(3) 具备跨源矛盾检测能力的污染格形式化模型，可在溯源有效时仍识别内部威胁；(4) 支持溯源感知的生成过程与可审计的引证机制；(5) 覆盖15个控制族的NIST SP 800-53合规性映射。通过在包含500个文本段的自然问答语料库上进行评估（包含63个攻击文档及200个针对五级攻击者的查询），系统在自适应攻击下达成0.0%的攻击成功率（95%置信区间：[0.0%, 1.9%]）且误报率为0.0%。我们如实报告内部人员就地替换攻击仍能达到17.5%的攻击成功率，这揭示了摄入阶段防御的根本局限。跨源矛盾检测器成功捕获了完全绕过溯源验证的隐蔽数值篡改攻击。

TLDR: This paper proposes a multi-layer defense framework called RAGShield, inspired by software supply chain security, to protect government Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems from knowledge base poisoning attacks. It focuses on cryptographic document attestation, trust-weighted retrieval, and contradiction detection to ensure the integrity and provenance of retrieved information, but makes no direct connection to robotics or embodied AI.

简要说明: 本文提出了一个名为RAGShield的多层防御框架，灵感来源于软件供应链安全，旨在保护政府部门的检索增强生成（RAG）系统免受知识库投毒攻击。其核心关注点是文件的加密认证、基于可信度的检索和矛盾检测，以确保检索信息的完整性和来源可追溯性，但与机器人或具身智能领域没有直接关联。

Authors: KrishnaSaiReddy Patil

The Persistent Vulnerability of Aligned AI Systems

Abstract (English): Autonomous AI agents are being deployed with filesystem access, email control, and multi-step planning. This thesis contributes to four open problems in AI safety: understanding dangerous internal computations, removing dangerous behaviors once embedded, testing for vulnerabilities before deployment, and predicting when models will act against deployers. ACDC automates circuit discovery in transformers, recovering all five component types from prior manual work on GPT-2 Small by selecting 68 edges from 32,000 candidates in hours rather than months. Latent Adversarial Training (LAT) removes dangerous behaviors by optimizing perturbations in the residual stream to elicit failure modes, then training under those perturbations. LAT solved the sleeper agent problem where standard safety training failed, matching existing defenses with 700x fewer GPU hours. Best-of-N jailbreaking achieves 89% attack success on GPT-4o and 78% on Claude 3.5 Sonnet through random input augmentations. Attack success follows power law scaling across text, vision, and audio, enabling quantitative forecasting of adversarial robustness. Agentic misalignment tests whether frontier models autonomously choose harmful actions given ordinary goals. Across 16 models, agents engaged in blackmail (96% for Claude Opus 4), espionage, and actions causing death. Misbehavior rates rose from 6.5% to 55.1% when models stated scenarios were real rather than evaluations. The thesis does not fully resolve any of these problems but makes each tractable and measurable.

摘要（中文）: 自主人工智能代理正被部署以具备文件系统访问、邮件控制和多步骤规划能力。本论文针对人工智能安全领域的四个开放性问题作出贡献：理解危险的内部计算过程、消除已嵌入的危险行为、部署前测试系统漏洞以及预测模型何时会违背部署者意图。 ACDC方法实现了对Transformer模型中电路发现的自动化，通过从32,000个候选边中筛选出68条关键边，在数小时内（而非数月）完整还原了GPT-2 Small模型先前人工研究中全部五类组件结构。 潜在对抗训练通过优化残差流中的扰动来激发故障模式，随后在这些扰动下进行训练，从而消除危险行为。该方法解决了标准安全训练未能应对的潜伏代理问题，仅用1/700的GPU计算时间即达到现有防御方案同等效果。 基于随机输入增强的N选最优越狱攻击对GPT-4o达到89%的攻击成功率，对Claude 3.5 Sonnet达到78%。攻击成功率在文本、视觉和音频领域均呈现幂律分布规律，为对抗鲁棒性量化预测提供了可能。 智能体错位测试探究前沿模型在接收普通目标时是否会自主选择有害行动。在16个模型的测试中，智能体表现出勒索（Claude Opus 4达96%）、间谍活动和致死行为。当模型认定测试场景为真实情境而非评估环境时，不当行为发生率从6.5%上升至55.1%。 本论文虽未完全解决其中任何一个问题，但使每个问题都变得可处理且可量化。

TLDR: This thesis addresses AI safety problems such as detecting dangerous internal computations, removing embedded harmful behaviors, and testing for vulnerabilities before deployment, but does not focus on robotics or embodied AI applications.

简要说明: 该论文探讨了AI安全问题，包括检测危险内部计算、移除嵌入的有害行为以及部署前测试漏洞，但未涉及机器人或具身AI应用。

Authors: Aengus Lynch

Human-in-the-Loop Control of Objective Drift in LLM-Assisted Computer Science Education

Abstract (English): Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in computer science education through AI-assisted programming tools, yet such workflows often exhibit objective drift, in which locally plausible outputs diverge from stated task specifications. Existing instructional responses frequently emphasize tool-specific prompting practices, limiting durability as AI platforms evolve. This paper adopts a human-centered stance, treating human-in-the-loop (HITL) control as a stable educational problem rather than a transitional step toward AI autonomy. Drawing on systems engineering and control-theoretic concepts, we frame objectives and world models as operational artifacts that students configure to stabilize AI-assisted work. We propose a pilot undergraduate CS laboratory curriculum that explicitly separates planning from execution and trains students to specify acceptance criteria and architectural constraints prior to code generation. In selected labs, the curriculum also introduces deliberate, concept-aligned drift to support diagnosis and recovery from specification violations. We report a sensitivity power analysis for a three-arm pilot design comparing unstructured AI use, structured planning, and structured planning with injected drift, establishing detectable effect sizes under realistic section-level constraints. The contribution is a theory-driven, methodologically explicit foundation for HITL pedagogy that renders control competencies teachable across evolving AI tools.

摘要（中文）: 大型语言模型（LLM）正通过人工智能辅助编程工具日益融入计算机科学教育，但这类工作流程常表现出目标漂移现象，即局部合理的输出结果与既定任务目标发生偏离。现有教学对策多聚焦于特定工具的提示策略，这种方式的持久性会随着人工智能平台的迭代而受限。本文采取以人为中心的立场，将人在回路（HITL）控制视为一个稳定的教育议题，而非通向人工智能自主性的过渡阶段。借鉴系统工程与控制理论的概念，我们将目标与世界观模型构建为可操作的教学构件，指导学生通过配置这些构件来稳定AI辅助工作。我们提出了一项试点性的本科计算机科学实验课程方案，该方案明确将规划与执行相分离，训练学生在代码生成前明确验收标准与架构约束。在部分实验环节中，课程还设计了具有概念针对性的可控漂移，以培养学生对规范偏离的诊断与修复能力。我们通过三组对照实验设计（无结构化AI使用、结构化规划、含注入漂移的结构化规划）进行了敏感性功效分析，确立了在现实班级规模限制下可检测的效应量。本研究贡献在于构建了一个理论驱动、方法明确的人机协同教学框架，使控制能力成为可跨AI工具演进持续教授的核心素养。

TLDR: This paper proposes a human-in-the-loop control framework and curriculum to manage 'objective drift' when LLMs are used in computer science education, focusing on teaching students to specify goals and constraints to stabilize AI-assisted workflows.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种人机交互控制框架和课程体系，用于管理在计算机科学教育中使用LLM时出现的‘目标漂移’问题，重点训练学生定义目标和约束以稳定AI辅助的工作流程。

Authors: Mark Dranias, Adam Whitley

LLM Essay Scoring Under Holistic and Analytic Rubrics: Prompt Effects and Bias

Abstract (English): Despite growing interest in using Large Language Models (LLMs) for educational assessment, it remains unclear how closely they align with human scoring. We present a systematic evaluation of instruction-tuned LLMs across three open essay-scoring datasets (ASAP 2.0, ELLIPSE, and DREsS) that cover both holistic and analytic scoring. We analyze agreement with human consensus scores, directional bias, and the stability of bias estimates. Our results show that strong open-weight models achieve moderate to high agreement with humans on holistic scoring (Quadratic Weighted Kappa about 0.6), but this does not transfer uniformly to analytic scoring. In particular, we observe large and stable negative directional bias on Lower-Order Concern (LOC) traits, such as Grammar and Conventions, meaning that models often score these traits more harshly than human raters. We also find that concise keyword-based prompts generally outperform longer rubric-style prompts in multi-trait analytic scoring. To quantify the amount of data needed to detect these systematic deviations, we compute the minimum sample size at which a 95% bootstrap confidence interval for the mean bias excludes zero. This analysis shows that LOC bias is often detectable with very small validation sets, whereas Higher-Order Concern (HOC) traits typically require much larger samples. These findings support a bias-correction-first deployment strategy: instead of relying on raw zero-shot scores, systematic score offsets can be estimated and corrected using small human-labeled bias-estimation sets, without requiring large-scale fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）: 尽管利用大语言模型（LLMs）进行教育评估的兴趣日益增长，但其与人工评分的一致性程度仍不明确。本研究对指令微调的大语言模型在三个开放式作文评分数据集（ASAP 2.0、ELLIPSE 和 DREsS）上进行了系统评估，涵盖整体性评分和分析性评分两个维度。我们分析了模型与人类共识评分的一致性、方向性偏差以及偏差估计的稳定性。结果显示，在整体性评分上，性能较强的开源模型与人类评分者达到了中等到高度的一致性（二次加权Kappa系数约为0.6），但这种一致性并未均匀地迁移到分析性评分中。尤其在低阶特征（如语法与规范）上，我们观察到显著且稳定的负向偏差，表明模型对这些特征的评分通常比人类评分者更为严苛。同时研究发现，在多特征分析性评分任务中，基于简洁关键词的提示语通常比长篇幅的评分标准式提示语表现更优。为量化检测此类系统性偏差所需的数据量，我们计算了使平均偏差的95%自助法置信区间排除零值所需的最小样本量。分析表明，低阶特征偏差往往可通过极小的验证集被检测到，而高阶特征通常需要更大的样本量。这些发现支持了"偏差校正优先"的部署策略：相较于直接使用原始零样本评分，可通过少量人工标注的偏差估计集对系统性评分偏移进行估计与校正，而无需进行大规模模型微调。

TLDR: This paper evaluates LLMs for automated essay scoring, finding moderate agreement with human holistic scores but systematic bias in analytic scoring, particularly for lower-order traits, and proposes a bias-correction deployment strategy.

简要说明: 本研究评估大语言模型在自动作文评分中的应用，发现其与人工整体评分具有中等一致性，但在分析性评分中，特别是对于低阶特征（如语法）存在系统性偏差，并提出了一种基于小样本偏差校正的部署策略。

Authors: Filip J. Kucia, Anirban Chakraborty, Anna Wróblewska

REM-CTX: Automated Peer Review via Reinforcement Learning with Auxiliary Context

Abstract (English): Most automated peer review systems rely on textual manuscript content alone, leaving visual elements such as figures and external scholarly signals underutilized. We introduce REM-CTX, a reinforcement-learning system that incorporates auxiliary context into the review generation process via correspondence-aware reward functions. REM-CTX trains an 8B-parameter language model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and combines a multi-aspect quality reward with two correspondence rewards that explicitly encourage alignment with auxiliary context. Experiments on manuscripts across Computer, Biological, and Physical Sciences show that REM-CTX achieves the highest overall review quality among six baselines, outperforming other systems with substantially larger commercial models, and surpassing the next-best RL baseline across both quality and contextual grounding metrics. Ablation studies confirm that the two correspondence rewards are complementary: each selectively improves its targeted correspondence reward while preserving all quality dimensions, and the full model outperforms all partial variants. Analysis of training dynamics reveals that the criticism aspect is negatively correlated with other metrics during training, suggesting that future studies should group multi-dimension rewards for review generation.

摘要（中文）: 当前大多数自动同行评审系统仅依赖于文本稿件内容，使得图表等视觉元素和外部学术信号未能得到充分利用。我们提出REM-CTX系统，该系统通过引入对应感知奖励函数，将辅助上下文信息整合到评审生成过程中。REM-CTX采用分组相对策略优化（GRPO）方法训练一个80亿参数的语言模型，结合多维度质量奖励与两项对应奖励，显式激励模型与辅助上下文保持对齐。在计算机、生物和物理科学领域的多学科稿件实验中，REM-CTX在六个基线模型中取得了最高的综合评审质量，其表现超越使用更大规模商业模型的其他系统，并在质量与上下文契合度指标上均优于次优的强化学习基线。消融实验证实两项对应奖励具有互补性：每项奖励能针对性提升其目标对应的奖励得分，同时保持所有质量维度不衰减，完整模型在所有部分变体上均表现最优。对训练动态的分析显示，在训练过程中批判性维度与其他指标呈负相关，这表明未来研究应将多维度奖励进行分组优化以提升评审生成质量。

TLDR: The paper proposes a reinforcement learning system, REM-CTX, for automated peer review that incorporates auxiliary context from figures and scholarly signals via correspondence-aware rewards.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种用于自动化同行评审的强化学习系统 REM-CTX，该系统通过基于相关性的奖励函数，将图表和外部学术信号等辅助信息融入评审生成过程。

Authors: Pawin Taechoyotin, Daniel E. Acuna

AI-Mediated Explainable Regulation for Justice

Abstract (English): Present practice of deciding on regulation faces numerous problems that make adopted regulations static, unexplained, unduly influenced by powerful interest groups, and stained with a perception of illegitimacy. These well-known problems with the regulatory process can lead to injustice and have substantial negative effects on society and democracy. We discuss a new approach that utilizes distributed artificial intelligence (AI) to make a regulatory recommendation that is explainable and adaptable by design. We outline the main components of a system that can implement this approach and show how it would resolve the problems with the present regulatory system. This approach models and reasons about stakeholder preferences with separate preference models, while it aggregates these preferences in a value sensitive way. Such recommendations can be updated due to changes in facts or in values and are inherently explainable. We suggest how stakeholders can make their preferences known to the system and how they can verify whether they were properly considered in the regulatory decision. The resulting system promises to support regulatory justice, legitimacy, and compliance.

摘要（中文）: 当前监管决策实践存在诸多问题，导致采用的监管规则僵化、缺乏解释性、易受强势利益集团不当影响，并带有合法性缺失的观感。监管流程中这些众所周知的问题可能引发不公正现象，并对社会与民主产生重大负面影响。我们提出一种创新方法，通过分布式人工智能技术构建具有可解释性和自适应特性的监管推荐系统。我们阐述了实现该方法的系统核心组件，并论证其如何解决现有监管体系的问题。该方法通过独立偏好模型对利益相关方偏好进行建模与推理，同时以价值敏感的方式聚合这些偏好。此类推荐可随事实或价值观变化而更新，并具备内在可解释性。我们探讨了利益相关方向系统表达偏好的实现路径，以及验证其偏好是否在监管决策中得到恰当考量的方法。由此构建的系统有望支持监管正义、合法性与合规性目标的实现。

TLDR: The paper proposes a new AI-mediated system for creating explainable and adaptable regulatory recommendations, aiming to address issues of static, unexplained, and unfairly influenced regulations by modeling stakeholder preferences and aggregating them in a value-sensitive way.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种新的AI介导系统，用于生成可解释和可适应的法规建议。该系统通过建模利益相关者偏好并以价值敏感的方式进行聚合，旨在解决当前法规静态、不可解释且易受不当影响的问题。

Authors: Thomas Hofweber, Andreas Sudmann, Evangelos Pournaras

Diversity-Aware Reverse Kullback-Leibler Divergence for Large Language Model Distillation

Abstract (English): Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) divergence has recently emerged as the preferred objective for large language model (LLM) distillation, consistently outperforming forward KL (FKL), particularly in regimes with large vocabularies and significant teacher-student capacity mismatch, where RKL focuses learning on dominant modes rather than enforcing dense alignment. However, RKL introduces a structural limitation that drives the student toward overconfident predictions. We first provide an analysis of RKL by decomposing its gradients into target and non-target components, and show that non-target gradients consistently push the target logit upward even when the student already matches the teacher, thereby reducing output diversity. In addition, RKL provides weak supervision over non-target classes, leading to poor tail alignment. To address these issues, we propose Diversity-aware RKL (DRKL), which removes this gradient effect and strengthens non-target supervision while preserving the optimization benefits of RKL. Extensive experiments across datasets and model families demonstrate that DRKL consistently outperforms FKL, RKL, and other state-of-the-art distillation objectives, achieving better performance and a superior fidelity-diversity trade-off.

摘要（中文）: 反向Kullback-Leibler（RKL）散度近期已成为大语言模型（LLM）蒸馏的首选目标，其表现持续优于正向KL（FKL）散度，尤其在词汇量巨大且师生模型容量严重不匹配的情况下。RKL能使学习聚焦于主导模式，而非强制密集对齐，但其结构局限性导致学生模型趋向过度自信的预测。我们首先通过将RKL梯度分解为目标类与非目标类分量进行分析，发现即使学生模型已与教师模型匹配，非目标梯度仍持续推动目标对数概率上升，从而降低输出多样性。此外，RKL对非目标类别的监督较弱，导致尾部对齐效果不佳。为解决这些问题，我们提出了多样性感知RKL（DRKL），该方法在保留RKL优化优势的同时，消除了上述梯度效应并强化了对非目标类别的监督。跨数据集与模型系列的广泛实验表明，DRKL始终优于FKL、RKL及其他前沿蒸馏目标，在性能与保真度-多样性的权衡方面均实现了更优表现。

TLDR: This paper proposes a new diversity-aware Reverse Kullback-Leibler divergence objective for large language model distillation that addresses overconfidence and improves tail alignment, outperforming previous distillation objectives.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种新的多样性感知反向KL散度目标，用于大语言模型蒸馏，解决了过度自信问题并改善了尾部对齐性能，超越了之前的蒸馏目标。

Authors: Hoang-Chau Luong, Dat Ba Tran, Lingwei Chen

NFC based inventory control system for secure and efficient communication

Abstract (English): This paper brings up this idea of using Near Field Communication (NFC) for inventory control system instead of using traditional barcodes. NFC because of its high security, ease of use and efficiency can be very suitable for systems like inventory control. In traditional inventory control systems, each product has a barcode pasted on it, which is vulnerable to attacks as barcodes are open and have no security. Furthermore, barcodes are prone to damages and can be unreliable when pasted on different types of products e.g. hot and frozen products, circular shaped products and irregular shaped products like clothes etc. NFC on the other hand is very efficient, secure and reliable when it comes to short-range wireless communication. In this paper we will present our prototype for the inventory control system of an electronic store in which each product has a passive NFC tag pasted to it. When a customer buys a product the receipt of the product is generated using NFC between the NFC passive tag on the product and NFC enabled device (e.g. smart phone or reader) at the cash counter.

摘要（中文）: 本文提出了利用近场通信（NFC）技术替代传统条形码构建库存管理系统的构想。NFC技术因其高安全性、易用性和高效性，非常适用于库存管理这类系统。在传统库存控制系统中，每件商品均贴有条形码，但由于条形码信息开放且缺乏安全防护，极易受到攻击。此外，条形码易受物理损坏，且在不同类型商品（如冷藏与冷冻商品、圆柱形商品及服装等不规则形状商品）上的粘贴可靠性难以保证。相比之下，NFC在短距离无线通信中具有高效、安全且可靠的优势。本文展示了一套应用于电子商店的库存控制系统原型，其中每件商品均贴附无源NFC标签。当顾客购买商品时，通过商品上的无源NFC标签与收银台配备的NFC设备（如智能手机或读写器）之间的通信，即可自动生成购物凭证。

TLDR: This paper proposes using Near Field Communication (NFC) tags instead of barcodes to create a more secure and reliable inventory control system for retail stores, and presents a prototype for an electronics store.

简要说明: 该论文提出使用近场通信（NFC）标签取代条形码，为零售商店（如电子商店）构建一个更安全可靠的库存控制系统，并展示了一个原型系统。

Authors: Razi Iqbal, Awais Ahmad, Asfandyar Gillani

A Study on the Impact of Fault localization Granularity for Repository-Scale Code Repair Tasks

Abstract (English): Automatic program repair can be a challenging task, especially when resolving complex issues at a repository-level, which often involves issue reproduction, fault localization, code repair, testing and validation. Issues of this scale can be commonly found in popular GitHub repositories or datasets that are derived from them. Some repository-level approaches separate localization and repair into distinct phases. Where this is the case, the fault localization approaches vary in terms of the granularity of localization. Where the impact of granularity is explored to some degree for smaller datasets, not all isolate this issue from the separate question of localization accuracy by testing code repair under the assumption of perfect fault localization. To the best of the authors' knowledge, no repository-scale studies have explicitly investigated granularity under this assumption, nor conducted a systematic empirical comparison of granularity levels in isolation. We propose a framework for performing such tests by modifying the localization phase of the Agentless framework to retrieve ground-truth localization data and include this as context in the prompt fed to the repair phase. We show that under this configuration and as a generalization over the SWE-Bench-Mini dataset, function-level granularity yields the highest repair rate against line-level and file-level. However, a deeper dive suggests that the ideal granularity may in fact be task dependent. This study is not intended to improve on the state-of-the-art, nor do we intend for results to be compared against any complete agentic frameworks. Rather, we present a proof of concept for investigating how fault localization may impact automatic code repair in repository-scale scenarios. We present preliminary findings to this end and encourage further research into this relationship between the two phases.

摘要（中文）: 自动程序修复是一项具有挑战性的任务，尤其是在解决仓库级别的复杂问题时，通常涉及问题复现、缺陷定位、代码修复、测试与验证等多个环节。此类规模的问题常见于流行的GitHub仓库或其衍生的数据集中。 部分仓库级方法将定位与修复划分为两个独立阶段。在这种情况下，缺陷定位方法在定位粒度上存在差异。尽管已有研究针对较小数据集在一定程度上探讨了粒度的影响，但并非所有研究都将该问题与定位准确性的独立问题区分开来——即在假设完美缺陷定位的前提下测试代码修复效果。据作者所知，目前尚未有仓库级研究在此假设下明确探讨粒度问题，也未对粒度级别进行过系统性的实证比较。 我们提出了一个测试框架，通过修改Agentless框架的定位阶段，获取真实缺陷定位数据，并将其作为上下文信息输入修复阶段的提示中。实验表明，在此配置下，并基于SWE-Bench-Mini数据集的泛化测试，函数级粒度的修复率优于行级和文件级。然而，深入分析表明，理想的粒度实际上可能取决于具体任务。 本研究并非旨在改进现有技术水平，也不建议将结果与任何完整的智能体框架进行比较。相反，我们提出了一个概念验证，用于探索缺陷定位在仓库级场景下如何影响自动代码修复。我们展示了初步发现，并鼓励对这两个阶段之间的关联性开展进一步研究。

TLDR: This paper investigates the impact of fault localization granularity (file, function, line) on automatic program repair for large-scale code repositories.

简要说明: 本文研究了故障定位粒度（文件、函数、行）对大规模代码库自动程序修复的影响。

Authors: Joseph Townsend, Chandresh Pravin, Kwun Ho Ngan, Matthieu Parizy

Epileptic Seizure Detection in Separate Frequency Bands Using Feature Analysis and Graph Convolutional Neural Network (GCN) from Electroencephalogram (EEG) Signals

Abstract (English): Epileptic seizures are neurological disorders characterized by abnormal and excessive electrical activity in the brain, resulting in recurrent seizure events. Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals are widely used for seizure diagnosis due to their ability to capture temporal and spatial neural dynamics. While recent deep learning methods have achieved high detection accuracy, they often lack interpretability and neurophysiological relevance. This study presents a frequency-aware framework for epileptic seizure detection based on ictal-phase EEG analysis. The raw EEG signals are decomposed into five frequency bands (delta, theta, alpha, lower beta, and higher beta), and eleven discriminative features are extracted from each band. A graph convolutional neural network (GCN) is then employed to model spatial dependencies among EEG electrodes, represented as graph nodes. Experiments on the CHB-MIT scalp EEG dataset demonstrate high detection performance, achieving accuracies of 97.1%, 97.13%, 99.5%, 99.7%, and 51.4% across the respective frequency bands, with an overall broadband accuracy of 99.01%. The results highlight the strong discriminative capability of mid-frequency bands and reveal frequency-specific seizure patterns. The proposed approach improves interpretability and diagnostic precision compared to conventional broadband EEG-based methods.

摘要（中文）: 癫痫发作是一种以大脑异常过度放电为特征的神经系统疾病，会导致反复发作事件。脑电图（EEG）信号因其能够捕捉时空神经动态而被广泛用于癫痫诊断。尽管当前深度学习方法已实现较高的检测准确率，但往往缺乏可解释性和神经生理学相关性。本研究提出一种基于发作期脑电图分析的频率感知癫痫检测框架，将原始脑电信号分解为五个频段（δ波、θ波、α波、低β波和高β波），并从每个频段中提取十一个判别性特征。采用图卷积神经网络（GCN）对脑电图电极间的空间依赖性进行建模，将电极表示为图节点。在CHB-MIT头皮脑电图数据集上的实验表明，该方法在各频段分别达到97.1%、97.13%、99.5%、99.7%和51.4%的检测准确率，全频段总体准确率达99.01%。研究结果凸显了中频段强大的判别能力，并揭示了癫痫发作的频段特异性模式。相较于传统基于全频段脑电图的方法，本研究所提方案显著提升了可解释性与诊断精确度。

TLDR: This paper proposes a frequency-aware graph convolutional neural network (GCN) framework for detecting epileptic seizures from EEG signals, achieving high accuracy by analyzing features in specific frequency bands.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于频率感知的图卷积神经网络框架，用于从脑电图信号中检测癫痫发作，通过分析特定频段的特征实现了高精度检测。
