Authors: Yaoming Yang, Shuai Wang, Bingdong Li, Peng Yang, Ke Tang

The Rashomon Effect for Visualizing High-Dimensional Data

Abstract (English): Dimension reduction (DR) is inherently non-unique: multiple embeddings can preserve the structure of high-dimensional data equally well while differing in layout or geometry. In this paper, we formally define the Rashomon set for DR -- the collection of `good' embedding -- and show how embracing this multiplicity leads to more powerful and trustworthy representations. Specifically, we pursue three goals. First, we introduce PCA-informed alignment to steer embeddings toward principal components, making axes interpretable without distorting local neighborhoods. Second, we design concept-alignment regularization that aligns an embedding dimension with external knowledge, such as class labels or user-defined concepts. Third, we propose a method to extract common knowledge across the Rashomon set by identifying trustworthy and persistent nearest-neighbor relationships, which we use to construct refined embeddings with improved local structure while preserving global relationships. By moving beyond a single embedding and leveraging the Rashomon set, we provide a flexible framework for building interpretable, robust, and goal-aligned visualizations.

摘要（中文）: 降维本质上并不唯一：多种嵌入方式可以在保持高维数据结构的同时，在布局或几何形态上呈现差异。本文正式定义了降维的"拉什蒙集合"——即"优质"嵌入的集合，并展示了如何通过接纳这种多样性来获得更强大且可信的表征。具体而言，我们追求三个目标。首先，引入基于主成分分析的定向对齐方法，使嵌入空间向主成分方向靠拢，在不扭曲局部邻域的前提下实现坐标轴的可解释性。其次，设计概念对齐正则化机制，将嵌入维度与外部知识（如类别标签或用户定义概念）进行对齐。第三，提出一种从拉什蒙集合中提取共性知识的方法，通过识别可信且稳定的最近邻关系，构建出既能改善局部结构又能保持全局关系的优化嵌入。通过超越单一嵌入并充分利用拉什蒙集合，我们为构建可解释、鲁棒且目标对齐的可视化提供了灵活框架。

TLDR: This paper introduces a framework for visualizing high-dimensional data by defining and analyzing the Rashomon set of multiple 'good' embeddings, offering methods to steer embeddings for interpretability, align with external concepts, and identify trustworthy structures.

简要说明: 本文介绍了一个用于可视化高维数据的框架，通过定义和分析多组“好”的嵌入的Rashomon集合，提供了引导嵌入以提高可解释性、与外部概念对齐以及识别可信结构的方法。

Authors: Yiyang Sun, Haiyang Huang, Gaurav Rajesh Parikh, Cynthia Rudin

Denoising distances beyond the volumetric barrier

Abstract (English): We study the problem of reconstructing the latent geometry of a $d$-dimensional Riemannian manifold from a random geometric graph. While recent works have made significant progress in manifold recovery from random geometric graphs, and more generally from noisy distances, the precision of pairwise distance estimation has been fundamentally constrained by the volumetric barrier, namely the natural sample-spacing scale $n^{-1/d}$ coming from the fact that a generic point of the manifold typically lies at distance of order $n^{-1/d}$ from the nearest sampled point. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach, Orthogonal Ring Distance Estimation Routine (ORDER), which achieves a pointwise distance estimation precision of order $n^{-2/(d+5)}$ up to polylogarithmic factors in $n$ in polynomial time. This strictly beats the volumetric barrier for dimensions $d > 5$. As a consequence of obtaining pointwise precision better than $n^{-1/d}$, we prove that the Gromov--Wasserstein distance between the reconstructed metric measure space and the true latent manifold is of order $n^{-1/d}$. This matches the Wasserstein convergence rate of empirical measures, demonstrating that our reconstructed graph metric is asymptotically as good as having access to the full pairwise distance matrix of the sampled points. Our results are proven in a very general setting which includes general models of noisy pairwise distances, sparse random geometric graphs, and unknown connection probability functions.

摘要（中文）: 本文研究从随机几何图重构$d$维黎曼流形潜在几何结构的问题。虽然近期研究在从随机几何图（更广义而言是从含噪距离）恢复流形方面取得显著进展，但成对距离估计的精度一直受到体积障碍的根本性限制——即由流形上一般点与其最近采样点之间距离量级$n^{-1/d}$所决定的自然样本间距尺度。我们提出一种创新方法：正交环距离估计算法（ORDER），该方法能在多项式时间内实现量级为$n^{-2/(d+5)}$（含$n$的多对数因子）的逐点距离估计精度。这一结果在维度$d > 5$时严格突破了体积障碍的限制。 由于获得了优于$n^{-1/d}$的逐点估计精度，我们证明了重构度量测度空间与真实潜在流形之间的格罗莫夫-瓦瑟斯坦距离量级为$n^{-1/d}$。该结果与经验测度的瓦瑟斯坦收敛速率相匹配，表明我们重构的图度量渐近等价于掌握了采样点间完整的成对距离矩阵。我们的证明建立在一个非常普适的框架中，涵盖含噪成对距离的一般模型、稀疏随机几何图以及未知连接概率函数等多种情形。

TLDR: The paper introduces a new method called ORDER for reconstructing a Riemannian manifold from noisy distance data, achieving theoretical precision that surpasses the previously fundamental volumetric barrier for dimensions d>5, which improves the convergence rate of the reconstructed metric measure space.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种名为ORDER的新方法，用于从有噪距离数据中重建黎曼流形，其理论精度超过了之前基本容积障碍的限制（对于维度d>5），从而改善了重建度量测度空间的收敛速度。

Authors: Han Huang, Pakawut Jiradilok, Elchanan Mossel

MambaVoiceCloning: Efficient and Expressive Text-to-Speech via State-Space Modeling and Diffusion Control

Abstract (English): MambaVoiceCloning (MVC) asks whether the conditioning path of diffusion-based TTS can be made fully SSM-only at inference, removing all attention and explicit RNN-style recurrence layers across text, rhythm, and prosody, while preserving or improving quality under controlled conditions. MVC combines a gated bidirectional Mamba text encoder, a Temporal Bi-Mamba supervised by a lightweight alignment teacher discarded after training, and an Expressive Mamba with AdaLN modulation, yielding linear-time O(T) conditioning with bounded activation memory and practical finite look-ahead streaming. Unlike prior Mamba-TTS systems that remain hybrid at inference, MVC removes attention-based duration and style modules under a fixed StyleTTS2 mel-diffusion-vocoder backbone. Trained on LJSpeech/LibriTTS and evaluated on VCTK, CSS10 (ES/DE/FR), and long-form Gutenberg passages, MVC achieves modest but statistically reliable gains over StyleTTS2, VITS, and Mamba-attention hybrids in MOS/CMOS, F0 RMSE, MCD, and WER, while reducing encoder parameters to 21M and improving throughput by 1.6x. Diffusion remains the dominant latency source, but SSM-only conditioning improves memory footprint, stability, and deployability.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： MambaVoiceCloning (MVC) 探究了基于扩散的文本转语音系统中，条件路径在推理时能否完全仅由状态空间模型构成，即在文本、节奏和韵律处理中去除所有注意力机制和显式的RNN式循环层，同时在受控条件下保持或提升语音质量。MVC融合了门控双向Mamba文本编码器、一个由轻量对齐教师在训练后丢弃所监督的时序双向Mamba模块，以及采用AdaLN调制的表达性Mamba模块，实现了线性时间复杂度O(T)的条件处理，具有有限激活内存占用和实用的有限前瞻流式能力。与此前推理阶段仍保持混合架构的Mamba-TTS系统不同，MVC在固定StyleTTS2梅尔谱扩散声码器主干框架下，移除了基于注意力的时长与风格模块。通过在LJSpeech/LibriTTS数据集上训练，并在VCTK、CSS10（西班牙语/德语/法语）及长篇Gutenberg段落上进行评估，MVC在MOS/CMOS、基频均方根误差、梅尔倒谱失真和词错误率等指标上，相比StyleTTS2、VITS及Mamba-注意力混合系统取得了有限但统计显著的提升，同时将编码器参数量降至2100万，吞吐量提升1.6倍。扩散过程仍是延迟的主要来源，但纯SSM条件路径显著改善了内存占用、系统稳定性和部署可行性。

TLDR: The paper proposes a text-to-speech model using state-space models and diffusion control, aiming for efficient and expressive speech synthesis, but it is not directly related to robotics or embodied AI.

简要说明: 该论文提出了一种使用状态空间模型和扩散控制的文本转语音模型，旨在实现高效和富有表现力的语音合成，但与机器人学或具身AI无直接关联。

Authors: Sahil Kumar, Namrataben Patel, Honggang Wang, Youshan Zhang

Autonomous Adaptive Solver Selection for Chemistry Integration via Reinforcement Learning

Abstract (English): The computational cost of stiff chemical kinetics remains a dominant bottleneck in reacting-flow simulation, yet hybrid integration strategies are typically driven by hand-tuned heuristics or supervised predictors that make myopic decisions from instantaneous local state. We introduce a constrained reinforcement learning (RL) framework that autonomously selects between an implicit BDF integrator (CVODE) and a quasi-steady-state (QSS) solver during chemistry integration. Solver selection is cast as a Markov decision process. The agent learns trajectory-aware policies that account for how present solver choices influence downstream error accumulation, while minimizing computational cost under a user-prescribed accuracy tolerance enforced through a Lagrangian reward with online multiplier adaptation. Across sampled 0D homogeneous reactor conditions, the RL-adaptive policy achieves a mean speedup of approximately $3\times$, with speedups ranging from $1.11\times$ to $10.58\times$, while maintaining accurate ignition delays and species profiles for a 106-species \textit{n}-dodecane mechanism and adding approximately $1\%$ inference overhead. Without retraining, the 0D-trained policy transfers to 1D counterflow diffusion flames over strain rates $10$--$2000~\mathrm{s}^{-1}$, delivering consistent $\approx 2.2\times$ speedup relative to CVODE while preserving near-reference temperature accuracy and selecting CVODE at only $12$--$15\%$ of space-time points. Overall, the results demonstrate the potential of the proposed reinforcement learning framework to learn problem-specific integration strategies while respecting accuracy constraints, thereby opening a pathway toward adaptive, self-optimizing workflows for multiphysics systems with spatially heterogeneous stiffness.

摘要（中文）: 刚性化学动力学的计算成本始终是反应流模拟中的主要瓶颈，而传统混合积分策略通常依赖于手动调优的启发式方法或仅根据瞬时局部状态进行短视决策的监督预测器。本文提出了一种约束强化学习框架，能够在化学积分过程中自主选择隐式BDF积分器（CVODE）与准稳态求解器。该框架将求解器选择问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程：智能体学习考虑当前求解器选择对下游误差累积影响的轨迹感知策略，同时通过在线乘子自适应拉格朗日奖励机制，在用户指定的精度容差下最小化计算成本。在零维均质反应器的采样工况中，强化学习自适应策略实现了约$3\times$的平均加速比（加速范围$1.11\times$至$10.58\times$），并准确保持了106组分正十二烷机理的点火延迟与组分分布，仅增加约$1\%$的推理开销。未经重新训练，该零维训练策略可迁移至应变率$10$--$2000~\mathrm{s}^{-1}$的一维对冲扩散火焰，在保持接近参考温度精度的前提下，实现相对CVODE稳定约$2.2\times$的加速效果，且仅在$12$--$15\%$的时空点选择CVODE求解器。整体研究表明，所提出的强化学习框架能够学习满足精度约束的特定问题积分策略，为具有空间异构刚度的多物理场系统开辟了自适应、自优化工作流程的新路径。

TLDR: A reinforcement learning framework is developed to autonomously select between numerical solvers for stiff chemical kinetics, achieving speedups while maintaining accuracy, and demonstrating transfer from 0D to 1D reactor simulations.

简要说明: 本研究开发了一个强化学习框架，用于在化学动力学刚性数值积分中自主选择求解器，在保持精度的同时实现了计算加速，并在0D到1D反应器模拟中展示了方法的迁移能力。

Authors: Eloghosa Ikponmwoba, Opeoluwa Owoyele

Learning to Shuffle: Block Reshuffling and Reversal Schemes for Stochastic Optimization

Abstract (English): Shuffling strategies for stochastic gradient descent (SGD), including incremental gradient, shuffle-once, and random reshuffling, are supported by rigorous convergence analyses for arbitrary within-epoch permutations. In particular, random reshuffling is known to improve optimization constants relative to cyclic and shuffle-once schemes. However, existing theory offers limited guidance on how to design new data-ordering schemes that further improve optimization constants or stability beyond random reshuffling. In this paper, we design a pipeline using a large language model (LLM)-guided program evolution framework to discover an effective shuffling rule for without-replacement SGD. Abstracting from this instance, we identify two fundamental structural components: block reshuffling and paired reversal. We analyze these components separately and show that block reshuffling strictly reduces prefix-gradient variance constants within the unified shuffling framework, yielding provable improvements over random reshuffling under mild conditions. Separately, we show that paired reversal symmetrizes the epoch map and cancels the leading order-dependent second-order term, reducing order sensitivity from quadratic to cubic in the step size. Numerical experiments with the discovered algorithm validate the theory and demonstrate consistent gains over standard shuffling schemes across convex and nonconvex benchmarks.

摘要（中文）: 随机梯度下降（SGD）的洗牌策略（包括增量梯度法、单次洗牌和随机重洗牌）已通过任意周期内置换的严格收敛性分析得到理论支持。特别地，随机重洗牌相比循环洗牌和单次洗牌策略具有更好的优化常数。然而，现有理论对于如何设计能进一步提升优化常数或稳定性的新数据排序方案缺乏有效指导。本文设计了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）引导的程序进化框架的流程，以发现无放回SGD的高效洗牌规则。通过该实例的抽象，我们识别出两个基本结构组件：块重洗牌与配对反转。我们分别对这两个组件进行分析，证明在统一的洗牌框架下，块重洗牌能严格降低前缀梯度方差常数，从而在温和条件下实现相较于随机重洗牌的可证明改进。同时，我们证明配对反转能使周期映射对称化，并抵消主导的序相关二阶项，将阶数敏感性从步长的二次方降低至三次方。采用所发现算法进行的数值实验验证了理论结果，并在凸与非凸基准测试中均展现出相较于标准洗牌方案的稳定优势。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method to discover improved data shuffling schemes for SGD using an LLM-guided program evolution framework, analyzing structural components like block reshuffling and paired reversal for provable optimization improvements.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种利用LLM引导的程序进化框架来发现改进的SGD数据洗牌方案的方法，分析了块重排和配对反转等结构组件，以证明其优化改进效果。

Authors: Lam M. Nguyen, Dzung T. Phan, Jayant Kalagnanam

Hierarchical Discrete Flow Matching for Graph Generation

Abstract (English): Denoising-based models, including diffusion and flow matching, have led to substantial advances in graph generation. Despite this progress, such models remain constrained by two fundamental limitations: a computational cost that scales quadratically with the number of nodes and a large number of function evaluations required during generation. In this work, we introduce a novel hierarchical generative framework that reduces the number of node pairs that must be evaluated and adopts discrete flow matching to significantly decrease the number of denoising iterations. We empirically demonstrate that our approach more effectively captures graph distributions while substantially reducing generation time.

摘要（中文）: 摘要： 基于去噪的模型，包括扩散模型和流匹配模型，在图生成领域取得了显著进展。尽管取得了这些进展，此类模型仍受限于两个基本约束：计算成本随节点数量呈二次方增长，且生成过程中需要大量函数评估。本研究提出了一种新颖的分层生成框架，该框架通过减少必须评估的节点对数量，并采用离散流匹配方法显著降低去噪迭代次数。实验证明，我们的方法在更有效地捕捉图分布的同时，大幅减少了生成时间。

TLDR: A hierarchical generative framework for graph generation using discrete flow matching, aiming to reduce computational cost and number of denoising steps.

简要说明: 一种用于图生成的分层生成框架，采用离散流匹配，旨在降低计算成本和去噪步数。

Authors: Yoann Boget, Pablo Strasser, Alexandros Kalousis

Risk-Aware Batch Testing for Performance Regression Detection

Abstract (English): Performance regression testing is essential in large-scale continuous-integration (CI) systems, yet executing full performance suites for every commit is prohibitively expensive. Prior work on performance regression prediction and batch testing has shown independent benefits, but each faces practical limitations: predictive models are rarely integrated into CI decision-making, and conventional batching strategies ignore commit-level heterogeneity. We unify these strands by introducing a risk-aware framework that integrates machine-learned commit risk with adaptive batching. Using Mozilla Firefox as a case study, we construct a production-derived dataset of human-confirmed regressions aligned chronologically with Autoland, and fine-tune ModernBERT, CodeBERT, and LLaMA-3.1 variants to estimate commit-level performance regression risk, achieving up to 0.694 ROC-AUC with CodeBERT. The risk scores drive a family of risk-aware batching strategies, including Risk-Aged Priority Batching and Risk-Adaptive Stream Batching, evaluated through realistic CI simulations. Across thousands of historical Firefox commits, our best overall configuration, Risk-Aged Priority Batching with linear aggregation (RAPB-la), yields a Pareto improvement over Mozilla's production-inspired baseline. RAPB-la reduces total test executions by 32.4%, decreases mean feedback time by 3.8%, maintains mean time-to-culprit at approximately the baseline level, reduces maximum time-to-culprit by 26.2%, and corresponds to an estimated annual infrastructure cost savings of approximately $491K under our cost model. These results demonstrate that risk-aware batch testing can reduce CI resource consumption while improving diagnostic timeliness. To support reproducibility and future research, we release a complete replication package containing all datasets, fine-tuning pipelines, and implementations of our batching algorithms.

摘要（中文）: 性能回归测试在大规模持续集成（CI）系统中至关重要，但为每次提交执行完整的性能测试套件成本高昂且难以实现。先前关于性能回归预测和批量测试的研究虽已显示出各自优势，但均存在实际局限：预测模型很少被整合到CI决策流程中，而传统的批量策略则忽略了提交层面的异构性。 本研究通过引入一个风险感知框架将这两条路径相统一，该框架将机器学习得出的提交风险与自适应批量处理相结合。以Mozilla Firefox为案例，我们构建了一个基于实际生产数据、与Autoland时间线对齐且经人工确认的回归数据集，并对ModernBERT、CodeBERT及LLaMA-3.1的变体模型进行微调以评估提交级别的性能回归风险，其中CodeBERT模型的ROC-AUC最高达到0.694。这些风险评分驱动了一系列风险感知批量策略，包括风险时效优先级批处理和风险自适应流批处理，并通过真实的CI仿真进行评估。 在对数千个历史Firefox提交的实验中，我们最优的整体配置——采用线性聚合的风险时效优先级批处理（RAPB-la）——相比Mozilla基于生产环境的基线实现了帕累托改进。RAPB-la将总测试执行次数减少32.4%，平均反馈时间缩短3.8%，在保持平均归因时间与基线水平相当的同时，将最大归因时间降低26.2%，根据我们的成本模型估算，每年可节约约49.1万美元的基础设施成本。这些结果表明，风险感知批量测试能够在降低CI资源消耗的同时提升诊断时效性。为支持研究复现与未来工作，我们开源了完整的复现资源包，包含所有数据集、微调流水线及批量算法的实现代码。

TLDR: This paper introduces a risk-aware batch testing framework for software CI systems, using ML models to predict performance regression risk from code commits and then applying adaptive batching strategies to reduce testing resources while improving diagnostic speed.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种用于软件持续集成系统的风险感知批量测试框架，利用机器学习模型从代码提交中预测性能回归风险，并应用自适应批处理策略以减少测试资源并提高诊断速度。

Authors: Ali Sayedsalehi, Peter C. Rigby, Gregory Mierzwinski

Measuring the Representational Alignment of Neural Systems in Superposition

Abstract (English): Comparing the internal representations of neural networks is a central goal in both neuroscience and machine learning. Standard alignment metrics operate on raw neural activations, implicitly assuming that similar representations produce similar activity patterns. However, neural systems frequently operate in superposition, encoding more features than they have neurons via linear compression. We derive closed-form expressions showing that superposition systematically deflates Representational Similarity Analysis, Centered Kernel Alignment, and linear regression, causing networks with identical feature content to appear dissimilar. The root cause is that these metrics are dependent on cross-similarity between two systems' respective superposition matrices, which under assumption of random projection usually differ significantly, not on the latent features themselves: alignment scores conflate what a system represents with how it represents it. Under partial feature overlap, this confound can invert the expected ordering, making systems sharing fewer features appear more aligned than systems sharing more. Crucially, the apparent misalignment need not reflect a loss of information; compressed sensing guarantees that the original features remain recoverable from the lower-dimensional activity, provided they are sparse. We therefore argue that comparing neural systems in superposition requires extracting and aligning the underlying features rather than comparing the raw neural mixtures.

摘要（中文）: 比较神经网络的内部表征是神经科学和机器学习领域的核心目标。标准对齐指标基于原始神经活动进行分析，其隐含假设是相似表征会产生相似的活动模式。然而，神经系统常在叠加状态下运行，通过线性压缩编码比神经元数量更多的特征。我们推导出闭式表达式，证明叠加会系统性地降低表征相似性分析、中心核对齐和线性回归等方法的有效性，导致具有相同特征内容的网络显得不相似。根本原因在于这些指标依赖于两个系统各自叠加矩阵之间的交叉相似性——在随机投影假设下这些矩阵通常存在显著差异，而非基于潜在特征本身：对齐分数混淆了系统"表征什么"与"如何表征"这两个维度。在特征部分重叠的情况下，这种混淆甚至可能颠倒预期顺序，使共享特征较少的系统显得比共享特征更多的系统更相似。关键的是，这种表面对齐偏差并不必然反映信息损失；压缩感知理论保证，只要原始特征具有稀疏性，仍可从低维活动中恢复出原有特征。因此我们认为，比较叠加状态下的神经系统需要提取并对其底层特征进行对齐，而非直接比较原始的神经混合信号。

TLDR: This paper introduces a methodological critique of standard neural representation alignment metrics, showing they are confounded by the presence of superposition (compressed feature representation) in neural systems, and argues for comparing latent features instead of raw activity.

简要说明: 本文批判了标准的神经表征对齐度量方法，指出当神经系统中存在叠加（压缩特征表示）现象时，这些度量会产生混淆，并主张比较底层特征而非原始神经活动。

Authors: Sunny Liu, Habon Issa, André Longon, Liv Gorton, Meenakshi Khosla, David Klindt

Lead Zirconate Titanate Reservoir Computing for Classification of Written and Spoken Digits

Abstract (English): In this paper we extend our earlier work of (Rietman et al. 2022) presenting an application of physical Reservoir Computing (RC) to the classification of handwritten and spoken digits. We utilize an unpoled cube of Lead Zirconate Titanate (PZT) as a computational substrate to process these datasets. Our results demonstrate that the PZT reservoir achieves 89.0% accuracy on MNIST handwritten digits, representing a 2.4 percentage point improvement over logistic regression baselines applied to the same preprocessed data. However, for the AudioMNIST spoken digits dataset, the reservoir system (88.2% accuracy) performs equivalently to baseline methods (88.1% accuracy), suggesting that reservoir computing provides the greatest benefits for classification tasks of intermediate difficulty where linear methods underperform but the problem remains learnable. PZT is a well-known material already used in semiconductor applications, presenting a low-power computational substrate that can be integrated with digital algorithms. Our findings indicate that physical reservoirs excel when the task difficulty exceeds the capability of simple linear classifiers but remains within the computational capacity of the reservoir dynamics.

摘要（中文）: 本文在 (Rietman et al. 2022) 先前工作的基础上，进一步研究了物理储层计算在手写数字和语音数字分类任务中的应用。我们采用未经极化处理的锆钛酸铅立方体作为计算基底来处理这些数据集。实验结果表明，在MNIST手写数字数据集上，该PZT储层系统实现了89.0%的分类准确率，相较于相同预处理数据上的逻辑回归基线提升了2.4个百分点。然而，在AudioMNIST语音数字数据集上，储层系统（88.2%准确率）与基线方法（88.1%准确率）表现相当，这表明储层计算在中等难度分类任务中效益最为显著——这类任务中线性方法表现欠佳，但问题本身仍具备可学习性。PZT作为已在半导体领域广泛应用的材料，其低功耗特性使其可作为计算基底与数字算法实现集成。我们的研究结果表明，当任务难度超出简单线性分类器的能力范围，但仍在储层动力学计算能力之内时，物理储层系统将展现出显著优势。

TLDR: The paper applies physical reservoir computing using Lead Zirconate Titanate for classifying handwritten (MNIST) and spoken (AudioMNIST) digits, showing benefits for tasks of intermediate complexity.

简要说明: 该论文利用钛酸锆铅材料进行物理储备池计算，用于手写和语音数字识别，展示了其对中等复杂度任务的适用性。

Authors: Thomas Buckley, Leslie Schumm, Manor Askenazi, Edward Rietman

Lévy-Flow Models: Heavy-Tail-Aware Normalizing Flows for Financial Risk Management

Abstract (English): We introduce Lévy-Flows, a class of normalizing flow models that replace the standard Gaussian base distribution with Lévy process-based distributions, specifically Variance Gamma (VG) and Normal-Inverse Gaussian (NIG). These distributions naturally capture heavy-tailed behavior while preserving exact likelihood evaluation and efficient reparameterized sampling. We establish theoretical guarantees on tail behavior, showing that for regularly varying bases the tail index is preserved under asymptotically linear flow transformations, and that identity-tail Neural Spline Flow architectures preserve the base distribution's tail shape exactly outside the transformation region. Empirically, we evaluate on S&P 500 daily returns and additional assets, demonstrating substantial improvements in density estimation and risk calibration. VG-based flows reduce test negative log-likelihood by 69% relative to Gaussian flows and achieve exact 95% VaR calibration, while NIG-based flows provide the most accurate Expected Shortfall estimates. These results show that incorporating Lévy process structure into normalizing flows yields significant gains in modeling heavy-tailed data, with applications to financial risk management.

摘要（中文）: 本文介绍Lévy流，这是一类将标准高斯基分布替换为基于莱维过程的分布（具体为方差伽马VG与正态逆高斯NIG）的正则化流模型。这些分布能自然捕捉重尾特征，同时保持精确似然评估与高效重参数化采样能力。我们从理论上证明了尾部行为的性质：对于正则变化基分布，尾部指数在渐近线性流变换下保持不变；对于恒等尾神经样条流架构，在变换区域外能精确保持基分布的尾部形态。在实证研究中，我们基于标普500日收益率及其他资产数据评估模型，发现其在密度估计与风险校准方面有显著提升。基于VG的流模型相比高斯流将测试负对数似然降低69%，并实现精确的95%在险价值校准；基于NIG的流模型则能提供最准确的期望损失估计。这些结果表明，将莱维过程结构融入正则化流可显著提升对重尾数据的建模能力，在金融风险管理中具有应用价值。

TLDR: Proposes Lévy-Flow models, a new class of normalizing flows using heavy-tailed Lévy process base distributions (VG, NIG) for improved density estimation and risk calibration in financial data.

简要说明: 提出 Lévy-Flow 模型，一种使用重尾 Lévy 过程基础分布（VG, NIG）的新标准化流，用于金融数据中改进的密度估计和风险校准。

Authors: Rachid Drissi

Predicting Wave Reflection and Transmission in Heterogeneous Media via Fourier Operator-Based Transformer Modeling

Abstract (English): We develop a machine learning (ML) surrogate model to approximate solutions to Maxwell's equations in one dimension, focusing on scenarios involving a material interface that reflects and transmits electro-magnetic waves. Derived from high-fidelity Finite Volume (FV) simulations, our training data includes variations of the initial conditions, as well as variations in one material's speed of light, allowing for the model to learn a range of wave-material interaction behaviors. The ML model autoregressively learns both the physical and frequency embeddings in a vision transformer-based framework. By incorporating Fourier transforms in the latent space, the wave number spectra of the solutions aligns closely with the simulation data. Prediction errors exhibit an approximately linear growth over time with a sharp increase at the material interface. Test results show that the ML solution has adequate relative errors below $10\%$ in over $75$ time step rollouts, despite the presence of the discontinuity and unknown material properties.

摘要（中文）: 我们开发了一种机器学习（ML）代理模型，用于近似一维麦克斯韦方程组的解，重点关注涉及反射和透射电磁波的材料界面场景。基于高保真有限体积（FV）模拟生成的训练数据，包含了初始条件的变化以及材料中光速的变化，使模型能够学习一系列波与材料相互作用的动态行为。该机器学习模型在基于视觉Transformer的框架中自回归地学习物理嵌入和频率嵌入。通过在潜在空间中引入傅里叶变换，所得解的波数谱与模拟数据高度吻合。预测误差随时间呈近似线性增长，并在材料界面处出现急剧上升。测试结果表明，即使存在非连续性和未知材料特性，该机器学习模型在超过75个时间步的推演中仍能保持低于$10\%$的相对误差。

TLDR: This paper presents a Fourier operator-based transformer model for predicting wave reflection and transmission in heterogeneous media, trained on 1D Maxwell's equations simulations.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种基于傅里叶算子的Transformer模型，用于预测异质介质中的波反射与透射，该模型基于一维麦克斯韦方程组的模拟数据进行训练。

Authors: Zhe Bai, Hans Johansen

Efficient Software Vulnerability Detection Using Transformer-based Models

Abstract (English): Detecting software vulnerabilities is critical to ensuring the security and reliability of modern computer systems. Deep neural networks have shown promising results on vulnerability detection, but they lack the capability to capture global contextual information on vulnerable code. To address this limitation, we explore the application of transformers for C/C++ vulnerability detection. We use program slices that encapsulate key syntactic and semantic features of program code, such as API function calls, array usage, pointer manipulations, and arithmetic expressions. By leveraging transformers' capability to capture both local and global contextual information on vulnerable code, our work can identify vulnerabilities accurately. Combined with data balancing and hyperparameter fine-tuning, our work offers a robust and efficient approach to identifying vulnerable code with moderate resource usage and training time.

摘要（中文）: 软件漏洞检测对于保障现代计算机系统的安全性和可靠性至关重要。深度学习模型在漏洞检测方面已展现出良好效果，但其在捕获漏洞代码的全局上下文信息方面仍存在不足。为突破这一局限，本研究探索将Transformer模型应用于C/C++程序漏洞检测。我们采用包含程序代码关键语法与语义特征的程序切片作为输入数据，这些特征涵盖API函数调用、数组使用、指针操作及算术表达式等。通过发挥Transformer模型同时捕获漏洞代码局部与全局上下文信息的能力，我们的方法能够实现精准的漏洞识别。结合数据平衡策略与超参数优化技术，本研究在适度资源消耗与训练时间的条件下，提供了一种鲁棒且高效的漏洞代码检测方案。

TLDR: This paper proposes a method for software vulnerability detection in C/C++ code using transformers to capture global contextual information from program slices, aiming to improve accuracy and efficiency.

简要说明: 本文提出了一种使用Transformer模型检测C/C++代码漏洞的方法，通过程序切片捕获全局上下文信息，旨在提高准确性和效率。

Authors: Sameer Shaik, Zhen Huang, Daniela Stan Raicu, Jacob Furst

Speeding Up Mixed-Integer Programming Solvers with Sparse Learning for Branching

Abstract (English): Machine learning is increasingly used to improve decisions within branch-and-bound algorithms for mixed-integer programming. Many existing approaches rely on deep learning, which often requires very large training datasets and substantial computational resources for both training and deployment, typically with GPU parallelization. In this work, we take a different path by developing interpretable models that are simple but effective. We focus on approximating strong branching (SB) scores, a highly effective yet computationally expensive branching rule. Using sparse learning methods, we build models with fewer than 4% of the parameters of a state-of-the-art graph neural network (GNN) while achieving competitive accuracy. Relative to SCIP's built-in branching rules and the GNN-based model, our CPU-only models are faster than the default solver and the GPU-accelerated GNN. The models are simple to train and deploy, and they remain effective with small training sets, which makes them practical in low-resource settings. Extensive experiments across diverse problem classes demonstrate the efficiency of this approach.

摘要（中文）: 机器学习正越来越多地被应用于改进混合整数规划中分支定界算法的决策过程。现有方法大多依赖深度学习，这通常需要大量训练数据集和显著的计算资源，包括训练和部署阶段，并通常依赖于GPU并行化。本研究另辟蹊径，开发了简洁而高效的可解释模型。我们重点关注近似强分支（SB）分数的计算，这是一种高效但计算成本高昂的分支规则。通过稀疏学习方法，我们构建的模型参数少于当前最先进图神经网络（GNN）的4%，同时保持了相近的准确性。相较于SCIP内置的分支规则以及基于GNN的模型，我们仅使用CPU的模型在求解速度上不仅超越了默认求解器，也超越了GPU加速的GNN。这些模型训练和部署简单，在小型训练集上依然有效，使其在资源有限的环境中具有实用价值。通过跨多个问题类别的广泛实验，验证了该方法的效率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a sparse learning approach to approximate strong branching scores for mixed-integer programming solvers, achieving competitive accuracy with far fewer parameters and faster CPU-only inference than GPU-accelerated GNN baselines.

简要说明: 本文提出一种稀疏学习方法来近似混合整数规划求解器中的强分支评分，使用比图神经网络基线少得多的参数，并在仅CPU推理上实现了更快的速度，同时保持竞争力的准确性。
